sections.Effects:
* Causes Isaac's active item to charge when Isaac deals damage to enemies, rather than when he clears rooms.
** Damage dealt by [[charm]]ed/[[friendly]] enemies, active items, orbitals, and familiars (including blue flies and spiders) works as well.
* Charges are gained at a rate equal to the following formula: (40 + (20 × stage)). For example:
** In {{s|Basement}} I / {{s|Downpour}} I, it takes 60 damage to gain 1 charge.
** In {{s|Caves}} II / {{s|Mines}} II, it takes 120 damage.
** In {{s|Womb}} I / {{s|Corpse}} I, it takes 180 damage.
** In {{s|Sheol}} / {{s|Cathedral}}, it takes 240 damage.
** In {{s|Home}}, it takes 300 damage.
** [[Ascent]] floors use the values of their regular floors, meaning the amount of damage 4.5 Volt needs to gain charges steadily decreases during the Ascent sequence until reaching Home.
* Multiple charges cannot be gained at once.
* Overkill damage does not count towards a charge.
sections.Notes:
* Tainted characters with active items in their pill/card slot will not have those items charged by 4.5 Volt if their active item isn't already fully charged.
* {{C|Lilith}} can be particularly strong with 4.5 Volt during long fights such as {{e|Delirium}} and {{E|Hush}} if she still has the {{i|Box of Friends}}, as the damage she deals will allow her to repeatedly duplicate her familiars, dealing many times her typical damage during a single fight.
* {{C|Bethany}} will benefit from 4.5 Volt's effect for regular item charges while retaining her ability to use {{e|Soul Heart}}s as item charges. This applies to {{C|Tainted Bethany}} with her {{e|Red Heart}} charges as well.
* {{C|Tainted Jacob}} will gain charges from 4.5 Volt when Dark Esau damages enemies.
* While the two versions of {{C|Tainted Lazarus}} normally charge both their active items at the same time, 4.5 Volt will only charge when the state that holds it deals damage, and will prevent it from being charged when the other clears a room. This makes 4.5 Volt much worse while playing {{C|Tainted Lazarus}}.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Book of Shadows}}: With sufficient damage, the Book of Shadows can be kept active indefinitely.
** If combined with {{i|9 Volt}}, it becomes even easier to achieve invincibility.
* {{t|Door Stop}} / {{i|Mercurius}} / any means of room resetting (infinite bombs): Provides infinite charges by clearing some enemies then leaving the room, and repeating.
* {{i|Jumper Cables}}: Increases the rate of charge by appending its 15-kills-per-charge quality on top of 4.5 Volt's damage-based charge.
* {{t|Old Capacitor}}: Since the 4.5 Volt also makes it so that active items don't charge when clearing rooms, this trinket can be picked up with no downside.
* {{i|Unicorn Stump}} + {{i|Sacrificial Dagger}}: In most boss fights, charges are regenerated faster than invincibility wears off.
* {{i|White Pony}}: Since the beam trail from the charge attack deals so much damage, if used on a boss with a high amount of health, 4.5 Volt will often completely recharge the item after each use, allowing for repeated usage while the boss is still alive.
** For the same reason (so much damage against bosses that the active item is recharged from its use), {{I|Tammy's Head}} + {{I|Brimstone}} / {{C|Azazel}} / {{C|Tainted Azazel|r}} is also a strong synergy.
sections.Interactions:
* Does not charge items which gain charge over time by default. (e.g. {{i|Sharp Straw}}, {{I|The Candle}}, {{i|Butter Bean}} etc.)
** Items converted to charge-over-time by {{i|9 Volt}} are not affected and may gain charge in both ways.
* {{i|Alabaster Box}}: No effect. It still must be charged with Soul Hearts.
* {{t|Dim Bulb}}: Does not deactivate until the first charge bar is completely filled. A partial charge of the first bar will retain Dim Bulb's bonus.
* {{i|Schoolbag}}: The item in the second slot gets charged when the first one is full. Overcharges on the first item also jump to the second one.

sections.Effects:
* Upon taking damage, Isaac leaves a trail of [[red creep]] that damages enemies until he leaves the room.
** The creep deals 2 damage per tick (6 damage per second) to enemies that walk over it.
* {{dlcalt|+5|r=+1.5}} [[range]].

* Fully charges the current [[activated item]].
* Spawns 2-4 random [[battery]] pickups.
sections.Notes: * Battery Pack's quality is considered 1 for the purposes of {{I|Bag of Crafting}}.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|Alabaster Box}} / {{I|Eraser}} / {{I|Notched Axe}}: No effect.
* {{I|Mega Blast}}: Will only give 3 ticks of charge.

sections.Effects:
* Upon taking damage, spawns a white attack fly for the duration of the current [[room]]. The fly [[orbital familiar|orbits]] Isaac at medium range, similar to {{i|Forever alone}}, but with much higher speed.
** {{dlc|nr}} The fly deals 5 damage per tick (75 contact damage per second).
** {{dlc|r}} The fly deals 10 damage per tick (150 contact damage per second).
* {{transformation contribution|Beelzebub}}
sections.Interactions: * {{i|Best Bud}}: Multiple copies of Best Buds do not stack, only 1 fly can be spawned

sections.Effects:
* Upon use, chains down the nearest enemy, completely preventing them from acting for 5 seconds.
** This effect works on enemies that are invulnerable.
** If used again, it releases the enemy early.
** If multiple enemies are chained down at once, the enemy released early will be the one closest to Isaac even if Dark Esau is chained down too.
* While playing as {{C|Tainted Jacob}}:
** Anima Sola will always target Dark Esau if he is present.
** While Dark Esau is chained down, using Anima Sola again will release him and cause him to charge directly at Tainted Jacob, damaging and burning enemies in its path. This will not use up additional item charges.
** Dark Esau deals no contact damage to Jacob while chained down.
** If used in a room with no enemies, Anima Sola will immediately summon Dark Esau.
** If {{I|Birthright}} is obtained, the recharge time is lowered to 10 seconds and the chain duration is increased to 6.67 seconds.
sections.Notes:
* Enemies other than Dark Esau can also be released. This will not cause them to do anything special.
* If {{E|The Visage}}'s mask is chained down when it runs out of HP, it will outright die instead of becoming temporarily inactive, leaving only the heart to be fought. It is unknown if this is a bug.
* If {{E|Mom's Heart}} / {{E|It Lives!}} is chained down before it can spawn the {{E|Eye}}s at the beginning of the fight and is damaged enough to advance a phase by the time the chains break, the Eyes will not spawn.
* {{E|Delirium}} will stop shapeshifting when chained.
* If an enemy is in the middle of attacking with tears, their tears will still be fired after the effect ends. This happens even if the enemy has zero HP by the end of the ability.
* If used against {{E|The Beast}} during her chase attack, the destructible pillars will stop spawning until the effect ends.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a [[familiar]] that drops random [[pill]]s.
** Acid Baby drops a pill every {{dlcalt|3|r=7}} cleared [[room]]s. The first drop happens after {{dlcalt|2|r=6}} rooms.
* Upon using a pill, all enemies in the room will be [[poison]]ed for {{dlcalt|2|r=6}} ticks. {{dlc|r}} Enemies also take 10 additional damage.
* {{transformation contribution|dlc=r|Conjoined}}
sections.Notes: * {{dlc|r}} [[Familiar]]s that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Acid Baby having the lowest priority at {{dlcalt|6th|r+=8th}} and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.
sections.Synergies:
* {{dlc|nr}} {{i|BFFS!}}: The familiar drops pills in a repeating pattern of 2, 2 then 3 rooms. No damage increase on the poison effect.
** {{dlc|r}} Acid Baby drops a pill every 6 cleared rooms.
* [[Vurp!]]: If Isaac's last used pill is a Vurp! pill and Isaac finds another Vurp! pill afterward, he can infinitely generate Vurp! pills and repeatedly use them for mass poison damage.
sections.Interactions:
* {{T|Second Hand}}: No effect.
* {{i|Starter Deck}}: All pills dropped by Acid Baby will turn into cards.

sections.Effects: * On use, destroys all [[item]]s on item pedestals in the room and gives a unique red locust [[familiar]] for each item destroyed. * These locusts are permanent once created, up to a maximum of 64, after which creating more will replace older locusts. ** This limit is shared with [[Blue Fly|Blue Flies]] and [[Blue Spider|Spiders]]. * The locusts loosely orbit Isaac similarly to regular Blue Flies, charging in the direction Isaac is firing until hitting an enemy, wall, or certain obstacles like key blocks. * {{dlc|nr+}} Locusts deal Isaac's damage unless they are a special locust (2-3 times per hit). * {{dlc|r+}} The damage locusts deal is a multiplier of Isaac's damage and dependent on the quality of the item destroyed (2-3 times per hit): ** Quality 0: 0.5x damage. ** Quality 1: 0.75x damage. ** Quality 2: 1x damage. ** Quality 3: 1.5x damage. ** Quality 4: 2x damage. * The locusts may gain additional effects depending on the item destroyed.Unique locusts and the items that give them are defined in locusts.xml. Every passive item in the game is listed in the file, but only the items mentioned actually have their locusts implemented.
sections.Notes:
* {{c|Tainted Apollyon}} starts with this item in the consumable slot.
* {{dlc|r+}} Effects from some special locusts have the following consistent properties:
** Explosions are smaller and deal 20 damage.
** Electricity deals 25% of Isaac's damage per tick. It also does not deal damage to the enemy hit, but arcs to other nearby enemies, similar to {{i|120 Volt}}
** {{i|Crack the Sky}} beams deal 3x the locust's damage per tick.
** Small poison farts deal 5 damage and poison all enemies caught in it.
** Regular large farts don’t deal damage, but push away other nearby enemies.
** All creep function identically to that from {{i|Mysterious Liquid}} regardless of color.
** Locusts which destroy enemy projectiles will still trigger their effect and block shots while orbiting around Isaac.
** {{i|The Necronomicon}} effect deals 40 damage. This can be affected by the damage increase from {{t|A Missing Page}} or {{i|Missing Page 2}}.
** The {{i|Brimstone}} vortex and subsequent laser each deal 75% of Isaac's damage per tick.
** The {{i|Maw Of The Void}} effect deals Isaac's damage per tick.
** Locusts that destroy rocks can also open regular doors as well as {{r|Secret Room}} entrances.
* Using Abyss in the {{R|Shop}} or the {{R|Devil Room}} will not affect any items that have not been purchased.
* In rooms where there are multiple items to choose from, using Abyss will give only one locust for each item choice/set.
* If already at the maximum amount of locusts and presented with multiple non-choice item pedestals, using Abyss will only consume half of the pedestals.
* If Abyss is used while Isaac is holding an item above his head, it can still consume the item and grant a locust.
** This mechanic can be used to destroy bought items, unwanted blind items as well as familiars given by {{p|Soul of Lilith}}.
* Using Abyss to destroy items in {{r|Boss Rush}} or {{r|Challenge Room}} counts as taking an item and causes waves of bosses or enemies to start spawning.
* Locusts granted by Abyss are not taken away during the sequence to obtain the {{i|Knife Piece 2}}. {{E|Mother's Shadow|n}} cannot be harmed, but they can help destroy {{e|Fire Place}}s blocking the path faster.
* Locusts granted by Abyss are nearly irremovable, only {{i|Genesis}} can completely remove all locusts from a character. {{i|Sacrificial Altar}} and exceeding the familiar limit can remove some locusts. Reroll effects such as {{i|D4}}, {{c|Tainted Eden}} taking damage, {{i|Missing No.}}, etc. cannot remove locusts.
* {{dlc|r+}} Locusts that have a chance to explode can extinguish {{E|Blue Fire Place}}s.
* In [[Repentance Co-Op]] if a player dies, any of the special locusts they have will persist, following and attacking from their ghost.
* Using Abyss will destroy the pedestal and the ghostly item from {{i|Flip}} is not obtainable.
** Passive items can still be consumed while Isacc is holding them above his head without destroying the ghostly item, active items can only be consumed this way while having an empty hand with {{i|Schoolbag}}.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|BFFS!}} / {{i|Hive Mind}}: Increases the locusts' size and damage by 25%.
** These two items don't stack.
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns wisps in the middle ring in the form of black-glowing flies with extra HP that do not fire tears.}}
* {{t|Extension Cord}}: Electricity will flow between Isaac and the locusts.
* {{tf|Guppy}} : Damage dealt by locusts can spawn blue flies.
* {{i|Ipecac}}: Locusts gain a flat +2 damage.
* {{c|Tainted Eden}}: Abyss can be rerolled, but the locusts are permanent.
sections.Interactions:
* {{t|Baby-Bender}} / {{i|Box of Friends}}: Does not affect locusts.
* {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.
* {{i|Death Certificate}}: Only allows the consumption of one item per Death Certificate room and the consumed item is treated as if it was picked up causing all other items in the room to disappear and forcing Isaac to leave the area.
* {{i|Genesis}}: The locusts created by Abyss are removed without creating items to replace them.
* {{i|Sacrificial Altar}}: Locusts can be sacrificed for items.
* {{i|Void}}: If Void consumes Abyss, the latter will take priority and using Void to consume another item pedestal will generate a locust. Even consuming active items will generate a locust, and Void will not copy that active item's effect. This essentially causes Void to act identically to Abyss, {{dlc|nr+}} albeit requiring 2 more charges per use. Stats and effects of the active items absorbed prior to consuming Abyss are kept and will trigger everytime Void will be used.

sections.Effect: * Gives Isaac 25 {{E|Penny|text=Pennies}}.
sections.Notes:
* The item has a chance to drop when destroying [[urn]]s or killing {{E|Super Greed}}.
** {{dlc|nr}} Super Greed can drop this item even if Isaac has already encountered/possessed it. 
** Will not spawn from Urns once picked up.
* Rerolling this item with the  {{I|D4}},  {{I|D100}} , {{I|Missing No.}}, or a 1 or 6 pip {{R|Dice Room}} will not remove 25 coins.
* {{dlc+|r}} Its Quality value is treated as 1 for the purposes of {{I|Bag of Crafting}}.{{dlc-}}

sections.Effects:
* Isaac builds up rage every time he clears a room, which is indicated by the patch of skin that spreads around his face, as well as the four sections of the horn lighting up red one at a time.
* After four rooms, Isaac's head will start to flash red; upon entering a room with enemies, he will fire a large {{I|Brimstone}} laser for ~3.33 seconds.
** The laser deals Isaac's damage per tick (15x Isaac's damage per second).
sections.Notes:
* The counter for activation will go up during [[Greed Mode]], {{r|Challenge Room}}s, {{r|Boss Challenge Room}}s and {{r|Boss Rush}} waves, as well as the waves in the {{e|The Beast}} fight.
** If the Brimstone laser is ready, it will fire automatically after clearing a Greed Mode or Beast fight wave.
** {{dlc|nr+}} It will not fire in challenge rooms or boss rush.

sections.Effects:
* Fully charges the currently held active item upon 9 Volt's first pickup.
* If the current active item has a recharge time of more than 1 bar, then it will grant 1 bar of charge whenever the item is activated.
* If the current active item has a recharge time of 1 bar, then it will change the item to have a timed recharge of 15 seconds. The recharging of the item only triggers so long as there are enemies present in the room in any fashion. Empty rooms do not cause recharging to start.
* {{dlc|a+}} If the current activated item already has a timed recharge, 9 Volt makes it start at half charge when used, effectively halving the time to recharge and allowing quicker reuse.
sections.Notes: * Enemies generated through a {{e|Slot Machine}}, {{e|Shell Game}}, {{e|Hell Game}}, {{e|Rotten Beggar}} or breaking Urns/Skulls will restart the charging process, even though a cleared room still counts as cleared if enemies are spawned in it.
sections.Synergies:
* '''2-bar items''': Fills the entire gauge in a single room, effectively granting the opportunity for the item to be used every room.
* {{dlc|a+}} '''3-bar items''': Quadruple rooms and L-shaped rooms give 2 bars after clearing them, allowing one free use of the item in those rooms if the gauge is full upon entering them. It can also be used at the beginning of a Boss Challenge Room to get the full charges back after beating both bosses.
** {{t|AAA Battery|a+}} + 3-bar items: Same as the 2-bar item synergy without AAA Battery.
* {{dlc|a+}} '''4-bar items''': In a Challenge Room, if the item is used during the first wave, it will get all its charges back at the end.
** {{t|AAA Battery|a+}} + 4-bar items: Same as the 3-bar item synergy without AAA Battery.
* {{i|Jacob's Ladder}}: Increases arcing distance of sparks.
* {{C|Keeper|a}}: The {{I|Wooden Nickel|n}} and the 9 Volt allow him to gain health (and money) forever, as long as there is an enemy in the room.
** An enemy spawned in a cleared room will also cause recharging to start.
* {{I|Telekinesis|r}}: The item can be reactivated the moment the previous charge stops, making it always active.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|9 Volt}}: No further decrease in charges.
* {{I|Alabaster Box}}: No effect.
* {{T|Dim Bulb}}: Prevents Dim Bulb from working, as minimum charge becomes 1 instead of 0.
* {{I|Eraser}}: No effect.
* {{I|Everything Jar}} / {{I|Larynx}}: The first bar gains an automatic recharge, but the further bars will not be affected.
* {{i|Sharp Plug}}:
** {{dlc|nr}} Renders the Sharp Plug unusable on 2+ charge items. Sharp Plug can only be used if the item is at 0 charges, but 9 Volt instantly gives +1 charge to the item upon activation.
** {{dlc|r}} Lowers the cost of using Sharp Plug by half a heart on 2+ charge items.
* {{i|The Battery}}: If the effect of 9 Volt would result in the active item having at least 1 full level of charge, 9 Volt has no effect. Otherwise, it functions as usual.

sections.Effect:
* Grants one full Red [[Heart container]].
* {{Dlc|r}} Heals 1 additional {{e|Red Heart}}.
sections.Synergies: * {{i|Binge Eater}}: When Isaac picks up A Snack it now grants: a permanent +0.2 [[Shot Speed]], +1.0 [[Luck]], -0.03 [[Speed]] and a temporary +3.6 [[Damage]] (which diminishes to 0 in 30 seconds).

sections.Effects:
* Adds a chance to shoot [[slow]]ing tears, reducing the speed of enemy movement and any projectiles they fire.
* Isaac leaves a trail of [[slow]]ing [[Black creep]].
sections.Notes:
* The chance to fire slowing tears depends on the [[luck]] stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: <math>\frac1 { 10 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} * 0.5  \right \rfloor}</math>
** At base luck (0), the chance is 10%, maxing out at 100% at 18 luck.
sections.Interactions: * {{t|Second Hand|a+nr}}: The creep generated by Ball of Tar will disable the slowing effect.

sections.Effect:
* Spawns 6 {{e|Troll Bomb}}s, generally near the center of the [[room]].
* {{transformation contribution|Bookworm}}
sections.Notes:
* This item can drop from killing {{e|Pride}}. {{dlc|nr}} Pride can drop this item even if Isaac has already encountered/possessed it. 
* Although visually unchanged, all passive {{e|Bomb}} effect items affect the spawned Troll Bombs unless otherwise noted.
* The Troll Bombs created by Anarchist Cookbook spawn in one at a time; if Isaac leaves the [[room]] soon after using it, not all 6 Troll Bombs will spawn.
* Using this item without any blast protection is not always recommended as it is very easy to be caught in the blast.
sections.Synergies:
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns wisps in the middle ring, looking like bombs. The wisps spawn {{e|Troll Bomb}}s when destroyed. These troll bombs will use Isaac's bomb synergies.}}
* {{t|Blasting Cap}}: Spawned Troll Bombs can drop extra bomb pickups.
* {{I|Car Battery}} : Spawns '''13''' troll bombs.
* {{I|Remote Detonator}}: The Troll Bombs generated will not explode until Remote Detonator is activated, unlike regular Troll Bombs.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|Bomber Boy}}: Not recommended. The cross pattern explosion makes it very hard to avoid taking damage.
* {{i|Mr. Mega}}: No effect.
* {{I|Pyromaniac}}: Spawned bombs can be used for mass healing.
* {{T|Safety Scissors}}: Spawned troll bombs become bomb pickups.
* {{i|Scatter Bombs|a+}}: Not recommended. Each Troll Bomb will spawn several smaller bombs upon exploding, making it very hard to avoid taking damage.
** {{dlc|r}} No visual change can be seen with the Troll Bombs, but the smaller bombs have the sprite of the smaller normal bombs.

sections.Effects: * Upon use, pressing an attack direction will cause a swipe attack with high knockback and 3 damage. ** The swipe scales in size with Isaac's size. ** The swipe will appear further from Isaac the higher his [[range]] is. ** The swipe can be used to open {{e|Spiked Chest}}s and {{e|Mimic Chest}}s without taking damage. ** The swipe can be used to block bullets. ** The swipe can be aimed at any direction. * Swiping a [[pickup]] on the floor will add it to the bag. The bag's contents cannot be dropped. Up to 8 pickups can be stored. ** Double pickups like {{e|Double Heart}}s will add two copies to the bag. {{E|Blended Heart}}s will add one red heart and one soul heart. ** {{e|Sticky Nickel}}s can't be picked up unless unstuck. ** {{e|Chest}}s and {{e|Grab Bag|text=Sacks}} can't be picked up, but can be opened with a swipe even behind obstacles. ** If Isaac has enough money to buy a pickup from a {{R|Shop}}, using Bag of Crafting on that pickup will purchase it and automatically add it to the bag. * Once 8 pickups are held in the bag, the bag can be used once more to spawn an item pedestal. ** If a recipe would result in an item that hasn't yet been unlocked, a random item will be crafted instead. * There are a total of 29 different types of consumables that can be placed in the bag. The ordering does not matter for the outcome. '''As {{c|Tainted Cain}}:''' * If pickups are collected after the max of 8 is reached, the contents shift left and up, deleting the top left slot and adding at the bottom right. Tapping the switch key cycles the bag's contents left and up in a loop, making it possible to choose which pickup to overwrite. * Once 8 pickups are held in the bag, the bag will show a preview what would be crafted. Holding down the Use Pill/Card button will craft the item and place it directly in Tainted Cain's inventory. ** Crafting an activated item while already holding one will turn the old one into pickups like collecting it would. ** {{cu|Blind}} hides the crafting preview. '''Item Tags:''' The Bag of Crafting respects item tags, and which items are available during the current run. This includes the following: * As {{c|The Lost}}, {{i|Birthright}} prevents items with the [[Item Tags nolostbr|nolostbr item tag]] from appearing when using the Bag of Crafting. * As {{c|Tainted Lost}}, items without the [[Item Tags offensive|offensive item tag]] will not appear. * As {{c|Keeper}}, items with the [[Item Tags nokeeper|nokeeper item tag]] will not appear. * In {{mode|greed|greedier}}[[Greed Mode|Greed Mode or Greedier Mode]], items with the [[Item Tags nogreed|nogreed item tag]] will not appear. * In [[Daily Challenge]]s, items with the [[Item Tags nodaily|nodaily item tag]] will not appear. * In [[Challenges|Challenge]], items with the [[Item Tags nochallenge|nochallenge item tag]] will not appear. * If {{t|NO!}} is held, active items will be skipped. * If {{i|Sacred Orb}} is held, items with Quality 0 or 1 will be skipped. If a recipe that can only result in a quality 0-1 item is put in the bag, it will replace the item with {{i|Breakfast}} instead.
sections.Interactions:
* {{t|Butter!}}: Bag of Crafting is dropped before pickups can be collected or items crafted.
* {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: Swiping the bag at the Ludovico tear will bat it in the direction of the knockback.
* {{i|Sacred Orb}}: Sacred Orb prevents crafting quality 1 and 0 items, typically resulting in them being replaced by quality 2 items. If a recipe that can only result in a quality 0-1 item is put in the bag, it will replace the item with Breakfast instead.
* {{c|Tainted Eden}}: If the Tainted Eden loses Bag of Crafting from a reroll while it contains pickups, then rerolls back into it at a later point, it will still contain the pickups.
* {{p|Wild Card}}: Holding up Bag of Crafting counts as an active item use for Wild Card, and can be replicated.
* {{p|? Card}}: Does NOT give a free duplicate of whatever the full bag would create.

sections.Effects:
* Quadruples [[fire rate]].
* ×0.3 [[damage]] multiplier.
* -0.16 tear size.
* Each tear gains the effects of either {{T|Flat Worm}}, {{T|Pulse Worm}}, {{T|Wiggle Worm}}, {{T|Hook Worm}}, {{T|Ring Worm}}, {{T|Whip Worm}}, {{T|Lazy Worm}}, {{T|Tape Worm}}, {{T|Ouroboros Worm}}, {{T|Brain Worm}}, {{I|Rubber Cement}}, {{I|My Reflection}} or {{I|Tiny Planet}} at random.
** Some tears may have multiple effects at once.
** These inherit the movement, [[shot speed]], [[range]], and [[Tear Effects#Spectral|spectral]] effects, but not changes to [[tears]] or [[damage]].
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Brimstone}} / {{C|Azazel}} / {{C|Tainted Azazel}}: The beam will fire continuously as long as the fire button is held and can be aimed in any direction. It shuffles through the worm effects rapidly.
* {{i|Chocolate Milk}} / {{i|Cursed Eye}} / {{i|Monstro's Lung}} / {{i|Tech X}}: Fires automatically upon reaching full charge.
** Tech X overrides the worm trinket effects.
* {{i|Tractor Beam}}: All tears now travel along the beam, improving overall accuracy and DPS.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Soy Milk}}: Overridden by Almond Milk (no additional effect on tears or damage).
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: The tear will rapidly teleport in a small area around it, making it difficult to aim.

sections.Effects: * Spawns an [[orbital familiar]] with a large orbital radius. Tears that pass through the prism split into four multi-colored tears.
sections.Notes: * It will also quadruple [[shooting familiar]] tears.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Akeldama}}: Turns the chain of tears into four multi-colored chains.
* {{i|Anti-Gravity}}: Tears that are floating in the air when they hit the prism will quadruple but will not move. Tears that begin moving before they hit the prism will travel outwards normally.
** By releasing the built up tears as the prism passes by, significantly more tears can be affected than normal.
** With {{i|Flat Stone}}, split suspended tears will bounce in place until their duration ends.
* {{T|Duct Tape}}: By keeping the prism in the same spot, damage output can be significantly increased in that direction.
** Picking up Angelic Prism while holding '''Duct Tape''' will cause it to spawn directly on top of Isaac and stay there.
** '''Duct Tape''' + {{i|Incubus}}: By stacking the incubus familiar on top of the prism before picking up Duct Tape, the shots will be affected no matter what direction Isaac is firing.
* {{i|Immaculate Heart}}: The extra spectral tears share the same orbit as Angelic Prism, making them very easy to split.
* {{i|Jacob's Ladder}}: All of the split tears will be electrified. Also, electric arcs that pass through the prism will be split.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: While the tear is in contact with the prism, it will fire 4 additional tears in cardinal directions at Isaac's tear rate.
* {{I|Saturnus}}: Since the prism and the orbiting tears have the exact same orbital radius, orbiting tears will immediately be split into 28 multi-colored tears upon entering a room.
* {{i|Tractor Beam}}: Tears will split but continue stacked on top of each other along the tractor beam, essentially quadrupling the shot's damage.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Bot Fly}}: Its tears are split in four.
* {{i|BFFS!}}: Only a visual size change, with no difference in the hitbox and thus usefulness of the Prism.
* {{i|Brimstone}} / {{i|Revelation}} / {{i|Salvation}} / {{I|Shoop da Whoop!}} / {{I|Tech.5}} / {{i|Technology}} / {{i|Technology 2}}: The laser is split in four.
* {{I|C Section}}: Fetuses split in four.
* {{p|Chaos Card}}: Four cards are shot out if Chaos Card hits the prism.
* {{Dlc|nr}} {{i|Dr. Fetus}}: Split bombs can also damage charmed enemies summoned by Friendly Ball, Poke Go, and Delirious.
** {{Dlc|nr}} '''Dr. Fetus''' + {{i|Remote Detonator}}: Bombs split through the prism cannot be remotely detonated.
* {{i|Epic Fetus}}: No effect.
* {{i|Eraser}}: The Eraser splits, like normal tears.
* {{T|Forgotten Lullaby}}: Forgotten Lullaby does not affect tears split by Angelic Prism.
* {{Dlc|nr}} {{i|Ipecac}}: Split explosions can also damage charmed enemies summoned by Friendly Ball, Poke Go, and Delirious.
* {{Dlc|nr}} {{i|Mom's Knife}}: When the knife touches the prism, split knives are launched that do not return to Isaac. The extra knives deal only 1x damage, unlike normal thrown knives.
** {{Dlc|r}} The duplicated knives deal full damage and return to Isaac normally.
* {{i|My Reflection}}: Tears made by the prism will not quadruple once more if they hit the prism again.
* {{i|Proptosis}}: Tears that hit the prism will continue to shrink as normal even after they split until they disappear.
* {{I|Rocket in a Jar}}: Rockets do not split, unless its paired with Dr. Fetus, and even then only normal attacks are affected.
* {{i|Rubber Cement}}: Tears will split and will bounce if they hit a wall. However, if split tears hit the prism, they will not split again.
* {{I|Sharp Key}}: Key projectiles can split through the prism.
* {{i|Tech X}}: Laser rings are split into four.
* {{i|Tiny Planet}}: Tears that hit the prism will quadruple, but all four tears will overlap and follow the same orbit.
* {{I|Urn of Souls}}: The flames split into four multicolored flames.

sections.Effects:
* Gives Isaac a flat [[damage]] up based on how many empty [[Red Heart container]]s he has.
** {{dlc|nr}} The damage up given is 0.2 for each empty Red Heart container Isaac has.
*** {{dlc|r}} The damage up given is ((2 × MissingHearts) ^ 1.6) × 0.1, where MissingHearts is the number of full red hearts of health missing. The amount of damage gained this way is exponential, so each heart lost will provide a bigger bonus than the last.
** Damage ups are only applied for every fully empty heart container.
* {{transformation contribution|Spun}}
sections.Notes:
* This item has no effect on characters that can't have any Red Heart containers, unless {{E|Bone Heart}}s are collected. If a Bone Heart is gone, so does the Adrenaline damage. This means that Adrenaline is only truly useless on {{C|The Lost}}.
* This item affects both {{C|Keeper}} and {{C|Tainted Keeper}}; empty Coin Hearts increase damage.
* As {{C|The Forgotten}}, empty Bone Hearts increase damage, but if the Bone Hearts are broken, the damage buff is lost.
* {{dlc+|r}} The maximum damage bonus from Adrenaline is 14.05 normally, 16.15 with Bone Hearts, and 30.9 for Magdalene with {{i|Birthright}}.{{dlc-}}
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Birthright}} + {{C|Magdalene}}: Allows Magdalene to gain more damage than the other characters can because of her 6 additional heart containers.
* {{I|Blood Oath}}: Activates the damage up effect of Adrenaline for the resulting empty heart containers at the start of each floor.
* {{I|Empty Heart}}: Activates the damage up effect of Adrenaline if an empty heart container is granted at the beginning of each floor.
* {{I|Rock Bottom}}: Allows Isaac to keep the damage up after refilling hearts.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a fly [[familiar]] that orbits around a random enemy and deals 2 damage per tick/30 damage per second to enemies it comes in contact with.
** It will occasionally make a lunge towards the enemy it is orbiting, allowing brief contact even with smaller enemies.
** If the enemy it is orbiting dies, it starts orbiting a different enemy.
** If there are no enemies, it orbits Isaac.
* {{transformation contribution|Beelzebub}}
sections.Notes:
* Angry Fly will orbit around invincible enemies such as {{e|Stone Grimace}}s without dealing damage.
* Due to its movement pattern, its actual damage dealt per second is erratic against most enemies and groups of them.
* {{dlc|r}} As {{c|Tainted Jacob}}, Angry Fly will orbit around {{e|Dark Esau|n}}.

sections.Effects:
* +1.5 [[damage]].
* +0.2 [[speed]]
** {{dlc|nr}} Also affects maximum speed (may never exceed 2.0).
* {{dlc|nr}} Removes all current Red [[Heart container]]s and grants 6 {{E|Black Heart}}s.
* {{dlc|r}} Converts all current Red [[Heart container]]s into {{e|Black Heart}}s, and adds 2 additional Black Hearts.
* {{dlc|a+}} Empties all {{E|Bone Heart|n}}s without removing them.
* Adds a chance to shoot [[fear]] tears.
* {{transformation contribution|Leviathan}}
sections.Notes:
* Fear tear effect depends on the [[luck]] stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: <math>\frac{15}{100 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \right \rfloor}</math>
** At base Luck (0), the chance is 15%, maxing out at 100% at 85 Luck.
** {{i|Dark Matter}} is significantly better at inflicting fear than Abaddon.
* Does not remove {{E|Soul Heart}}s or {{E|Eternal Heart}}s.
* {{dlc|nr}} As it removes all Red Heart Containers, other Deals with the Devil can be taken for "free" as long as Abaddon is taken last while still having at least 1 Container.
* Can always be taken as a deal. Even if Isaac only has one or two Soul Hearts, the Black Hearts will be granted after taking the item.
* {{dlc|r}} Emptied {{E|Bone Heart|n}}s will not be converted to {{E|Black Heart}}s.
sections.Synergies: * {{t|Black Feather}}: Grants a damage boost.

sections.Effects:
* +0.7 [[tears]] up.
* Grants an {{e|Eternal Heart}}.
* Allows {{r|Angel Room}}s to spawn even after Isaac has taken a [[Devil Room|Deal with the Devil]].
* Mitigates the penalties to [[Devil Room#Conditions to Make Devil Rooms Appear|the chance for a deal to appear]] from taking red heart damage.
** Damage during the stage replaces the 99% no-damage bonus with 40% instead of removing it.
** Damage against the boss replaces the 35% no-damage bonus with 15% instead of removing it.
** In practice, this results in a -24% chance instead of -64% for taking damage during the stage, and -44% instead of -99% for taking damage against the boss.
sections.Synergies: * {{i|Goat Head}}: Keeps the chance split between Angel and Devil Rooms, rather than guaranteeing a Devil Room.

sections.Effect:
* {{dlc|nr}} When Isaac takes damage, a black ring briefly appears around him, dealing tear damage at a rapid rate to everything touching it.
** When an enemy is killed with the black ring, there is a 15% chance for it to drop a {{E|Black Heart}}.
** Black Hearts will drop as soon as the enemy is killed. (In other words, the heart will drop at the beginning of the death animation rather than at the end of the death animation.)
* {{dlc|r}} When Isaac kills an enemy, gives a chance for a black ring to appear around where it once was, dealing Isaac's tear damage at a rapid rate to everything touching it. The chance scales with Isaac's [[luck]]. The base chance is 25%, with an additional 2.5% chance per point of luck, capping out at 100% at 30 luck.
sections.Notes:
* The ring created by Athame is identical to the ring created by {{i|Maw Of The Void}}.
* Athame is especially effective against bosses that summon many monsters, such as {{E|Envy}}, {{E|Super Envy}}, and {{E|Brownie}}.
** {{dlc|nr}} Each piece of Envy/Brownie Corn grants a 15% chance for a Black Heart.
* {{dlc|r}} Black rings can also be generated by destroyed {{e|Shopkeeper}}s.
sections.Synergies:
* {{dlc+|r}} {{i|Contagion}}/{{i|Toxic Shock}}: Can allow for substantial chains of enemy kills and rapid room clearing.{{dlc-}}
* [[Homing tears]]: The black ring becomes homing, curving around to hit enemies.
* {{i|Hemoptysis}}: Enemies hit by the sneeze will gain a curse that increases the damage the black ring deals to 2x and +3 flat damage. Enemies who die to the black ring under the curse will damage and spread the curse to nearby enemies.
* {{i|Ipecac}}: Massively increases damage and poisons enemies. {{dlc|r}} Causes the ring to explode upon contact with walls or obstacles. The explosions can damage Isaac.
* {{dlc|na+}} {{i|Proptosis}}: The ring is much larger and deals 1.5x damage.
* {{dlc|a+nr}} {{i|Proptosis}}: The ring is much larger but deals normal damage.
* {{t|Wiggle Worm}}: The ring has wavy edges.
sections.Interactions:
* {{dlc|r}}[[Cards and Runes|Ace Cards]]: Enemies that are turned into [[pickup]]s can't create black rings.
* {{i|E. Coli|r}}/{{i|Flush!}}: Enemies that are turned into poop can't create black rings.
* {{i|Holy Mantle|nr}}: Getting hit when the Holy Mantle shield is active prevents Athame from triggering its effect.
* {{dlc|na+}} {{i|A Lump of Coal}}: The ring damage is halved.
* {{dlc|r}} {{I|Proptosis}}: No effect.

sections.Effects:
* +0.25 [[speed]].
** {{dlc|nr}} Also affects maximum speed (may never exceed 2.0).
* Running into enemies while at a high speed will deal {{dlcalt|18|r=25}} damage.
** At least 0.85 Speed is required to be able to move quickly enough.
*** {{dlc|r}} Moving at this speed also prevents contact damage.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Serpent's Kiss|r}}: Allows Isaac to poison enemies without needing to take a hit, allowing for an impressive amount of {{E|Black Heart}}s to be collected.
* {{c|Tainted Forgotten|r}}: Throwing the skeleton will deal 80 damage on contact.
* {{c|Tainted Magdalene|r}}'s hugs stack with Aries, dealing insane combined contact damage to enemies. This also makes T. Magdalene invulnerable at high speeds, whilst still generating a decent amount of red hearts.
sections.Interactions: * {{i|Isaac's Heart|r}}: The invulnerability does not extend to the heart.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a familiar that flies around the room like a {{E|Boom Fly}} and explodes on contact with an enemy.
** Deals {{dlcalt|60|r=100}} damage to all enemies within its blast radius and 10 damage to the enemy it touched.
* It will respawn 10 seconds after exploding, or upon entering a different room.
* {{transformation contribution|Beelzebub}}
sections.Notes:
* Most obtained bomb modifiers are applied to BBF as well.
* The blast can damage Isaac as a normal bomb would.
* For the first few moments after entering a room, the familiar will do contact damage instead of exploding. This means the familiar will not blow up in Isaac's face if there is an enemy right next to the familiar's starting point. However, it may kill enemies that explode on death.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|BFFS!}} / {{I|Hive Mind}}: Doubles the contact damage to 20 and increases explosion damage by 25.
** {{dlc|r}} Contact damage becomes 20 and explosion damage increases to 125.
* {{i|Mr. Mega}}: The explosion damage increases by 50 points.

sections.Effect: * Tears gain a flat damage bonus of about +0.5-0.6 per tile of distance traveled, unaffected by all multipliers. There is no upper limit to the bonus.
sections.Notes:
* This item can be found as a drop from killing {{E|Krampus}} {{dlc|a+|or a possible payout of {{I|Mystery Gift}}}}.
** Both Krampus and Mystery Gift can drop this item, even if Isaac has already encountered/possessed it. 
* The item has somewhat of an opposite effect of the item {{i|Proptosis}}, which makes Isaac deal more damage at close range. Proptosis is based on a shrinking multiplier instead of an increasing flat bonus, however.
* Multiple instances of A Lump of Coal grants no additional effect.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Godhead|n}}:
** {{dlc|nr}} Tears' auras will increase in size and damage the farther they travel.
** {{dlc|r}} Tears' auras will increase in size the farther they travel. The damage of the auras is unaffected.
* {{t|Hook Worm}}: The movement pattern increases Coal's damage at the same effective distance.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: Increases the tear's damage and size the farther the tear is from Isaac.
* {{i|My Reflection}}: Hitting enemies with tears that initially missed will grant possibly considerable extra damage.
* {{i|Pop!}}: Tears will increase their damage and size as they travel, and they are not limited by range.
* {{i|Soy Milk}}: Coal's flat damage increase is not affected by Soy Milk's multiplier, so tears gain the full benefit from Coal.
* {{i|Tiny Planet}}: The movement pattern allows much longer airtime and reasonably easy way to hit enemies with the powered-up tears.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Anti-Gravity}}: Despite the tears visually growing while they hover, they will still only deal bonus damage based strictly on how far they travel. If the enemy hits the tears by running into them, Coal will add no damage.
** {{dlc|a+}} Tears no longer grow while hovering.
* {{i|Athame}}:
** {{dlc|na+}} Damage of the Athame ring is halved.
** {{dlc|a+}} The ring deals normal damage.
* {{i|Brimstone}}:
** {{dlc|na}} +2 flat damage.
** {{dlc|a}} Beam will gradually increase in size and damage the farther it travels, on a multiplier that is roughly +20% per tile of distance.
** '''Brimstone''' + {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: Makes the Brimstone circle widen and deal damage based on how far away it is from your character. {{dlc|nr}} While Isaac is in the center of the circle, the damage is ''reduced'' to about 50% (unlike normal Coal effects).
* {{I|C Section}}: Just as expected, fetuses deal more damage a tick the longer they travel.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}}: No benefit though the bombs appear darker.
* {{i|Epic Fetus}}: No benefit.
* {{i|Lachryphagy}}: Tears will grow until they burst, though their actual damage bonus is only based on distance traveled. Burst tears will also grow as they travel.
* {{i|A Lump of Coal}}: No benefit from an additional Lump.
* {{i|Maw Of The Void}}:
** {{dlc|na+}} Damage of the Maw ring is halved.
** {{dlc|a+}} The ring deals normal damage.
* {{i|Mom's Knife}}: No benefit. The Knife becomes a very dark brown.
* {{i|Proptosis}}:
** {{dlc|nr}} The damage of the tears decreases at about the same rate it increases, resulting in them dealing approximately the same damage at any range.
** {{dlc|r}}: Slightly increases the range and damage of Proptosis tears.
* {{t|Ring Worm}} / {{t|Ouroboros Worm}}: The peculiar movement patterns result in overall less damage from the same effective distance.
* {{i|Technology}} / {{i|Technology 2}}:
** {{dlc|na}} No benefit.
** {{dlc|a}} Damage increases the further away the enemy is, on a multiplier that is roughly +20% per tile of distance.
* {{i|Tech X}}: The laser ring will grow as the ring distances itself from the player, but will shrink as the player approaches it. Damage increases the further away the enemy is.
** {{dlc|r}} The damage increase per tile is significantly lower.
* {{i|Trisagion}}: The damage of the blasts is increased by a negligible amount and will be increased further if Isaac has an item that extends the length of the beams such as {{i|My Reflection}}.
** {{dlc|r}} The damage of the blasts will not be increased unless Isaac has an item that extends the length of the beams such as {{i|My Reflection}}.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a [[familiar]] that mirrors Isaac's movements and shoots tears that deal 3.5 damage.
** Abel shoots once per {{dlcalt|second|r=half-second}}.
** {{dlc|na}} Abel shoots tears in the opposite direction of Isaac.
** {{dlc|a}} Abel shoots tears towards Isaac regardless of which direction Isaac is shooting.
* {{dlc+|r}} {{transformation contribution|Conjoined}}{{dlc-}}
sections.Notes:
* Although it is difficult to hit enemies with Abel, he can be useful in certain situations. {{E|Dople}}s and {{E|Evil Twin}}s can be easily taken care of without risk of damage using Abel. Abel can also assist in killing slow or stationary [[monster]]s that happen to be around the center of the [[room]].
* In symmetrical room layouts Abel can be used to clear away destructible [[obstacle]]s such as fire places and poops.
sections.Synergies: * {{C|Cain}} / {{C|Tainted Cain}}: Abel's tears are red and deal 7.5 damage.

sections.Effects:
* Passively gives [[flight]] whether it has charges or not.
* If Isaac's [[speed]] is less than 1.5, passively increases his speed to 1.5.
* Upon use, Isaac charges in the direction the pony is facing, giving invincibility during the charge and dealing contact damage to enemies.
** {{dlc|nr}} The dash deals 40 flat contact damage to enemies.
** Invincibility granted by dashing will not prevent Isaac from being damaged by {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}s, {{e|Devil Beggar}}s, and similar self-damage active items (when holding {{I|Schoolbag}}).
** {{dlc|r}} The dash deals 4 times Isaac's damage, plus a flat 28 damage.
** {{dlc|r}} Isaac can dash through doors, which means that damage from {{r|Curse Room}} doors can be avoided.
*** The dash persists through rooms, and lasts up to the length of 2 normal rooms unless Isaac collides with a closed door/wall.
**** This allows Isaac to enter and exit curse rooms for free, provided the dash is activated to give invincibility before charging through the exit.
**** Caution should be taken when dashing into rooms that have not been explored, as some room layouts have {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}s or {{e|Devil Beggar}}s, which Isaac may dash into and get damaged.
***** This is more important to {{C|The Lost}} and {{C|Tainted Lost}}, as {{i|Holy Mantle}} or {{P|Holy Card}} can not prevent damage from them.{{dlc-}}
sections.Synergies:
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns wisps in the middle ring, looking like "A Pony". The wisps charge in the direction Isaac shoots instead of firing tears. While charging, the wisps deal contact damage equal to 40% of Isaac's damage per tick (120% of Isaac's damage per second) and are immune to damage. Wisps must wait 2.5 seconds after hitting a wall before they can charge again. The wisps deal their normal contact damage while not charging.}}
* {{I|Mars}}: Using A Pony after dashing lowers the dash cooldown to approximately 1 second.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.
* {{i|Taurus}} / {{i|Thunder Thighs}}: The speed decreases from the items can lower Isaac's speed past 1.50 (making the new lower speed limits 1.20 and 1.10, respectively). Having both items can lower the minimum speed to 0.80.

sections.Notes:
* Unlike The Ludovico Technique, it cannot be controlled with the mouse, even with mouse control enabled.
* Holding two opposite fire keys (both left and right or both up and down) at the same time will keep the familiar in place, while making Isaac fire in the direction of whichever fire key was pressed second.
** This can help during combats with bosses who do not move a lot, as the familiar can continuously damage the boss when kept stationary.
** On some keyboards, holding opposite fire keys may cause other keys to become unresponsive.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|BFFS!}} / {{i|Hive Mind|r+}}: Double the damage. The items don't stack.
* {{i|King Baby}} / {{t|RC Remote}}: No effect.

sections.Effects:
* The first time Isaac takes damage while in an uncleared room, time is stopped for 2 seconds and Isaac becomes a ghost and leaves his body behind, which drops to the floor. While in ghost form, Isaac has [[flight]] and [[Tear Effects#Spectral|spectral tears]] and the next hit he takes is negated.
** Isaac's tears and speed are greatly increased while time is stopped, although this is not shown on the HUD.
** Isaac's ghost re-enters his body after the room is cleared or if he gets hit again.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|r+}} This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|Clutch}}.{{dlc-}}
* The damage blocked by being in ghost form also affects self-damage and red-heart draining sources, like {{e|Devil Beggar}}s, {{I|IV Bag}}, etc.
* Receiving lethal damage can potentially save Isaac's life if he manages to heal before the ghost reenters the body.
* {{I|Dull Razor}} may be used to safely activate Astral Projection as The Lost.
* It's also possible to leave the room while the ghost is outside the body, either by bombing it or having items that keep doors open, such as {{t|Door Stop}} or {{i|Mercurius}}. This grants Isaac an additional chance to heal.
** Teleporting outside of the room will not work.
* {{dlc|nr+}} Astral Projection cannot be triggered inside of {{r|Boss Rush}}.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Hypercoagulation}}: Due to the effective speed up, the heart used to activate Astral Projection can easily be collected before it disappears.
* {{i|IV Bag}} / {{i|Dull Razor}} / Other sources of self damage: If used in a hostile room, Astral Projection will trigger, effectively granting flight and {{i|Holy Mantle}} for the room.
* {{I|Old Bandage}} / {{i|Gimpy}}: When getting hit with only one heart left, Astral Projection allows for picking up the dropped heart in the brief time of invincibility even when the player has no hearts left. Failing to do so or having no hearts dropped results in guaranteed death however, but with luck this loop can be used to potentially save runs.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Holy Mantle}}: The shield will activate before Astral Projection.
* {{c|The Lost}} / {{c|Tainted Lost}}: The Lost will continue to fight after taking damage, however he will instantly die upon taking damage again or once the room is cleared.
** If The Lost receives at least half a {{e|Soul Heart}} through any means while the effect is active, he will survive. {{e|Black Heart}}s cannot be used for this.
* {{i|Plan C}} / Other insta-kill effects: Will kill Isaac without triggering the ghost effect.
* {{i|Rock Bottom}}: Does not preserve the tears and speed bonus Isaac receives after activating Astral Projection.
* {{i|Spirit Shackles}}: This item will not activate if Isaac received lethal damage when Astral Projection activated.

sections.Effect: * Upon [[death]], Isaac will respawn as {{c|???}} in the previous room, with 3 {{E|Soul Heart}}s.
sections.Interactions: * {{c|Tainted ???}}: Revives as himself, rather than normal ???. Effectively acts as a {{I|1up!}}.

sections.Effects:
* Gives Isaac an extra life. Upon death, he will respawn in the previous room with full health, after which 1up! will disappear.
** If Isaac has no Red Heart Containers, he'll respawn with a {{e|Half Soul Heart|n}} instead.
* The 1up! mushroom begins following Isaac like a familiar upon pickup, but doesn't do anything. It disappears when its life is used up.
* {{transformation contribution|Fun Guy}}
sections.Notes:
* Resurrection items activate in a [[:Category:Revival items|set order]]. 1up! is {{dlcalt|1st in this order|r=2nd in this order after {{p|Soul of Lazarus|n}}}}.
* {{c|???}} ({{dlc|r}} {{c|Tainted ???|n}} / {{c|Tainted Bethany}} / {{c|Tainted Forgotten}}) will each respawn with 3 {{e|Soul Heart}}s.
* {{dlc+|a+}} {{c|The Forgotten}} will respawn with {{dlcalt|3|r=2}} filled {{e|Bone Heart}}s and {{c|The Soul}} with whatever Soul and Black Hearts he had on death.
** Dying as The Soul respawns him with {{dlcalt|a Half Soul Heart|r=1 Soul Heart}} and The Forgotten with whatever Bone Hearts he had on death.
* {{dlc|r}} {{c|Black Judas}} / {{c|Tainted Judas}} will respawn with 2 {{e|Black Heart}}s.
* {{c|Tainted Jacob}} will respawn in his ghost form if he had been turned into his ghost form before dying.
* {{dlc|r}} [[Familiar]]s that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with 1up! having the lowest priority at {{dlcalt|6th|r+=8th}} and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.

sections.Effects:
* Drops a random [[trinket]].
* Grants a second trinket slot.
sections.Interactions: * {{i|Mom's Purse}}: No effect; Isaac can still only carry two trinkets.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a random [[Harbinger]] [[familiar]] that changes every 10 seconds. All harbingers deal contact damage to enemies and periodically spawn [[locust]]s if Isaac currently doesn't have any, though each harbinger behaves slightly differently:
** {{e|Famine}} wanders around the room, leaves a trail of slowing black creep, deals 0.5 contact damage per tick or 15 damage per second, and spawns [[Locust of Famine|yellow locusts]] every 3 seconds that deal double Isaac's damage and slows enemies.
** {{e|Pestilence}} wanders around the room, leaves a trail of green creep that deals 1 damage per tick or 30 damage per second, deals 0.5 contact damage per tick or 15 damage per second, and spawns [[Locust of Pestilence|green locusts]] every 3 seconds that deal double Isaac's damage and poisons enemies, which deals double Isaac's damage over time.
** {{e|War}} chases enemies, moves faster than the other Harbingers, deals 1.5 contact damage per tick or 45 damage per second, and spawns [[Locust of War|red locusts]] every 5 seconds which detonates upon impact with enemies, dealing double tear damage for the impact of the locust and 60 damage for the explosion. The explosion synergizes with multiple bomb related items.
** {{e|Death}} chases enemies, deals 1.5 contact damage per tick or 45 damage per second, and spawns [[Locust of Death|black locusts]] every 3 seconds that deal quadruple Isaac's damage, applied as two hits of double damage.
** {{e|Conquest}} wanders around the room, deals 0.5 contact damage per tick or 15 damage per second, and spawns two [[Locust of Conquest|white locusts]] at a time every 2 seconds that deal double Isaac's damage.
*** {{dlc|nr}} Conquest ignores the locust spawn timer.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|r}} Explosive locusts have a larger aggro range than all other locusts. They will target an enemy from further away.
* {{dlc|nr}}If Conquest is on top of an enemy when Isaac has no white locusts, it will spawn locusts at an incredibly high rate and deal a lot of damage.
* If an enemy is large enough to stand on multiple segments of Pestilence's creep trail, the damage from each pool of creep will stack.
* The locusts that War spawns can damage Isaac if they explode near him.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|BFFS!}}: Increases Horsemens' size and doubles their contact damage. Does not affect locusts spawned.
* {{i|Bomber Boy|r}}: War's locusts explode in a small horizontal cross-shape pattern.
* {{i|Box of Friends}}: Creates another random horseman that can be different from the original.
** This makes it possible to gain multiple varying horsemen and gain all of their locusts at one time.
* {{i|Brimstone Bombs}}: War's locusts will shoot out four brimstone beams in a + formation after hitting an enemy.
* {{i|Glitter Bombs|r}}: Locust explosions have a chance to spawn pickups or trinkets.
* {{i|Hive Mind}}: Increases locusts' size and doubles their damage.
** Red locusts’ impact damage is doubled and the explosion damage is increased to 85.
* {{i|Sad Bombs}}: War's locusts fire a ring of ten tears outward upon detonation, which are affected by Isaac's tear modifiers, and deal damage equal to 15 + 0.6x, where x is Isaac's [[Damage]].
* {{i|King Baby}} / {{t|RC Remote}}: No effect.
sections.Interactions: * {{t|Fish Tail}}: Despite working with the locust trinkets, it does not double locusts from any of the 7 Seals Horsemen.

sections.Effect:
* Isaac fires two tears at once, one from each eye.
* {{dlc|r}} 0.8× [[damage]] multiplier.
sections.Notes:
* Unlike other multiple shot items like {{i|Mutant Spider}} or {{i|The Inner Eye}}, 20/20 does not reduce the rate of fire.
* The maximum amount of tears per volley that can be reached by combining and/or duplicating 20/20, {{i|The Inner Eye}}, {{i|Mutant Spider}}, and {{i|The Wiz}} is 16.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Blood Clot}} / {{i|Chemical Peel}}: Every second row of tears has increased damage.
* {{dlc|a}}{{i|Brimstone}}: Two Brimstone shots are fired, without an increase in charge time.
* {{i|Diplopia|anr}}: Every additional 20/20 adds 2 more tears in a tight pattern.
** {{dlc|r}} Adds one more tear without further lowering damage.
* {{dlc|a}}{{i|Doctor's Remote}} / {{i|Epic Fetus}}: Replaces the single missile strike with a barrage of two consecutive missiles.
* {{dlc|anr}}{{i|The Inner Eye}} / {{i|Mutant Spider}}: Adds two/three tears to each shot, with no extra fire rate decrease.

sections.Effects: * When Isaac's attacks land on the "back" of enemies, they deal double [[damage]] and inflict [[Status Effects#Bleed|bleeding]]. ** {{dlc|nr}} Bleeding enemies take damage equal to 10% of their maximum health every 5 seconds. Bosses cannot be inflicted with bleeding, but will still take the extra damage. ** {{dlc|r}} Enemies bleed for 5 seconds, bleeding enemies repeatedly take 2.8 + (floor * 0.3) damage based on how quickly they move; the faster the enemy, the more damage they take. While moving, a bleeding enemy leaves behind [[red creep]] that can damage other enemies. ** The extra damage is dealt even if the enemy is already bleeding.
sections.Notes:
* The damage is dealt as 2 separate hits, as opposed to one double damage hit.
* What is considered to be the "back" of an enemy is based solely on their velocity when the attacks land: their back is opposite to their movement direction.
** High [[knockback]] makes it easier to get follow-up backstabs as the enemies are pushed away from the tears.
** Pushing enemies while shooting makes them easy to backstab, though is mostly viable only on ones that don't deal contact damage or while having a [[shield]].
** Completely stationary enemies generally have their back on their upper and right sides, but knockback considerations apply.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Dark Arts}}: Freezing an enemy from its back using Dark Arts will apply bleeding, though there is no extra direct damage.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}}/{{i|Epic Fetus}}/{{i|Ipecac}}: These explosives can backstab but deal only 3.5 bonus damage instead of double damage.
* {{dlc|nr}} [[Shooting familiar]]s: Tears fired by familiars can inflict the effects of Backstabber.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: The Ludovico tear will nearly always backstab when over an enemy.
* {{i|Trisagion}}: The Trisagion blasts' shape and size make them almost guaranteed to backstab.
* Worm Trinkets, like {{T|Hook Worm}} and {{T|Wiggle Worm}} make Backstabber's effect possible even if the enemy is facing Isaac.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Akeldama}}: Akeldama tears cannot backstab.
* {{i|Bag of Crafting}}: The melee swing cannot backstab.
* [[Bomb]]s: Unlike Dr. Fetus bombs, normal bombs cannot backstab.
* {{i|Breath of Life|r}}: Neither normal contact beams or the perfectly timed ones cannot backstab.
* {{i|Divine Intervention}}: The shield cannot backstab.
* {{i|Hemoptysis}}/{{c|Tainted Azazel}}: The sneeze cannot backstab.
* {{t|Lost Cork|r}}: No effect on enemy blood creep.
* {{i|Salvation}}: The beams cannot backstab.
* {{i|Spear Of Destiny}}: The spear cannot backstab.

sections.Effect:
* Gives Isaac 100 {{e|Penny|text=Pennies}}.
** This does not extend past the normal cap of 99.
sections.Notes:
* A Dollar can only be found from paying out a {{e|Slot Machine}}, as a starting item for {{c|Eden}}, using {{i|Spindown Dice}} on {{i|Boom!}}, by using {{i|Death Certificate}}, or by using {{p|0 - The Fool?}} with {{i|Deep Pockets}} and at least 100 coins.
** Multiple copies of A Dollar can be found in the same run from paying out different {{e|Slot Machine}}s.
* Rerolling this item with the {{i|D4}}, etc., will not remove the coins acquired.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Deep Pockets}}: Allows Isaac to gain the full 100 coins.
* {{i|Bag of Crafting}}: The item cannot be crafted.

sections.Effect:
* Isaac leaves a trail of [[blue creep]] where he walks that damages enemies that walk over it.
** {{dlc|nr}} The creep deals 2 damage per tick or 6 damage per second.
** {{dlc|r}} The creep deals 66% of Isaac's damage 10 times per second.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|r+}} This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|Lil Blub}}.{{dlc-}}
* {{dlc|r}} The creep copies Isaac's [[tear effect]]s and changes colors based on Isaac's tears.
** Chance for triggering the effects works like it does for tears.
** The creep's color changes even if the items don't have an applicable tear effect.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Apple!|r}} / {{I|Knockout Drops}} / {{I|Tough Love|r}}: Creep does not appear visually different but has a chance to inflict the respective bonus effects.
* {{dlc|r}} [[Homing]] tears: Creep moves towards nearby enemies that are on the ground, ignoring ones that fly.
* {{I|Ipecac|r}}: Creep becomes green and poisons enemies but does not explode.
* {{t|Lost Cork}}: The creep is 50% larger.
* {{I|A Lump of Coal|r}}: Creep does more damage the farther Isaac is from the enemy.
* {{i|Proptosis|r}}: Creep deals 2x Isaac's damage instead of 66%.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|Eye of the Occult}}: Turns the creep purple but creep can't be controlled.
* {{I|Fire Mind|dlc=r}}: Turns the creep orange and burns enemies but does not explode.
* {{I|Godhead|r}}: Creep becomes homing as expected but does not have a larger radius.
* {{I|Montezuma's Revenge}}: Turns the creep brown despite the item not affecting Isaac's tear color.
* {{I|Sulfuric Acid|r}}: Occasionally turns the creep yellow but doesn't destroy obstacles.

sections.Effects:
* +0.5 [[Tears]].
* +0.2 [[Shot Speed]].

* While in a room with enemies, creates a trail of tears that Isaac drags behind him.
** Each tear deals 3.5 damage, regardless of Isaac's damage.
** Tears are spawned at an irregular rate, roughly between once every 0.1 to 1 seconds.
** The tears are [[spectral]].
* Once the room is cleared, the trail will remain but will stop regenerating.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|r+}} This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|The Shell}}.{{dlc-}}
* Another trail of tears may appear if the trail is cut in the middle.
* A maximum of 20 tears can exist at once, shared between all trails.
* The tears cannot push active {{e|Bomb}}s and {{e|Troll Bomb}}s.
* The tears can extinguish {{e|Fire Place}}s and set off {{g|TNT}}.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Angelic Prism}}: Splits the trail of tears into four multi-colored chains.
* {{I|Lachryphagy}}: Some Akeldama tears will absorb tears shot by Isaac and gain size and damage as expected, but will not burst from being overloaded and can be fed infinite amount of tears. Meaning that each tear, if fed enough, can deal massive amounts of damage.
* {{I|Lodestone}}: Magnetized enemies will attract the tears from Akeldama's trail, making it easier to use.
* {{I|Multidimensional Baby}}: Akeldama tears that passes through Multidimensional baby will be cloned and may also create a separate trail if enough tears are cloned.
* {{I|Tear Detonator}}: Will burst tears generated by Akeldama into Isaac's current tears.
* {{I|Technology Zero}}: Shot tears will create a laser between it and the Akeldama tear closest to Isaac.
* {{i|Dead Eye}}: The tears in the trail will contribute to the damage boost, making it possible to stack damage while having items that do not interact with Dead Eye on their own (such as {{i|Brimstone}}).
* {{I|IBS}}: Holding a {{g|White Poop}} above your head will give Akeldama tears homing.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|Anti-Gravity}}: Akeldama tears are unaffected by Anti-Gravity.
* {{i|Brimstone}}: Akeldama creates normal tears.
* {{I|Godhead}}: Akeldama tears do not have the aura.
* {{i|Ipecac}}: Akeldama creates normal tears.
* {{i|Pop!}}: Akeldama blocks the eyeballs created by {{i|Pop!}}, making it quite difficult to hit enemies.
* {{I|Scissors}}: The trail will follow Isaac's body.

sections.Effects:
* Holding the fire buttons causes tears to hover in midair. When released, the tears will all shoot in the direction they were originally fired.
** If the fire buttons are not released, the tears will fire on their own after 3 seconds.
* {{dlc|nr}} {{tear delay down|2}}
* {{dlc|r}} +1.0 [[fire rate]].
sections.Notes:
* Gravitational effects, such as {{E|Mega Fatty}}'s inhalation or a {{E|Gaping Maw}} will pull floating tears toward them.
* The [[range]] attribute only affects the lifespan of the tears after they have been released.
* Hovering tears can damage monsters like {{E|Knight}}s or {{E|Mask of Infamy}} from the front, even if they don't have the [[piercing]] effect.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|C Section}}: Fetuses stand in place while the fire button is held. They will still home on enemies in this state. Fetuses attacking this way deal more damage.
* {{C|The Forgotten|a+}}: Each swing of his club creates an additional hitbox in front of him that lasts for about a second before proceeding forward and disappearing. The club throw is unaffected.
* {{i|Lachryphagy}}: Tears will float in midair, making them easier to feed. Burst tears will also float in midair before moving.
* {{i|Proptosis}}: The tears will not decrease in size or damage until they start moving, making this excellent against enemies that chase Isaac.
* {{C|Tainted Magdalene}}: Hug swipes float, allowing for extra hits as the swipes remain mid-air.
* {{I|Tech.5|r}}: Creates floating laser balls that will all fire simultaneously when the fire button is released.
* {{i|Technology Zero}}: All of the tears fired are connected by electricity, creating a series of electric fences.
* {{i|Tiny Planet|nr}}: Tears stay in place until released, they will start to orbit around Isaac when released.
** {{dlc|r}} Tears orbit close to Isaac when held, then snap to the edge of the orbit when released.
sections.Interactions:
* {{c|Azazel}} / {{i|Brimstone}}: A red mist expands and then contracts, doing contact damage to any enemy that touches it. It then fires the original Brimstone shot before disappearing. It allows a new shot to be charged up immediately after firing without interrupting the first shot. It does not increase the range of Azazel's Brimstone beam.
** {{dlc|nr}} '''Brimstone''' + {{tf|Conjoined}}: Fires a single laser instead of a triple laser.
** '''Brimstone''' + {{i|Soy Milk}}: Brimstone continues firing from the position it was fired.
* {{i|Bob's Rotten Head}}: Continues to hover in the air while the fire button is pressed after launching it.
* {{i|Chocolate Milk}}: Overrides Anti-Gravity.
** {{i|Chocolate Milk}} + {{i|Soy Milk}}: Tears are released immediately, despite not charging.
* {{i|Compound Fracture}} / {{i|Cricket's Body}} / {{i|Haemolacria}} / {{i|The Parasite}}: Burst tears will not hover even if a fire button is held.
* {{i|Cursed Eye}} / {{i|Dr. Fetus}} / {{i|Epic Fetus}} / {{i|Eye of the Occult}} / {{i|The Ludovico Technique}} / {{i|Marked}} / {{i|Mom's Knife}} / {{i|Monstro's Lung}} / {{i|Tech X}}: Only tear delay down applies.
* {{i|Diplopia}}: No effect; -2 tears delay does not stack.
* {{i|Euthanasia}}: If a needle tear destroys an enemy and the fire button is held, the burst needles will hover until the button is released.
* {{i|Kidney Stone}}: When the Kidney Stone effect is activated, the tear barrage will hover until released. The stone will not hover and will travel regardless.
** {{dlc|r}}: ('''Not recommended''') The anti-gravity effect stays in place for the whole duration of the tear barrage even if the fire button isn't held resulting in a complete loss of control of fire for as long as the barrage is active.
* {{i|A Lump of Coal}}: Despite the visual increase in size, damage still only increases based on the distance traveled.
** {{dlc|a+}} Tears no longer increase in size while hovering.
* {{i|Multidimensional Baby}}: Multidimensional Baby will travel the same path as the Anti-Gravity tears, easily doubling any stationary shots. Any moving tears that hit it will produce a normal moving copy, however stationary tears will spawn a copy that will eventually fall to the ground even after the direction is released.
** {{dlc|a+}} Stationary duplicated tears will release normally.
* {{i|My Reflection}}: Combines both effects. Tears no longer hover in place; instead, they will weakly home in on Isaac like he is a pivot point, following as he moves. Releasing the attack buttons will launch the tears from their position as usual.
* {{I|Notched Axe|r}}: Melee attacks will generate a hovering tear in the shape of the swing of the pickaxe.
* {{i|Spirit Sword}}: Sword beams are affected normally by Anti-Gravity. Regular sword swipes are unaffected, but spin attacks freeze for a short time before firing.
* {{i|Technology|nr}}: Only tear delay down applies.
** {{dlc|r}} Creates floating laser balls that will all fire simultaneously when the fire button is released.

sections.Effects:
* Upon use, puts Isaac in a berserk state for 5 seconds, during which the following effects apply:
** +0.4 [[speed]].
** +3 flat [[damage]] .
** Tears are replaced by a jawbone melee weapon that is similar to {{C|The Forgotten}}'s bone club.
*** The jaw bone deals 3× Isaac's damage when swung and 1.5× Isaac's damage per tick when thrown (3× Isaac's damage per second).
*** The swung jaw bone reflects enemy shots.
**** Reflected projectiles deal 6 damage if they would've hurt Isaac for half a heart, and 7 for a full heart.
*** The thrown jaw bone charges very quickly compared to the Forgotten's bone club, but as berserk only lasts five seconds, it uses a noticeable amount of the effect's limited duration to charge and throw the jaw bone.
*** The swung jaw bone can collect pickups and open [[chest]]s.
*** A successful melee hit on an enemy makes Isaac immune to damage for roughly 0.25 seconds. This immunity doesn't protect against self-inflicted damage such as {{i|IV Bag}} or {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}.
** While Berserking, Isaac's [[fire rate]] is halved then increased by 2. This will be a tears upgrade unless Isaac's tears is 4 or above.
*** If playing as The Forgotten, the ×0.5 fire rate modifier isn't applied, as he already has it.
** Killing an enemy while "Berserking" increases Berserk's current duration by 1 second.
** Killing an enemy grants very brief invincibility, preventing damage from exploding enemies.
** Every enemy killed will also grant +0.4 [[speed]] until the effect ends.
** Isaac is unable to [[Death|die]] while Berserk is active. He can be reduced to 0 [[Health|hearts]], but will not die until the effect ends.
*** This does not apply to insta-kill effects (such as {{i|Damocles}} and {{i|Plan C}}) - they will kill Isaac even if Berserk is active.
* This item charges when Isaac deals damage to enemies rather than by clearing rooms or picking up batteries. It requires a base total of 120 damage, and increases by 40 for every next floor.
sections.Notes:
* The jaw bone has all the same synergies that The Forgotten's bone club does.
** {{I|Mom's Knife}}: This version of the attack doesn't deflect projectiles.
sections.Synergies:
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns a pale wisp on the middle ring. The wisp has extra HP and does not shoot.}}
* {{i|C Section}}: Replaces club throw with two swings in quick succession which fire a fetus. All fetuses fired will hold bone clubs, similar to the interaction with {{c|The Forgotten}}.
* {{i|Scapular}}: If the fatal damage occurs during Berserk state, Scapular will trigger and grant the {{e|Soul Heart}}.
* {{i|Suplex!}}: When used near the end of the Berserk state (any time after the second bell ring), Suplex receives a unique visual effect, and will deal massive damage to the target, while setting off a {{i|Mama Mega!}} style explosion, destroying all [[obstacle]]s in the current room and blowing open all doors. The target being Suplexed, as well as nearby enemies, will receive 300 base damage that scales with Isaac's size. All other enemies receive 200 flat damage.
* {{c|The Lost}} / {{c|Tainted Lost}}: This can allow either variant of The Lost to survive being damaged if it happens while Berserk is active. Despite having no visible health bar, their health is normally set to a {{e|Half Soul Heart}}. If they take damage while Berserk is active, they will not die if they are able to pick up a {{e|Soul Heart}} or half soul heart before the effect ends. {{e|Black Heart}}s do not count for this.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: While under the Berserk state, you lose control of the Ludovico Technique tear, which can now be deflected by the jaw bone swing, bouncing off nearby walls and dealing damage to enemies.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|4.5 Volt}} / {{I|9 Volt}} / {{I|Jumper Cables}}: No effect.
* {{dlc|r}}[[Cards and Runes|Ace Cards]]: Turning enemies into [[pickup]]s doesn’t count as damaging or killing them for the sake of charging this item or extending its duration.
* {{I|Car Battery}}: Duration is only extended if no enemies are killed during the first half, thus only providing a benefit against bosses that can't spawn enemies.
* {{i|E. Coli}} / {{i|Flush!}}: Turning enemies into poop doesn’t count as damaging or killing them for the sake of charging this item or extending its duration.
* [[Freeze|Freeze Effects]]: Killing enemies by freezing them will not extend the timer, which can make it difficult to maintain the duration.
** {{dlc|r+}} Frozen enemies do extend the timer.
* {{I|Libra}}: Because of Berserk giving you +0.4 speed with every kill, Libra will instead steadily increases the damage, tears, and range stats with seemingly no limit, allowing massively high DPS, but targets are much more difficult to hit due to the range of the swing gradually extending outwards more and more with each kill.
* {{I|Sharp Plug}}: Isaac will take damage without gaining any charges.
