sections.Effects:
* Enemies that touch Isaac will bounce off him and propel in the opposite direction. If they hit an obstacle or wall while bouncing, they will take damage.
** If an enemy bounces into another enemy, the second enemy will also take damage.
* When an enemy bounces off of Isaac, there's a 50% chance that Isaac won't receive contact damage.
* Additionally grants a 50% chance for projectiles to bounce off of Isaac without taking damage.
sections.Notes: * The damage enemies receive when they get bounced into a wall or an obstacle is equal to 8 + 2 * floor. ** The same damage value applies when an enemy gets bounced into by another enemy. * Enemies that don't deal contact damage cannot be bounced off. * Since contact damage is applied rapidly, it is possible to end up taking damage and then immediately bouncing the enemy off. * Bounced off projectiles deal a flat damage that doesn't scale with the current floor or Isaac's stats. This damage is usually 6, but can slightly vary depending on the enemy that shot the projectile. ** Lasers cannot be bounced off. * The bouncing effect also works against {{e|Fire Place}}s and spiked enemies such as {{e|Poky}}, {{e|Slide}}, and {{e|Grudge}}, granting a chance to avoid unintentional damage. * Isaac can also bounce off {{e|Fly Bomb}}s spawned by {{e|Blaster}}s and even deny damage from their explosion. * {{e|Bomb}}s and {{e|Troll Bomb}}s cannot be bounced off. * Belly Jelly can prevent damage from Bad Trip [[pill]]s. * Belly Jelly can prevent {{C|Tainted Jacob}} from being turned into his Lost form by Dark Esau.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Aries}}: Retains the chance to bounce enemies while preventing damage simultaneously.
* {{i|Book of Shadows}} / {{i|Unicorn Stump}}: Can be used as a powerful offensive item since Isaac can still bounce off enemies while invincible.
* {{i|Cone Head}} / {{i|Hallowed Ground}} / {{i|Host Hat}} / {{i|Infamy}} / {{i|Metal Plate}} / {{i|Star of Bethlehem}}: Offers an additional chance to negate damage.
* {{i|Gnawed Leaf}}: The bouncing effect works while Isaac is invincible.
* {{i|Serpent's Kiss}}: Allows Isaac to bounce enemies and poison them at the same time, with a decent chance to get a lot more health back in the form of {{e|Black Heart}}s than originally spent.
sections.Interactions: * {{t|Panic Button}}: The active item will still be activated if Belly Jelly blocks damage.

sections.Effects:
* +1.5 [[damage]].
* Isaac's tears are replaced with nails, which have increased [[knockback]].
sections.Notes:
* Does not grant penetrative shots, despite the appearance of Isaac's tears.
* Any item that normally colors Isaac's tears red will cause the nails to become bloody.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}} / {{i|Epic Fetus}} / {{i|Ipecac}}: Explosions also gain increased knockback.
* [[Piercing tears]]: Allows tears to knock enemies back again.
* {{i|Brimstone}} / {{i|Tech.5}} / {{i|Technology}} / {{i|Technology 2}} / {{i|Tech X}} / {{i|Mom's Knife}} / {{i|Trisagion}}: They gain knockback. Especially powerful with Tech X, as the knockback helps keeps enemies within the ring for longer.
sections.Interactions: * {{t|Blister}}: The knockback from Blister is stronger than from 8 Inch Nails, and knockback boosts do not stack.

sections.Effects:
* Applies [[fear]] to enemies in a small radius around Isaac.
* {{dlc|r+}} +0.5 [[fire rate]].
* {{dlc|r+}} +0.2 [[shot speed]].
sections.Notes: * 2Spooky can be used to manipulate {{e|Ultra Greed}}. Once {{e|Greed Gaper}}s spawn and Ultra Greed is in his resistance stance, the gapers will be feared when getting close, leaving the boss unable to move or damage Isaac.
sections.Interactions:
* {{c|Tainted Forgotten}}: Not recommended, the fear aura makes it more difficult to hit enemies with Tainted Forgotten and does not provide protection to {{c|Tainted Soul}}.
* {{I|Venus}}: Overrides 2Spooky.

sections.Effects:
* +0.35 [[tears]] up.
* Allows tears to be fired diagonally.
** With a keyboard or using buttons to fire with a controller, tears can be shot at 45-degree angles by holding two buttons. This is known as eight-directional firing. For example, holding the up button and right button will shoot diagonally towards the upper right-hand corner.
** Using a controller with a physical analog stick, its input is accepted, allowing for tears to be shot in any direction, as it shoots wherever the analog stick is pointing without being limited to 45-degree angles.
sections.Notes: * Enables full directional firing for keyboard and mouse users with the accessibility option EnableMouseControl enabled.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|Abyss}}: Locusts cannot attack diagonally, and will attack upwards or downwards instead.
* {{I|Book of Virtues}}: Summoned wisps are unable to shoot diagonally, and will shoot upwards or downwards instead.
* {{i|Cain's Other Eye|r}}: The familiar will fire in completely random directions, not locked to the cardinal ones.
* {{i|Compound Fracture}}: When bone tears are fired diagonally, the bone shards will not always move diagonally.
* {{i|Cricket's Body}}/{{i|The Parasite}}: When tears are fired diagonally, the split tears will also move diagonally.
* {{i|Epic Fetus}}: No effect, as missiles will always be fired towards the landing point.
* {{I|Epiphora}}: Tears fired diagonally can retain the bonus fire rate, as long as Isaac's head continues to face the same direction.
* {{i|Incubus|nr}}: Incubus cannot fire in non-cardinal directions, only tears up applies.
** {{dlc|r}} Incubus can fire diagonally in the same direction Isaac is shooting.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: No effect; the singular tear already has this ability, being able move in any direction.
* {{i|Marked}}: Overridden by Marked.
* {{i|Mom's Knife}}: Only the tears up applies, since Mom's Knife already has the ability of being able to be pointed in any direction.
* {{i|Tiny Planet}}: Overridden by Tiny Planet.
* {{i|Tractor Beam}}: Overridden by Tractor Beam.
** {{dlc|r}} Tractor Beam can be pointed in any direction.

sections.Effects:
* [[Devil deal]]s and {{r|Black Market}} items can now be paid with {{E|Penny|text=Coins}}.
** Anything that generates Devil Deals (such as {{i|Satanic Bible}} or the special chests in {{s|Dark Room}}) will also create items that cost coins.
* Items in {{r|Shop}}s now cost [[health]].
* [[Consumable]]s in shops have no cost, but are surrounded with [[Spikes]] and can't be pushed out with an explosion.
sections.Notes:
* Buying shop items for health does not prevent {{r|Angel Room}}s from appearing.
* Taking a health consumable surrounded by spikes at a single heart or less will still result in Isaac's death.
* Immunity to spikes or invulnerability of any kind (e.g. via {{i|The Gamekid}}) does not prevent damage when taking consumables in shops.
* Shop consumables cannot be taken during invincibility frames, e.g. from taking another consumable.
** {{c|The Lost}} can take the consumables, without losing his {{I|Holy Mantle}}.
** When transformed into {{c|The Lost}} in {{s|Downpour}}/{{s|Dross}} II with the {{e|White Fire Place}}, shop consumables can be taken for free even without {{I|Holy Mantle}}.
* The item is not available to {{C|Keeper}} and {{c|Tainted Keeper}} normally. If acquired through {{i|Spindown Dice}}, {{i|Death Certificate}} or such, it has no effect.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Binge Eater}}: All shops become free stat-ups if the food item is chosen.
* {{I|Restock}}: The price never increases, staying at one red heart container/three soul hearts for each item, and one full heart of damage for pickups.
** However, Restock's coin cost increase mechanic is still present, and if Pound of Flesh is lost, the items will have their equivalent coin cost displayed.
** With {{I|Binge Eater}}, this can result in infinite stat gains.
** If a Heart is on sale, Isaac can trigger [[:Category:Damage-triggered items|items that activate upon taking damage]] indefinitely.
** If a {{E|Lil' Battery}} is on sale, Isaac can buy items indefinitely with certain active items such as {{I|Blank Card}} with {{p|XI - Strength}} or {{I|Book of Revelations}} with {{I|Car Battery}}.
** When transformed into a ghost in {{s|Downpour}} II or as {{C|Tainted Jacob}}, or playing as{{C|The Lost}}, Isaac can buy items indefinitely.
* {{I|Maggy's Bow}}: Buying a Red Heart will out-heal the damage taken from the spikes if Isaac can survive it.
* {{I|The Wafer}} / {{I|Cancer}} / [[Percs!]]: The spikes only deal half a heart damage, allowing Isaac to gain health from buying hearts.
** With {{i|Restock}}, any character except {{C|Bethany}} can buy items indefinitely if a Soul Heart is on sale.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|Chaos}}: Items in Devil Rooms that would otherwise cost two heart containers will only cost one if found in Shops.
* {{t|Flat File}}: No effect. Spikes generated surrounding consumables will not be removed.
* {{I|Holy Mantle}} / {{p|Holy Card}} / {{t|Wooden Cross}} / {{I|Blanket}} / {{I|Dogma}}: Unless Isaac is {{C|The Lost}}, the spikes around consumables will simply break the shield without letting him take them.
* {{I|Isaac's Heart}}: Consumables can no longer be picked up in shops.
* {{T|Judas' Tongue}}: Ensures that items in the {{I|Member Card}} secret shop only cost one heart container, but Devil Deal prices are not reduced, and other shop items already only cost one heart container.
* {{i|Keeper's Box}}: Items and pickups generated outside Devil Rooms will cost health, but items generated inside Devil Rooms will cost coins.
* {{i|Keeper's Sack}}: Because shop items no longer cost coins, stat bonuses are no longer gained from buying shop items, but they are gained from Devil Deals.
* {{C|The Lost}}: Only one item can be picked up from each shop; any other items will vanish. Consumables can be taken for free.
** However, multiple items can be bought from Devil Deals.
** Items will not disappear when taking any consumable.
** With {{i|Restock}}, the Lost can buy items indefinitely.
* {{I|Member Card}}: Items in the secret shop can cost two heart containers.
* {{I|Redemption}}: Doesn't change the conditions to lose or keep the cross even when spending health in shops.
* {{I|The Stairway}}: Affects Angel Shops the same way it does regular shops.
* {{I|Steam Sale}}: Devil Deals will have their price reduced. Shop items will cost the same amount of health.
* {{T|Store Credit}}: Store Credit becomes a useless trinket, as neither Devil Deals nor shop items will become free.

sections.Effects:
* This item starts with no charges. Rather than gaining charges by clearing [[room]]s or picking up [[battery|batteries]], Alabaster Box has to be charged through {{e|Soul Heart|text=Soul}} or {{e|Black Heart|text=Black Hearts}}. Instead of being added to [[Health|Isaac's health bar]], they charge the box at a rate of one charge per half heart.
* Both Soul or Black Hearts that are picked up, or directly added to Isaac's health will count towards Alabaster Box's charges.
* Upon use, Alabaster Box is consumed and vanishes from Isaac's inventory, spawning three Soul Hearts and two [[item]]s from the [[Angel Room (Item Pool)|Angel Room item pool]].
** There's a small chance for each of the spawned Soul Hearts to be replaced with an {{e|Eternal Heart}}.
** If a [[Devil Room|Devil Deal]] was taken previously, it spawns only two Soul Hearts and one Angel Room item instead.
sections.Notes:
* If Isaac takes a [[Devil Room|Devil Deal]] that requires Soul Hearts while holding a charged Alabaster Box, hearts are taken from the box before it takes from Isaac's health.
* {{dlc|nr+}} If Isaac has a full HP bar, and he has either Soul or Black Hearts in his health pool, picking up {{e|Bone Heart}}s will take away 2 charges from Alabaster Box each, instead of replacing any Soul/Black Hearts as they normally would. Bone Hearts will only replace health if the Alabaster Box has no charges.
** If Isaac picks up a Bone Heart at max HP while the Alabaster Box only has 1 charge, then it will take away both that 1 charge and half of a whole Soul/Black Heart (half hearts are unaffected).
* If {{c|The Lost}} picks up a Black Heart the box will not gain any charges.
* If the box requires two or more charges and Isaac picks up a Black Heart, the box gains charge as for a Soul Heart and the last Soul Heart (or half Soul Heart, if there is one) in Isaac's health becomes black.
* If the box requires only one more charge and Isaac picks up a full Soul Heart or a Black Heart, then the box becomes fully charged and a half heart of the same type is added to Isaac's health.
* If sleeping in a [[bed]] would restore Soul Hearts, they are used to charge the Alabaster Box instead. Any excess are added as Soul Hearts as normal.
** This applies to {{c|The Lost}}, who is always in the state to recover Soul Hearts, even if usually without effect.
* Soul hearts from {{e|Blended Heart}} can also be used to charge the box. They are, as usual, used for red health first.
* {{e|Bulb}}s are able to drain charges from Alabaster Box.
sections.Synergies:
* {{p|? Card}}: Activates Alabaster Box without consuming it, allowing for multiple uses.
* {{c|Bethany}} / {{c|Tainted Bethany}}: Soul/blood charges count as charges for Alabaster Box.
* {{Book of Belial synergy|description=Changes the payout to 2 {{e|Black Heart}}s and 1 item from the [[Devil Room (Item Pool)|Devil Room item pool]]. If a [[Devil Deal]] has been taken, the payout is boosted to 3 Black Hearts and 2 Devil items.}}
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns up to 8 normal wisps, filling up the middle ring.}}
* {{T|Found Soul}}: Found Soul will also activate Alabaster Box when Isaac does, doubling the rewards.
* {{i|Guppy's Paw}} + {{i|Schoolbag}}: Heart containers converted to Soul Hearts contribute to Alabaster Box's charge instead of being added to Isaac's health. This enables a full charge for just two heart containers.
* {{I|Metronome}}: When Metronome chooses Alabaster Box, it will immediately activate without requiring {{E|Soul Heart}}s.
* {{i|Void}}: Can activate Alabaster Box without consuming Soul Hearts. The effect is only used by Void once.
* {{P|Wild Card}}: Allows for multiple uses of Alabaster Box so long as no other activated item, [[card]], [[pill]] or [[rune]] has been used following the initial activation.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|4.5 Volt}} / {{i|9 Volt}} / [[48 Hour Energy]] / {{i|The Battery}} / {{i|Battery Pack}} / {{i|Car Battery}} / {{t|Charged Penny}} / {{t|Hairpin}} / {{i|Habit}} / {{i|Jumper Cables}} : No effect.
* {{i|Abaddon}}: Red Hearts will be converted to Black Hearts, which will be used to charge the box. If Isaac would die as a result of picking up Abaddon (he only has Red health), he is given a Half Soul Heart.
* {{e|Battery Bum}}: No effect, even though there's a cue that the item was charged.
* {{i|Converter}}: Cannot use charges stored in Alabaster Box.
* {{t|Devil's Crown}} / {{i|Satanic Bible}}: The extra Devil items will count as taking a deal, lowering Alabaster Box's payout.
* {{c|Keeper}} / {{C|Tainted Keeper}}: Though Keeper cannot encounter Soul Hearts normally, it is possible to charge the Alabaster Box by having something that adds them directly to health, such as {{i|Schoolbag}} with {{i|Book of Revelations}} or {{i|Dream Catcher}}, purchasing soul hearts spawned by {{I|Keeper's Box}}, or playing in [[Co-op]] alongside someone not playing as Keeper.
* {{c|Tainted Magdalene}}: Not recommended. If Tainted Magdalene has any soul hearts as health, then soul hearts will leak from the box, taking priority over soul health.
* {{c|The Lost}} / {{c|Tainted Lost}}: Alabaster Box does not gain charges from Black Hearts. Soul Hearts still function as expected.
* {{i|Magic Skin}} / {{i|Sumptorium}}: Will use Soul Hearts from the box before removing the ones in health.
* {{t|Mother's Kiss}}: Taking this trinket as a character that can't use red hearts grants a Soul/Black Heart instead of giving it to Alabaster Box.
* {{i|Schoolbag}}: Picked up Soul Hearts are consumed by Alabaster Box, even if it's in the second slot.
* {{i|Sharp Plug}}: Takes up to 6 full hearts if possible without giving charge, even when having Soul Hearts.
* {{P|XI - Strength}} and {{p|III - The Empress?}} cards apply a temporary charge on characters that can only use Soul/Black Hearts such as {{c|???}} or {{c|Tainted Judas}}.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns an [[orbital familiar]] that deals {{dlcalt|105|r=52.5}} contact damage per second.
* {{dlc|na}} Unlike the {{i|Cube of Meat}}, it does not block enemy shots.
* {{dlc|a}} Ball of Bandages blocks enemy shots.
* Each subsequent Ball of Bandages obtained are combined with the first one (increasing its 'level'), changing its characteristics:
** '''Level 2''': Gives the orbital the ability to shoot [[Charm]] tears once every {{dlcalt|second|r=0.73 seconds}}, with each tear dealing 3.5 damage.
** '''Level 3''': Changes it from an orbital to a Bandage Girl that that chases nearby enemies dealing {{dlcalt|52.5|a+nr=8.75|r=12.5}} contact damage per second and fires Charm tears in the direction Isaac shoots. The tears it fires are the same as the ones fired by the Level 2 form.
** '''Level 4''': Increases the size of the Bandage Girl and increases its contact damage to  {{dlcalt|82.5|a+nr=13.75|r=25}} per second. Enemies killed by a level 4 Bandage Girl's tears have a chance to drop full {{e|Red Heart}}s.
** The fifth Ball of Bandages will create a new Level 1 ball, and start the cycle again.
sections.Notes:
* Multiple Balls of Bandages can be collected in a single run.
* {{dlc|r}} The orbital orbits Isaac significantly faster, making it more effective at blocking shots but less effective for dealing damage.
* {{e|Famine}}, {{e|Pestilence}}, {{e|War}}, and {{e|Death}} will always drop either a Ball of Bandages or {{i|Cube of Meat}}. After the first one drops, further Harbingers will only drop that same one and never the other for the duration of the run.
* The ticking rate for Bandage Girls' contact damage causes them to often deal damage twice once they touch an enemy, making their first second of DPS up to 1.5x higher than normal.
* Level 3 and 4 Bandage Girls' tears inherit Isaac's momentum.
sections.Interactions:
* {{t|Duct Tape}}: Familiar will stay in place relative to Isaac at levels 1 and 2. No effect at levels 3 and 4.
* [[Pretty Fly]]: Ball of Bandages will replace one if Isaac already has 3 Pretty Flies. If the Ball of Bandages reaches level 3 or 4, the Pretty Fly will come back when a familiar is obtained, until another Ball of Bandages orbital is obtained.

sections.Effects:
* Repeatedly zaps enemies that are in close proximity to Isaac with electricity beams for light damage.
** Enemies can be zapped up to five times per second, with each zap dealing 0.75× Isaac's damage.
** Each zap can hit up to 4 enemies, if they are sufficiently close to each other.
** If the floor is wet, such as in {{s|Downpour}}, {{s|Flooded Caves}}, some rooms in {{s|Dross}}, {{s|Scarred Womb}}, and {{S|Corpse}}, as well as under the effect of {{i|Flush!}}, the initial distance is unchanged, but enemy-to-enemy arcs reach further.
** Trigger range appears to be approximately two tiles wide — it's possible to zap an enemy standing directly on the other side of a rock.
sections.Notes: * This item has a brief targeting delay, such that enemies can close in and touch Isaac before they start getting zapped.
sections.Synergies:
* {{dlc|r}} Multiple battery-themed items have special synergies with the zaps:
** {{I|Sharp Plug}} / {{I|Car Battery}}: Electricity deals 100% of Isaac's tear damage if he owns 1 of these items, and 150% if Isaac owns both.
** {{I|The Battery}} / {{I|Jumper Cables}} / {{T|AAA Battery}}: Increases amount of arcs a zap can generate.
** {{T|Old Capacitor}}: Allows zaps to arc on the same enemy multiple times.
* {{I|Abyss}}: When Isaac uses Abyss to absorb 120 Volt, it turns into a pale blue locust.
**{{dlc|nr+}} The locust can create arcs of electricity dealing 0.1 damage per tick.
**{{dlc|r+}} The locust can create arcs of electricity dealing 25% of Isaac's damage per tick.
* {{i|Camo Undies}}: Enemies won't target Isaac, thus he can safely zap enemies while standing near them. However, this won't work with bosses.
* {{i|Isaac's Heart}}: 120 Volt becomes much safer to use offensively as Isaac's body no longer takes damage.
* Items granting [[invulnerability]] or a [[shield]]: 120 Volt zaps enemies while Isaac is invincible.
** This includes {{i|Gnawed Leaf}}, allowing Isaac to clear most rooms without moving.
** {{i|Dark Arts}}: Enemies and bosses will be zapped while Dark Arts' effect is active, allowing Isaac to safely deal damage while invulnerable in this way.
* {{i|Pause}}: Zaps will not stop the pause effect allowing Isaac to kill or chip bosses easily by standing near them for the duration of the pause effect.
* {{c|Tainted Forgotten}}: Tainted Forgotten zaps enemies, allowing {{c|Tainted Soul}} to damage enemies from a safe distance.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Ipecac}}: The zaps get only a +2 flat damage bonus instead of +40 from Ipecac. The 0.75x-1.5x damage multiplier applies afterwards.
* {{i|Libra}}: The zaps ignore damage modification from Libra, both positive and negative: the actual unbalanced damage value is used.
* {{i|Mine Crafter}}: The TNT is spawned and then instantly detonated by 120 Volt's electric shock, inflicting 1 full heart of damage.

sections.Effects:
* Adds a chance to fire razor blades that deal quadruple Isaac's [[Damage|tear damage]].
* +0.3 [[tears]].
sections.Notes:
* The chance to fire a razor blade depends on the [[luck]] stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: <math>\frac1 { 15 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck}  \right \rfloor}</math>
** At base luck (0), the chance is 6.66%, maxing out at 100% at 14 luck.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Cricket's Body}} / {{i|Compound Fracture}} / {{i|The Parasite}}: When razors are fired, the split tears will also be razors and do quadruple damage. The Parasite's split tears look like normal tears.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}}: Adds a chance for the bombs to deal increased damage. See the page for the specific damage formula.
* {{dlc|nr}} {{i|Glass Cannon}}: Adds a chance to fire a giant razor that does roughly triple damage.
** {{dlc|r}} Adds a chance to fire a giant razor that does quadruple damage (x40 + 10 flat damage).
* {{i|Haemolacria}}: Adds a chance for tears to do quadruple damage. Burst tears will also do quadruple damage if the main tear does quadruple damage.
* {{i|Technology Zero}}: When razors are fired, they will connect to other tears via electricity. The electricity also does quadruple damage.
* {{i|Lachryphagy}}: Tears can be fed to razors, increasing damage and splitting into 8 razors after a little while. If razors are fed to the tears, the razor damage doesn't apply to the tear both before and after splitting.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Brimstone|nr}}: Each entire beam has a chance to gain the damage boost.
** {{dlc|r}} Each tick of the beam has a chance to gain the damage boost.
* {{i|Papa Fly}}/{{i|Pointy Rib}}/{{i|Linger Bean}}: Can benefit the damage multiplier. 
* {{i|Tech X|nr}}: Overrides Apple!.
** {{dlc|r}} Each tick of the laser rings have a chance to gain the damage boost.
* {{i|Tough Love}}: With 14 luck, overrides Tough Love, as the razor blades do more damage anyways. With 13 luck, Apple and Tough Love each have about an equal chance to trigger.

sections.Effects:
* Grants 5 {{e|Bomb}}s.
* Grants homing bombs.
sections.Notes: * This item can make bombing out of rooms difficult, as the bombs may slide towards enemies and away from the door.
sections.Synergies: * {{i|Dr. Fetus}}: The bombs that Isaac fires will be homing.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Doctor's Remote}}/{{i|Epic Fetus}}: Crosshair will not home in on enemies.
* {{i|Bob's Rotten Head}}: No effect.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a [[familiar]] that follows Isaac and charges across the [[room]] when Isaac fires, dealing 2.7 damage per tick or 40.5 damage per second to enemies it comes in contact with.
** The familiar's charging speed is very slow, unlike its counterpart {{i|Little Chubby}}.
** The familiar blocks enemy shots.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|r+}} This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|The Matriarch}}.{{dlc-}}
* Big Chubby takes 6 seconds to travel the other end of normal-sized rooms.
* Big Chubby will travel forward until hitting an obstacle or wall.
* Big Chubby will continue to travel forward between rooms.
* {{dlc|r}} [[Familiar]]s that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Big Chubby having {{dlc|nr+}} 5th / {{dlc|r+}} 7th priority.
sections.Interactions: * {{t|Duct Tape}}: Big Chubby stays in place relative to Isaac until it is fired.

sections.Effects:
* Upon use, gives one {{e|Soul Heart}}.
* Increases chance for a {{r|Devil Room}} or {{r|Angel Room}} door to open if held while killing the final [[boss]] of the [[floor]].
** {{dlc|na}} The chance is increased by 35%.
** {{dlc|a}} The chance is increased by 17.5%.
* If the Book of Revelations is used at least once on a floor, a [[Harbinger]] will replace the current floor's boss if possible.
** {{dlc|nar}} This will always happen as long as the floor's respective Harbinger has not been encountered, the boss has not been fought yet, and a Harbinger can appear on the floor normally.
** {{dlc|anr}} This has a high chance to happen but is not guaranteed.
* {{transformation contribution|Bookworm}}
sections.Notes:
The [[Harbinger]]s capable of appearing, and the floors they appear on, are as follows:
# {{e|Famine}} in [[Chapter 1]]
# {{e|Pestilence}} in [[Chapter 2]]
# {{e|War}} in [[Chapter 3]], floor 1
# {{e|Death}} or {{e|Conquest}} (if unlocked) in [[Chapter 4]], floor 1
# {{e|Headless Horseman}} on any floor in [[Chapter]]s 1-4
* Set bosses ({{e|Mom}}, {{e|Isaac}}, {{e|The Lamb}}, etc.) are unaffected by Book of Revelations.
* Only the first boss of a floor affected by {{cu|Labyrinth}} is affected.
* Book of Revelations won't replace the boss on double-sized {{r|Boss Room}}s, like [[Double Trouble]] rooms or if the boss is {{e|Mr. Fred}}.
** Furthermore, if the Book of Revelations is used on the first floor of a Chapter with a Double Trouble room no Harbinger will spawn on the second floor, even if Book of Revelations is used again. If finding a Harbinger is desired, Isaac should wait until seeing the shape of the Boss Room before using it.
* Keeping Book of Revelations until [[Chapter 4]] is one of the methods to unlock achievements related to Super Meat Boy and Super Bandage Girl, [[Unlocking Super Meat Boy & Super Bandage Girl|explained in detail here]].
* {{dlc|na+}} This item can replace the Boss even after Isaac initiates a battle with a normal boss and then teleports out before the fight is completed.
* {{dlc+|a+}} This item can replace {{e|The Bloat}} with a Harbinger in {{chal|Aprils Fool}}.{{dlc-}}
* {{dlc+|r}} Bosses in {{s|Downpour}} / {{s|Mines}} / {{s|Mausoleum}} and their variants cannot be replaced with Harbingers.{{dlc-}}
sections.Synergies:
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Creates wisps in the inner ring, resembling tiny crosses that do not fire tears. The wisps create a Harbinger that spawns [[Locust]]s (the same ones that {{i|7 Seals}} creates) for the current room when destroyed.}}
* {{i|Converter|r}}: Allows for generation of Heart Containers. ({{i|Schoolbag|r}} required)
* {{i|Car Battery}}: Gives Isaac two soul hearts.
* {{i|There's Options|r}}: Defeating a [[Harbinger]] will spawn both a regular [[Boss (Item Pool)|Boss pool]] item and either {{i|Ball of Bandages}} or {{i|Cube of Meat}}.
* {{i|Dream Catcher}}: If the floor boss is revealed to be one of the horsemen, book of revelations can be used early as the downside is no longer relevant.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|Genesis}}: Effects on the {{R|Boss Room}} and boss item still apply to the floor even after using Genesis.
* {{I|Satanic Bible}}: The spawned {{i|Ball of Bandages}} or {{i|Cube of Meat}} will cost hearts like a normal devil deal.
* {{p|IV - The Emperor?}}: Does not guarantee the extra boss to be a horseman.

sections.Effects:
* {{dlc|nr}} Upon use, copies the effect of the [[card]] or [[rune]] currently held by Isaac.
* {{dlc|r}} Upon use, copies the effect of the [[card]] currently held by Isaac. Blank Card's recharge time changes upon use, depending on the card Isaac was holding when he used it.
sections.Synergies:
* {{dlc+|r}}{{t|Butter!}}: As Blank Card is dropped upon usage, the recharge time for it is reset to 4, allowing to use more expensive cards much more frequently.{{dlc-}}
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns card wisps in the middle ring. Enemies killed by the wisps' tears have a 15% chance to drop a [[cards|card]]. A wisp is given even if Isaac is not holding a card when the item is used.}}
* {{i|Car Battery}}: Uses the card twice. For example, if used with the Two of Hearts/Diamonds/etc. cards it will quadruple whatever amount Isaac has.
* {{i|Tarot Cloth}}: Invokes the extra effect when used.
** {{dlc|r}} Only certain cards gain the Tarot Cloth effect with Blank Card.
** '''Car Battery''' + '''Tarot Cloth''': The effect of the active card is quadrupled.
*** {{dlc|r}} Only certain Tarot Cloth effects will be doubled again.
* {{p|2 of Diamonds|a}} + {{i|Restock|n}} or in [[Greed mode]]:
** {{dlc+|anr}} [[Coins]] can be infinitely generated by buying {{E|Lil' Battery|text=Lil' Batteries}}. As Lil' Batteries only cost 5 coins (need two lil' batteries to reload blank), as long as Isaac starts with at least 21, the maximum of 99 coins can be quickly reached.{{dlc-}}
** {{dlc+|r}} This cannot be repeated infinitely outside of Greed Mode, as '''Restock''' now increases the price of a shop slot each time something is purchased from it. Having 12 coins will very slowly allow Isaac to obtain 99 coins, however.
*** {{i|Deep Pockets}} allows this to once again be repeated infinitely, as the price will cap at 99 coins, while up to 999 coins can be obtained.{{dlc-}}
* {{p|? Card}}: Teleports Isaac to the {{r|I AM ERROR}} room. This will consume both the Blank Card and the ? Card.
** An exception is when they are used on {{s|Chest}}, {{s|Dark Room}}, {{s|The Void}}, {{E|Ultra Greed|dlc=x}}, {{S|Mausoleum}}/{{S|Gehenna}} II leading to [[Ascent]], {{s|Corpse}} II, or {{s|Home}} floors. Using them here consumes both the Blank Card and the ? Card, spawning an I AM ERROR {{E|Shopkeeper}}.
* {{p|Jera|nr}}: Copies pickups with every use. This combination can double {{E|Lil' Battery|text=Lil' Batteries}}, which can allow for game-breaking combos, due to repeated use of the synergy.
** Spawning too many items will cause objects to despawn. This can even despawn the [[Endings|End]] Chest after finishing a final boss fight.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Little Baggy}}: All cards are replaced by pills, rendering Blank Card useless unless Isaac also has {{i|Starter Deck}}.
* {{p|Wild Card}}: Does nothing if used through Blank Card. Wild Card can, however, copy the last card used through Blank Card.

sections.Effects:
* Gives Isaac a chance to shoot fires alongside his regular tears that block enemy shots and deal damage to enemies that touch them, similar to those shot by {{I|Red Candle}}.
** Fires can block up to four shots and/or deal four ticks of damage before being destroyed, and last up to 10 seconds.
** Fires deal 4× Isaac's [[damage]] at full durability, 3× Isaac's damage after taking damage once, and 2× Isaac's damage otherwise, for a max possible damage output of 11× Isaac's damage per fire.
** Any fart-related effect that occurs will also generate a flame, like using {{I|The Poop}} or when generating a bomb with {{I|No. 2}}.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|r+}} This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|Singe}}.{{dlc-}}
* The chance to shoot fires depends on the [[luck]] stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: <math>\min(\frac1 { 12 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \right \rfloor},50\%)</math><ref>https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/15K8Xgxoxdx68AIaxuLXgZoJJlG36UPgy3_aeDpAM5tU/edit?usp=sharing</ref>
** At base luck (0), the chance is 8.33%, maxing out at 50% at 10 luck.
* Flames will destroy {{e|Shopkeeper}}s.
* The size of the flames depends on Isaac's tears size.
* Converts enemies into their fire-like variations, such as a {{E|Clotty}} into a {{E|Grilled Clotty}}.
** A Clotty won't be converted if it's in a wet room, such as those found in the Flooded Caves or the one created by an item such as {{I|Flush!}}
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Butter Bean}} / {{I|Wait What?}} /{{I|The Black Bean}} / {{I|Mega Bean}}: Spawn a fire upon activation.
* {{i|Chocolate Milk}}: As each flame's damage is unaffected by the charge of each tear, a flame-thrower-like effect with very high damage can be achieved with a decent luck stat and rapidly fired low-charge tears.
* {{I|Contagion}}: Creates a fire behind Isaac for each enemy that produces a gas cloud on death.
* {{I|Farting Baby}}: Farts have a chance to spawn a fire.
* {{i|Ghost Pepper}}: Changes the activation rate to <math>\frac1 { 8 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \right \rfloor}</math>
** At base luck (0), the chance is 12.5%, maxing out at 100% at 7 luck. Only one type of fire can be spawned at a time; however, each flame has an equal chance of being launched.
* {{I|Monstro's Lung}}: When releasing the tear barrage, multiple fires are fired.
* {{I|Mucormycosis}}: When a mucormyosis spore explodes, Isaac has a chance to spawn a fire
* {{I|The Poop}}: Creates a fire behind Isaac.
* {{i|Proptosis}}: Size and damage of fires is increased but does not decrease with range.
* {{I|Pupula Duplex}}: The fires and their hitbox get a lot bigger.
* {{i|Urn of Souls}}: Causes the Urn to emit Bird's Eye's red flames in addition to its regular flames.
* Tear-copying [[Familiar]]s like {{I|Incubus}} / {{T|Lil Clot}} / {{I|Evil Eye}}: Don't shoot fires, but make Isaac shoot fires more often.
* {{I|Lil Dumpy}}: Every time Lil Dumpy farts, Isaac emits a flame too.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|Brimstone}}: Will occasionally spawn a fire when firing and with high luck will spawn four fires.
* {{I|The Ludovico Technique}}: Will occasionally shoot fire from Isaac toward the floating tear.
* {{I|20/20}}/{{I|Mutant Spider}}/{{I|The Inner Eye}}: Only one fire spawns at a time.
* {{i|1=Bird's Eye}}: No effect. Will not boost the chances of shooting out a fire like with Ghost Pepper.
* {{I|Dr. Fetus}} / {{I|Tech X}} / {{I|Technology}}: fires spawn when firing.
* {{I|Epic Fetus}}: Fires spawn when moving the crosshair and are launched in the direction of the crosshair similarly to {{i|Marked}}.
* [[Tear Effects#Homing|Homing Tears]]: Fires aren't homing.
* {{I|IBS}}: '''Not Recommended.''' Farts caused by IBS release flames, which will automatically detonate the toxic cloud and hurt Isaac, unless he has explosion immunity. Similarly, stinky poops can explode while held by Isaac if he happens to be near flames when IBS activates
* {{I|Ipecac}}: Fires spawn as normal, but can be hit by ipecac tears, making them especially dangerous.
* {{I|A Lump of Coal}}: No effect on fires.
* {{I|Mom's Knife}}: Fires spawn occasionally when fired.
* {{I|Sprinkler}}: No effect. Sprinkler doesn't shoot fires.
* {{i|Jupiter}}: No effect.

sections.Effects:
* Randomly grants the effect of {{i|Treasure Map}}, {{i|The Compass}}, or {{i|Blue Map}} for the duration of the current [[floor]].
** {{dlc|r}} If all effects are active,  {{i|X-Ray Vision}} is provided for the floor instead.
* Repeated activations will continue to add the other items' effects.
** {{dlc|nr}} The chosen effect on activation may be one that Isaac already has—effectively doing nothing.
** {{dlc|r}} Book of Secrets cannot give mapping effects that Isaac already has (whether from a previous activation or through possessing the equivalent item). After all effects have been given, further activations do nothing.
* {{dlc|r}} Highlights any [[Tinted Rock]]s and rocks with {{R|Crawl Space}} in the room.
* {{transformation contribution|Bookworm}}
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|nr}} Book of Secrets has no effect on floors affected by {{Curse|lost}} or an [[Amnesia]] pill.
* {{dlc|r}} If {{Curse|lost}} or an [[Amnesia]] pill is active on a floor, X-Ray Vision effect is provided immediately.
sections.Synergies:
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns wisps in the middle ring, looking like tiny spinning question marks. The wisps invoke the effect of {{I|Cracked Orb}} when destroyed.}}
* {{i|Car Battery}}:

sections.Effects:
* Grants one Red [[Heart Container]] and fully heals Isaac.
* Item pedestals cycle between the initial item and one of several food items.
* Upon picking up an affected food item, in addition to their normal effects, Isaac gains a temporary +3.6 [[Damage]] boost (which fades over 30 seconds), a permanent boost to 2 [[stat]]s depending on the food item consumed, and a permanent -0.03 speed reduction.
* Affected food items heal 3 Red Hearts instead of 2.
sections.Notes:
* Food items that Binge Eater affects and can cycle between, and their bonuses, include:
** {{i|Breakfast}}: +0.2 [[Shot Speed]], +2.5 [[Range]].
** {{i|Dessert}}: +1.0 [[Damage]], +0.2 [[Shot Speed]].
** {{i|Dinner}}: +0.5 [[Tears]], +0.2 [[Shot Speed]].
** {{i|Lunch}}: +0.5 [[Tears]], +2.5 [[Range]].
** {{i|Midnight Snack}}: +1.0 [[Damage]], +1.0 [[Luck]].
** {{i|Rotten Meat}}: +1.0 [[Damage]], +2.5 [[Range]].
** {{i|A Snack}}: +0.2 [[Shot Speed]], +1.0 [[Luck]].
** {{i|Supper}}: +0.5 [[Tears]], +1.0 [[Luck]].
* All Food items that Isaac has collected before picking up Binge Eater will provide their respective stats, including the -0.03 speed down for each item, but excluding the temporary damage up and extra healing.
* The temporary Damage boost cannot be stacked, and picking up additional food items resets it to +3.6.
* Has no effect on certain items that are required to progress through the game, such as {{i|The Polaroid}}, {{i|Knife Piece 1}}, or {{i|Dad's Note}}.
* No bonuses are granted from other items alluded to be edible, such as {{i|MEAT!}}.
* Removing collected food items or Binge Eater itself will also remove associated stat bonuses.
* Because this affects items in {{r|Devil Room}}s and all of them cost 1 Red Heart Container, Devil Deals can be used as free stat upgrades.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Crooked Penny}} / {{i|Diplopia}}: If an item pedestal is copied while the original item is revealed, it will create an identical cycling pedestal of the same two items. If an item pedestal is copied when the food item is revealed, it will create a non-switching pedestal of the food item only.
* {{i|A Pound of Flesh}}: Food items in {{r|Shop}}s cost 1 Red Heart Container, much like with Devil Deals. If Isaac also has {{i|Restock}}, he is able to gain infinite stats this way.
* {{i|Death Certificate}}: Has no effect on the items in the generated areas.
* {{i|Glitched Crown}}: The food item is added to the end of the cycle for a total of 6 items per pedestal.
* {{i|Sacred Orb}}: The food item is not re-rolled.
* {{c|Jacob and Esau}}: Items will swap between the initial item and food item as normal, but only the brother who picked up Binge Eater gets the additional stat bonuses.
* {{c|Tainted Isaac}} / {{c|Isaac}}'s {{i|Birthright}}: The food item will cycle alongside the original 2 granted by the character, resulting in a total of 3 items per pedestal.
* {{C|Tainted Lazarus}}: In a {{r|Devil Room}}, Tainted Lazarus is effectively able to give items to his inactive form for free by picking up a food item. This will remove one heart container, and then instantly restore it. The mirrored Devil items will remain however, meaning he can use {{i|Flip}} and pick them up as his alternate form for no cost.
* {{C|Tainted Bethany}}: On pick-up, grants 12 blood charges. Increases blood charges gained from food items from 4 to 6.

sections.Effects:
* Enemies spawn 1–2 floating bones on death, which block enemy shots and damage/repel enemies that touch them.
** Bones block 2 shots and/or deal 2 ticks of damage before breaking.

sections.Notes:

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a floating brain [[familiar]] that can be fired towards enemies as a projectile.
** {{dlc|na}}Bob's Brain is fired directly from where Isaac is standing.
** {{dlc|a}}Bob's Brain is fired directly from where it is located in the chain of familiars behind Isaac, making aiming it slightly more difficult.
* If it hits an enemy, it deals 3.5 damage and explodes, further damaging and [[poison]]ing monsters.
** {{dlc|nr}} The explosion deals 60 damage. The poison deals double Isaac's [[Damage]] over time.
** {{dlc|r}} The explosion deals 100 damage. The poison damage is dealt 4 times, inflicting Isaac's Damage per tick.
** {{dlc|r}} The explosion ignores armor.
* The explosion can hurt Isaac, dealing a full heart of damage.
** This can make picking up the item a risky choice, as Bob's Brain will always fire, regardless of whether or not Isaac will be caught in the explosion.
* Once it explodes, it takes a few seconds to re-appear.
* {{transformation contribution|Bob}}
sections.Notes:
* Bob's Brain is affected by most bomb modifiers.
* Bob's Brain only explodes when hitting an enemy, and does not explode upon hitting a fire, poop, or wall. It can destroy poops and fires like normal shots, however.
* Bob's Brain never launches immediately upon entering a room unless a tear-firing key is released and pressed again, or until several seconds have passed.
* If Isaac has multiple copies of Bob's Brain, only one familiar will be active at a given time, with another one firing immediately after the first has exploded or starts to return from a miss.
** {{dlc|na}} Multiple copies of Bob's Brain will float in the same spot in the familiar line.
** {{dlc|a}} Each copy takes up their spot on the familiar line, but only the first one launches out. Respawning brains may end up stacking on top of each other.
* {{dlc|r}} [[Familiar]]s that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Bob's Brain having {{dlc|nr+}} 5th / {{dlc|r+}} 7th priority.
sections.Synergies:

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a [[familiar]] that stabs Isaac at the beginning of each [[floor]] if Isaac has more than a {{e|Half Red Heart}}. This drains as much red health as possible without killing him, leaving a half red heart if Isaac only had red health, or none at all if Isaac has soul/black/bone hearts.
* For the rest of the floor, Isaac gains extra damage and speed for each heart lost. The amount of damage gained this way is quadratic, so each heart lost will provide a bigger bonus than the last.
** The exact formula is about +(0.15 <!-- exactly 20/132.25 --> * HeartsLost ^ 2) [[damage]] and +(0.1 * HeartsLost) [[speed]], where HeartsLost is the total hearts of damage taken from Blood Oath (half a heart counts as 0.5).
sections.Notes:
* Although the animation is only a single stab when the effect is triggered, it's treated as taking damage one time per half heart lost, leading to synergies with items that activate upon taking damage.
* The damage from Blood Oath can be avoided with invincibility, but will not provide any damage and speed increase. That's a useful strategy for the {{chal|Bloody Mary|n}}.
* {{e|Eternal Heart}}s give the health up before Blood Oath stabs Isaac, so the new heart is also drained.
* {{e|Rotten Heart}}s are only counted as half a red heart each.
* If Isaac has only {{e|Rotten Heart}}s, blood oath will leave Isaac at a{{e|Half Red Heart}}, the final rotten heart taken will still give stats equivalent to a {{e|Half Red Heart}} 
**This effect causes {{i|Whore of Babylon}} to trigger unconditionally when Blood Oath is activated 
* {{p|XI - Strength}} can be activated at the start of a floor before Blood Oath triggers to have one more heart counted in the bonus.
* If Isaac has half a red heart or less, the effect will not trigger, even if Isaac has soul/black hearts.
* Blood Oath also drains the health of {{C|Keeper}} / {{C|Tainted Keeper}}, leaving their health at one coin heart.
* The damage caused by Blood Oath does not lower the chance for a {{R|Devil Room}} or {{R|Angel Room}} to appear.
* While playing as {{c|The Forgotten}}, red health will not be drained if {{c|The Soul}} is being controlled when Blood Oath triggers.
* If Blood Oath is removed (such as with {{c|Tainted Isaac}}), any existing damage and speed bonuses will remain until the next floor.
** The damage and speed bonuses '''are''' removed after defeating {{E|The Lamb}} and refusing a [[Victory Lap]], or upon coming back from obtaining {{i|Knife Piece 2}}.
* [[Familiar]]s that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Blood Oath having the lowest priority at 6th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.
* The maximum achievable amounts of stats are +20 damage and +1.15 speed if starting the floor with 12 filled normal red hearts (of which only 11.5 are drained), or +21.8 and +1.2 if there is at least one {{e|Bone Heart}} (which allows all hearts to be drained).
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Adrenaline}}: Activates the damage up effect of Adrenaline for the resulting empty heart containers at the start of each floor.
* {{I|BFFS!}}: Adds 2 full hearts' worth of bonuses if any health is drained at all, e.g. losing 1 heart gives the bonuses of 3 hearts. This allows for up to 14 hearts' worth of bonuses.
** 14 hearts' bonus gives +29.6 damage and +1.4 Speed.
* [[:Category:Damage-triggered items|Damage-triggered items]]: Activate a number of times equal to the total half hearts drained.
** Does ''not'' activate the {{T|Panic Button}} trinket.
** {{i|Bozo}}: Each half-heart lost has a chance of spawning a rainbow poop, allowing for full red heart regeneration.
** {{i|Fanny Pack}}: Each half-heart lost has a chance of spawning a pickup, which can include hearts.
** {{i|Gimpy}} / {{i|Old Bandage}} / {{i|Shard of Glass}}: Each half-heart lost has a chance of spawning a full red/soul heart, allowing Isaac to heal back some of the damage immediately if he has high luck or a large amount of hearts lost.
** {{i|Scapular}}: Gives Isaac a soul heart if he had only red heart containers upon entering a floor.
* {{C|Magdalene}} + {{I|Birthright}}: With full Red Health, Magdalene can achieve up to +46.3 damage and +1.75 speed, and up to +49 and +1.8 with at least one heart being a Bone Heart.
* {{t|Myosotis}}: Can transport {{e|Red Heart}}s left on the previous floor, allowing early healing from the damage of Blood Oath.
* {{i|The Jar}}: Red hearts can be stored for use on the next floor.
* {{i|Placenta}}: With enough patience, health can be safely restored each floor by waiting in the starting room.
* {{T|Stem Cell}}: The healing occurs before health is drained, allowing for a greater stat bonus.
*{{i|Sol}}: Fills all empty heart containers upon defeating a boss, maximizing potential stat bonuses. 
* {{i|Whore of Babylon}}: Activates the Whore of Babylon effect at the start of each floor.
*{{I|Gnawed Leaf}} / {{i|Tooth and Nail}}: Effectively give Isaac the choice to trigger Blood Oath, by either standing still at the start of the floor or by immediately moving with {{i|Gnawed Leaf}}, or by timing going to the next floor right before {{i|Tooth and Nail}} triggers (at about the third "tick" before triggering).
sections.Interactions:

* {{i|Curse of the Tower}}:  Not recommended. Spawns 6 troll bombs for each half heart removed, typically filling the starting room with troll bombs.
*[[Temporary Buffs#Invulnerability|Invulnerability]], [[Temporary Buffs#Shield|Shield]], & [[Temporary Buffs#Statue|Statue]] Effects: Prevent Blood Oath from triggering, causing health to not drain and no bonuses being given 
**Active items or consumables that trigger these effects can be triggered at the start of the floor to prevent Blood Oath from triggering if desired

sections.Effects:
* Upon use, spawns a wisp that orbits Isaac and fires small [[spectral]] tears alongside him. The wisps can block shots and deal contact damage to enemies, but take damage when doing so and will be destroyed when enough damage is taken.
** When a wisp is destroyed, the sound of fire being extinguished plays.
*** A normal wisp is white and blue, has 2 health and spectral tears which deal 3 damage, and is summoned in the middle ring.
*** A wisp's health can be represented by its size, shrinking as its health decreases.
*** Most wisps deal contact damage equal to 2x Isaac's [[damage]]. Doing damage this way usually destroys the wisp unless Isaac is [[invulnerability|invulnerable]].
** Multiple wisps can exist at once. Some combinations have an upper limit of 26 wisps: an inner counterclockwise ring of 6, a middle clockwise ring with 8, and an outer counterclockwise ring of 12.
* If another active item is picked up, Book of Virtues will become a passive item that causes active items to spawn wisps when used, often with [[Wisps.xml|special effects]].
* While held, changes the first {{r|Devil Room}} encountered to be an {{r|Angel Room}}, and increases the chance of an Angel Room appearing by 25%.
** Allows for Angel Rooms to appear even if a Deal with the Devil was taken before.
* {{transformation contribution|Bookworm}}
sections.Notes:
* It is the only passive item in the [[Library (Item Pool)|Library pool]].
** If Isaac walks into a library for the first time with {{t|NO!}}, The Book of Virtues is very likely to appear.
** Because of this, when acquired from a library, the book cannot be rerolled by use of the {{i|D4}}, {{i|D100}}, a {{r|Dice Room}}, or getting hit as {{c|Tainted Eden}}.
* Whenever Isaac is [[invulnerability|invulnerable]], the wisps are as well, but can still deal contact damage.
* Summoning a wisp while at the maximum will replace the most damaged wisp.
* While having 100% chance of {{r|Angel Room}} discovery, Isaac will not get teleported to a {{r|Devil Room}} by using some items which allow it. Instead, he will be teleported to the Angel Room, keeping his 100% chance of discovering an Angel Room. This can be used to get to the Angel Room on the first floor, where Devil/Angel Rooms do not naturally spawn, and still keep the 100% chance for the next floor.
* This item's passive effects also apply to active items in the consumable slot. (e.g. {{c|Tainted Bethany}}'s {{i|Lemegeton}}, {{c|Tainted Jacob}}'s {{i|Anima Sola}}, dice from {{t|Dice Bag}}, etc.)
* While the item can function as both passive and active item, it is treated as a passive item by {{t|NO!}}, {{i|Void}}, and {{p|XVII - The Stars?|n}}.
* This item is displayed in the Extra HUD as a passive item.
** It will take up one of {{c|Tainted Isaac}}'s limited item slots.
sections.Synergies:
* {{t|Baby-Bender}}: Wisps gain homing tears.
* {{i|BFFS!}}: Increases the tear size and doubles the damage of wisps.
* {{Book of Belial synergy|description=Can be stacked along with The Book of Belial, allowing you to carry 2 passive books and an activated item on top of them.}}
* {{t|'M}}: If an active item is combined with the Book, only the active item is rerolled; the Book remains unchanged. If no active item is combined with the Book, the Book will be rerolled on use. 'M also cannot give Book of Virtues from rerolling other items, as it is considered a passive item.

sections.Interactions:

* {{i|Void}}: Book of Virtues is considered to be a passive item, so stat boosts will be gained by using Void on it and further uses of Void will not have the Book's effects.

* {{dlc|r+}} Grants larger explosions and deal 185 damage instead of 100 similar to {{I|Mr. Mega}}.

* {{dlc|r+}} Destroying {{e|Fire Place}}s causes them to explode.
** Explosions from destroyed fire places do not hurt Isaac.
sections.Notes:
* The trail of black powder left on the floor will quickly disappear, meaning that there is an effective limit to the size of the pentagram that can be created, though bigger pentagrams can be created if the player has higher movement speed.
* The traced pattern does not have to be perfectly circular; closed shapes such as squares or very narrow crescents will work.
sections.Interactions: * {{t|Lost Cork|a+nr}}: Although the powder trail is wider in appearance, it has no effect on how easily a valid shape is determined.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Ventricle Razor}}: When the Ventricle Razor portals are placed on the opposite wall of a room and Isaac goes from one portal to another repeatedly, a pentagram symbol can be created which covers almost the whole room.
* {{I|How to Jump}}: Jumping can create large pentagrams by drawing a rectangle.
* {{i|Spin to Win}}: Faster movement speed while using spin to win allows for larger pentagrams to be created.

sections.Effects:
* Grants 5 {{e|Bomb}}s.
* Causes bombs to explode in a large cross-shaped blast by adding two additional explosions in each cardinal direction.
** The damage for a single explosion is {{dlc|nr}} unchanged (60) {{dlc|r}} 0.75x times its normal damage (resulting in 75 damage per explosion). Each successive explosion that hits the same enemy has its damage halved.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|nr}} The damage per successive explosion is: 60, 30, 15, 7.5, 3.75, 1.875, 0.9375, 0.46875, 0.234375.
* {{dlc|r}} The damage per successive explosion is: 75, 37.5, 18.75, 9.375, 4.6875, 2.34375, 1.171875, 0.5859375, 0.29296875.
** {{i|Mr. Mega}} changes the explosions' base damage to {{dlc|nr}}110/{{dlc|r}}185, with the same damage reductions as above.
* With Bomber Boy, [[Bedroom]]s, [[Rocks#Super Special Rocks|Super Special Rocks]], and the {{s|Mines}} can be accessed with a single bomb.
* Bombing the {{e|Donation Machine}} will cause a greater than normal amount of coins to drop from the Donation Machine.
** The total amount of dropped coins is still deducted from the Donation Machine, however.
* {{dlc|na+}} Bombing a {{E|Blue Fire Place}} or {{E|Purple Fire Place}} may cause it to drop multiple {{e|Soul Heart}}s.
* {{dlc|r}} Bombs are colored blue and no longer have a skull on them.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|BBF|nr}}/{{i|Best Friend}}/{{i|Bob's Brain}}/{{dlc|a+nr}}[[Locust|Red Locusts]]: Explosion damage is halved with no additional explosions.
** {{i|BBF|r}}/{{i|Best Friend}}/{{i|Bob's Brain}}/{{i|Mr. Boom}}/{{dlc|r}}[[Locust|Red Locusts]]: Bomber Boy affects the item’s explosion.
*** Red Locusts will create additional smaller explosions that spawn in a tight cross formation.
* {{I|Pyromaniac}}: Heals Isaac multiple times per bomb depending on the number of explosions that hit him.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}}: Bomber Boy affects the bombs fired by Dr. Fetus.
* {{i|Doctor's Remote|r}}/{{i|Epic Fetus}}: Bomber Boy affects the missiles' explosions from Epic Fetus, with the explosions' multiplier resulting in 15 times Isaac's damage per explosion. Unlike with regular bombs, Bomber Boy won't decrease the damage from each of the missile's successive explosions, drastically increasing damage.
* {{i|Hot Bombs}}: Each extra explosion creates an additional fire.
* {{i|Mr. Mega}}: All explosions deal more damage, have a larger radius and will overlap each other more, potentially vastly increasing damage. Caution should be exercised, as the explosions' increased radius make self-damage likely.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Anarchist Cookbook}}/{{i|Curse of the Tower}}/{{p|XVI - The Tower}}: Not recommended. The cross pattern explosion makes it very hard to avoid taking damage.
* {{i|Bob's Rotten Head}}: No effect.
* {{t|Blasting Cap}}: The extra explosions cannot drop bomb pickups.
* {{i|Epic Fetus|nr}}: Epic Fetus explosions are unaffected.
* {{i|Glitter Bombs|nr}}: Each additional explosion created has a chance to spawn a pickup or trinket.
** {{i|Glitter Bombs|r}}: Extra explosions are unaffected by Glitter Bombs.
* {{i|Ipecac}}: Ipecac explosions are unaffected.
* {{i|Sad Bombs|anr}}: Each explosion releases 10 tears in all directions.
** {{dlc|r}}{{i|Sad Bombs}}: Only the center-most explosion creates 10 tears.

sections.Notes: * [[Familiar]]s that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Boiled Baby having the lowest priority at {{dlcalt|6th|r+=8th}} and thus staying the farthest away from Isaac when compared to other familiars with higher priorities.

sections.Effects:
* Upon use, Isaac holds a [[poison]] {{e|Bomb}} over his head which can be thrown in the cardinal directions and explodes on impact.
** The bomb can fly across the room for 9.5 tiles before falling to the ground and exploding.
** {{dlc|nr}} The explosion deals a flat 50 + Isaac's [[Damage|tear damage]] and poisons affected [[monster]]s.
** {{dlc|r}} The explosion deals a flat 185 + Isaac's tear damage and leaves behind a gas cloud that poisons affected monsters. The poison cloud deals 5 damage.
** {{dlc|na}} The poison deals 6 or 8 points of damage over time.
** {{dlc|a}} The poison deals 3 times Isaac's tear damage over time.
* {{transformation contribution|Bob}}
sections.Notes:
* This item can drop from killing {{E|Sloth}}. {{dlc|nr}} Sloth can drop this item even if Isaac has already encountered/possessed it. 
* Bob's Rotten Head is affected by many tear modifiers and some bomb modifiers. Notable exceptions and precautions are listed below.
* Bob's Rotten Head passes through {{e|Beggar}}s, {{e|Slot Machine}}s, or {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}s, but can destroy them with the blast damage if it impacts anything nearby.
* Can open open {{R|Secret Room}}s, {{R|Super Secret Room}}s, or destroy [[rock]]s like any other bomb.
* Certain interactions require Flat Stone to be effective or work.
sections.Interactions:
* {{t|Bob's Bladder}} / {{i|Bobby-Bomb}} / {{i|Bomber Boy}} / {{i|Fast Bombs}} / {{i|Rocket in a Jar}} / {{i|Scatter Bombs}} / {{i|Mr. Mega}}: No effect.
* {{i|Bob's Curse}}:
** {{dlc|nr}} No effect.
** {{dlc|r}} The explosion leaves behind a poison cloud.
* {{I|Blood Bombs}}: Bob's Rotten Head leaves a pool of [[red creep]] on the ground after each explosion.
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns wisps in the middle ring. The wisps shoot arcing green tears with decreased range, with a 7.5% chance of firing an explosive, poisonous tear.}}
* {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.
* {{i|Compound Fracture}}: Spawns 1-3 smaller heads that explodes for half the damage of the bigger one.
* {{i|Continuum}}:
** {{dlc|anr}} Bob's Rotten Head can now travel through walls and appear out of the opposite wall, similar to a portal-type mechanic.
** {{dlc|r}} No longer travels through the wall; instead he bounces off it, like with {{i|Rubber Cement}}, and then travels for the rest of its duration at a slower speed and then explodes.
* {{i|Cricket's Body}}: Spawns four smaller heads that explode for half the damage of the bigger one.
* {{i|Explosivo}} / {{i|Sticky Bombs}}:
** {{dlc|anr}} If Bob's Rotten Head sticks to an enemy (sometimes with Explosivo, always with Sticky Bombs), the explosion is delayed but will deal 110 damage.
** {{dlc|r}} No longer sticks to monsters.
* {{i|Eye of the Occult}}: Isaac can control the mid-flight direction of the head, however its air-time is not increased.
* {{i|Flat Stone|r}}: Will cause Bob's Rotten Head to bounce once, exploding twice and leaving two gas clouds.
* {{I|Fire Mind}}: Creates fire when the head lands.
* {{I|Godhead}}: Creates a Godhead aura around the head and applies homing effect when thrown.
* {{I|Haemolacria}}: When the head lands, tears are fired.
* {{I|Holy Light}}: Has a chance to throw a Holy Light head that spawns a damaging beam of light dealing ({{Dlc|nr}}4x) {{dlc|r}}3x the explosion damage when it hits an enemy.
* [[Homing]] tears: Homing is applied to the thrown head as well.
* {{dlc|nr}} [[Spectral]] tears: The head will pass through obstacles and walls, meaning it will no longer destroy obstacles or open secret rooms on impact. They can still be opened if the user stands back far enough to let the thrown head run out of range.
** {{dlc|r}} The head will slightly bounce off of walls with spectral tears. It still passes through obstacles.
* {{i|Lachryphagy}}: The head act as a tear, dividing itself if enough time has passed and interacting with other tears. The five heads coming from the main head deal half damage. Feeding a head with another increases damage by the amount of damage Isaac has. If a tear is fed with a head, the tear will gain the head's damage.
* {{i|The Parasite}}: Causes two smaller tears to appear that explodes for half the damage of the head. Tears do not look like the normal head.
* {{i|Rubber Cement}}: Causes the head to bounce off of [[rock]]s and walls.
* {{i|Tiny Planet}}: When used, Bob's Rotten Head will orbit the player similar to a tear.
* {{i|Trisagion}}:
** {{dlc|a+nr}} '''Not recommended''' as it explodes multiple times before reaching its target, dealing explosive damage and knockback to Isaac.
** {{dlc|r}} Shoots a white blast of light instead of the head that pierces through monsters, and causing explosions when it contacts an enemy (if not killing it at the first tick), an obstacle, or when it runs out of range. One tick of the beam deals 33% of Bob's Rotten Head's damage to monsters, but the resulting explosion every tick deals full damage.
* {{I|Uranus}}: Monsters are frozen when dying to Bob's Rotten Head.
* [[:Category:Worm trinkets|Worm trinkets]]: Bob's Rotten Head is affected by [[trinket]]s like {{t|Hook Worm}} and {{t|Wiggle Worm}} the same way tears are.

sections.Effects:
* Grants immunity to floor [[curse]]s.
** Will immediately remove any curses on the current floor except {{curse|labyrinth}}.
* Grants a {{E|Black Heart}} upon pickup.
* Increases chance for a {{R|Devil Room}} / {{R|Angel Room}} to open by 15%.
sections.Notes:
* Picking up this item during {{chal|Cursed!}} will not remove the {{curse|cursed}}.
* Picking up this item during {{chal|Pitch Black}} will not remove the {{curse|darkness}} or {{curse|unknown}}.
* {{dlc+|a+}} Picking up this item during {{chal|Ultra Hard}} will not remove '''any''' of the curses.{{dlc-}}
* Picking up this item while under the effect of an Amnesia [[pill]] or ??? pill will remove the effect of the pill. However, the item does not negate the effects of Amnesia or ??? pills used after picking up this item.
* Picking up this item can affect whether [[Level Generation|Floor Generation]] chooses between 2 or 3 added rooms in [[Hard mode]] which can cause room content to change for affected floors.
* {{dlc|r}} Picking up this item does not make the second item in alt floor treasure rooms visible.
* {{dlc|r}} Doesn't remove {{curse|darkness}} afflicted by {{p|XIX - The Sun?|n}}, no matter if Black Candle was picked up before or after using the card.
sections.Synergies:
* {{t|Black Feather}}: Grants a damage boost.
* {{dlc|a}}{{i|Cursed Eye}}: Removes teleportation effect of Cursed Eye.
* {{T|Cursed Penny}}: Prevents the teleport effect from triggering for all coins except the still-stuck Sticky Nickel.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a [[familiar]] that drops a {{e|Bomb}} every 3 rooms.
** The first drop happens after 2 rooms.
** The bomb dropped can be a  {{e|Double Bomb}}, {{e|Troll Bomb}}, {{e|Mega Troll Bomb}}, {{e|Golden Bomb}}, or a {{E|Golden Troll Bomb}}.
sections.Notes: * {{dlc|r}} [[Familiar]]s that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Bomb Bag having the lowest priority at {{dlc|nr+}} 6th / {{dlc|r+}} 8th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.
sections.Synergies: * {{i|BFFS!}}: The familiar drops bombs in a repeating pattern of 2, 2 then 3 rooms.

sections.Effects:
* [[Damage]] increases as Isaac receives damage. The damage increase stays for the whole floor, but resets upon entering a new floor.
** {{dlc|nr}} The first three times Isaac is hit, his damage is increased by 0.5. The next three times Isaac is hit, his damage is increased by 33%.
*** {{dlc|r}} Damage is increased by flat amounts: +0.5 for the first hit and an additional +0.2 for each hit, until +1.5 at the sixth. The maximum total is +6.0.
** Any damage taken past the sixth hit does not further increase damage.
* Isaac becomes redder as his damage increases.
sections.Notes: * {{C|Samson}} starts with this item by default.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Blood Rights}} / {{i|Razor Blade}} / {{i|IV Bag}}: The damage from the items count for the stats up.
* {{i|Birthright}} + {{C|Samson}}: Birthright allows him to gain 4 more damage boosts at the same +0.2 intervals, for a new maximum total of +14.0.
* {{i|Dull Razor}}: Safely provides the damage boost without needing to take damage.
sections.Interactions:
* '''Bloody Lust''': No effect, damage up still caps at +6 and increases at the same intervals.
* {{I|Bloody Gust}}: Bloody Lust's "rage" effect is shared with Bloody Gust, so if Isaac picks up Bloody Gust after already getting hit with Bloody Lust (or vice versa) the boosts will automatically update to that level.

sections.Effects:
* Upon use, Isaac throws a black hole that lands on the ground and forcefully sucks in enemies and their shots, which lasts for about 6 seconds.
** It deals 0.4 damage per tick very rapidly to enemies in the area, for a maximum of 6 damage per second.
** Isaac and pickups are slightly sucked towards the black hole.
** Nearby [[obstacle]]s are occasionally destroyed by the black hole.
sections.Synergies: * {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns black wisps on the middle ring. Wisps' tears have the {{I|Strange Attractor}} effect.}}
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.
* {{i|Gnawed Leaf}}: The black hole does not pull Isaac in while he is a statue.

sections.Effects:
* +0.1 flat [[damage]].
* Grants a {{e|Soul Heart}}.
* Enemies may randomly become briefly [[charm]]ed or [[fear]]ed.
* Taking damage has a 5% chance to spawn {{g|Rainbow Poop}}.
sections.Notes: * None of the above effects are affected by [[luck]].
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Blood Oath}}: Each half-heart lost has a chance of spawning a rainbow poop, allowing for full red heart regeneration.
* {{I|IV Bag}}: Each use has a chance of spawning a rainbow poop.
* With max red hearts, {{I|The Wafer}}, and careful timing to get the maximum healing from each rainbow poop, Isaac's effective health pool could be extremely high.
