sections.Notes:
* Birthright effects are stackable when playing as {{c|Tainted Lost}} and {{c|Tainted Bethany}}.
* Each additional copy of Birthright for {{c|Magdalene}}, {{c|Tainted Magdalene}}, and {{c|Keeper}} will add another heart container; however, their respective health caps will not be raised any further. {{c|Cain}} will also gain +1 Luck for each copy of Birthright.
* When {{c|Magdalene}} or {{C|Keeper}} enter the area in which {{I|Knife Piece 2}} can be acquired, all hearts above the usual cap are removed and are not restored upon leaving the area. Additional hearts can be regained afterwards.
* While playing as {{c|Tainted Cain}} in Greed Mode, purchasing an on-sale item over and over while having Birthright results in almost infinite consumables.
* If {{c|The Soul}} enters a new floor with Birthright, swapping back to {{c|The Forgotten}} will cause him to appear at The Soul's current location.
* This item can drop from killing {{E|Super Sloth}}. {{dlc|nr}} Super Sloth can drop this item even if Isaac has already encountered/possessed it.

sections.Effects:
* {{dlc|nr}} When used, spawns one of the following for each enemy already killed in the current room (capped at 8): ** 80% chance for an orbital bone familiar. ** 20% chance for a [[friendly]] bone monster. *** 66% chance for a {{e|Bony}}. *** 33% chance for a {{e|Black Bony}}. * {{dlc+|r}} When used, spawns one of the following for each enemy already killed in the current room (capped at 8): ** 80% chance for an orbital bone familiar. ** 20% chance for a friendly bone monster. *** The bone monster starts as a {{e|Bony}}. *** The Bony has a 25% chance to become a {{e|Black Bony}}. *** The Bony or Black Bony has a 25% chance to become a {{e|Big Bony}} if a killed enemy has enough HP to meet the formula:
baseHP + floor * stageHP * min(floor, 10) * 0.81 on floor 4+. > 18 + floor * 3 * min(floor, 10) * 0.8 *** The Bony, Black Bony, or Big Bony has a 25% chance to become a {{e|Bone Fly}}. *** The Bony, Black Bony, Big Bony, or Bone Fly has a 1% chance to become a {{e|Revenant}}. *** There is an additional 8.33% chance for the bone monster to become a Revenant on {{s|Mausoleum}} / {{s|Gehenna}} / {{s|Sheol}} / {{s|Dark Room}}.{{dlc-}} * {{dlc|rnr+}} Spawning an enemy other than a Bony/Black Bony is only possible after dying at least once to said enemy on the save file. * {{transformation contribution|Bookworm}}
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|r+}} This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|The Forsaken}}.{{dlc-}}
* Orbital bones deal contact damage equal to Isaac's damage at the time it was spawned and repel enemies that touch them.
** {{dlc|nr}} They block 3 shots or deal 2 ticks of contact damage before being destroyed.
** {{dlc|r}} They block 1 shot or deal 2 ticks of contact damage before being destroyed.
* {{dlc|nr}} Bonies deal 5 contact damage and 5 damage with thrown bones.
* {{dlc|r}} Bonies deal 8.7 contact damage and 6 damage with thrown bones.
* Black Bonies will explode on death, dealing 40 damage to enemies it hits. The explosion will not hurt Isaac. {{dlc|nr}} It will knock him back.
* Internally, the book tracks up to 32 positions each enemy was killed at in the current room, and uses those locations as spawn points for bone orbitals and Bonies.
** Using the book will always spawn at least 1, gives the rest a 66% chance for each location to spawn one, and can spawn up to 8 per use.
*** Having more locations than 8 will effectively increase the odds to spawn each.
*** If one of these locations doesn't spawn a bone orbital or Bony, it can still spawn one if the book is used in the same room without leaving. However, once a location spawns something, it cannot do so again.
* Using the book in a room that had no enemies or was re-entered does nothing and expends the charge.
* Orbital bones occupy the same area around Isaac as [[Blue Fly|Blue Flies]], meaning Isaac can have an incredibly dense ring of bone orbitals around him that nullifies most attacks.
* Non-hostile NPCs such as friendly enemies and {{e|Shopkeeper}}s can also provide bone orbitals and Bonies when killed or destroyed.
* {{dlc|nr}} Destroying {{g|Black Poop}} will damage the friendly monsters acquired from this item.
* {{dlc+|r}} Frozen enemies (enemies killed by {{I|Uranus}}, {{I|Cube Baby}}, etc.) will not summon bone familiars unless their frozen bodies are shattered.{{dlc-}}
sections.Synergies:
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns tiny skull wisps on the inner ring. The wisps fire bones and spawn friendly Bonies when destroyed. The book will summon wisps regardless of whether or not there were enemies killed in the current room.}}
* {{i|Car Battery}}: Gives a higher chance to spawn bone orbitals or friendly enemies, and can spawn up to 16 per use.
sections.Interactions:
* {{dlc|r}}[[Cards and Runes|Ace Cards]]: Friendly monsters are still affected by Ace Cards and enemies that are turned into pickups can't be animated.
* {{t|Baby-Bender}}: No effect.
* {{i|Blood Puppy}}: Either angry version of Blood Puppy will target friendly enemies as well and can drag them along with it when it charges them. Blood Puppy cannot damage friendly enemies however friendly enemies can damage Blood Puppy despite not targeting it outright.
* {{i|Broken Modem}}: Broken Modem also affects friendly enemies and projectiles created by them.
* {{dlc|nr}} {{I|Contagion}}: [[Poison]] effect can spread to and kill friendly {{E|Bony|text=Bonies}}.
* {{i|E. Coli}} / {{i|Flush!}}: Enemies that are turned into poop can't be animated.
* {{I|Eraser}}: Bonies erased via Eraser will never spawn again from Book of the Dead, greatly decreasing its power.
* {{dlc+|r}} {{I|Ghost Bombs}} / {{i|Hungry Soul}} / {{I|Purgatory}} / {{i|Vade Retro}}: Explosions from ghosts can and will kill Bonies.{{dlc-}}

sections.Effect:
* Summons an [[orbital familiar]] eye that deals contact damage and occasionally fires tears that deal 3.5 damage. {{dlc|r}} It also blocks enemy shots.
** {{dlc|nr}} The eye deals 2 contact damage per tick or 30 contact damage per second. Tears are fired once every 2 seconds in the direction its currently facing.
** {{dlc|r}} The eye deals 2 contact damage per tick or 20 contact damage per second. It shoots a tear once every 1/3rd of a second as long as an enemy is in its line of sight.
sections.Notes:
* The orbital's tears can knock Isaac's {{e|Bomb}}s around.
* {{dlc|nr}} Unlike other orbitals, the eye does not block enemy shots.
* {{Dlc|nr}} Bloodshot Eye can override [[Pretty Fly|Pretty Flies]] without giving protection from enemy shots.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a [[familiar]] that chases nearby enemies and deals 2 contact damage to them per tick (~8.57 per second).
* After killing 15 enemies, Blood Puppy becomes angry, and changes in the following ways:
** Deals 7.5 damage per tick instead of 2 (15 per second, or 90 per second while charging).
** Charges at enemies that are aligned with it in the cardinal directions.
*** If Blood Puppy charges into a live {{e|Bomb}}, it will get caught on its mouth, preventing it from moving until it explodes.
** Drops a {{e|Half Red Heart}} for every 10 enemies it kills.
** Will also try to attack Isaac, dealing a half heart of contact damage to him.
** Can be damaged by Isaac, returning it to normal after it takes enough damage. Blood Puppy has 20 health and 90 [[armor]] (effective health is ~140-180).
* After getting 25 more kills (40 total), the angry version evolves, gaining the following modifications:
** Becomes much larger and deals 15 damage per tick instead of 7.5 (30 per second, or 180 per second while charging).
** Destroys [[obstacle]]s it runs into while charging.
** Deals a full heart of damage to Isaac instead of half a heart.
** Drops a {{e|Red Heart}} after every 10 kills instead of a half red heart.
** Has 50 health instead of 20 (effective health is ~400-500).
* Each boss killed by Blood Puppy counts as killing 4 enemies.
sections.Notes:
* Blood Puppy appears in the [[Bestiary]] as a type of monster if Isaac turns it back to normal after it becomes angry. This is required to complete the Bestiary.
* Blood Puppy is not targeted by other familiars while it is angry.
** [[Blue Fly|Blue Flies]] and other familiars that deal contact damage will still damage Blood Puppy if they happen to collide.
** {{i|Mr. ME!}} will target Blood Puppy if the crosshair targets nothing and there are no enemies in the room, and has a chance to do so if there are enemies in the room.
* Since {{e|Bomb}}s ignore armor, a single bomb will tame the Blood Puppy.
* Stages 2 and 3 of Blood Puppy are an enemy for all intents and purposes, similar to {{E|Dark Esau}}. This means it can be affected by, for example, the slow effect of {{i|Broken Watch}}.
* Friendly Blood Puppies will spawn beside Isaac when he enters a new room, while hostile ones will spawn in the middle or opposite ends of the room.
* Once a hostile Blood Puppy spawns, it might start targeting Isaac, ignoring any enemies it may have spawned on top of. This can be dangerous, as you may unexpectedly get cornered from multiple sides right as you enter a room.
* Starting the {{e|Mega Satan}} or {{e|Dogma}} fight while Blood Puppy is angry can be dangerous, as it will let Blood Puppy attack Isaac while he is unable to move during the boss's spawning animation.
* {{e|Level 2 Willo}} will orbit angry Blood Puppy.
sections.Interactions:
* {{dlc|nr+}} {{p|Ace of Spades}} / {{p|Ace of Clubs}} / {{p|Ace of Diamonds}} / {{p|Ace of Hearts}}: Using them on an angry Blood Puppy will create the respective pickup and tame it.
* {{i|BFFS!}}: Only increases the size and damage of Blood Puppy during its first phase.
* {{I|Box of Friends}}: Spawns another tamed Blood Puppy.
* {{I|C Section}}: C Section babies do not home on angry Blood Puppy.
* {{I|Camo Undies}}: While the camo effect is active, stages 2 and 3 of Blood Puppy will not target Isaac, but will still target other enemies.
* {{i|Eraser}}: Using Eraser on Blood Puppy while it's angry will permanently prevent it from advancing to the erased phase. Using it on phase two will prevent it from becoming angry altogether.
* {{I|Flush!}}: Using Flush! will instantly tame an angry Blood Puppy and create a {{g|Poop}}.
* [[Freeze]] effects: "Killing" an angry Blood Puppy by freezing it will cause it to stay frozen until Isaac touches it or leaves the room, causing the frozen Blood Puppy to revert back to its tamed phase.
* {{I|Friendly Ball}}: Using the ball on an angered Blood Puppy will instantly tame it. Using the ball again results in a purely cosmetic blood explosion.
* [[Friendly]] enemies: Either angry version of Blood Puppy will target friendly enemies as well and can drag them along with it when it charges them. Blood Puppy cannot damage friendly enemies; however, friendly enemies can damage Blood Puppy despite not targeting it outright.
* {{i|GB Bug}}: Hitting Blood Puppy with GB Bug will transform it into a random enemy and spawn a tamed Blood Puppy.
* {{i|God's Flesh}}: If an angry Blood Puppy is shot with a God's Flesh tear, Isaac can instantly change it back to a tamed Blood Puppy by touching it.
* {{I|Humbleing Bundle}}: Allows an angry Blood Puppy to drop {{e|Double Heart}}s.
* {{i|Meat Cleaver}}: If Blood Puppy is angry, splits it into two copies. One copy can level up and be tamed like normal, but the other cannot level up and dies instead of being tamed.
* {{i|Spider Mod}}: An angry Blood Puppy can be inflicted with a random [[status effect]] if the spider comes into contact with it.
** Status effects will persist through multiple rooms.
* Using Horse Pill Pheromones on angry Blood Puppy will make it friendly until it becomes angrier or dies, preventing it from dealing damage to Isaac.

sections.Effects:
* Visually increases the size of all [[familiar]]s by 25%, and improves the effectiveness of most of them.
** Doubles the damage of Familiars that deal damage through tears and contact damage.
*** Has no effect on [[Creep]] generated by familiars.
** For pickup-generating familiars, increases the frequency that they drop pickups.
*** Familiars that require clearing a certain number of rooms will require one less room.
*** Familiars that have a random chance to drop items have a higher chance.
*** Familiars that pick up consumables require less, except {{i|Dark Bum}} which is unaffected.
** Some familiars have unique synergies.
sections.Notes:
* The size change is only cosmetic: familiars' hitbox for blocking damage or attacking is not affected.
* Familiars summoned by a [[trinket]] or by {{i|Monster Manual}} are also affected by BFFS!.
** {{dlc|r}}Wisps are also affected by BFFS!.
* [[Blue Fly|Blue Flies]] and [[Blue Spider]]s are not affected, they instead benefit from {{i|Hive Mind}}.
* Does not increase the frequency or effectiveness of [[status effect]]s applied by familiars.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|BBF}}/{{i|Bob's Brain}}: Doubles impact damage and increases explosive damage by 25.
* {{I|Bird Cage}}: Spawns 4 rock waves in an x pattern. Doubles the damage when the bird lands and doubles contact damage. Damage of waves unaffected.
* {{i|Blood Oath}}: Adds 2 extra full hearts worth of bonuses if any health is drained.
* {{dlc|r}}{{I|Holy Water}}: Double water damage and spawns a blue flame at point of impact.
* {{i|Incubus}}: Shoots tears that do {{dlcalt|2x|r=1.5x}} Isaac's damage. Still deals 2x as {{C|Lilith|n}}.
* {{dlc|r}}{{i|Isaac's Heart}}: Fires additional shots in random directions and leaves a larger puddle of creep. Does not change the heart's size.
* {{i|Juicy Sack}}: Spawns an extra Blue Spider.
* {{i|Lil Spewer}}: Increases the creep pool's size, but not its damage.
* {{I|Lost Soul}}: Gives the Lost Soul a {{I|Holy Mantle}} effect.
* {{i|Mystery Egg}}: Spawns a champion variant of an enemy, even if the enemy normally can't be a champion.
* {{i|Stitches}}: On use, fires eight tears from Isaac's original location. The tears synergize with Isaac's tear effects.
* {{I|Succubus}}: The aura's radius increases, but the damage multiplier and damage to enemies remain the same.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Blood Puppy}}: Only increases the damage and size while it isn't hostile.
* {{i|Evil Eye}}: The eyes are not treated as familiars and therefore will not synergize with BFFS!
* {{i|Guillotine}}/{{i|Scissors}}: Doesn't change the head's size, but still improves its damage.
* {{dlc|r}}{{I|Hive Mind}}: Does not stack.
* {{i|Shade}}: Retains the increased damage even after being absorbed.

sections.Effects:
* When Isaac takes damage, he gains [[Speed]] and [[Fire Rate]] for the rest of the floor.
** Speed gained per hit is (0.04x previous hits taken) +0.07.
** Fire Rate gained per hit is (0.1x previous hits taken) + 0.25.
*** Both effects stack up to six times, for a total of +1.02 speed and +3 fire rate.
*** Fire rate bonuses can exceed the normal maximum fire rate limit.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Blood Rights}} / {{i|Razor Blade}} / {{i|IV Bag}}: The damage from the item counts for the stats up.
* {{I|Bloody Lust}}: Bloody Gust's "rage" effect is shared with Bloody Lust, so if Isaac picks up Bloody Lust after already getting hit with Bloody Gust (or vice versa) the boosts will automatically update to that level.
* {{i|Dull Razor}}: Safely provides the stat boosts without needing to take damage.

sections.Effects:
* Grants one full [[Red Heart container]].
* Restores 4 {{e|Red Heart}}s.
* Causes Isaac's {{e|Bomb}}s to leave a pool of [[red creep]] on the ground when they explode.
** The creep deals 2 damage per tick (20 per second) and lasts 15 seconds.
** Leaves one large creep in the middle, and four small creeps on random direction and distance.
*** Multiple creeps do not inflict damage on an enemy simultaneously.
* If Isaac has no bombs, allows him to place a bomb at the cost of taking half a heart of damage. This prioritizes {{e|Red Heart}}s over {{e|Soul Heart}}s.
sections.Notes:
* Placing a bomb using health counts as self-damage, and as such, does not affect the chances for a [[Devil deal]], does not trigger {{i|Damocles}}, nor does it reroll {{C|Tainted Eden}}.
** {{C|The Lost}} / {{c|Tainted Lost}} will die if a bomb is placed this way.
*** This includes the version of {{C|The Lost}} you turn into after touching the white fireplace in {{s|Downpour}} II.
* {{c|Keeper}} / {{C|Tainted Keeper}} will take 1 [[Coin Heart]] of damage in exchange for 1 bomb.
* {{C|Tainted Bethany}} can use 1 blood charge in exchange for 1 bomb.
* You can remain at zero bombs and leave excess drops of bombs and hearts to maximize resource use for the floor.
* Placing a bomb using health can let Isaac enter/exit a {{R|Curse Room}} without taking soul/black heart damage.
** But be careful and remember to move quickly upon exiting the Curse room, otherwise you'll take damage from the previous bomb.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a robotic {{E|Pooter}} familiar that orbits around Isaac and fires shielded tears at incoming enemy projectiles, which destroy them on contact.
** The shielded tears home in on projectiles, but not enemies.
** The familiar deals 1 contact damage per tick or 3 damage per second, and instantly kills weak fly enemies on contact.
** The shielded tears deal 3 damage if they hit an enemy.
* {{transformation contribution|Beelzebub}}
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|nr+}} Only 5 Bot Flies can circle Isaac at a time.
* While most orbital familiars orbit Isaac counter-clockwise, Bot Fly orbits clockwise. It shares this orbit ring, speed, and pattern with {{i|Distant Admiration}}.
sections.Interactions: * {{i|BFFS!}}: Increases contact damage but does not increase the damage of the tears.

sections.Effects: * Reveals the locations of {{r|Secret Room}}s and {{r|Super Secret Room}}s on the map.
sections.Notes:
* When combined with {{i|The Compass}} and {{i|Treasure Map}}, the entire floor is revealed, identical to the effect of {{i|The Mind}}.
* {{dlc+|r}} Blue Map does not display {{r|Ultra Secret Room}}s.{{dlc-}}
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Book of Secrets|r}}: Makes it easier to gain {{i|X-Ray Vision}} as Book of Secrets cannot give a mapping effect Isaac already has.
* {{t|Fragmented Card}} / {{I|Luna}}: Extra {{r|Secret Room}}s / {{r|Super Secret Room}}s are revealed as well.

sections.Effect:
* Grants one full Red [[Heart container]].
* {{Dlc|r}} Heals 1 additional {{e|Red Heart}}.
sections.Synergies: * {{i|Binge Eater}}: When Isaac picks up Breakfast it now grants: a permanent +0.2 [[Shot Speed]] and +2.5 [[Range]], a temporary +3.6 [[Damage]] (which diminishes to 0 in 30 seconds), heals 1 additional red heart, and takes a permanent -0.03 [[Speed]] reduction.

sections.Effect:
* Upon use, it adds one copy of each of Isaac's [[familiar]]s for the duration of the current room.
* If Isaac has no familiars, a {{i|Demon Baby}} will spawn for the duration of the current room.
sections.Notes: * If Isaac has more than one copy of the same familiar, it will still only add one copy. * Blue Flies, Blue Spiders, and orbitals ({{i|Halo of Flies}}, {{i|Leprosy}}, etc) are not copied. ** {{dlc|r}} It now copies some orbitals. * Many familiars can be spawned in [[Greed mode]] and {{R|Boss Rush}}, as completing waves charges the item. * {{dlc|r}} Familiars with the [[Item Tags uniquefamiliar|uniquefamiliar]] item tag are ignored by Box of Friends. If Isaac has only unique familiars, a Demon Baby is spawned. * {{dlc|r}} The item will cost 10 cents if found in a {{r|Shop}}.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Ball of Bandages}} / {{i|Cube of Meat}} / {{i|Potato Peeler|a+nr}}: Upgrades the cube/ball for the current room. This can be used to easily unlock the [[Super Meat Boy]] and [[Bandage Girl]] achievements.
** {{dlc|r}} Cubes of Meat from {{i|Potato Peeler|n}} cannot be duplicated or upgraded.
* {{i|Blood Puppy}}: Tames an angry Blood Puppy and spawns another temporary one.
* {{i|Bob's Brain}}: When used upon entering a room, Box of Friends eliminates the item delay, which allows Isaac to launch Bob's Brain immediately.
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns black wisps on the middle ring. After creating a wisp, Box of Friends also gives temporary copies of all of Isaac's wisps, including any extra copies Box of Friends made.}}
* {{i|Car Battery}}: Adds two copies of each familiar.
* {{i|Charged Baby}}: All around useful, can charge box of friends mid room to spawn more of itself creating a charging loop.
* {{i|Daddy Longlegs}}: Familiar will be copied.
* {{i|Incubus}}: Creates additional Incubus familiars, which share the same tear modifiers as the player.
* {{i|Lil Dumpy}}: Will copy Lil Dumpy, effectively adding an extra charge to Lil Dumpy's {{i|Holy Mantle}}-like protection.
** This process can be repeated to make Isaac near-invincible.
* {{i|Smart Fly}}: Very useful on Greed mode, as using it will add an attacking fly, killing enemies and bosses very quickly.
* {{I|Twisted Pair}}: Creates additional Twisted Pairs with the same tear modifiers as the player. Multiple twisted pairs will line up horizontally, covering a broader area.
sections.Interactions:
* {{t|???'s Soul}} / {{i|Dead Bird}} / {{t|Eve's Bird Foot}} / {{t|Isaac's Head}} / {{i|Scissors}}: These familiars are not copied.
* {{i|1up!|nr+}} / {{i|Dead Cat|nr}}: Familiars are multiplied but do not give Isaac additional lives.
** {{i|1up!|r+}} / {{i|Dead Cat|r}}: No longer copies the familiar either.
* {{I|Abyss}}: Flies gained from Abyss do not count as familiars for Box of Friends, and are not copied.
* {{i|Best Bud}}: If used before taking damage, the white fly will circle Isaac. However, multiple white flies cannot be spawned, so using Box of Friends after taking damage or using it multiple times in a room creates no effect.
* {{i|Buddy in a Box}}: Creates another randomly generated familiar, rather than copying the same one.
* {{i|Bumbo}}: Will spawn a level 1 Bumbo regardless of the original Bumbo's current level.
* {{i|Tinytoma|r}}: Сreates an orbital even if it is destroyed. If the copy splits into smaller versions, they will remain when moving between rooms.
* {{i|Guillotine}}: Duplicates the Head circling Isaac's body. Only one head will shoot tears.
** Considers the second head as an extra copy, granting Isaac a temporary stat boost for the room
* {{i|Hallowed Ground|r}}: All poop familiars turn into white poop at the same time, and their effects are accumulative. A new poop familiar appears even if the previous poops have been used up.
* {{i|Isaac's Heart}} / {{tf|Super Bum}}: Not copied. They will not spawn a {{i|Demon Baby}} if no other valid familiars are found, unlike other familiars that aren't copied.
* {{i|Key Piece 1}} / {{i|Key Piece 2}}: Key pieces are multiplied, but do not complete the other half.
** {{dlc|r}} Key pieces are not copied.
* {{I|Knife Piece 1}} / {{I|Knife Piece 2}}: Knife pieces and the knife are not copied.
* {{i|Lil Spewer}}: Creates a random spewer rather than copying the current one.
* {{i|Lost Soul}}: Cannot be duplicated.
* {{dlc|na+}} {{i|Milk!}}: The familiar itself doesn't appear, but instead, it decreases tear delay by 2 (effective tears up) when used, without needing to take damage.
** {{dlc|r}}No extra tear delay is granted, neither before or after breaking.
* {{i|Monster Manual}}: Familiars spawned by Monster Manual are not copied. It will still spawn a {{i|Demon Baby}} if a familiar from Monster Manual is generated and there are no other valid familiars that can be duplicated.
* {{i|Multidimensional Baby}}: Each copy of Multidimensional Baby follows the previous copy with a 2-second ({{dlc|r}} 0.66-second) delay. Tears shot through multiple babies will only be duplicated once.
* [[Pickup generation familiar]]s: The copied familiars will drop pickups independently.
* {{i|Quints}}: Existing Quints familiars will not be duplicated, nor more will be created. If Isaac has no other familiars, the generated Demon Baby will hover with the Quints instead of following Isaac.
* {{i|Shade}}: A new follower Shade spawns even if Isaac has already absorbed the original.
* {{P|XV - The Devil?}}: The Seraphim familiar is not copied.

sections.Notes:
* The Big Fan orbits independently rather than occupying one of the three defense orbital slots.
* {{dlc|r}} Pretty Fly [[Horse Pill]]s spawn a Big Fan without granting it as an item. These Big Fans spin at normal pace and don't affect rotation speed of other orbitals. 
** Unlike regular Pretty Fly, there is no limit to how many familiars can be spawned this way.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|BFFS!}} / {{i|Hive Mind|dlc=r}}: Big Fan becomes visually larger and deals more damage.
* {{i|Guillotine}}: Reduces the head's rotation speed, making it easier to aim.
sections.Interactions:
* {{t|Friendship Necklace}}: No effect.
* {{i|Guardian Angel}}: Overrides Guardian Angel's speed boost. If Guardian Angel was obtained first, it will retain its own increased speed. If Big Fan was obtained first, Guardian Angel will be slower.
* {{i|Psy Fly}}: Rotates slower, but moves at full speed while blocking incoming projectiles.

sections.Effect:
* Spawns a decoy vaguely resembling Isaac in his crying animation, which explodes after 5 seconds with the blast radius of a {{e|Mega Troll Bomb}}.
** {{dlc|nr}} The explosion deals 110 [[damage]].
** {{dlc|r}} The explosion deals 185 [[damage]].
* The decoy bomb distracts enemies, as they will target the decoy instead of Isaac regardless of distance.
sections.Notes:
* All {{e|Bomb}} modifier items will affect Best Friend, with the exception of {{i|Bobby-Bomb}}, {{i|Bomber Boy|dlc=nr}}, {{i|Fast Bombs}}, {{i|Mr. Mega}}, and {{i|Rocket in a Jar}}.
** {{i|Scatter Bombs}} will create mini decoys.
** {{i|Sticky Bombs}}. When sticking to a flying enemy that can fly off-screen, Best Friend will fly off with them but will not deal explosion damage.
* Bosses such as {{E|Chub}} or {{E|Carrion Queen}} can swallow the decoy bomb just like a regular bomb.
* Isaac can push the decoy bomb by walking into it or shooting it with his tears just like regular bombs.
* If Isaac leaves and re-enters a room after placing the decoy bomb, its explosion timer will be set to that of a regular bomb (1.5 seconds).

sections.Effects: * Grants 10 {{e|Bomb}}s.

* Gives Isaac a fat bird familiar that sits on Isaac's head until he takes damage.
* Upon taking damage, it will jump off of Isaac's head and land on the nearest enemy, dealing damage and creating a rock line in a random direction. For the rest of the room, it acts like {{i|Dead Bird}}, flying around, albeit slower, and dealing contact damage to enemies.
** Bird Cage does 45 damage to enemies it lands on and 10 damage per rock wave that hits enemies, then does 3 contact damage per tick while chasing enemies (~6.43 damage per second). The rock waves can destroy obstacles.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|r+}} This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|The Cage}}.{{dlc-}}
* If damage is taken in a room with no enemies, the familiar will directly go to the flying phase without performing the jump attack.
* Contact damage can be dealt to nearby enemies even when the familiar jumps off of Isaac's head.
* Bird Cage's jump can be carried over to another room mid-jump to create a rock line there instead. The direction of the line is preserved from how it would be in the original room.
* While the familiar is sitting on Isaac's head, it can be affected by certain character appearances. For example, it will appear fully black if obtained by {{c|Tainted Judas}}.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|BFFS!}}: Spawns 4 rock waves in an X pattern and doubles contact damage. Damage of the jump and the rock waves is unaffected.
* {{i|Sacrificial Altar}}: Can be used after the familiar has jumped.
* {{i|Spin to Win}}: Boosts the familiar's damage while spinning, although has no effect on its speed.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Bird Cage}}: Multiple copies of the item provide no benefit and won't make more than one familiar appear.
* {{i|Box of Friends}}: Immediately makes the familiar jump, leaving a ghost copy on Isaac's head until he takes damage. This has no benefit to the damage dealt and will not spawn more than one familiar.
* {{t|The Twins}}: If Bird Cage was active in a previous room and it was chosen by the trinket, it skips the jump and enters its flying phase. Behavior otherwise identical to that with Box of Friends.

sections.Effects:
* Enemies, enemy shots, tears and pickups will briefly freeze in place at random intervals.
** The frequency of the effect depends on Isaac's [[luck]].
** {{dlc|r}} Frozen enemy shots will disappear, but are still able to inflict damage if touched.
* Room clear rewards have a 25% chance to spawn a duplicate, except for [[chest]]s, [[pill]]s, or [[card]]s.
sections.Notes:
* If Isaac exits the room before the glitching animation is completed on the drop, it will not be duplicated.
* Broken Modem also affects [[friendly]] enemies and their projectiles.
sections.Synergies: * {{dlc+|r}}{{i|Magneto}} + {{i|Options?}}: If Broken Modem duplicates a chest that was spawned by Options?, using Magneto to immediately open the chest while in its glitched form will create a {{i|TMTRAINER}} item if the chest contained an item.{{dlc-}}
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Contract From Below}}: Broken Modem has an independent chance to duplicate each item spawned by Contract From Below.
* {{i|Options?}}: Chests that were an alternative reward can be duplicated. The two chests contain different items.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a [[familiar]] who follows Isaac around and fires normal tears {{dlcalt|once per second|r=1.88 times a second}} that each do 3.5 damage.
* {{transformation contribution|Conjoined}}
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|nr}} Brother Bobby is functionally identical to {{i|Sister Maggy}}.
* {{dlc|r}} Brother Bobby has a higher tear rate than {{i|Sister Maggy}}, whereas Sister Maggy has increased damage.
* {{dlc|r}} [[Familiar]]s that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Brother Bobby having  {{dlcalt|5th|r+=7th}} priority.
sections.Synergies: * {{I|Mongo Baby}}: Will copy Brother Bobby’s tears.

sections.Effects: * Upon use, Isaac farts and [[knock-back|knocks back]] nearby enemies. ** {{dlc|a}} Projectiles are also deflected. *** {{dlc|r}} Enemies pushed into walls or [[obstacle]]s take 10 + 2 * (floor - 1) damage. *** {{dlc|r}} The deflected projectiles deal 6 damage if they would've hurt Isaac for half a heart, and 7 for a full heart.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|a+nr}} If Isaac swaps Butter Bean for a different active item, then picks up Butter Bean again, it has a 10% chance to transform into {{i|Wait What?|n}}.
* {{dlc|r}} When a run is started, the game has a 5% chance to replace Butter Bean with {{i|Wait What?|n}} in item pools. Both items are generally not available in the same run.

sections.Effects:
* Drops 1-6 random [[pickup]]s around Isaac.
* Causes items to be chosen from random [[item pool]]s.
** Fixed item drops that ignore the current room's item pool will not be replaced. Examples include {{i|Cube of Meat}} after defeating one of [[The Harbingers]] as a floor boss, or {{i|The Small Rock}} after breaking a [[Tinted Rock]].
sections.Notes: * When playing [[Greed mode]], items that are available only in the normal game will still not appear despite Chaos; the modes' different item pools stay separate. * As the item does not mix or combine item pools, it is possible to deplete smaller item pools and end up with {{i|Breakfast}} before all items in the game have been taken. ** Thus, if Chaos tries to pull from an item pool that is already depleted, it will not pull from a different pool and instead give Isaac Breakfast. *** As many Greed mode item pools are small, Chaos tends to result in Breakfast more often during Greed mode. * {{dlc|nr}} Chaos will draw items even from item pools that are not used in the game, but defined in the game's files. The unused pools are bossrush containing nearly all bomb related items, challenge with a smaller selection of bomb items and dungeon containing several Mom related items and food items. * {{dlc|nr}} Since all item pools have the same probability of being selected, bomb-related items are much more common due to the [[Bomb Bum (Item Pool)|Bomb Bum]], bossrush and challenge item pools. * {{dlc|r}} Each pool has a weight based on the number of items in the pool. Items from large pools such as [[Treasure Room (Item Pool)|Treasure Room]], [[Shop (Item Pool)|Shop]], and [[Boss (Item Pool)|Boss]] are very likely, while items from small pools like [[Bomb Bum (Item Pool)|Bomb Bum]] and [[Planetarium (Item Pool)|Planetarium]] are more rare. * If an item outside of the [[Devil Room (Item Pool)|Devil Room pool]] appears as a [[Devil Deal]], it will always cost 1 Red Heart Container (or 3 Soul Hearts should Isaac have no Red Hearts). ** {{dlc+|r}} If an item from the [[Angel Room (Item Pool)|Angel Room pool]] appears as a [[Devil deal]], it will cost 2 Red Hearts if it would cost 30 cents in the Angel Shop generated by {{i|The Stairway}}, and 1 Red Heart if it would cost 15 cents in the Angel Shop. *** Similarly, if an item from the [[Devil Room (Item Pool)|Devil Room pool]] appears in an Angel Shop generated by {{i|The Stairway}}, it will cost 30 cents if it would cost 2 Red Hearts as a [[Devil Deal]], and 15 cents if it would cost 1 Red Heart as a [[Devil Deal]].{{dlc-}} * If an item that grants an {{E|Eternal Heart}} is taken in a devil deal, the eternal heart will ''not'' keep Isaac alive if he has no other hearts. * {{dlc+|a+}} Bosses defeated in {{s|The Void}} drop items as if Chaos was active. Rerolling the items uses the Boss Room pool as normal.{{dlc-}}

sections.Effects:
* Grants charged tears that deal greater damage when fully charged.
** Tear damage scales from approximately 10% damage at a minimum charge to 400% damage at full charge.
*** The minimum charge damage increases as Isaac's fire rate increases.
* {{Dlc|nr}} Tear delay: ×2.5.
sections.Notes:
* Repeatedly pressing a key to fire allows Isaac to fire as quickly as the key is pressed, up to the equivalent of a maxed tears stat. This is not generally recommended, as overall damage per second is greatly reduced.
** Rapid-fire can be useful for dealing with low-health enemies or for quickly destroying obstacles like poops or fireplaces, for whom DPS is less relevant, or chance-based tear effects.
* Having multiple instances of Chocolate Milk has no effect.
* {{Dlc|r}} At 30.00 fire rate or above, charging is no longer needed. Higher fire rate results in higher tear damage. At 120.00 fire rate, tears deal 4× Isaac's damage.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|20/20}} / {{i|The Inner Eye}} / {{i|Mutant Spider}}: Fires multiple charged shots.
* {{i|Cricket's Body}} / {{i|The Parasite}} / {{i|Compound Fracture}}: Since split tears tend to hit the same target the main tear hits, this can allow for much higher damage.
* {{c|The Forgotten}}: When charging the club, instead of being thrown, the club grows bigger in size and damage.
* {{c|Tainted Azazel}}: The beam takes longer to fully charge, but can be released at any point during its charge. Sneezing on enemies fills half the charge meter and can be immediately released for high damage.
* {{i|Explosivo}}: Firing quickly generates a lot of explosive tears, which leads to a much higher damage than firing tears alone.
* {{i|Godhead|nr}}: Charging the shots increases the size and damage of the aura.
** {{dlc|r}} Charging the shots increases the size of the aura, but not its damage.
* {{tf|Guppy}}: Firing quickly generates lots of Blue Flies, which can lead to much higher damage than firing tears alone.
* {{i|Haemolacria}}: Increased tear delay. Completely charged shots and their burst tears are larger and deal higher damage than normal. Chocolate Milk also allows low-damage Haemolacria shots to be fired rapidly.
** {{i|Haemolacria}} + {{i|Tech X}}: rings are created where the Haemolacria shot splashes. The Tech X rings do full damage even on minimum charge shots that were fired rapidly.
** {{i|Haemolacria}} + {{i|Brimstone}}: Haemolacria bursts into 4-7 brimstone beams that do full damage even on minimum charge shots that were fired rapidly.
* {{i|Immaculate Heart}}: Orbiting tears' damage does not depend on the charge of Chocolate Milk, so Isaac can shoot low damage tears rapidly to produce a large number of orbiting tears which do full damage.
* {{i|Ghost Pepper}} / {{i|Bird's Eye}}: Fires' damage does not depend on the charge of Chocolate Milk, so Isaac can shoot low damage tears rapidly to fire full damage flames frequently.
* {{i|Parasitoid}} / {{i|The Mulligan}}: Flies and spiders generated deal full damage regardless of charge, allowing Isaac to shoot low damage tears to generate flies and spiders rapidly which do full damage.
* {{Dlc|nr}}{{i|Isaac's Tears}} / {{i|Sad Bombs}} / {{i|Tammy's Head}}: The size and damage of all generated tears correspond to the current charge level of Chocolate Milk. Isaac's Tears will nearly instantly recharge while charging a Chocolate Milk shot.
** {{Dlc|r}} Charge level does not affect generated tears. Isaac's Tears recharge only when a shot is fired.
* {{i|Ipecac}}: Increased tear delay. Charged shots deal massively increased damage, as the +40 damage from Ipecac is run through the damage multiplier of Chocolate Milk. It also allows low-damage Ipecac shots to be fired rapidly.
* {{i|Lachryphagy|nr}}: Rapidly firing small, uncharged tears can cause the fed tear to grow into a gigantic tear that will still deal fairly low damage while feeding tears with charged tears will result in higher-damage tears.
** {{dlc|r}} Charged and uncharged fed tears deal similar damage.
* {{i|Mom's Wig|nr}}: Spiders rapidly spawn while charging.
** {{Dlc|r}} Spiders spawn only when a shot is fired.
* {{i|Monstro's Lung|nr}}: Reduces Isaac's current tear delay by 20%, allowing Monstro's Lung to charge faster. Each tear from Monstro's Lung is also a charged Chocolate Milk shot, massively increasing damage.
** {{dlc|r}} Tear damage, along with the number of tears fired is dependent on charge time.
* {{i|Polyphemus}}: Increased tear delay. Massively increases the damage of each shot, and charged tears decay in damage much slower as they pierce as a result.
* {{i|Sinus Infection}}: Booger damage is influenced by the damage of the individual tear, so fully-charged Chocolate Milk shots can result in very potent damage over time.
* {{i|Technology 2|nr}}: Damage dealt by the laser is equal to Isaac's current charge, leading to constant high damage from a safe distance.
** {{Dlc|r}} The laser deals 13% of Isaac's damage regardless of charge, tears are affected by Chocolate Milk as normal.
* {{i|Trisagion}}: Fully charged beams deal four times normal damage. Trisagion's shots are colored brown.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Anti-Gravity}}: No effect, but retains the reduced tear delay.
* {{C|Azazel}} / {{i|Brimstone|nr}}: Reduces Isaac's current [[Tears#Tear Delay|tear delay]] by 20%. Doesn't increase damage.
** {{dlc|r}} The beam takes longer to fully charge, but can be released at any point during its charge. Width and damage of the beam increases at higher charges; width scales from 50% at minimum charge to 160% at maximum charge, while damage scales from 25% at minimum charge to 250% at maximum charge.
* {{i|C Section|r}}: Overrides Chocolate Milk.
* {{i|Cursed Eye|nr}}: The charge bar only indicates the current charge for Chocolate Milk, not for Cursed Eye; the latter's charge is determined by the eye's glow. If charged until Cursed Eye fully glows, Isaac fires one Chocolate Milk shot, followed by up to three minimal power ones.
** {{dlc|r}} Cursed Eye takes longer to charge, but low damage shots can be fired rapidly. If fully charged, Isaac fires five Chocolate Milk shots.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus|nr}}: Reduces Isaac's current tear delay by 20%. Bombs can't be charged.
* {{i|Epic Fetus|nr}}: Reduces Isaac's current tear delay by 20%. Missiles can't be charged.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique|nr}}: Reduces Isaac's current tear delay by 20%. The tear can't be charged.
** {{dlc|r}} Overrides Chocolate Milk.
* {{i|Mom's Knife|nr}}: Reduces Isaac's current tear delay by 20%. Doesn't increase damage.
* {{i|Marked}}: Isaac will automatically charge his shots. Fire rate increases when the crosshair is closer to Isaac, and damage increases when the crosshair is farther from Isaac.
* {{i|Mega Blast}}: Firing the Mega Blast beam while Chocolate Milk charges preserve the charge, but does not increase the beam's damage.
* {{i|Neptunus}}: Overrides Chocolate Milk's active charge. Tear damage is determined by how charged Neptunus is.
** '''Neptunus''' + {{i|Kidney Stone|n}}: Isaac will not fire any tears during the Kidney Stone burst.
* {{i|Soy Milk|nr}}: Overrides Chocolate Milk, but Isaac gains a flat +1 damage bonus after the Soy Milk damage penalty.
** {{dlc|r}} Shoots moderately charged shots at a quick pace with no increase in damage.
* {{i|Sprinkler|a+nr}}: The size and damage of the sprinkler's tears depend on Isaac's current charge amount.
** {{dlc|r}} No effect on Sprinkler.
* {{i|Technology|nr}}: Reduces Isaac's current tear delay by 20%. Lasers can't be charged.
** {{dlc|r}} Lasers can be charged, dealing up to 4× damage when fully charged. Low-damage lasers can also be fired rapidly.
*** At 30.00 fire rate or above, charging is no longer needed and lasers deal 4× damage.
* {{i|Tech X|anr}}: Reduces Isaac's current tear delay by 20%. Doesn't increase damage.

sections.Effect: * Causes eligible [[activated item]]s to have their effects doubled or otherwise upgraded.
sections.Notes: * Having more than one Car Battery has no effect.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Best Friend}}: Spawns two decoys on top of each other.
* {{i|Blank Card}}: Uses the card twice. For example, if used with the Two of Hearts/Diamonds/etc. cards it will quadruple whatever amount Isaac has.
** '''Blank Card''' + '''Tarot Cloth''': The effect of the active card is quadrupled.
* {{i|Broken Shovel 1}}: Prevents the Mom's Foot from appearing for two rooms (empty or not), or for two waves of a {{R|Challenge Room}} or the {{R|Boss Rush}}, essentially removing the stomping attacks for the entire duration of the Boss Rush.
* {{i|D10|r}}: Weakens affected enemies twice.
* {{I|Isaac's Tears|r}}: The damage of tears shot from the active item is doubled.
* {{i|Kamikaze!}}: Now causes smaller explosions in a ring around Isaac.
* {{i|Jacob's Ladder}} / {{i|120 Volt}}: Electricity deals 75% of Isaac's tear damage if he owns 1 of these items, to 100% if Isaac owns both.
* {{i|Crooked Penny|dlc = a+nr}}: Splits the 50% chance to succeed into a 25% chance to quadruple all items and a 25% chance to duplicate all items while consuming the originals; the latter will make Devil deal and Shop items free.
** {{dlc|r}} The 25% chance to duplicate all items while consuming the originals now generates 2 pennies instead.
* {{i|Sulfur}}: Will count as giving double Brimstone, giving extra damage and a x1.2 damage multiplier for the current room.
* {{i|Void}}: Applies Car Battery's effect on all eligible absorbed active items. Absorbing passives will not give extra stat ups.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Anarchist Cookbook}}: Spawns '''13''' {{e|Troll Bomb}}s.
* {{i|Book of Revelations}}: Give Isaac 2 soul hearts.
* {{i|Converter|r}}: Consumes 2 Soul Hearts and produces 2 Red Heart Containers.
* {{i|The Bean}} / {{I|Mega Bean}} / {{I|Kidney Bean}}: Deals double damage, but charms/poisons/petrifies for the same amount of time.
* {{I|Berserk!}}: Will only increase rage duration if no enemies are killed in the first half, effectively only affecting bosses that can't spawn enemies.
* {{I|Book of Virtues}}: Doubles the spawned wisps on activation.
* {{i|Book of Secrets}}: Activates twice, {{dlc|nr}} but has a chance to uselessly activate the same effect twice.
* {{i|Book of Shadows}} / {{I|The Gamekid}} / {{I|My Little Unicorn}} / {{i|Unicorn Stump}}: Doubles the length of invincibility, but no effect on damage where applicable.
* {{i|The Candle|r+}} / {{i|Red Candle|r+}}: Spawns a second flame that travels a shorter distance.
* {{i|Clicker}}: If the Car Battery is removed by the first activation, a second activation will not happen. Two activations in a row is mostly detrimental, removing two items and possibly cycling through a character that lowers health.
* {{i|D infinity|a+nr}}: Activates 2 dice. The second activation die cannot be predicted.
** {{Dlc|r}} Activates the currently selected die twice.
* {{i|D4}} / {{i|D100}}: Instantly re-rolls Isaac's items twice, which doubles the speed at which the item pools are exhausted and transformations are achieved.
** {{dlc|r}} As items are returned back into the item pool when re-rolled, the item pools aren't exhausted at all. In addition, you need to actively be holding a transformation's respective items to retain them now, so using the double re-roll to gain multiple transformations is no longer possible.
* {{i|The D6}} / {{i|D8}} / {{i|D12}} / {{i|D20}}: Re-rolls twice instantly without any benefits. The D6 depletes item pools at double the speed, and the D20 may invisibly reroll a trinket, effectively skipping it in the circulation.
** {{i|D12|r}}: Roughly doubles the rare chance of obstacles being turned into {{g|Reward Plate}}s, {{g|Kill Plate}}s, and very rarely {{r|Crawl Space}}s, as the D12 can create these but cannot re-roll them.
* {{i|D7|na+}}: Doubles the amount of enemies summoned, but does not give double rewards.
* {{i|Dark Arts}}: Doubles the duration, giving more time to walk through more enemies, if you end the effect before the end of the first second, the item will reactivate itself; allowing to target the same enemies twice.
* {{i|Dead Sea Scrolls}}: Activates 2 random effects.
* {{i|Doctor's Remote|r+}}: Drops an additional missile after the first one.
* {{i|Dull Razor}}: The invulnerability time is not increased, but damage-triggered items will activate twice if applicable.
* {{i|Eternal D6}}: Re-rolls twice like The D6 (see above), but the 25% chance of the item disappearing is increased to approximately 44%.
* {{I|Everything Jar}}: Instead of doubling its effect, Everything Jar will spawn a poop alongside its normal drop.
* {{I|Gello|r+}}: Spawns an additional familiar.
* {{i|Guppy's Head}}: Increases range of flies spawned to 4-7.
* {{i|Head of Krampus}}: Doubles the damage the brimstone beams deal (for a total of {{Dlc|nr}}880 damage/ {{Dlc|r}}400 damage per use). Doesn't double the brimstone beams' duration.
* {{i|The Hourglass}}: Doubles the length of the effect.
* {{I|Mega Blast|r+}}: Extends the length of the effect from 15 seconds to 23 seconds.
* {{i|Mega Mush}}: Makes the effect twice as long.
* {{I|Metronome}}: Metronome is activated twice at once as expected, but the item chosen for the first activation is shown raised above Isaac's head, instead of the second one that actually remains active.
** Moreover, active item effects chosen by Metronome are only activated once.
* {{i|Mine Crafter|ana+}}: Spawns a Movable TNT and instantly detonates it, damaging Isaac.
** {{dlc|a+}} This has been changed to spawn two Movable TNT barrels instead, which you can detonate at will.
* {{i|Moving Box}}: Activation swaps the contents of the box with the contents of the room.
** {{dlc|r}} This has been changed to have no effects.
* {{I|The Scooper}}: Will summon 2 peepers in a bifurcated direction.
* {{i|Spider Butt}}: Deals 10 damage to enemies twice but does not increase slow effect.
* {{I|Spindown Dice}}: Lowers ID by 2.
* {{i|Stitches}}: Swaps places with Isaac twice in quick succession, rendering Stitches useless for collecting pickups & items beyond pits, rocks etc.
** However, it can still be used to telefrag enemies.
* {{i|Tear Detonator}}: Multiplies detonated tears, resulting in 6x more tears than normal.
* {{I|Telekinesis|r}}: Grants 7 seconds of protection, effectively giving Isaac immunity to enemy bullets as long as the item is used immediately upon recharging.
* {{i|Ventricle Razor|na+}}: Places both trapdoors in same location.
** {{dlc|a+}} Ventricle Razor works normally.
* {{i|We Need To Go Deeper!}} / {{i|Mom's Shovel}}: In most cases, no extra effect. When used near the entrances to a room, the item can occasionally open 2 trapdoors at once, {{Dlc|nr}} increasing the chance of opening a {{r|Crawl Space}}.

sections.Effects:
* +1 [[damage]].
* Increases the chance for [[champion|champion enemies]] to appear by 15%.
** Without any other champion enemy appearance modifiers the chance increases from 5% to 20% ({{dlc|nr}} 20% to 35% in [[hard mode]]).
sections.Interactions: * {{t|Purple Heart}}: Champion Belt's increased chance is also doubled.

sections.Effects:
* Grants three {{E|Soul Heart}}s.
* After taking damage, grants {{i|The Wafer}} effect of damage reduction for the current room.

* Gives Isaac one of the following stat boosts, depending on what [[attribute]] Isaac has the least of:
** +1.0 flat [[damage]]
** +0.5 [[fire rate]]
** +0.2 [[speed]]
** +2.5 [[range]]
* Also drops either 3 {{e|Penny|text=Coins}}, 1 {{e|Bomb}}, or 1 {{e|Key}} on the ground.
** Bombs and keys are valued at 3 coins' worth. The pickup dropped will be what Isaac has the least value of, and in case of a tie one is chosen randomly.
* As {{C|Bethany}} and {{c|Tainted Bethany}}, one {{e|Soul Heart}} or two {{e|Red Heart}}s can also be dropped if they are low on charges.
** Charges are valued at ''2 × Charges - 1'' coins' worth. For instance having 7 charges would be valued at 13 coins.
sections.Notes:
* Pickups spawned can be variants of their type.
* {{dlc|nr+}} As {{c|Tainted ???}}, the game still checks the bomb count instead of the poop count. Since Tainted ??? cannot get bombs normally and bombs are turned into poop pickups or troll bombs, he will receive them every time once he has at least 3 coins and a key.
* The tears up can break the soft tears cap of 5, due to the fact that it is a fire rate modifier.
* Cards and trinkets that grant temporary stat increases will affect the stat given by Consolation Prize (e.g. using {{P|I - The Magician}} or carrying {{T|Tape Worm}} will likely prevent the item from granting a range up,  {{P|VII - The Chariot}} or {{T|Goat Hoof}} - speed, and so on.)
** This can be use to force the raise of a chosen stat, if the player knows that 2 of them are tied.
* The stat up is permanent and won't go away even if the item is removed, similar to {{i|Experimental Treatment}}.
** Because of that, {{c|Tainted Isaac}} can pick it up and freely drop it without losing anything.

sections.Effects: * Spawns ''N'' + 1 [[Room Clear Awards]], but has a (0.666<sup>''N''</sup> / 2) chance to set the number of spawned pickups to 0, where ''N'' is the number of copies of this item held.
sections.Notes:
* In practice, the effect means the overall number of pickups is increased by 1/3 over the rest of the run, on average.
* Neither effect applies to [[trinket]]s.
* Doubled Chests will not necessarily be of the same kind.
* {{dlc+|a}} Neither effect applies to {{e|Penny|text=Pennies}} dropped in [[Greed mode]].{{dlc-}}
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Diplopia}}: Each additional Contract increases the number of room drops by one and lowers the chance of getting nothing.
* {{i|Guppy's Tail}}: Higher chance of double chests upon clearing a room.
* {{i|Deep Pockets|r}}: If Contract removes the reward, spawns 1-3 random coins. Allows Deep Pockets to remain useful at high luck.
* {{i|Options?|r}}: Spawns a second set of consumables. The "Options?" consumable is not guaranteed to be the same for each copy of the original consumable.

sections.Effects:
* Grants one full [[Red Heart container]].
** {{Dlc|r}} Heals 1 additional {{e|Red Heart}}.
* Spawns one random [[trinket]].

sections.Notes:
* Isaac will look progressively more pregnant as he takes damage.
* Familiars spawned this way do not count towards [[transformation]]s nor the [[collection page]].
* {{C|Lilith}} starts with this item by default, even if it hasn't been unlocked. Lilith can get a second {{I|Incubus}} through this.
* Only one of each familiar can be spawned.
* Familiars that have yet to be unlocked can spawn,  {{dlc+|r}} with the exception of {{i|Lil Abaddon}} and {{i|Twisted Pair}}, which must be unlocked before they can spawn through Cambion Conception.{{dlc-}}
* Only actually getting damage counts towards the payout. For example, negating damage with the {{i|Holy Mantle}} will not count. Using the {{e|Blood Donation Machine}} or {{e|Devil Beggar}} counts as damage taken.
* Familiars spawned by the item do not affect item pools, so multiple copies of one familiar can be obtained. For example, a second Incubus can be purchased after Cambion Conception spawns one.
* If a familiar obtained is a copy of another one already obtained, using {{i|Box of Friends}} will only clone one of that familiar.
* If this item is removed in any way (such as with a {{P|XVII - The Stars?|r}}), the familiars from Cambion Conception will be removed upon updating familiars, including picking up items that don't add familiars but update its cache, such as {{i|Brimstone}}.
** If the item is re-obtained after being removed (e.g. by dropping the item as {{C|Tainted Isaac|r}}), the damage counter and familiar limit will be reset, allowing Isaac to obtain all eight familiars with only one Cambion Conception. If the familiars were removed, all will return once familiars are updated.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Dull Razor}}: Dull Razor counts towards the payout despite not removing health from Isaac.
* {{i|Hypercoagulation}}:  By intentionally taking damage with something like a fire and grabbing the half-red hearts, Isaac can easily generate powerful familiars for free.
* {{i|Scapular}}: By intentionally taking damage with something like a fire to half a red heart a soul heart will be generated. Leaving the room and taking damage again will continuously allow damage to be taken.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Caffeine Pill}}: Makes it impossible to tell how far along the pregnancy is.
* {{i|Cambion Conception}}: Having a second Cambion Conception allows Isaac to get the eight familiars, but cannot give an already obtained familiar. The hit counters do not stack. Isaac has to fully pay out the first cambion before collecting the second to get all 8 familiars. Collecting a second Cambion Conception will restart the damage counter and number of familiars received even if the first one has not finished paying out yet.

sections.Effects:
* {{dlc|nr}} Converts two {{e|Soul Heart}}s or {{e|Black Heart}}s into one filled {{e|Red Heart}} container.
* {{dlc|r}} Converts one {{e|Soul Heart}} or {{e|Black Heart}} into one filled {{e|Red Heart}} container.
sections.Synergies:
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns wisps in the middle ring, looking like hearts. Wisps have slightly higher health than average. Red Heart pickups can be used to restore their health.}}
* {{i|Book of Revelations|r}} / {{i|Satanic Bible|r}}: Allows for generation of Heart Containers. ({{i|Schoolbag|r}} required)
** {{i|9 Volt|r}} + {{i|Habit|r}}: Allows for an easy setup to get max health as long as one has a self-damage source, such as a {{e|Blood Donation Machine}} or a {{e|Devil Beggar}}.
* {{i|Guppy's Paw}}:
** {{dlc|nr}} Allows Isaac to have 10 Heart Containers and 1 Soul Heart.
** {{dlc|r}} Allows Isaac to attain up to 12 Red Heart Containers or any combination of Red Heart Containers and Soul Hearts.
*** {{i|Potato Peeler|r}} + {{i|Sharp Plug}}: Allows Isaac to generate infinite damage upgrades and {{i|Cube of Meat||Cubes of Meat}}.
* {{dlc|r}} {{c|???}} + {{i|Birthright}}: Removes one Soul Heart and grants two, effectively becoming a 3-room charge {{i|Book of Revelations}}.
* {{c|Tainted Eden|r}}: Heart containers gained from Converter are kept, even after rerolling.
* {{dlc|r}} {{c|Black Judas}} / {{c|Tainted Judas}}: Converts one Black Heart into one Black Heart, keeping Judas’ health the same as before but activates {{I|The Necronomicon}} effect regardless.
sections.Interactions:
* {{c|Bethany|r}}: Bethany cannot activate the Converter whether she has soul charges or not.
* {{i|Car Battery}}: {{dlc|r}} Consumes 2 Soul Hearts and produces 2 Red Heart Containers.
* {{c|The Soul}}: Consumes Soul Hearts and produces {{e|Bone Heart}}s for {{c|The Forgotten}}. Does nothing when used by The Forgotten.
* {{c|Tainted Bethany|r}}: When used while fully charged, adds 2 Blood Charges to her pool at no cost to her Heart total. When used with no charges, consumes 3 Blood Charges and produces 2, resulting in a net loss.
** With {{i|Car Battery|n}}: Consumes 3 Blood Charges and produces 4, still at no cost to Heart total, resulting in infinite Blood Charges.

sections.Effect: * Grants a chance to trigger the {{i|Book of Shadows}} effect upon taking damage, creating a [[shield]] that nullifies all types of damage for 7 seconds.
sections.Notes:
* The base chance of creating the protective shield is 20%.
* The activation chance of this item depends on the [[Luck]] stat and goes up to 100% at 27 Luck.
* The shield negates health loss from {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}s and {{e|Devil Beggar}}s.
* Does not prevent Heart Container loss from [[Health Down]] pills or {{r|Devil Room}} Deals.
* Does not prevent damage from {{i|IV Bag}}.
sections.Synergies: * {{Dlc|r}}{{i|The Polaroid}}, {{i|Virgo}}: Can trigger at the same time as The Polaroid or Virgo, cumulating to up to 22 seconds of shield.

sections.Effects:
* Grants [[spectral]] tears.
* When tears travel off-screen, they loop back around through the opposite wall.
* {{dlc|nr}} +2.25 [[range]].
* {{dlc|r}} +3 [[range]].
* {{dlc|nr}} +1.5 [[tear falling speed]].
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|r+}} This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|Mega Maw}}.{{dlc-}}
* {{dlc+|r}} When fighting {{E|The Beast}} tears will not loop downward identical to a {{R|Crawl Space}}.{{dlc-}}
sections.Synergies:
* {{Dlc|r}}{{C|Azazel}} / {{I|Brimstone}} / {{I|Revelation|n}} / {{C|Tainted Azazel}} / {{i|Technology}}: The laser continues behind Isaac and back once again, potentially hitting enemies twice in one blast.

** {{dlc|nr}} '''Tech X''' + {{i|Incubus}}: Incubus's laser rings cannot go through walls. This applies to {{C|Lilith}} too.
** {{Dlc|r}} '''Tech X''' + {{i|Incubus}}: Laser rings travel through walls and continue on the other side of the room.
* {{i|Tractor Beam}}: Causes the tears to loop right back in front of Isaac after they go offscreen.

sections.Effects:
* Surrounds Isaac with a large white halo.
** Once per second, the halo deals Isaac's [[Damage]] to all enemies currently inside it.
** Each enemy shot has a 30% chance to be reflected by the halo.
*** The chance is predetermined, and not affected by how long it is exposed by the halo.
*** The reflectable tears are reflected once they touch the middle line of the halo, and is converted into friendly purple [[homing]] tears that have Isaac's Damage and no other tear modifiers.
*** {{dlc+|r}} Projectiles that create other projectiles (e.g. {{E|Shady}}) do not create the projectiles once reflected.{{dlc-}}
*** Can reflect:
**** Explosive projectiles (e.g. from {{E|Gurgle}}), which do not explode once reflected.
**** {{dlc+|r}} Fireballs (e.g. from {{E|Crackle}}), which do not create lines of fire once reflected.{{dlc-}}
**** Fire projectiles (e.g. from {{E|Mega Satan}}).
**** {{dlc+|r}} Obstacles thrown by {{E|Polty}} or {{E|Kineti}}.{{dlc-}}
*** Does not reflect:
**** Lasers or beams.
**** {{dlc|r}} Lines of fire from fireballs.
**** {{dlc+|r}} Projectiles from {{E|Big Bony}}, {{E|Coal Boy}}, {{E|Danny}}.{{dlc-}}
sections.Interactions: * Circle of Protection: Multiple copies of this item through sources such as {{I|Diplopia}} or {{I|Crooked Penny}} has no effect.

sections.Effects:
* Every 4th newly discovered room, [[slow]]s all enemies and their attacks down to half their normal speed, but has a ~13% chance of speeding them up by 40% instead.
** The effect is lost upon leaving the room, and not gained again if re-entering it.
sections.Notes:
* The effect is lost upon exiting and continuing the run. This can be used when the speed up chance is hit when fighting a Boss.
* {{Dlc|nr}} Because of the slow effect, champion versions of enemies will be tinted the same color as all other enemies. This makes it much harder to distinguish certain champion types, such as those that explode upon death.
* The player can abuse the Broken Watch to have the Broken Stopwatch trigger during any difficult boss fight by making sure that the fight is the fourth room since the last time the effect activated.
** For example, if the third undiscovered room was the Mom boss fight, Boss Rush will be the fourth undiscovered room, resulting in it being slowed down. This necessitates skipping the {{R|Devil Room}} or {{R|Angel Room}}, however.
** To trigger the effects of Broken Watch during the {{E|The Beast}} fight and do not have either the {{I|Red Key}} or a {{P|Cracked Key}}, you have to clear 1 room after the effect has activated, then explore every room in {{s|Home}}. Otherwise, after the effect has activated in a room, immediately go to {{s|Home}} and explore every room.{{dlc-}}
** There is also the 13% risk of the room being sped up, so this strategy can rarely backfire.
* If the slow effect triggers when entering The Boss Rush or {{E|The Beast}} boss area, it will be active for the entire Boss Rush/all four Horsemen and the Beast. This is also true of the speed effect.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Glowing Hourglass}}: The Glowing Hourglass does not reset the entered room counter: using it in a room where the Broken Watch is active and immediately returning without visiting other new rooms will not trigger the effect again.
* {{T|Lil Clot}} / {{I|Sumptorium}} / {{C|Tainted Eve}}: Clots are moving and firing at normal speeds when a room is sped up. This can be extra hurtful as Tainted Eve, since the clots will not move in sync with her.
* {{dlc|na}} {{i|Stop Watch}}: Overrides Broken Watch; the speed-up effect will not occur.
** {{dlc|a}} Both the slow effect and the rarer speed up can trigger at the start of a room.
*** {{dlc|nr}} This results in enemies being slowed to around 71.8% of their original speed.
*** {{dlc|r}} This results in enemies being sped up by 12%.

sections.Effects:
* +1 [[damage]].
* +0.23 [[shot speed]].

* Tears turn into bones, which shatter into 1-3 shards upon hitting an obstacle or enemy, which each deal 50% of Isaac's [[Damage]].
** Unlike {{i|The Parasite}}, there is no damage minimum on splitting, but the tears can also split only once.
** The shards have a fixed size, about the same as a 3.5 damage tear, regardless of their Damage.
* +1.5 [[Range]].
* {{dlc|nr}} +1.0 [[Tear Falling Speed]].
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Bob's Rotten Head}}: The bomb will break into 1-3 more bombs which are launched in random directions from the point of impact.
* {{i|C Section}}: Fetuses are skeletons that shoot splitting bone fragments when in contact with an enemy.
* {{i|Cricket's Body}}/{{i|The Parasite}}: Each tear splits into more tears, which will all shatter.
* {{i|Haemolacria}}: Tears will sometimes burst into smaller tears when hitting obstacles or enemies. These smaller tears are miniature versions of Haemolacria tears, which will burst when hitting the ground.
* {{i|Ipecac}}: If the bone tear hits a wall or an obstacle, it will split into explosive half-damage shards. Hits on enemies and the floor behave as normal Ipecac.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: Tear turns into a spinning bone that rapidly spews out smaller bone shots on contact with enemies.
* {{I|Kidney Stone}}: First bullet shatters into smaller kidney stone bullets.
* [[Spectral]] tears: Bones pass through obstacles and generate shards for each obstacle they pass through, which can result in many shards being generated from a single bone.
* {{i|Technology Zero}}: The bone fragments will be connected by the electric current.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Anti-Gravity}}: Bone tears will hover until released but bone shards will travel normally.
* {{i|Brimstone}} / {{i|Dr. Fetus}} / {{i|Epic Fetus}} / {{i|Technology}} / {{i|Tech X}}: Overrides Compound Fracture.
* {{i|Flat Stone}}: Bone tears will bounce when they are fired, however, bone shards will not bounce when they travel.
* {{c|The Forgotten}}: Smaller bone shots appear whenever an enemy is hit with the melee attack. {{dlc|nr}} The bone toss is unaffected.
** {{dlc|r}} Bone toss attack also creates bone tears.
* {{i|Lachryphagy}}: Bone tears can be fed and will burst into split tears. Bone tears will burst into bone shards when hitting obstacles or enemies which can also be fed and burst into split tears and bone shards yet again. When bone shards are fed, they turn back into bone tears which can repeat this process again and again.
* {{dlc|nr}}{{i|Mom's Knife}}: Overrides Compound Fracture.
** {{dlc|r}} Knife will occasionally spawn bone fragments.
* {{dlc|nr}}{{i|Rubber Cement}}: Tears turn to bones, but bones do not shatter.
** {{dlc|r}} Tears hitting enemies will both shatter and bounce simultaneously.
* {{i|Technology 2}}: The laser is not affected, but bone tears still shoot from Isaac's left eye.
* {{i|Tractor Beam}}: Bone tears will not burst into bone shards when fired at obstacles, however, bone tears will burst into bone shards when fired at enemies.
* {{i|Trisagion}}: Beams will only burst when hitting obstacles.

sections.Effects: * Spawns a [[familiar]] projecting a circular aura that [[slow]]s enemies and enemy shots within its radius and for a short period once they exit.
sections.Notes:
* The aura does not affect bosses but slows down their shots.
** Bosses that use tight volleys of projectiles are extremely difficult to avoid without additional items to block, remove, or redirect those shots, as the slowing effect will cause their attacks to clump together.
* {{dlc|r}} [[Familiar]]s that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Censer having {{dlc|nr+}} 4th / {{dlc|r+}} 6th priority.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|BFFS!}}: The aura does not slow things from further away despite increased visual size.
* {{i|Montezuma's Revenge}}: The corn shots are slowed by the aura.

sections.Effects: * +2 flat [[damage]] to tears fired from Isaac's left eye.
sections.Notes:

* {{C|Cain}} has a 50% chance of firing a shot with the effects of Chemical Peel whenever he fires.
* {{i|Blood Clot}} applies to the same eye and the effects stack.

sections.Effects:
* Upon entering a new room, Isaac will become camouflaged and all enemies become [[confusion|confused]]. The effect will last until Isaac presses a fire button.
** Bosses will not be confused when Isaac is camouflaged.
** {{dlc|r}} While camouflaged, Isaac gains +0.5 [[Speed]]. When the camouflage is dropped, enemies in a short radius around Isaac take 15 damage, and he gains a temporary +10.5 [[Damage]] and +7.5 [[Tears]] up which both rapidly scale down to 0. The tears up ignores the soft tears cap.
*** If Isaac is firing tears while walking into a room, the camouflage and stat boost will not apply.
**** This also applies when pressing a fire button to skip boss transition cutscenes.
