* {{E|Red Fire Place}}s & {{E|Purple Fire Place}}s are not affected by this item.
* While bosses are not confused, monsters spawned during boss fights are confused, as long as the effect lasts.
* The item's effect can potentially cause FPS drops.
* Champion enemies become tinted the same color as regular enemies, making it difficult to distinguish them.
* A co-op baby firing will also end the camouflage effect.
* {{dlc|r}} {{E|Shopkeeper}}s can be destroyed by the area effect when firing tears for the first time in a room.
* {{dlc|nr}} This item does almost nothing in [[Greed mode]], despite being able to be obtained from the [[Treasure Room (Greed Mode Item Pool)|Greed mode Treasure Room]].
** {{Dlc|r}}Due to its ability to destroy {{E|Shopkeeper}}s, Camo Undies can net you some extra [[Penny|Pennies]] or [[Nickel]]s from shops and [[The Shop]] floor, should a Shopkeeper wave appear there.
sections.Synergies:
* [[activated collectible|Active]] items: May be used to deal damage without canceling the effect.
* [[Chasing familiar]]s: Familiars like these can chase and damage enemies with little risk. Best ones for the task are {{I|7 Seals}} and {{I|Daddy Longlegs}}, since they have long aggro range.
* [[Orbital familiar]]s: Enemies can be damaged with little risk, as the camo effect allows Isaac to get close enough for the orbital to deal damage with low risk of taking damage in return.
* {{I|120 Volt}} / {{I|Jupiter|n}} / {{I|Monstrance|n}} / {{i|Salvation|n}}: Great sources of passive damage without disrupting camo.
* {{i|Aries|r}}: Isaac can run into enemies without disrupting the camouflage.
* {{I|Blood Puppy}}: Like most enemies, a hostile Blood Puppy will not target Isaac while the camo effect is active, but it will still target and attack other enemies.
* {{I|Dark Arts}}: The stealth mode given by Camo Undies won't be removed by activating Dark Arts. However, Dark Arts only gives +0.5 speed while Camo Undies is active.
* {{i|Mars}}: Can be used to deal damage without cancelling the effect.
* {{I|Mom's Knife}}: As long as it's not being charged, the knife can deal damage passively.
** Will not break camouflage while using mouse controls to aim.
* {{I|Neptunus}}: The passive charge of Neptunus does not disrupt Camo, and the initial burst of damage is enhanced by Neptunus.
* {{I|Rock Bottom}}: Temporary tears and damage up do not go away, causing a permanent boost for the rest of the run.
* {{dlc+|r}} {{C|Tainted Judas}}: Gets a lot of use out of Camo Undies due to his in-built {{I|Dark Arts}} not disrupting camo.{{dlc-}}
* {{i|Venus}}: Charm effect activates while in stealth.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Brimstone}} / {{I|Chocolate Milk}} / {{I|Cursed Eye}} / {{I|Monstro's Lung}} / {{I|Spirit Sword}} / {{I|Tech X}}: Charging ends the camo effect, and the effect doesn't happen when entering a room with a full charge.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: Camo Undies will remain active until the tear is moved by pressing a button.
** {{Dlc|nr}} Since the tear follows Isaac, he can run around and use the tear to kill enemies.
*** {{dlc|r}} Tear no longer follows Isaac, but will still not remove Camo effect until moved.
* {{C|Tainted Forgotten}}: The item does not affect {{c|Tainted Soul}}, making it useless.

sections.Effects:
* Holding the active item button will deplete the charge bar. As the charge gets closer to zero, Isaac turns bluer over time.
* Once the charge bar hits zero, Isaac will become invincible to all outside sources of damage. If the button is held for an additional second after hitting zero, Isaac will take damage for every second the button is held down.
** Isaac loses invincibility once the active item button is released.
** {{dlc|r}} If the button is released before the charge bar hits zero, a negative sound effect will play and the item will lose all of its charge.
** {{dlc|r}} While Isaac is invincible, he deals 3.5 contact damage to enemies and beams of light will strike down enemies touching Isaac, dealing 15 damage.
** {{dlc|r}} Blocking damage at the exact moment the invincibility activates will create a 4-way cardinal beam of light that deals 12 damage per tick for a total of 180 damage per beam.
*** If an enemy is standing in the center of all the light beams, they will take a total of 720 damage.
* The item will recharge on its own, but cannot be used again until it is fully charged (even if the charge bar wasn't fully depleted).
sections.Notes:
* While not time-based, invincibility from Breath of Life is otherwise identical to damage immunity granted by the [[shield]] effect.
* Breath of Life will prevent damage from {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}s, {{e|Devil Beggar}}s, {{e|Hell Game}}s, and {{e|Confessional}}s, allowing them to be played infinitely for free.
* {{dlc|a+}} Once the invincibility takes effect, Isaac starts flashing rapidly.
** {{dlc|nr}} Isaac will continue flashing for about a second even when invincibility has ended after releasing the active item button.
* {{Dlc+|r}} Cannot be used to prevent damage from the door to the {{s|Mausoleum}}.{{dlc-}}
* {{dlc|r}} Taking damage from holding the active item button for too long is considered self-damage for the purposes of [[Devil Room#Conditions to Make Devil Rooms Appear|Angel/Devil Deal chances]] and items such as {{i|Paschal Candle|n}}.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Void|nr}}: Using Void with Breath of Life will immediately grant invincibility frames, then inflict damages to Isaac every second until he leaves the room.
* {{P|? Card}}/{{I|Car Battery}}/{{dlc|nr}}{{I|Habit}}/{{P|Wild Card}}: No effect.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac and picks up coins on the ground.
* After picking up 6 coins, Bum Friend will return to Isaac and drop a pickup.
* After that, Bum Friend has a 67% chance to drop a pickup after picking up 3 coins and a 33% chance to drop a pickup after picking up 4 coins.
* {{transformation contribution|Super Bum}}
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|BFFS!}}: All future drops will happen every 3 coins. If the next scheduled drop at the moment of acquiring BFFS! requires more than 3 coins, the amount will not be lowered.
* {{i|Mitre}}: {{e|Red Heart}}s that Bum drops can be converted into {{e|Soul Heart}}s.
* {{i|King Baby}} / {{t|RC Remote}}: No effect.
* {{I|Chaos|dlc=r}}: Bum Friend's item pedestals will be affected by Chaos, spawning an item from a random pool.

sections.Effects:
* Restores a {{E|Half Red Heart}} for every 13 [[monster|enemies]] killed.
* {{dlc|r}} +0.3 [[damage]].
sections.Notes:
* As {{C|Keeper}} and {{C|Tainted Keeper}}, [[Coin Heart]]s can be restored with this item.
* The healing effect is useless for characters that cannot use Red hearts.
** {{dlc+|r}} {{C|Tainted Bethany|n}} will gain one blood charge when it activates.{{dlc-}}
* Destroyed {{E|Shopkeeper}}s contribute to the counter.
* The healing counter also applies to enemies killed by familiars.
* If a room is cleared save for one enemy, it can be reset if the games is quit and resumed. The counter for Charm of the Vampire is saved along with the game, meaning the same room can be farmed for Red Hearts.
** The {{t|Door Stop}} trinket can be used to achieve this without having to save and quit the game. Simply leaving the room will reset the room.
sections.Interactions:
* {{dlc|r}} [[Cards and Runes|Ace Cards]]: Turning enemies into [[pickup]]s doesn't count towards the healing counter.
* {{i|E. Coli}} / {{i|Flush!}}: Enemies that are turned into poop don't count towards the healing counter.
* {{dlc|r}} [[Freeze|Freeze Effects]]: Enemies that die from being frozen don't count towards the healing counter.
** {{dlc|r+}} Frozen enemies do count for the healing effect.
* {{i|Maggy's Bow}}: No effect.
* {{I|My Reflection}}: Despite vampires having no reflection, Charm of the Vampire does not remove the effect of My Reflection.
* {{c|Tainted Magdalene}}: Restores a full {{E|Red Heart}} instead.

sections.Effects:
* Isaac gains a short delay charge attack that fires [[homing]], [[piercing]], [[spectral]] fetus tears.
** The fetus tears do 75% of Isaac's [[Damage]], 3.75 times per second, until they run out of [[Range]].
** The fetuses will automatically fire when Isaac is at full charge, meaning the charge cannot be held.
** Charge time is calculated based on [[Tear Delay]].
*** <math>\text{Fetuses per Second} = \frac{30}{Roundup(\text{Tear Delay} \times 3) + 1}</math>
*** Fetuses per second is capped at 15.
sections.Notes:
* Fetus size scales with damage.
* The fetuses slow down upon contacting enemies, making its homing effect more powerful.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Berserk!}}: Isaac can fire the fetuses on duration. The fetuses hold and attack with bone clubs that are identical to {{C|The Forgotten}}'s one.
* {{i|Brimstone}} / {{c|Azazel}}: Shoots 4 fetus tears along with the brimstone beam.
** Each additional beam created from {{I|Monstro's Lung}}, split tears (such as {{I|The Parasite}}), or multi-shot effects (including {{I|Loki's Horns}} and {{I|Eye Sore}}) spawns four additional fetuses.
** {{I|Anti-Gravity}}: The fetuses spawn when the beam is being released. The fetuses do not spawn if Isaac is charging when the beam is being released.
** {{I|The Ludovico Technique}}: When combined with {{i|Brimstone}}, overrides {{i|C Section}}: fetuses no longer spawn.
* {{i|Compound Fracture}}: Fetuses are skeletons that shoot splitting bone fragments when in contact with an enemy.
* {{i|Cricket's Body}}: Fetuses drop four short-ranged tears when they hit the ground.
* {{I|Dead Eye}}: Damage boost is granted once a fetus hits an enemy (once per fetus) and is reset when a fetus does not hit anything before going down, using the same rule to determine whether the damage boost is reset or not.
** This makes for a great synergy since the fetuses are homing and stay up much longer than regular tears.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}}: The fetuses drop small bombs when they touch an enemy. The bomb's damage follows Dr. Fetus' damage calculation, based on half of the fetuses damage. A fetus can drop only one bomb.
** The fetuses' bombs do not benefit from Isaac's bomb effects such as {{I|Hot Bombs}} or {{I|Bobby-Bomb}}. However, they do benefit from Isaac's tear effects and have the appearance of the corresponding bombs. For example, {{I|Hot Bombs}} from {{I|Fire Mind}}, {{I|Bobby-Bomb}} from [[homing]] tears. As such, {{I|Cricket's Body}}, {{I|The Parasite}}, and {{I|Polyphemus}} leave a subsequent bomb or bombs, and {{I|Mysterious Liquid}} leaves a creep.
** Dr. Fetus + {{I|Ipecac}}: The fetuses explode before dropping any bomb.
** Dr. Fetus + {{I|Haemolacria}}: Fetuses will both drop a bomb on touching an enemy and burst into multiple small bombs upon hitting the ground.
* {{I|Explosivo}}: Some Fetuses stick to enemies, expand, then explode. However, they do not inflict their contact damage while sticking.
** Explosivo + {{I|Mom's Knife}}: The knives from fetuses with Explosivo's effect create exploding tears for each damaging tick. The explosions from a knife deal 60 + half of the fetus' damage which held it.
** Explosivo + {{I|Berserk!}} / {{I|Spirit Sword}} / {{C|The Forgotten}} / {{C|Tainted Forgotten}}: The clubs/swords from fetuses with Explosivo's effect create exploding tears for each damaged enemy from their attack. The explosions from a club/sword deal 60 + the damage its attack dealt.
** Explosivo + {{I|Technology}}: The lasers from fetuses with Explosivo's effect create exploding tears for each damaged enemy from their attack. The tears inherit the fetuses' property, including laser attacks, from which can create more tears. The tears from a laser deal 60 + the laser's damage they originated, and their lasers deal the same as the lasers they originated. Fetuses can fire lasers while sticking to an enemy and spin, while tears do not spin.
** Explosivo + {{I|Tech X}}: The laser rings from fetuses with Explosivo's effect create exploding tears for each damaging tick. The explosions from a ring deal 60 + the ring's damage.
* {{c|The Forgotten}} / {{c|Tainted Forgotten}}: Fetuses are skeletons that attack with bone clubs in addition to contact damage. The fetuses from Tainted Forgotten deal 80% of their normal damage.
** With {{I|Brimstone}}: Spawns a brimstone ball along with a fetus. Shots are fired automatically as the charge completes.
** With {{I|Mom's Knife}}: Fetuses hold knives instead of bone clubs and no longer perform the swing attacks.
** With {{I|Monstro's Lung}} Tears remain unchanged; the Forgotten will fire a burst attack alongside the fetus. No effect on the Soul.

** [[Luck]]-based tear effects + {{I|Berserk!}} / {{I|Spirit Sword}} / {{I|Technology}} / {{C|The Forgotten}} / {{C|Tainted Forgotten}}: If a fetus has the effect, each attack also causes the effect.

** Mom's Knife + {{I|Proptosis}}: The knives shrink along with the fetuses, but they retain their tripled damage.

* {{i|Mucormycosis}}: Some Fetuses stick to enemies, expand, then burst. However, they do not inflict their contact damage while sticking. Unlike normal spores, the fetuses from the burst can home into the enemy they burst from.
** Mucormycosis + {{I|Mom's Knife}}: The knives from fetuses with Mucormycosis' effect create spores for each damaging tick. Their knives deal twice of Isaac's Damage, same as the ones they originated.
** Mucormycosis + {{I|Berserk!}} / {{I|Spirit Sword}} / {{C|The Forgotten}} / {{C|Tainted Forgotten}}: The clubs/swords from fetuses with Mucormycosis' effect create spores for each damaged enemy from their attack. The fetuses from the burst also hold clubs/swords which are able to create another wave of spores. The damage of attacks are calculated based on half of the spores' flat 3.5 damage.
*** {{I|Berserk!}} / {{C|The Forgotten}}: Their swings deal 10.5 damage.
*** {{C|Tainted Forgotten}}: Their swings deal 8.4 damage.
*** {{I|Spirit Sword}}: Their swing attacks/spin attacks/projectiles deal 8.75/24/11 damage.
** Mucormycosis + {{I|Technology}}: The lasers from fetuses with Mucormycosis' effect create spores for each damaged enemy from their attack. The spores inherit the fetuses' property including laser attacks, which can create another spores. The fetuses from the burst also has laser attacks which are able to create another wave of spores. Their laser attacks deal 3.5 damage, based on the spores' flat 3.5 damage. Fetuses can fire lasers while sticking to an enemy and spin, while spores do not spin.
** Mucormycosis + {{I|Tech X}}: The laser rings from fetuses with Mucormycosis' effect create spores for each damaging tick. The fetuses from the burst are also surrounded by laser rings which are able to create another wave of spores. Their rings deal 1.75 damage, based on half of the spores' flat 3.5 damage.
* {{I|My Reflection}}: Fetuses travel a short distance, then reverse direction and return to Isaac.
* {{i|The Parasite}}: Fetuses fire short-ranged tears constantly while in contact with an enemy.
* {{i|Parasitoid}}: Parasitoid fetuses spawn spiders/flies and slowing creep with every hit on an enemy.
* {{i|Polyphemus}}: Grants +5 flat damage with no fire rate down.
* {{i|Sinus Infection}}: Some Fetuses stick to enemies. However, they only do the Sinus Infection damage ticking and often result in dealing much less damage.
** Sinus Infection + {{I|Mom's Knife}}: The knives from fetuses with Sinus Infection's effect create boogers for each damaging tick. The boogers from a knife deal half of the fetus' damage which held it per tick.
** Sinus Infection + {{I|Berserk!}} / {{I|Spirit Sword}} / {{C|The Forgotten}} / {{C|Tainted Forgotten}}: The clubs/swords from fetuses with Sinus Infection's effect create boogers for each damaged enemy from their attack. The boogers from a club/sword deal half of the fetus' damage which held it per tick.
** Sinus Infection + {{I|Technology}}: The lasers from fetuses with Sinus Infection's effect create boogers for each damaged enemy from their attack. The boogers inherit the fetuses' property including laser attacks, which can create another boogers. The boogers from a laser deal the laser's damage, so does their lasers. Fetuses can fire lasers while sticking to an enemy and spin, while boogers do not spin.

On base [[Range]], they have just enough time to perform the attacks twice. The sword's size scales with the fetus' size.
** Spirit Sword + {{I|Berserk!}} / {{I|Mom's Knife}} / {{C|The Forgotten}} / {{C|Tainted Forgotten}}: The fetuses hold swords and do not benefit from the others.

sections.Effects:
* Gives Isaac one of the following [[stat]] boosts per half heart healed with {{e|Red Heart}} pickups or when gaining an extra filled heart container:
** +0.02 [[speed]].
** +0.05 [[tears]].
** +0.10 flat [[damage]].

sections.Notes:
* Items/effects that directly heal Isaac (such as {{i|Yum Heart}}, {{p|XIX - The Sun}}, {{i|Charm of the Vampire}}, etc.) do not trigger stat boosts from Candy Heart.
* Healing using {{e|Rotten Heart}}s triggers the stat boosts for Candy Heart.
* Picking up an {{e|Eternal Heart}} while already having one so that a new Red Heart container is formed provides stat boosts.
** The stat boosts are equivalent to picking up a full {{e|Red Heart}}.
** Picking up the first {{e|Eternal Heart}} does not grant stat boosts.
** Adding the second {{e|Eternal Heart}} to Isaac's health directly (e. g. by using {{i|Prayer Card}}) does not give stat boosts.
* This item does not give stats when adding to {{c|Tainted Bethany}}'s blood charges.
* This item is useless for characters that can't have red hearts (e.g. {{c|The Lost}}, {{c|Keeper}}, {{c|???}}, etc.).
* Any healing prior to picking up Candy Heart will not provide stat boosts.
* {{dlc|nr+}} The stat bonuses are "stored" on the Candy Heart. Dropping or losing it in any way won't immediately revert the bonuses gained, only when Isaac's stats are updated again. The respective stat changed is the one that loses the Candy Heart bonuses.
** The bonus stats will be lost if Isaac's stats are updated by dropping out of the game or if the game crashes.
* The stat bonuses are [[seed]]ed, meaning the same stat ups will apply in the same order in the same seed.
* Strategy Suggestion: Leaving Soul Hearts on the ground during a level allows the player to force Red Heart damage and still offer Devil/Angel Deal protection for the next floor.

sections.Effect:
* Upon use, transforms Isaac into a random [[character]] and {{dlc|nr+}} removes the last item collected (not including Clicker) or gulped [[trinket]].
** {{dlc|r+}} Now has a 50% chance to remove the last item collected or gulped [[trinket]].
** All stat changes of the new character are applied.
* {{dlc|r}} Non-tainted characters can only transform into other non-tainted characters, and tainted characters can only transform into other tainted characters.
sections.Notes:
* Clicker can only transform Isaac into characters that have already been unlocked, along with {{C|Black Judas}} and {{C|Lazarus Risen}}, who are counted as separate from {{C|Judas}} and {{C|Lazarus}} respectively. {{C|The Forgotten}} and {{C|The Soul}}, {{C|Jacob and Esau}}, {{c|Tainted Lazarus}} and {{C|Dead Tainted Lazarus}}, {{C|Tainted Forgotten}} and {{C|Tainted Soul}} are all counted as inherently linked dual-characters.
* {{i|Ankh}}, {{i|Lazarus' Rags}}, {{t|Missing Poster}}, or {{i|Judas' Shadow}} can allow a tainted character to become {{c|???}}, {{c|Lazarus}}, {{c|The Lost}}, or {{c|Black Judas}} (besides their respective tainted forms) allowing the Clicker to transform them into other non-tainted characters. There is no way for a non-tainted character to become a tainted character.
* {{dlc|nr}} It is possible for the Clicker to choose the same character as the one that is already being played as, making it seem like the item created no effect at all.
* Transforming into a new character does not grant Isaac the starting items of the new character unless they are inherent to the character. For example, transforming into {{C|Cain}} does not grant {{i|Lucky Foot}}.
* Changing characters can adversely affect health.
** All [[Red Heart container]]s will be lost, and all {{e|Bone Heart}} containers will be emptied when changing into {{C|???}}, {{dlc|r}} {{C|Black Judas}}, {{C|Tainted ???}}, {{C|Tainted Judas}}, or {{C|Tainted Forgotten}}. They will gain a {{E|Half Soul Heart}} if they would otherwise have no health.
** All health will be lost when changing into {{C|The Lost}}. Changing from The Lost to any other character will leave them with a {{E|Half Soul Heart}}.
** {{dlc|nr}} {{C|Keeper}} will always start with 2 [[Coin Heart]] containers. Bone and Half Soul/Black Hearts will be rounded up to 1 or 2 filled coins. Red Hearts are not rounded, which allows him to have half Coin Hearts. Changing from Keeper to any other character will turn his Coin Hearts into Red Hearts.
*** {{dlc|r}} All Red Heart containers are converted to Coin Heart containers when transforming into Keeper, with a minimum of 2 and up to a maximum of 3. Only red hearts will determine if the coin heart containers are filled or not, and Soul/Black hearts will be converted into blue flies. One coin heart container will be filled if he would otherwise have no health. Changing from Keeper to any other character will turn his Coin Hearts into Red Hearts.
** Changing into {{C|The Forgotten}} will not affect {{C|The Soul}}'s health. Red Hearts are converted into {{e|Bone Heart}}s. Soul/Black Hearts will be lost. He will gain an empty Bone Heart if he would otherwise have no health.
** {{dlc|r}} All soul hearts will be converted to soul charges when changing into {{C|Bethany}}. She will gain one full Red Heart container if she would otherwise have no health. Changing from Bethany to any other character will convert her soul charges into soul hearts.
** {{dlc|r}} Heart Containers will be divided evenly and split up when changing into {{C|Jacob and Esau}}. Changing from Jacob and Esau to any other character will leave them with Jacob and Esau's combined health.
* Activating Clicker typically only consumes passive items, but with {{i|Schoolbag}}, it can consume the item in the other activated item slot if that item was the most recently collected.
* Similarly to items such as {{i|Ankh}}, {{i|Lazarus' Rags}}, or {{i|Judas' Shadow}}  any [[completion mark]]s obtained will correspond with the character the Clicker turns you into.
** {{C|Tainted Cain}} can craft the Clicker and other useful items and then use Clicker to change characters.  In this way, runs started as Tainted Cain can be useful to complete other characters' completion marks, even when Tainted Cain's own completion marks are finished.  Although Clicker will only turn tainted characters into other tainted characters, Tainted Cain can also craft {{i|Ankh}}, {{i|Lazarus' Rags}}, or {{i|Judas' Shadow}} and die to become a non-tainted character then use the Clicker to change into other non-tainted characters.
* {{dlc|nr}} Removed items still count towards [[transformation]]s.
* Changing into {{C|Eden}} or {{C|Tainted Eden}} will not use tokens. Additionally, both Eden's base stats will be the same as Isaac's if he wasn't the character selected at the start of the run.
* Changing from {{C|Eden}} or {{C|Tainted Eden}} will leave the [[Luck]] stat decimal. If the character the Clicker turns you into has base luck stat different from 0, Luck will change by a whole number (e. g. turning into {{C|Keeper}} will decrease your base luck by 2 instead of setting it to -2.00).
* Changing into {{C|Jacob and Esau}} will randomly distribute items between the two. Changing from Jacob and Esau to any other character will leave them with Jacob and Esau's combined items. Changing into Jacob and Esau will drop the currently held consumables like [[pill]]s, [[card]]s etc. on the floor, but will keep trinkets. Esau's consumables and trinkets will always be dropped on the ground when changing to a different character. Jacob's consumables and trinkets will be transferred to the new character.
* Changing into {{c|Tainted Isaac}} will remove every passive item except the 8 oldest items Isaac holds.
* Changing into {{c|Tainted Lazarus}} will give every passive item to only one of the forms.
** Changing into {{c|Dead Tainted Lazarus}} will remove the auto-swap affect.
** Changing from {{c|Tainted Lazarus}} into another character will only keep the items of the form that used Clicker.
* {{dlc|nr}} If {{i|Dead Cat}} was the last item to be picked up, Clicker will remove individual lives instead of the entire item.
* {{dlc|nr}} If {{i|Halo of Flies}} was the last item to be picked up, Clicker will only remove one fly at a time (including [[Pretty Fly|Pretty Flies]] obtained from [[pill]]s and {{e|Slot Machine}}s) instead of the entire item.
* In {{mode|greed|greedier}}[[Greed Mode]], changing character using Clicker will update the Jam Chance of the [[Greed Donation Machine]] to the corresponding character chosen by Clicker.
** This can be useful for maxing out the coin counter of the machine, and obtaining unlocks while using a single character (like {{c|Lilith}} or {{c|Judas}}) to make the process easier and faster, and only changing characters at the end of the run.

sections.Effects:
* Isaac's tears are replaced with a charged blood laser beam. The beam is [[piercing]] and [[spectral]], dealing damage to all enemies and ignoring all obstacles in its path.
** The laser deals damage equal to Isaac's damage and deals damage each tick.
*** These ticks occur every 1/15th of a second (once every 4 frames). However, after the first damage tick, there is an additional pause for ~0.12 seconds (7 frames). Damage ticks work normally after that.
*** {{Dlc|nr}}Brimstone ticks 13 times over the course of 0.9 seconds (54 frames).
*** {{Dlc|r}}Brimstone ticks 9 times over the course of ~0.63 seconds (38 frames).
** <math>\text{Charge Time (s)} = \frac{1}{30}(Roundup(\text{Tear Delay)}) \approx \frac{1}{\text{Fire Rate}}</math>
** {{Dlc|r}}Starting from 15.00 [[fire rate]], the beam can last indefinitely as long as the fire key is held, and higher fire rate results in higher damage and larger scale.
*** <math>\text{Damage per Tick} = \frac{6 \times \text{Damage}}{\text{Tear Delay} + 1} = \frac{\text{Damage} \times \text{Fire Rate}}{5}</math>
* [[Tears]] down: {{Dlc|nr}} Tear Delay × 3 / {{Dlc|r}} Fire Rate ÷ 3.
* {{transformation contribution|Leviathan}}
sections.Notes:
* {{Dlc|nr}} Brimstone is a [[special item]].
* {{C|Azazel}} starts the game with a short-ranged, slower-charging version of Brimstone. Without the long-range version, his mini-brimstone won't have enough length to use any [[homing]] items.
** {{Dlc|a}}His Brimstone's shorter range can be increased with [[range]]-[[Range#Items That Affect Range|increasing]] items or [[pill]]s.
* Multi-shot effects like {{I|20/20}} will increase the number of beams accordingly, with exceptions listed below.
** Although extremely unlikely, Isaac can shoot a total of 16 blood beams at a time via multi-shot items. If the number of blood beams would exceed this number, the beams' span will instead widen.
* {{Dlc+|r}}{{c|Tainted Azazel}} has a full-range, but thinner beam whose damage is halved unless enemies are cursed by his inherent {{I|Hemoptysis}} sneeze.{{Dlc-}}
* The beam will apply [[Tear effect]]s and does so frequently thanks to its high tick rate.
* Any item that grants [[homing]] tears: will cause the beam to make sharp turns and even loops to hit enemies, which is extremely powerful. {{C|Azazel}}'s mini-brimstone does not home unless he has a high range stat.
* This item can be crafted from {{i|Bag of Crafting}} with eight {{e|Black Heart}}s.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|20/20|a}} / {{I|The Inner Eye}} / {{I|Mutant Spider}}: Fires a spread of 2/3/4 Brimstone beams.
** Despite the fire rate penalty caused by The Inner Eye and Mutant Spider, the overall DPS increase is more significant compared to 20/20. {{Dlc|r}}However, if combined, 20/20 negates the fire rate penalty of the aforementioned items, which results in enormous damage output.
* {{I|Almond Milk}}: Fires automatically upon reaching full charge. The beam lasts indefinitely as long as the fire key is held. The beam can change its direction while being fired, and can be aimed in any direction with joystick controls. The beam will also gain random worm trinket effects.
** Increasing the tears stat will increase the damage and width of Brimstone as well.
*** Damage per Tick = (Damage × Fire Rate) ÷ 5
* {{C|Azazel}} / {{C|Tainted Azazel|r}}: Picking up Brimstone with him will give him the regular version.
* {{I|Apple!|a+nr}} / {{I|Euthanasia|a+nr}} / {{I|Tough Love|nr}}: The beam can gain the damage multiplier from each of the items, although there is no visual difference. The bonus applies for the whole beam and not on a per-tick basis. Euthanasia loses its instant kill ability, however.
** {{Dlc|r}}The bonus applies randomly on every tick of the beam, including the insta-kill ability from Euthanasia.
* {{I|Anti-Gravity}}: An orb of energy expands, then shrinks while firing the beam after a delay. The orb still hurts enemies if they touch it. Isaac can start charging a new shot immediately after releasing the fire key without canceling the first shot, effectively allowing for a faster firing rate. It makes it harder to hit enemies with {{C|Azazel}} as the beam does not increase in range. {{Dlc|r}}Size and damage of the beams no longer scales with fire rate, nor is it possible to sustain a perpetual beam at above 15 fire rate.
** {{Dlc|r}} '''Anti-Gravity''' + {{I|Soy Milk}} / {{I|Almond Milk|n}}: Allows auto-firing upon full charge, but without permanent beam uptime.
** {{Dlc|anr}} '''Anti-Gravity''' + {{I|Incubus|n}}: Isaac will fire Brimstone orbs, while Incubus will fire regular Brimstone beams.
*** {{Dlc|r}} Both Isaac and Incubus fire Brimstone orbs.
* {{T|Brain Worm}}: The beam will curve 90 degrees in order to attack opponents, effectively acting as a stronger form of homing. Very strong against multi-segment bosses such as {{e|Pin}} or {{e|Mother|n}}.
* {{i|Brimstone}}:
** {{Dlc|nr}} Additional copies of this item, such as from {{I|Diplopia}} / {{I|Crooked Penny}}, adds another beam, with no increase in charge time.
** {{Dlc|r}} The first additional copy of this item grants a 1.2× damage multiplier and +1 [[damage]] and doubles the beam's width. Further copies will only grant +1 [[damage]].
*** If combined with {{C|Azazel}}'s {{I|Birthright|n}} effect, the laser beam will be 4× wider.
*** The bigger beam granted by double Brimstone synergizes with other items as expected.
* {{I|Chocolate Milk|dlc=r}}: Brimstone laser takes longer to fully charge, but can be released at any point. Width and damage of the laser increases with charge, from 25% damage and 50% width at minimum charge to 250% damage and 160% width at maximum charge.
* {{I|Continuum|r}}: Brimstone laser travels through the wall and appears out the other side once.
** '''Continuum''' + {{i|Rubber Cement|r}}: Instead of Continuum being overridden, the beam is reflected the second time it hits the wall. This results in it potentially overlapping with itself a total of three times.
* {{I|Cricket's Body|r}}: Spawns split tears on the first enemy or obstacle the beam hits.
* {{i|C Section}}: Shoots 4 fetus tears along with the Brimstone beam.
** '''C Section''' + {{i|Soy Milk|r}} / {{i|Almond Milk}}: Small fetuses fire continuously alongside the beam.
** '''C Section''' + {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: Fetus tears no longer fire with the Brimstone circle, even on doing damage.
* {{I|Dead Eye}}: The damage multiplier that was gained before picking up Brimstone will now be permanent. However, saving and quitting the run will result in this damage multiplier being permanently lost (which is a bug).
* {{I|Dataminer|r}}: Dataminer can be used to underflow Isaac's tears to immediately bring it to 120, maxing out Brimstone's width and damage via tears.
* {{I|Epic Fetus|a}}: Adds a Brimstone Sad Bombs effect: missile explosions shoot ten beams in all directions, massively increasing damage and area of effect.
* {{I|Explosivo|r}} / {{i|Sinus Infection|n}}: The beam has a chance to stick tears to enemies on every other tick.
* {{dlc+|r}}{{I|Eye of the Occult}}: Creates a controllable crosshair similar to {{i|Marked}}. Fires automatically upon reaching full charge. The beam curves towards the crosshair and then attempts to hit the wall Isaac is facing.{{dlc-}}
** '''Eye of the Occult''' + {{i|Tech.5}} / {{i|Technology 2}}: Tech.5 and Technology 2 lasers are also affected by the crosshair but cannot create the crosshair on their own.
* {{tf|Guppy}}: [[Blue Flies]] are spawned at a rate of approximately one blue fly per tick ({{Dlc|r}}every other tick) of damage for each enemy it hits, up to 13 flies. The spawned blue flies will also move to attack the targeted enemy immediately.
* {{I|Haemolacria}}: +20 Tear Delay after Haemolacria's tears down. Tears burst into 4-7 Brimstone beams that do Isaac's damage per tick.
** {{C|Azazel}} / {{C|Tainted Azazel|r}}: Overrides these characters' Brimstone. Tears do not burst into Brimstone beams.
** {{Dlc|r}} Double '''Brimstone''': Grants +1 Damage but not the 1.2× damage multiplier. The width of the beams doubles.
** '''Haemolacria''' + {{I|Chocolate Milk}}: The Brimstone beams deal full damage regardless of charge.
** {{Dlc|r}} '''Haemolacria''' + {{I|Technology}}: The lasers coil the beams. This is purely visual and does not grant a 1.5× damage multiplier.
* {{I|Head of the Keeper|r}}: Makes the laser yellow and each tick has a chance to drop a coin.
* {{i|Hemoptysis}}: Enemies hit by the sneeze will gain a curse that increases the damage Brimstone deals to 2× and +3 flat damage. Enemies who die to Brimstone under the curse will damage and spread the curse to nearby enemies.
* {{I|Holy Light|r}}: Every tick of the beam has a chance of summoning a beam of light.
* {{T|Hook Worm}}: Beam shifts left to right while firing straight and forms angles that constantly flatten and expand, effectively increasing its width.
* {{I|Jacob's Ladder|r}}: Upon hitting an enemy, wall, or obstacle, the beam generates sparks that home in on enemies.
* {{I|Lead Pencil|r}}: Lead Pencil triggers approximately every 2 seconds as the beam is fired (charge time is not counted).
* {{I|Loki's Horns}}: Adds a chance to shoot a beam from all four cardinal directions, similarly to {{I|Head of Krampus}}'s effect.
* {{i|Lost Contact}}: Beam destroys projectiles, although only during its damage tick interval. The projectiles are not instantly destroyed when they touch the beam.
* {{I|The Ludovico Technique}}: The Ludovico Technique has priority. The beam forms a large ring that is controllable and does not need to be charged. The damage is dealt 15 times per second, unaffected by [[Tears]]. Enemies inside the ring without touching it are not hurt.
** '''The Ludovico Technique''' + {{I|Brimstone}} same size and damage output multiplier as 2 copies of Brimstone, but applied to the laser ring.
** '''The Ludovico Technique''' + multi-shot effect: No effect.
** '''The Ludovico Technique''' + {{i|Apple!}} / {{i|Holy Light}} / Other tear effects: no effect.
** '''The Ludovico Technique''' + {{i|C Section}}: Disables C Section. Fetuses no longer spawn.
** '''The Ludovico Technique''' + {{I|Incubus}}:
*** {{Dlc|nr}} Incubus' Brimstone laser is not affected by Ludovico Technique.
*** {{Dlc|r}} Adds a smaller controllable laser ring in addition to the main one.
** {{Dlc|r}} '''The Ludovico Technique''' + {{I|Twisted Pair}}: Adds 2 even smaller controllable laser rings in addition to the main one.
** '''The Ludovico Technique''' + {{I|A Lump of Coal}}: The ring increases in diameter when Isaac is further; 100% when he is on the center, 1.25× when he is 12.5 tiles of distance away.
*** {{Dlc|nr}} The damage increases with distance but is reduced while Isaac is in the ring.
*** {{Dlc|r}} The damage increases 20% per tile of distance.
** '''The Ludovico Technique''' + {{I|Mom's Knife}}: Overrides Brimstone.
** '''The Ludovico Technique''' + {{I|Proptosis}}: The ring deals 1.5× Isaac's Damage at its largest, and 50% at its smallest. The ring increases in diameter when Isaac is closer; 1.25× when he is on the center, 100% when he is 12.5 tiles of distance away.
* {{I|A Lump of Coal|dlc=a}}: The beam gradually increases in size and damage the farther it travels, with the damage increasing on a multiplier that is +20% per tile of distance. This allows for a huge damage increase from longer distances.
* {{I|Marked|r}}: Fires automatically upon reaching full charge. Fires at the direction of the crosshair.
* {{I|Mom's Eye}}: Adds a chance to shoot a beam from the back of Isaac's head.
* {{I|Mom's Knife}}: Mom's Knife has priority. Does not apply Brimstone's tears down. Adds a small barrage of knives after the main knife is fired, with each knife doing {{Dlc|nr}} 80% of / {{Dlc|r}} 2× Isaac's tear damage.
** The barrage of knives goes all the way across the screen and does not return.
** Charge amount increases the barrage size; 2-4 knives at 0%, 8-10 knives 100%.
** This effect does not work with {{C|Azazel}} or {{C|Tainted Azazel}}'s versions of Brimstone.
* {{I|Mom's Wig|dlc=na+}}: Holding down a fire button to charge the attack very rapidly rolls the probability to spawn [[Blue Spider]]s; releasing to fire the beam, however, does not.
** {{dlc|a+}} The blue spiders only spawn while the beam is firing.
* {{I|Monstro's Lung|a}}: Brimstone has priority. Does not apply Monstro's Lung's tears down. Fires 3-5 additional beams in random directions around Isaac. This effect also applies to {{C|Azazel}} and {{C|Tainted Azazel|r}}'s Brimstone.
** {{Dlc|nr}} Charging a new Brimstone beam removes the original from in front of Isaac, but not the additional ones added by Monstro's Lung.
* {{I|Multidimensional Baby}}: If a brimstone laser is shot through the baby, it will double the laser.
* {{I|My Reflection|anr}}: Makes the beam curve when moving. It has the same effect on {{C|Azazel}}'s mini-brimstone but doubles the range.
** {{Dlc|r}}Makes the beam shoot from the back. An oval beam is shot from the front instead.
* {{I|Mucormycosis}}: The beam has 25% chance to spawn spore to enemies on every other tick.
* {{I|Mysterious Liquid|a}}: Leaves a creep for each enemy and obstacle the beam hits, on every other tick. {{C|Azazel}}'s Brimstone leaves creeps at the end of its range.
* {{I|Ocular Rift}}: Rifts may appear where the beam hits rocks, walls, or enemies.
* {{T|Ouroboros Worm|dlc=r}}: The beam will make large loops on itself. The homing is present, but unreliable.
* {{I|The Parasite|r}}: Spawns two perpendicular beams on the first enemy or obstacle the beam hits.
** {{dlc|r+}} Also spawns small split tears.
* {{I|Rotten Tomato}}: Each tick of the beam's damage can mark enemies.
* {{I|Rubber Cement|a}}: Beams bounce off of walls once, creating a second beam that deals {{Dlc|nr}}half/{{Dlc|r}}full damage.
** {{Dlc|ana+}}If {{C|Azazel}}'s mini Brimstone beam bounces off a wall, it effectively becomes a full-length Brimstone beam, but it will still only deal half damage.
*** {{Dlc|a+}}{{C|Azazel}}'s Brimstone no longer becomes a full length beam after bouncing, instead bouncing as a regular mini-Brimstone.
** {{i|Soy Milk}}: The Brimstone beam bounces off the wall at a perpendicular angle to where the beam was fired.
* {{I|Sad Bombs}}: Upon exploding, bombs release ten beams in all directions.
** {{Dlc|r}}Brimstone does not benefit from Sad Bombs' flat damage bonus.
* {{I|Soy Milk|dlc=r}}: Fires automatically upon reaching full charge. The beam lasts i

sections.Effects:
* Upon use, copies the effects of the [[Cards and Runes#Runes|rune]] or [[Cards and Runes#Soul Stones|soul stone]] currently held by Isaac.
* Drops one random rune upon being picked up for the first time.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Tarot Cloth}}: No effect.
* {{I|Void}}: If Void absorbs both Clear Rune and a consumable-producing item like {{I|Mom's Bottle of Pills}} the latter takes effect first, shifting any held rune out of the primary consumable slot and rendering the Clear Rune effect useless.

sections.Effects:
* Grants a {{E|Soul Heart}}.
* Any damage dealt to Isaac has a 20% chance to be ignored.
** This includes damage through tears, contact, explosions, {{R|Curse Room}}, {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}s, {{e|Devil Beggar}}s, and Bad Trip [[pill]]s.
*** Contact damage with enemies is difficult to avoid, as the damage negation does not provide invincibility frames.
** Isaac flashes briefly blue when damage is negated. The flash can occur even while invincible from taking a hit or using an invincibility effect.
sections.Synergies:

* {{i|Hallowed Ground}} / {{i|Host Hat}} / {{i|Infamy}} / {{i|Belly Jelly}} / {{i|Metal Plate}} / {{i|Star of Bethlehem}}: Offers an additional chance to negate damage.
* {{i|Holy Mantle}}: Cone Head's chance of blocking damage is applied before the Holy Mantle, allowing the Holy Mantle shield to be saved.
sections.Interactions: * {{i|Dull Razor}}: Damage prevention will prevent on-damage effects from occurring.

sections.Effects:

* The flies are completely invulnerable and ignored by enemies.

* {{dlc+|r}} {{transformation contribution|Oh Crap}}{{dlc-}}
sections.Notes:

* All flies spawned during {{e|The Beast}}'s fight (and any Ultra Harbinger fight before that) will persist at a static position on-screen and will not move as the screen scrolls.
sections.Synergies:

* {{i|Car Battery}}: Two flies will be spawned instead of one.

sections.Effect:
* Spawns a [[familiar]] which follows Isaac and picks up any nearby [[coin]]s. Bumbo changes level based on the amount of coins it's collected.
:: [[file:Collectible Bumbo level 1.png|30px|link=]] '''Level 1 (0-5 coins):''' Bumbo just collects coins to level up.
:: [[file:Collectible Bumbo level 2.png|30px|link=]] '''Level 2 (6-11 coins):''' Bumbo occasionally drops a [[pickup]], [[trinket]], [[chest]] or pedestal item after a room clear.
:: [[file:Collectible Bumbo level 3.png|30px|link=]] '''Level 3 (12-23 coins):''' Bumbo now fires tears that deal 3.5 damage in the same direction Isaac does. Bumbo's tears have a chance to drop a coin if they hit an enemy.
:: [[file:Collectible Bumbo level 4.png|30px|link=]] '''Level 4 (24+ coins):''' Bumbo no longer fires tears and instead chases enemies slowly and deals contact damage (2.5 per tick, or {{dlc|nr}}37.5 per second/{{dlc|r}}10.7 per second). Bumbo will occasionally drop {{e|Bomb}}s while chasing enemies or coins.
* After reaching level 4, Bumbo will continue to collect coins, and can drop a pickup, trinket, or chest for each coin it collects, similar to {{i|Bum Friend}}.
** Bumbo can also drop items from the current room's [[Item Pool]].
sections.Notes:
* Level 1-3 Bumbo can fly over pits and [[obstacle]]s, despite having limbs at level 2 and 3 that serve him as legs.
* If Bumbo consumes an absurd amount of coins while level four, Bumbo can become level one again (Unsure if bug, likely a buffer overflow)
* If Level 4 Bumbo targets {{E|Mega Satan}}'s head, Bumbo will attempt to "chase" him the entire fight by standing in the middle of the room.
* Level 4 Bumbo's bombs are unaffected by Isaac's bomb synergies.
* Bumbo cannot pick up {{e|Sticky Nickel}}s and will hover over them. Level 4 Bumbo can eventually bomb the Sticky Nickel to free it.
* Bumbo will pick up {{E|Lucky Penny|text=Lucky Pennies}}, without additional benefit to evolution or drops.
* If Bumbo drops a pedestal item, it will be pulled from the current room's [[item pool]].
* In a [[RERUN]], Bumbo's level is reset.
* Level 4 Bumbo can target charmed enemies and will try to follow them around to no effect.  This prevents him from picking up coins until the target is changed.
* {{Dlc+|r}} There is a [[boss]] that resembles Bumbo level 4 named {{E|Bumbino}}.{{dlc-}}
* {{dlc|anr}} From a scoring perspective, Coins that Bumbo picks up count towards your Schwag bonus on daily runs.
sections.Synergies: * {{i|BFFS!}}: Doubles both the contact and shot damage, when applicable.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Box of Friends}}: Will spawn a level 1 Bumbo regardless of the original Bumbo's current level.
* {{C|Keeper}}: Not recommended, as the coins Bumbo collects could have been used to heal Keeper.
* {{C|Tainted Keeper}}: Due to the large influx of coins spawned, it's technically possible to sustain Bumbo while also maintaining a good level of wealth and health.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a battery [[familiar]] that, while Isaac is in an uncleared room, every 30 seconds, starting from the moment it has been picked up, does one of the following:
** Spawns a {{E|Lil' Battery}}. It does this a maximum of 2 times per [[room]].
*** {{dlc|r}} Can also spawn a {{E|Micro Battery|n}} or {{E|Mega Battery|n}} instead.
** Adds a charge to Isaac's [[activated collectible|activated item]]. It does this a maximum of 2 times per [[room]].
** [[Petrification|Petrifies]] all enemies for 1.3 seconds.
** Nothing.
sections.Notes:
* Charged Baby becomes very powerful as {{C|Lilith}} in [[Greed mode]], as the duplicates will continue to spawn Lil' Batteries, leading to a huge chain of familiars.
* {{dlc|r}} [[Familiar]]s that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Charged Baby having the lowest priority at {{dlc|nr+}} 6th / {{dlc|r+}} 8th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.
* In an uncleared room, if Charged Baby familiar has reached the maximum of spawned batteries and/or added activated item charges, Isaac may re-enter the room (e.g. by bombing a closed door, having {{t|Door Stop}} or {{I|Mercurius}}) to reset Charged Baby's effect limits.
** This effectively allows farming for batteries and activated item charges, given the player's patience, ability to avoid enemies present in the room, and a way to re-enter the room indefinitely.
sections.Synergies: * {{i|BFFS!}}: Familiar is bigger and drops Lil' Batteries more often. No effect on its other abilities.

sections.Effects:
* +0.3 [[speed]].
* Decreases Isaac's size, making him less likely to be hit.
* Upon pickup, gives Isaac a random [[pill]]. If he is already holding a consumable, it is forcibly dropped to the ground.
sections.Notes: * {{Dlc|nr}} It will still drop a pill even if the player has {{I|Starter Deck}}.

sections.Effects:
* Gives Isaac +5 {{e|Bomb}}s.
* Upon exploding, Isaac's bombs fire 4 {{i|Brimstone}} lasers in the cardinal directions.
** Each laser deals 8 damage per tick, and can hit up to 19 times.
** Multiple lasers cannot hit the same enemy simultaneously.
** The lasers cannot damage Isaac.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|BBF}} / {{I|Bob's Brain}}: Inherits the effect in full, firing lasers every time they explode.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}} / {{i|Epic Fetus}}: Attacks have a small chance to trigger this effect. Chance goes up to 100% at 30 luck.
* {{i|Hemoptysis}}: Enemies hit by the sneeze will gain a curse that increases the damage the Brimstone lasers deal to 19 damage per tick. Enemies who die to the Brimstone lasers under the curse will damage and spread the curse to nearby enemies.
* {{tf|Guppy}} / {{i|The Mulligan}}: The lasers can create [[Blue Fly|Blue Flies]] when they deal damage.
* {{I|Kamikaze!}}: Activating Kamikaze! sends Brimstone lasers in all 4 directions.
* [[Locust|Red Locusts]] / {{i|Scatter Bombs}}: Explosions made by the red locusts and tiny bombs create thinner lasers that deal 4.8 damage per tick instead of 8.
* {{i|Multidimensional Baby}}: Placing Multidimensional Baby in front of the beam will transform it into two black-and-white beams.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Bomber Boy}}: Only the center explosion will fire lasers.
* {{i|Anarchist Cookbook}}: The lasers fired by the troll bombs will push other troll bombs around, likely to the edges of the room.

sections.Effects:
* Grants 6 empty {{e|Bone Heart}}s.
* Removes all current {{E|Red Heart|text=Red Heart Containers}}. Does not remove existing Bone Hearts, but does empty them.
* Upon losing a Bone Heart, including ones acquired from other sources, Isaac fires a ring of 8 bones that split into more bones.
** Each Bone Heart lost adds a permanent {{dlcalt|+0.5 [[tears]] up|r=+0.4 [[fire rate]], which can break the tear fire rate cap}}.
** Each bone does twice Isaac's damage plus a flat 22 damage; split bones do half this amount.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Empty Vessel}}: The empty Bone Hearts will trigger Empty Vessel's effects.
* {{p|XIX - The Sun?}}: Using the card before picking up Brittle Bones allows Isaac to keep the [[heart container]]s since they will be temporarily converted to {{e|Bone Heart}}s.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Genesis}}: Removes the tear upgrades upon use.
* {{t|Found Soul}}: The soul does not benefit from the tears up granted to Isaac. However, it will receive a fire rate increase if it somehow receives Bone Hearts and breaks them.

sections.Effects:
* At the beginning of each floor, spawns 2 portals that lead to certain special rooms:
** A red portal leading to the {{R|Boss Room}}.
** A yellow portal leading to the {{R|Treasure Room}}.
** A blue portal leading to the {{R|Secret Room}}.
**{{dlc|r+}} A green portal leading to the {{R|Shop}}.
* On floors with no treasure rooms or no secret rooms, only 1 portal will spawn.
* The portals will disappear once the starting room is left, whether a portal was taken or not.
sections.Notes:
* Assuming that each portal has an equal chance of spawning, before chapter 4, each portal has a {{dlc|nr+}}2/3 {{dlc|r+}}1/2 chance to appear. From chapter 4 onward, there's a 1/2 chance of either color spawning.
** In challenges without treasure rooms or without secret rooms, only 1 portal will spawn on each floor.
* No portals will spawn in {{s|Home}}.
* During the [[Ascent]], the portal will spawn in the "starting room" that leads to the next floor.
* Entering the starting room in the [[Mirrored World]] will cause the portals to spawn there, leading to the mirror's treasure, secret, boss, {{dlc|r+}} or shop.
* If the run is exited, the portals will not be there upon continuing.
* In {{s|The Void}} the boss portal will lead to a random boss, not necessarily {{E|Delirium}}.
* Entering a portal with {{cu|Maze}} active on the current floor has a chance of teleporting Isaac to a random room instead.
* The Treasure Room portal will not lead to a {{R|Planetarium}} if available, unlike {{P|XVII - The Stars}}.
* {{dlc+|r+}} Card Reading's quality is treated as 2 for the purposes of {{I|Bag of Crafting}}.{{dlc-}}
sections.Interactions:
* {{t|Bloody Crown}}: Makes a second portal spawn in Chapter 4.
* {{T|Holy Crown}}/{{T|Wicked Crown}}: Makes a second portal spawn in Chapter 5, if on the respective floor.

sections.Effects:
* In each room, the first enemy killed will release a gas explosion and [[poison]] nearby enemies.
** Poisoned enemies will also release gas upon death, spreading the effect.
*** Poisoned enemies do not need to die while the poison is still active to spread the effect.
** The initial gas explosion deals 5 damage, and the poison deals Isaac's [[Damage|tear damage]] per tick, for 6 ticks.
sections.Notes:
* The effect will also activate if a {{e|Shopkeeper}} is destroyed before killing any enemies.
** Re-entering a room and destroying another {{e|Shopkeeper}} inside it will trigger the effect for a second time.
* The gas explosion and poison can damage [[friendly]] enemies.
sections.Synergies: * {{t|Gigante Bean}}: Greatly increases the size of the gas explosions, making the poison spread much more effective.
sections.Interactions:
* {{dlc|r}} [[Cards and Runes|Ace Cards]]: Enemies that are turned into [[pickup]]s can't create a gas explosion.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}}/{{i|Epic Fetus}}: Explosion damage does not apply to poison damage.
* {{i|E. Coli}}/{{i|Flush!}}: Enemies that are turned into poop can't create a gas explosion.
* {{dlc|r}} [[Freeze]] effects: Enemies that are frozen are still "alive" and can create a gas explosion when they are the first ice statue broken before any other enemy in the room dies.
* {{i|Ipecac}}: Ipecac only applies a 2x multiplier as opposed to +40 to poison damage.
* [[Poison]] tears: No effect. Gas explosions will only be triggered by poison caused by Contagion.
* {{t|Second Hand}}: Poison duration is not affected.

sections.Effects:
* Grants 3 {{e|Black Heart}}s.
* +1 [[damage]].
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|r+}} This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|The Heretic}}.{{dlc-}}
* When purchased at a {{r|Devil Room}} by {{c|???}} (or another character who has lost all Red Heart containers), this item effectively converts 3 {{e|Soul Heart}}s into 3 {{e|Black Heart}}s, increasing damage at no downside.
sections.Synergies: * {{t|Black Feather}}: Ceremonial Robes counts as an 'evil' item, granting a damage boost.

sections.Effect:

*** {{dlc|r}} Also: {{e|Rock Spider|n}}, {{e|Strider|n}}, {{e|Swarm Spider|n}}, {{e|Tinted Rock Spider|n}} and {{e|Trite|n}}.

**** Trites will still uselessly try to target Isaac.
*** {{dlc|a+}} Spiders and Big Spiders don't blink red when Isaac has the item.

** {{dlc|r}} Affected enemies that deal no contact damage but can still damage Isaac through other methods include: {{e|Blind Creep|n}}, {{e|Blister|n}}, {{e|Migraine|n}}, {{e|Rage Creep|n}}, {{e|Ragling|n}}, {{e|Rag Man's Ragling|n}}, {{e|Soy Creep|n}}, {{e|Tainted Soy Creep|n}}, {{e|The Thing|n}}, {{e|Ticking Spider|n}}, and {{e|Wall Creep|n}}.

** {{dlc|r}} {{e|Coal Spider|n}}s aren't aggressive to Isaac, but will still deal contact damage.
** {{dlc|r}} {{e|Twitchy|n|text=Twitchies}} are not counted as "spider" enemies and are unaffected by this item.
* {{transformation contribution|Spider Baby|dlc=r}}
sections.Notes: * {{dlc|r}} If either one of {{C|Jacob and Esau}} holds Bursting Sack, both gain the benefits.

sections.Effects:
* Upon use, converts [[pickup]]s within the current room to [[Blue Fly|Blue Flies]] or [[Blue Spider]]s.
* Doubles Isaac's current amount of Blue Flies and Spiders.
** If Isaac has no Blue Flies or Spiders, spawns one Blue Fly or Spider.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|r}} The item will cost 10 cents if found in a {{r|Shop}}
* Does not work on {{E|Troll Bomb}}s or {{E|Mega Troll Bomb}}s.
* One character using it does not seem to double the spiders/flies for other characters. It only seems to double the ones following the character using the item.
* {{dlc|r}} [[Locust]]s will not be doubled by Compost.

sections.Effects:
* This item is acquired when Isaac takes damage while holding {{i|Glass Cannon}}. It begins with no charges.
* Once fully charged, it automatically turns back into Glass Cannon.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|nr+}} {{c|Eden}} can start with this item.
* Charging this item does not count as using it. Items and trinkets that activate on active item use (such as {{t|Broken Remote}}) do not activate when charging this item.
* If the player manages to obtain a usable fully charged Broken Glass Cannon, it will turn into Glass Cannon on use. This use counts as a use for items and trinkets that activate on active item use.
** Clearing a room with this fully charged Broken Glass Cannon will also turn it into Glass Cannon. This does not count as a use.

sections.Effects:
* {{Dlc|nr}} Spawns a [[familiar]] that floats slowly around the room in a zig-zag pattern similar to {{i|The Peeper}} and shoots normal tears in the same direction as Isaac.
** {{dlc|na}} Each tear deals 3.5 damage.
** {{dlc|anr}} Each tear deals Isaac's damage.
* {{Dlc|r}} Spawns a [[familiar]] that follows Isaac and copies all of his tear modifiers/stats (like {{I|Incubus|n}}), with a 25% [[damage]] reduction. It fires randomly in the cardinal directions.
sections.Notes:
* Unlike {{i|The Peeper}}, Cain's Other Eye does no contact damage.
* {{dlc|r}} [[Familiar]]s that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Cain's Other Eye having {{dlc|nr+}} 5th / {{dlc|r+}} 7th priority.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Analog Stick|r}}: The familiar will fire in completely random directions, not locked to the cardinal ones.
* {{I|Epic Fetus|r}}: Cain's Other Eye gains a crosshair and rocket similar to Isaac's but smaller. Caution is required, as the crosshair is erratic and will constantly shake, possibly making the rocket hit Isaac.
* {{i|Eye of the Occult}}: The familiar's tears travel a very short distance in their original direction and can be controlled afterwards.
* {{I|King Baby|r}}: Cain's Other Eye will attempt to fire directly at enemies but only when they are on the same side as the random direction it is firing in.
* {{i|Mom's Knife|r}}: The familiar will constantly swing its knife, trying to point it in the random direction it is firing in. When the fire button is released, the knife will travel in whatever direction it is pointing at the moment (it can be '''any''' direction, not necessarily a cardinal one).

sections.Effects:
* Sets Isaac's Red [[Heart container]]s to 1 when being picked up.
** Does not remove {{E|Soul Heart}}s or {{E|Black Heart}}s unless picked up as {{C|???}}, {{c|The Soul}}, {{dlc|r}} {{C|Black Judas}}, {{C|Tainted Judas}}, {{c|Tainted ???}}, {{c|Tainted Forgotten}}, or {{C|Tainted Bethany}}.
** {{dlc|a+}} Does not remove {{E|Bone Heart|n}}s unless picked up as {{c|The Forgotten|n}}.
*** Can be picked up as The Soul half of The Forgotten to remove all but 1 Soul heart and keep all Bone Hearts.
* Grants 9 extra lives.
** Upon death, Isaac respawns with 1 Red [[Heart container]], typically in the previous room. 
* The head of Guppy begins following Isaac like a familiar upon pickup but doesn't do anything.
** When Isaac has lost all of the lives provided by this item, the Guppy familiar will disappear.
* {{transformation contribution|Guppy}}
sections.Notes:
* This item can drop from killing {{e|Super Pride}}. {{dlc|nr}} Super Pride can drop this item even if Isaac has already encountered/possessed it. 
* Resurrection items activate in a [[:Category:Revival items|set order]]. Dead Cat is {{dlc|nr}} 2nd / {{dlc|r}} 4th in this order after {{p|Soul of Lazarus}}, {{i|1up!}}, and {{c|Lazarus|r}}' inherent extra life.
* {{dlc|na}} Picking this item up as {{c|The Lost}} does not show the number of lives remaining, but still functions normally.
* {{dlc+|a+}} If picked up as {{c|The Forgotten}}, his Bone Hearts are reduced to 1 but {{c|The Soul}}'s Soul Hearts remain unaffected; It is also true the other way.{{dlc-}}
* The lives are added after the "picking up an item" animation has ended, so characters that die while the animation is playing will not be revived by this item.
* {{dlc|nr}} The effects of the {{i|D4}}, {{i|D100}}, {{i|Missing No.}}, or a 1- or 6-pip {{r|Dice Room}} will not remove the lives granted by this item.
* Additional Dead Cats can be picked up during a run, increasing lives well past 9. {{dlc|nr}} Only the first dead cat counts toward becoming Guppy.
* {{dlc|a+nr}} This item counts as 9 items, so if Isaac is trying for an early portal to {{s|The Void}} after beating {{E|Mom}}, this will significantly boost the progress closer to 20 items.
* {{Dlc+|r}} If {{c|Jacob and Esau}} take the item, only the brother who takes it will be set to one Red Heart Container on pickup. But if they die, both are resurrected with one Red Heart Container.{{dlc-}}
** If both brothers take the item (via {{I|Diplopia}} or {{I|Birthright}}), resurrections will be subtracted from Jacob before Esau, regardless of which brother actually died.
* {{c|Tainted Jacob}}'s health will still be reduced to 1 Red Heart Container if he takes this item after being touched by {{E|Dark Esau|n}} or if he dies in his Lost form.
* {{dlc|r}} [[Familiar]]s that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Dead Cat having the lowest priority at {{dlc|nr+}} 6th / {{dlc|r+}} 8th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.
* If Isaac somehow obtains Dead Cat in the starting room of Chapter 1 and dies before ever leaving it, he will respawn in that same room.
** {{dlc|r}} Similarly, during the fight against {{E|The Beast|n}}, Isaac will respawn in the same room on the spot and can continue the battle.
* {{dlc|r}} Despite the life counter being shown during the {{e|Mother's Shadow|n}} chase, the item is inactive like all other items and will not provide extra lives.
* {{dlc|r}} If all 9 lives are used, Dead Cat disappears from Isaac's inventory.  If Isaac only has three Guppy items prior to losing Dead Cat, then its disappearance will cause the Guppy transformation to be lost.
* {{dlc+|r+}} Dead Cat's quality is treated as 2 for the purposes of {{I|Bag of Crafting}}.{{dlc-}}
sections.Synergies:
* {{E|Gold Heart|anr}}s: Gives Isaac many coins when picked up, due to the amount of hearts lost.
* {{i|Guppy's Paw}}: In addition to contributing to the transformation, converting the Red Heart Container obtained after revival into three Soul Hearts effectively triples Isaac's HP.

{{cit|ua|r}} {{C|Tainted Judas}} starts with this item in his consumable slot.

sections.Effects:
* When used, Isaac gains +1.0 [[speed]] and can walk through enemies/bullets for 1 second or until he shoots. If Isaac walks through an enemy or bullet during this time, it freezes until the effect ends, then takes damage equal to 2× Isaac's [[damage]] plus a flat 3.5. If there are multiple enemies/projectiles caught in the attack, each consecutive attack deals an additional flat 3.5 damage. At the end of the effect, an area of effect blast is created, dealing more damage the more enemies or bullets were pierced during the effect.
** The damage of the blast at the end of Dark Arts is equal to the sum of all damage dealt while dashing between enemies.
*** Bullets walked through will still count for the final blast damage calculation, even though they can't be damaged.
sections.Notes:
* The invincibility can be canceled early by firing tears (and hence receive the damage bonus early with Tainted Judas or Black Judas).
* If an enemy/bullet Isaac walks through dies or otherwise disappears before Dark Arts deactivates, they will not grant a damage bonus.
* Orbitals that deal contact damage such as {{i|Forever alone}} will still deal damage and potentially kill an enemy, while those that block shots like [[Familiar#Orbital Familiars|Pretty Flies]] will still block and destroy projectiles.
** Dark Arts still works on reflected bullets.
** Explosive projectiles will explode when destroyed by Dark Arts.
* While Dark Arts is active, Isaac:
**Cannot pick up items or donate to {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}s or {{e|Devil Beggar}}s.
**Cannot open [[Chests]]. Standing on {{E|Spiked Chest}}s or {{E|Mimic Chest}}s when the effect ends will safely open them without taking damage.
**Can pass through {{r|Curse Room}} doors or over [[spikes]].
**Can still press {{g|Pressure Plate}}s, including the button in [[Greed Mode]] without taking damage.
* Dark Arts will trigger certain tear effects on enemies it damages, such as burning from {{I|Fire Mind}}.
* Invincible enemies such as {{E|Stoney|text=Stonies}} and {{E|Stone Grimace}}s can still be affected and used to increase the damage.
** {{E|Host}}s can be damaged and killed even while they are lowered and invincible.
** Similarly, using Dark Arts on {{E|Scolex}}'s invulnerable segments will deal damage.
* If Isaac walks through an enemy/bullet, the blast at the end of Dark Arts can destroy {{E|Shopkeeper}}s.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|9 Volt}}: Halves the time required to charge Dark Arts.
* {{I|Backstabber}}: Tagging an enemy from behind will apply bleeding.
* {{I|The Battery}}: Second charge can be used while Dark Arts is active.
* {{Book of Belial synergy|description=Grants temporary damage ups for every enemy/projectile hit by Dark Arts, similarly to {{c|Tainted Judas}}. This stacks with {{c|Black Judas}}' inherent version of this, doubling the amount of damage gained.}}
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns black wisps on the middle ring whenever an enemy is killed with Dark Arts. The wisps do not persist between rooms.}}
* {{I|Camo Undies}}: The stealth mode given by Camo Undies won't be removed by activating Dark Arts. However, Dark Arts only gives +0.5 speed while Camo Undies is active.
* {{I|Car Battery}}: Dark Arts will last twice as long, totalling at 2 seconds per use.
* {{I|Euthanasia}}: Dark Arts can apply the Euthanasia effect.
* {{I|Pause}}: Activating Dark Arts will not cancel the effect.
* {{I|Taurus}}: Dark Arts' speed increase will contribute towards Taurus' activation.
* {{c|Black Judas}} / {{c|Tainted Judas}}: For every enemy/bullet he walks through, he will gain a temporary +1 [[damage]] bonus, which wears off at a rate of -0.25 damage every half second.
* [[Wisps]]: Wisps cannot be destroyed while Dark Arts is in effect.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Aries}} / {{i|E. Coli}} / {{i|Midas' Touch}} / {{i|Mom's Heels}} / {{i|Serpent's Kiss}} / {{i|The Virus}}: On-touch effects won't activate while Dark Arts is active.
** The effects will safely activate if Isaac is touching an enemy when he reappears, as there are a few frames where he is immune to damage but can still collide with enemies.
* {{i|Blood Oath}}: Using Dark Arts will block the damage, preventing Blood Oath from activating.
* {{I|Gnawed Leaf}}: If Isaac is stationary when Dark Arts ends, he will gain invulnerability without any downtime. Dark Arts can also be used from invulnerability without taking damage.
* {{I|How to Jump}}: Can be used while Dark Arts is active.
* {{i|Kamikaze!}}: Can be activated without harm while using Dark Arts.
* {{t|Lil Clot}} / {{i|Sumptorium}}: Clots gain increased speed and are no longer able to fire, but are still vulnerable to damage while Isaac is using Dark Arts.
* {{I|Mars}}: Isaac is able to dash while using Dark Arts.
* {{c|Tainted Forgotten}}: Tainted Soul will gain the speed increase, but the invulnerability & attack portion of the activation will only apply to Tainted Forgotten.

sections.Effect:
* Creates a ring of light around Isaac that [[petrification|petrifies]] enemies on contact.
** Normal enemies stay permanently petrified as long as they are within the ring, whereas bosses get a standard petrification effect that stays even outside the ring but isn't permanent.
sections.Notes:
* Dad's Ring has no effect on the Mask of a {{e|Mask + Heart}}.
* {{dlc+|r}} Will not affect invincible boss enemies such as {{E|Dark Esau}} or {{E|Mother's Shadow}}.{{dlc-}}

sections.Effect:
* Upon use, spawns {{E|Delirium}} in a form of a [[friendly]] [[boss]].
** {{dlc|nr+}} The boss lasts for the current room, or until killed.
** {{dlc|r+}} The boss persists between rooms until killed. Using the item again will kill the current summoned boss if it is still alive. Any friendly monsters spawned by the previous boss will also be killed. Their health will deteriorate steadily and their color will slowly turn more gray until they reach 1 health.
*** If used on a boss that has a phase change which requires the boss to die, the boss will still persist in its new phase (i.e. {{e|The Frail}} or {{e|Fistula}}). (This may be a bug as some bosses, such as {{e|Blastocyst}}, are unaffected)
* Changes the appearance of the current room so it looks like a different [[chapter]].
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|r+}} {{e|Hush}} has an extremely low chance of spawning.
* {{dlc|nr+}} Sometimes bosses don't spawn because of grid entities getting in the way. When this happens, the upper door appears to have friendly particles.
* {{dlc|nr}} Unlike {{i|Mega Blast}}, this item can be charged with a single {{E|Lil' Battery}}.
** {{E|Lil' Battery|r}} gives 6 charges.
* Delirious has a 60% decreased item pool weight, making it less likely to appear than other collectibles.
* Using Delirious in the {{e|Delirium}} fight is ill-advised, as it can be confusing which Delirium is the right one to attack.
* Some bosses leave fires on the ground, such as the orange champion {{E|Little Horn}}, which can still hurt Isaac.
sections.Synergies:
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Generates a white wisp that resembles one random boss from this list:
** {{e|Monstro}}: Fires an inaccurate spray of 6-10 tears, similar to {{I|Lil Monstro}} but without the charge time.
** {{e|The Duke of Flies}}: Creates [[Blue Flies]] instead of firing tears. Each wisp can have a maximum of 3 flies at a time.
** {{e|Loki}}: Fires four tears that alternate between cardinal and ordinal directions.
** {{e|The Haunt}}: Fires {{I|Brimstone}} lasers. The laser does not need to be charged to be fired, and can tick up to 8 times for a total of 8 damage.}}
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Blood Puppy}}: Either angry version of Blood Puppy will target friendly bosses as well and can drag them along with it when it charges them. Blood Puppy cannot damage friendly bosses; however, friendly bosses can damage Blood Puppy despite not targeting it outright.
* {{i|Broken Modem}}: Broken Modem also affects friendly bosses and projectiles created by them.
* {{i|Eraser}}: The thrown Eraser can’t hit friendly bosses; however, if it erases their hostile variant, they too are erased. If Delirious attempts to spawn an erased boss, it will fail to do so, wasting a use.
* {{dlc+|r}} {{I|Ghost Bombs}} / {{i|Hungry Soul}} / {{I|Purgatory}} / {{i|Vade Retro}}: Explosions from ghosts can harm friendly bosses.{{dlc-}}
* {{t|Tick}}: [[Friendly]] bosses start with less health if they have over 60HP.

sections.Effects:
* Upon taking damage, activates the following effects:
** Unlocks all locked doors in the room (doors that need the room to be cleared are not affected).
** Opens the {{R|Secret Room}} and the {{R|Super Secret Room}} if adjacent to the room you are in.
** Reveals a random unmapped room on the floor.
** Destroys all [[tinted rock]]s and rocks with {{R|Crawl Space}}s in the room.
sections.Notes:
* The effect is able to reveal the {{R|Ultra Secret Room}}.
* The unlocking effect is able to open:
** The golden door to {{E|Mega Satan}};
** Doors leading to {{s|Downpour}} / {{s|Mines}} / {{s|Mausoleum}};
*** Since opening the door to {{s|Mausoleum}} requires taking damage, Cracked Orb will immediately open it, effectively halving the cost.
** The entrance to the {{E|Mom's Heart}} fight in the {{s|Mausoleum}} and {{s|Gehenna}};
** {{A|A Strange Door}}.
* The effect will not open the doors to:
** {{r|Challenge Room}} or {{r|Boss Challenge Room}} from inside or outside
** Regular doors in {{s|Chest}} / {{s|Dark Room}}.
** {{R|Boss Rush}} / {{S|???}} doors even after the fight.
** Greed mode
* Taking damage while inside a {{r|Secret Room}} will open all its entrances, even if they lead to {{r|Challenge Room}}s and are barricaded after {{e|Greed}} / {{e|Super Greed}} encounter.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Dog Tooth}} / {{t|Shiny Rock}} / {{i|YO LISTEN!}}: Makes it extremely easy to destroy tinted rocks and enter Crawl Spaces.
* {{i|Dull Razor}}: Allows the player to benefit from the item without taking actual damage.
* {{i|Book of Secrets}} / {{i|The Mind}} / {{i|Blue Map}} / {{i|Treasure Map}} / {{i|The Compass}}: Having more rooms already discovered makes Cracked Orb more likely to reveal the ultra secret room.
* {{p|XIV - Temperance}}: Allows the player to spawn a source of damage, making it easier to access rooms such as the entrance to {{E|Mom's Heart}} and {{E|Mega Satan}}'s door when lacking bombs or being immune to explosive damage.

[[Category:Damage-triggered items]]

sections.Effects:
* Upon use, summons five beams of light in random locations on the ground. Each beam lasts for 0.8 seconds and deals large amounts of damage to enemies that touch them. They have a hitbox in a 3×3 cross shape.
** Each beam can hit the same enemy up to 8 times, and deals Isaac's tear [[damage]] plus a flat 20 damage per hit.
* {{dlc|na}} The beams tend to gravitate towards the enemies, unlike the original game.
* {{dlc|a}} The beams have a high chance to directly target enemies.
sections.Synergies: * {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns wisps in the middle ring. The wisps summon a beam of light when touched, dealing 12 damage to nearby enemies in addition to their normal contact damage.}}

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a [[familiar]] that follows Isaac and leaves a trail of [[blue creep]] that damages enemies.
** The creep deals 2 damage per tick or 6 damage per second to non-flying enemies.
* If the cloud touches an enemy, it has a 1% chance to spawn a damaging {{I|Holy Light}} beam onto the enemy.
** The light beams deal 20 + Isaac's tear damage per tick and may strike an enemy up to 8 times.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|r+}} This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|The Rainmaker}}.{{dlc-}}
* {{dlc|r}} [[Familiar]]s that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Depression having the lowest priority at {{dlc|nr+}} 6th / {{dlc|r+}} 8th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.
sections.Interactions: * {{i|BFFS!}}: Increase cloud size but does not increase damage.

sections.Effect: * Upon taking damage, spawns six {{e|Troll Bomb}}s around the room, similar to the effect of {{p|XVI - The Tower}}.
sections.Notes:
* Despite appearing as Troll Bombs, the bombs are mechanically identical to player-placed bombs and will benefit from Isaac's bomb-enhancing items.
* These bombs hurt the player as well as enemies.
* Taking damage from the Troll Bombs spawned by Curse of the Tower or any other type of bomb, including Isaac's bombs, will not re-activate the effect.
* {{Dlc|nr}} Picking up this item will make all health transactions more difficult. {{e|Devil Beggar}}s and {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}s will be almost impossible to use because they will very likely be destroyed by bombs.
** {{Dlc|r}} Taking damage from {{e|Devil Beggar}}s and {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}s does not trigger the effect. {{i|IV Bag}}, however, does trigger the effect.
* The bombs prefer to spawn near the center of the room.
* The 6 {{e|Troll Bomb}}s are difficult to dodge in small rooms.
sections.Synergies:
* {{t|Blasting Cap}}: Spawned Troll Bombs can drop extra bomb pickups.
* {{I|Glitter Bombs}}: Each troll bomb has a chance to spawn a [[pickup]] or a [[trinket]] including [[heart]]s for repeated use.
* {{I|The Polaroid}}: If Isaac is damaged when he has half a {{e|Red Heart}} or less, the shield will activate and protect him from the Troll Bombs.
* {{I|Pyromaniac}}: Troll Bombs will heal Isaac instead, allowing for essentially infinite health with proper usage.
** {{dlc|r}} Due to Pyromaniac being weakened to healing half a heart per explosion in ''Repentance'', this synergy requires {{i|The Wafer}} to continue being effective past [[Chapter 3]]/[[Chapter 3.5]].
* {{I|Remote Detonator}}: The Troll Bombs generated will not explode until Remote Detonator is activated, unlike regular Troll Bombs.
* {{T|Safety Scissors}}: The Troll Bombs generated will be converted into bomb pickups rather than exploding.
sections.Interactions:
* {{t|Blind Rage}}: Normally, the invincibility frames will end before most of the explosions take place. However, if Isaac takes a full heart of damage (e. g. from a [[champion]]), the invincibility will protect him from all spawned Troll Bombs.
** Damage sources that scale up from half a heart of damage to a full heart of damage starting on [[Chapter 4]] don't provide enough invincibility frames to ignore the explosions.
* {{I|Blood Oath}}: Not recommended. Spawns 6 Troll Bombs for each {{e|Half Red Heart}} removed, making death highly likely if Isaac does not leave the room immediately after being stabbed by Blood Oath, and leaving the starting room unsafe.
* {{i|Sharp Plug|r}}: Not recommended. Spawns 6 Troll Bombs for each {{e|Half Red Heart}} removed, making extra damage highly likely if Isaac does not leave the room immediately after using Sharp Plug.
* {{I|Bomber Boy}}: Not recommended. The cross pattern explosion makes it very hard to avoid taking damage.
* {{i|Mr. Mega}}: No effect.
* {{i|Scatter Bombs|a+}}: Not recommended. Each Troll Bomb will spawn several smaller bombs upon exploding, making it very hard to avoid taking damage.
** {{dlc|r}} No visual change can be seen with the Troll Bombs, but the smaller bombs have the sprite of the smaller normal bombs.

sections.Effects:
* Grants one full Red [[Heart container]].
* {{Dlc|r}} Heals 1 additional {{e|Red Heart}}.
sections.Notes: * This item has a 12.6% chance to spawn from paying out a {{e|Beggar}} in addition to being in the [[Beggar (Item Pool)|Beggar item pool]]. Multiple copies can be obtained through this method.
sections.Synergies: * {{i|Binge Eater}}: When Isaac picks up Dinner it now grants: a permanent +0.5 [[Tears]] and +0.2 [[Shot Speed]], a temporary +3.6 [[Damage]] (which diminishes to 0 in 30 seconds), heals 1 additional red heart, and takes a permanent -0.03 [[Speed]] reduction.

sections.Effects:
* +1 [[damage]].
* Adds a chance to shoot [[fear|fear tears]], causing enemies to run away from Isaac.
sections.Synergies:

* {{i|Compound Fracture}}/{{i|Cricket's Body}}/{{i|The Parasite}}: Chance for tears and split tears to cause fear. If the main tear causes fear, the split tears cause fear too.
sections.Interactions:

* {{i|Lachryphagy}}: If a fear tear is fed, all burst tears cause fear. If a normal tear is fed, the burst tears cannot cause fear.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: Tear occasionally changes appearance to Dark Matter tears and causes fear.

sections.Notes:
* If Dark Bum enters one of a set of {{r|Super Secret Room}}s which allow only certain types of hearts to generate in them, he will drop that type of heart instead of what he normally would.
** The one which only allows Red Hearts will cause Dark Bum to consume the Red Hearts on the floor only to generate yet more Red Hearts. Leading Dark Bum around the room to consume the Red Hearts and then leaving the room before he's able to generate anything will avoid this.
* {{dlc+|a}} Dark Bum will only pick up regular Red Hearts ({{e|Half Red Heart}}s, {{e|Red Heart}}s, {{e|Double Heart}}s, {{e|Scared Heart}}s).{{dlc-}}
* {{dlc+|r}} Temporary hearts (such as from {{c|Tainted Magdalene}}, {{c|Tainted Eve}} with {{i|Birthright}}, etc.) can be collected by Dark Bum, which situationally may prove useful or dangerous.{{dlc-|r}}
* This item is very beneficial for characters that can't have [[Red Heart container]]s ({{c|???}}, {{c|Tainted ???}}, {{c|Black Judas}}, {{c|Tainted Judas}}, {{c|Tainted Forgotten}}) since they have no use for Red Hearts.

** This is averted if Keeper is in a [[co-op]] party with other characters that can utilize hearts.
** Dark Bum may also be picked up by Keeper for the potential transformation.

sections.Synergies: * {{i|Humbleing Bundle}} / {{t|Equality!|a+nr+}}: Most Red Heart drops will become Double Red Heart drops. This counts as two full Red Hearts for Dark Bum, essentially doubling the value of it.
sections.Interactions:
