sections.Notes:
* The effect can only trigger once per 3 seconds.
* If IBS triggers while Isaac is charging a shot (with items such as {{i|Brimstone}}, {{i|Monstro's Lung}}, {{i|Chocolate Milk}}, etc.), the charged shot will only fire after IBS's effect activates. In the case of thrown poops, the charged shot only fires after Isaac throws the poop IBS gives him.
* Poops spawned by IBS can give [[pickups]].
* If Isaac is currently holding a poop, IBS cannot activate until he throws it.
* Isaac can carry poop he is holding between rooms.
* If Isaac takes damage while holding a poop/bomb, he will drop it where he is standing.
* If Isaac hits an enemy with a thrown poop, it will immediately break.
* {{dlc|r+}} {{transformation contribution|Oh Crap}}

sections.Effects:
* {{Dlc|nr}} Tears fire 1-2 sparks of electricity in random directions upon hitting an obstacle or enemy.
* {{Dlc|r}} Tears fire 1 short-ranged spark of electricity in a random direction upon hitting an obstacle or enemy. When an arc strikes an enemy, it will strike another nearby enemy, chaining up to four times.
* Sparks deal half of the tear's damage.
** Sparks behave like [[Spectral tears|spectral]] and [[Piercing tears|piercing]] lasers and will arc to hit enemies that are close enough, even striking multiple ones in a row.
** An enemy can take damage multiple times from sparks of a single chain. If an enemy take damage from a tear, it does not take any damage from the chain which the tear causes.
** Tears that hit the floor due to running out of range do not generate arcs.
** {{dlc+|r}} If the floor is wet, such as {{S|Downpour}}, {{S|Dross}}, {{S|Flooded Caves}}, some rooms in {{S|Scarred Womb}} and {{S|Corpse}}, and after using {{I|Flush!}}, the arcing distance is increased.{{dlc-}}
sections.Synergies:
* {{dlc|r}} Multiple battery-themed items have special synergies with the sparks:
** {{I|Sharp Plug}} / {{I|Car Battery}}: Electricity deals 75% of Isaac's tear damage if he owns 1 of these items, and 100% if Isaac owns both.
** {{I|9 Volt}} / {{T|Watch Battery}} / {{T|Hairpin}}: Increases arcing distance of sparks.
** {{I|The Battery}} / {{I|Jumper Cables}} / {{T|AAA Battery}}: Increases amount of arcs a spark can generate.
** {{T|Old Capacitor|n}}: Allows sparks to arc on the same enemy multiple times.
* {{I|Abyss}}: When Isaac uses Abyss to absorb Jacob's Ladder, it turns into a pale blue locust. 
**{{dlc|nr+}}The locust can create arcs of electricity dealing 0.1 damage per tick.
**{{dlc|r+}} The locust can create arcs of electricity dealing 25% of Isaac's damage per tick.
* {{I|Angelic Prism}}: All of the split tears will be electrified. {{Dlc|nr}} Also, the sparks that pass through the prism will be split.
* {{dlc|r}} {{I|Brimstone}} / {{c|Azazel}} / {{c|Tainted Azazel}}: The beam gains a light blue tint, spawning sparks at the end of the beam and near enemies hit by the beam.
* {{I|C Section}}: Spawns the sparks for each tick they hit.
* {{I|Little Horn}}: Enemies hit by the sparks also get hit with Big Horn's hand.
* {{I|Lost Contact}}: Tears block enemy shots as normal and will then spawn the sparks where the shot was blocked.
* {{I|A Lump of Coal}}: Sparks deal damage based on the tear's range, increasing with distance. No extra damage is applied by the distance covered by the spark.
* {{dlc|r}} {{I|Mom's Knife}}: The knife will occasionally generate sparks when hitting an enemy.
* [[Piercing tears]]: A tear will generate sparks for each enemy it hits.
* [[Spectral tears]]: The tears can spawn sparks while passing through obstacles, and a tear can spawn sparks only once in this way.
* {{c|Tainted Magdalene}}: Hugs cause sparks to spawn.
* [[Tear effects]]: The tear effects will be applied over the sparks as well.
** {{I|Serpent's Kiss}}: The poison caused by the sparks will not drop black hearts.
** {{T|Nose Goblin}} / {{I|Sinus Infection}}: The boogers do not spawn sparks when directly hit on an enemy, but their sparks spawn the boogers for each enemy hit.
** {{I|Euthanasia|dlc=r}}: The sparks coming off of needle shots also act as needle shots themselves, allowing entire rooms to be killed instantly.
* {{Dlc|r}} {{I|Tech.5}} / {{I|Technology}} / {{I|Technology 2}} / {{I|Tech X}}: Lasers gain a light blue tint and generate sparks.
* {{I|Trisagion|dlc=r}}: Spawns the sparks for each tick they hit.
sections.Interactions:
* {{Dlc|nr}} {{I|Brimstone}} / {{C|Azazel}}: The beams do not spawn the sparks.
* {{I|Backstabber}}: The sparks cannot hit the enemies' backs for the extra damage and bleeding.
* {{I|Compound Fracture}} / {{I|Cricket's Body}} / {{I|The Parasite}}: Split tears can spawn the sparks.
* {{I|Dr. Fetus}} / {{I|Epic Fetus}}: The bombs do not spawn the sparks.
* {{I|Haemolacria}}:
** {{Dlc|nr}} Only the main tear can spawn the sparks.
** {{Dlc|r}} Burst tears can also spawn the sparks.
* {{I|Ipecac}}: The sparks spawn only when they hit a wall.
* {{I|The Ludovico Technique}}: The Ludovico tear spawns a large number of sparks when in contact with an enemy, but not on obstacles.
* {{I|Mom's Knife|dlc=nr}}: The knife does not spawn the sparks.
* {{I|Proptosis}}: The sparks will decrease in damage based on how much damage the tear has lost. The spark's damage also dereases by the distance covered by the spark.
* {{I|Rubber Cement}}: Tears will only spawn the sparks when hitting enemies.
* {{I|Spirit Sword}}: Both swing attacks and projectiles can spawn the sparks.
* {{Dlc|nr}} {{I|Tech.5}} / {{I|Technology}} / {{I|Technology 2}} / {{I|Tech X}}: The lasers do not spawn the sparks.
* {{I|Trisagion|dlc=nr}}: Only spawns the sparks when hitting obstacles.

sections.Effects:
* Isaac gains +5 {{e|Bomb}}s on pickup.
* Placed bombs deal damage to enemies on contact and will leave behind a fire that damages enemies on contact upon exploding for 10 seconds.
** {{dlc|nr}} The fire does 22 damage per tick (66 damage per second).
** {{dlc|r}} The fire can block four shots and/or deal four ticks of contact damage before expiring. It deals 23 damage at full durability, 17.25 damage after taking one hit, and 11.5 damage otherwise for a maximum damage of 63.25 damage.
** Fire from a Hot Bomb doesn't damage Isaac.
** {{dlc|nr}} Bombs deal 1 point of contact damage to enemies.
** {{dlc|r}} Bombs deal 16 contact damage to enemies.
* {{dlc|r}} Isaac can no longer take contact damage from static fires such as {{e|Fire Place}}s or enemy fires. Fire projectiles still damage Isaac.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|r}} This item has a 1/7 chance to drop if {{e|Hornfel}} is killed in his second phase.{{dlc-}}
** {{dlc+|r+}} It also has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|Hornfel}}.{{dlc-}}
* If a {{e|Hopper}} touches a Hot Bomb, it will become a {{e|Flaming Hopper}}.
* The contact damage does not scale with Isaac's damage and is completely removed if Isaac acquires another bomb item that overrides the flaming bomb graphic such as {{i|Mr. Mega}} or {{i|Glitter Bombs}}.
* {{e|Big Horn}} will throw Hot Bombs at Isaac that deal contact damage.
* If eaten by a boss such as {{e|Chub}}, a Hot Bomb will continously deal damage to the boss until it explodes.
* {{dlc|r}} Negates the damage from the floor of lava in {{e|The Beast|n}}'s chamber, but not from its fire inhalation attack.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|BBF}} / {{i|Best Friend}} / {{i|Bob's Brain}} / {{i|Bob's Rotten Head}} / {{i|Mr. Boom}}: These explosions are affected by Hot Bombs.
* {{i|Bomber Boy}}: Bombs leave behind nine fires in a cross shaped pattern.
* {{dlc|a}}{{i|Doctor's Remote}} / {{i|Dr. Fetus}} / {{i|Epic Fetus}}: Bombs/missiles are affected by Hot Bombs.
* {{dlc|a+}}[[Familiars#Locusts|Red Locusts]]: Red locust explosions are affected.
* {{I|Remote Detonator}}: Allows for maximization of contact damage, especially if an enemy gets stuck on a bomb.
* {{dlc|anr}} {{i|Scatter Bombs|n}}: Each additional explosion creates a fire.
** {{dlc|r}} Fires from extra bombs now start with 1 less durability.
sections.Interactions:
* {{dlc|na}}{{i|Doctor's Remote}} / {{i|Dr. Fetus}} / {{i|Epic Fetus}}: Bombs/missiles are not affected by Hot Bombs.
* {{i|Ipecac}}: Ipecac shots are unaffected.

sections.Effects:
* After Isaac takes damage from an enemy or donates health, he drops a {{e|Red Heart}} that despawns after 1.5 seconds.
** The heart dropped depends on the source: half-hearts of damage taken drop {{e|Half Red Heart}}s, and full hearts of damage taken drop full hearts.
** The hearts will get launched out of Isaac with momentum, making them difficult to pick up.
** If Isaac is firing tears as he gets hit, the heart will get launched in that direction.
sections.Synergies:
* [[Cards and Runes#Playing Cards|Ace Cards]] / {{i|Diplopia}} / {{i|D1}} / {{P|Jera}}: Converted/duplicated hearts will not disappear.
* {{i|Blood Rights}} / {{i|Razor Blade}}: Damage taken to use the item also spawns hearts, reducing the cost of using them. The first usage of these items each room will spawn a full red heart.
* {{i|Cancer}} / [[Pills|Percs!]] pill / {{I|The Wafer}}: Damage sources that spawn full red hearts will still spawn a full red heart despite the cost being reduced to half a heart.
* {{i|Dull Razor}}: Can be used to spawn full red hearts for Isaac to pick up.
* {{T|Equality!|nr+}}: As long as Equality is active, all hearts spawned will be doubled and never disappear. Hearts remain on the ground even after the effect is no longer active.
* {{i|Humbleing Bundle}}: {{e|Red Heart}} spawns can be converted to {{e|Double Heart}}s.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Cambion Conception}}: By intentionally taking damage with something like a fire and grabbing the half-red hearts, Isaac can easily generate powerful familiars for free.
* {{i|Candy Heart}} / {{i|Immaculate Conception}}: The hearts will count toward gaining stat boosts/familiars.
* {{i|Compost}}: The temporary heart will be converted into a [[Familiar#Blue Flies|Blue Fly]][[Familiar#Blue Spiders|/Spider]].
* {{i|D20}} / {{i|GB Bug}}: Rerolled hearts will still disappear.
* {{t|Daemon's Tail}}: Hearts spawned do not turn into keys but simply do not spawn 80% of the time, and the 20% that do spawn will always be {{e|Black Heart}}s.
* {{i|Glass Cannon}}: Spawns two more full red hearts when Glass Cannon breaks, regardless of how much health was lost to it.
* {{c|Keeper}} / {{c|Tainted Keeper}}: Spawns blue flies upon getting hit, essentially granting them the same effect as {{i|Infestation}}.
* {{p|IX - The Hermit?}}: The heart will not be converted to coins.
* {{i|IV Bag}}: Doesn't spawn hearts.
* {{i|Maggy's Bow}}: Doubles the healing received from the hearts spawned.
* {{i|Magneto}} / {{t|Super Magnet}}: Will immediately start pulling the dropped hearts to Isaac, breaking their momentum and making collection much easier.

sections.Effect:
* {{dlc|nr}} Spawns a [[familiar]] that follows Isaac. If Isaac takes damage, it will shatter and create a pool of damaging [[blue creep]], similar to {{i|Lemon Mishap}}.
** The pool lasts for ~9 seconds and deals 8 damage per tick to non-flying enemies (24 damage per second).
** After breaking, Holy Water will reappear in the next room.
* {{dlc|r}} Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and launches itself in the direction Isaac shoots. Upon hitting an enemy, it will deal 7 damage and shatter, creating a pool of damaging [[blue creep]] that also [[petrification|petrifies]] enemies that touch it.
** Once the pool disappears completely, Holy Water will respawn and can be fired again. Holy Water does not immediately respawn upon entering a new room.
sections.Notes: * {{dlc|r}} [[Familiar]]s that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Holy Water having {{dlcalt|5th|r+=7th}} priority.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|BFFS!|nr}}: Familiar is bigger but no effect on damage.
** {{dlc|r}} Doubles the initial damage and causes it to also spawn a blue flame on point of impact that blocks shots and deals 6 contact damage per tick to enemies (36 damage per second). The fire can hit flying enemies, persists for the same amount of time as the creep, and cannot be destroyed.
* {{i|Vasculitis}}: Upon killing an enemy while they are inside the puddle of holy water,  The enemy bursts into a cluster of petrifying tears.

sections.Notes:
* Standing still while jumping only grants invincibility for the first jump. Isaac has to move to regain invincibility while jumping.
* If Isaac has [[flight]], Isaac dashes instead of jumping. This is functionally the same as jumping, but without the animation playing. Isaac will have invincibility during the dash, and the dash will only stop on terrain that can be walked on.
** While flying above a pit, the dash distance will be very short.
* This item can also be used to pass through otherwise impassible {{r|Crawl Space}} walls.
* Isaac can't jump through doors, which means damage from {{r|Curse Room}} doors cannot be avoided.
* If Isaac has a Stompy trait (from items such as {{I|Leo}} and {{I|Thunder Thighs}}), rocks won't be destroyed mid-jump.
* When jumping in an uncleared room, it is easy to land on top of an enemy, especially one that follows Isaac's position when attacking. The damage can be avoided by immediately triggering another jump, however.
** This can be repeated indefinitely, and it may be a good idea to keep jumping until you find a safe spot to land.
* {{dlc|r}} How to Jump can be used to jump over [[pillar]]s and [[spiked rock]]s safely.
* Isaac can jump over [[key block]]s. However, if he has a key, it will be spent to open the key block.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.
* {{i|Void}}: If this item is activated by {{i|Void}}, it is possible to get stuck in an impassable area with no ability to escape. Exiting and resuming the run will place Isaac at whichever door he entered the room through.

sections.Effects:
* Grants a shield that negates the first instance of damage taken from a hostile source in each room.
* {{transformation contribution|Seraphim}}
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|nr}} When the shield is broken, Isaac gets invincibility frames like he does when he would normally take damage, based on the damage it negated; 1 second for half a heart of damage, 2 seconds for a full heart, and 4 seconds for 2 full hearts.{{dlc-}}
** {{dlc|r}} Holy Mantle breaking grants one second of invincibility frames, regardless of the damage source.
* {{dlc|nr}} Holy Mantle won't be active when initially appearing in the starting room of a floor if it was lost in the room where Isaac left the previous floor.
** {{dlc|r}} If Holy Mantle's shield is broken prior to using {{i|R Key|n}}, the shield won't be active in the new starting room initially.
* As the shield gets restored whenever another room is entered, Holy Mantle allows {{r|Curse Room}}s to be entered and exited without taking damage.
* Holy Mantle does not prevent damage from {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}s, {{e|Devil Beggar}}s, and {{i|Blood Rights}}.
** {{dlc|nr}} However, Blood Donation Machines and Devil Beggars can be played practically for free during the invincibility frames granted when losing the shield, by taking damage from touching a {{e|Fire Place}}, etc.
* Damage from {{r|Sacrifice Room}} spikes can be blocked by Holy Mantle, but no payout is rewarded.
* The blocked hit does not count as damage taken for related achievements and will not trigger items that activate upon taking damage, like {{i|Dead Bird}}.
* {{c|The Lost|a}} starts with this item after donating 879 coins to the {{e|Greed Donation Machine|n}}.
* {{dlc|r}} When Holy Mantle's shield is broken, a white cross symbol will briefly appear overlaid on top of Isaac and a smashing sound will play.
* {{dlc|r}} While Holy Mantle is in effect, a blue cross [[File:Holy Mantle hp.png|10px]] icon appears in the HUD next to Isaac's health.
sections.Interactions:
* [[Bad Trip]]: Damage is blocked by Holy Mantle.
* {{i|Dull Razor|r}}: Ignores Holy Mantle's shield and works normally.
* {{i|IV Bag}}: IV Bag ignores the shield's protection, resulting in Isaac taking damage regardless.
* {{i|Glass Cannon|nr}}: Holy Mantle's effect will apply after Glass Cannon reduces Isaac's health to half a heart.
* {{i|Holy Mantle}} / {{c|The Lost|r}}: An extra shield is given in the room it was found in, but the shield is removed when leaving that room and does not reapply.
* {{i|Sharp Plug|nr}}: Holy Mantle blocks the damage from Sharp Plug, but also prevents it from adding charges.

sections.Effects:
* Isaac will frequently fire extra [[spectral tears]] that orbit around him until they hit the ground, similar to {{i|Tiny Planet}}. These tears mimic Isaac's in most cases.
* x1.2 [[damage]] multiplier. This multiplier does not stack with multiple Immaculate Hearts.
* Adds one Red [[Heart Container]] and fully replenishes Isaac's health.
* {{transformation contribution|Seraphim}}
sections.Notes:
* The tears cannot push active {{e|Bomb}}s and {{e|Troll Bomb}}s.
* The tears can extinguish {{e|Fire Place}}s and set off {{g|TNT}}.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Angelic Prism}}: The extra tears share the same orbit as Angelic Prism, making them very easy to split.
* {{I|Chemical Peel}}: Some of the orbiting tears will gain Chemical Peel's 2 flat damage bonus.
* {{i|Chocolate Milk}}: Orbiting tears' damage does not depend on the charge of Chocolate Milk, so Isaac can shoot low damage tears rapidly to produce a large number of orbiting tears which do full damage.
* {{I|Death's Touch}}: Death's Touch tear modification will also affect the orbiting tears.
* {{I|Eye of Belial}}: Orbiting tears get piercing and homing on nearby enemies on contact, and return orbiting after no targets left.
* {{I|Haemolacria}}: The orbiting tears will be affected by Haemolacria but the tears created upon hit will not orbit.
* {{I|Lachryphagy}}: Lachryphagy will affect the orbiting tears and become bigger when in contact with other tears. The Lachryphagy tears will split upon hit and the split shots will orbit around the point where the original tear had split.
* {{I|The Ludovico Technique}}: Isaac will frequently shoot tears that orbit around him, even without pressing any fire buttons.
* {{i|Monstro's Lung}}: Fires a large number of extra tears alongside the burst that begin orbiting Isaac once they reach the orbit range.
* {{I|Urn of Souls}}: Each individual flame shot from the Urn has a chance to spawn an orbiting tear.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|Anti-Gravity}}: Tears will orbit very close and fast around Isaac's body, and return to normal orbit once he stops firing.
* {{I|Brimstone}} / {{I|C Section}} / {{I|Dr. Fetus}} / {{I|Epic Fetus}} / {{I|Mom's Knife}} / {{I|Technology}} / {{I|Tech X}}: No unique interactions; regular tears are generated which orbit Isaac normally.
* {{i|Explosivo}}/{{t|Nose Goblin}}/{{i|Sinus Infection}}: Orbiting tears that stick to an enemy will return to the ring if the enemy cannot be stuck to anymore before the tear's duration ends.
* {{I|Eye of the Occult}}: Orbiting tears cannot be controlled.
* {{i|Hallowed Ground}}: The damage multiplier does not stack with that from a white poop.
* {{I|Incubus}}: The orbiting tears will orbit whoever fired it, whether it be Isaac or the Incubus.
* {{I|Ipecac}}: Orbiting tears explode.
* {{C|Tainted Bethany}}: On pickup, grants 12 blood charges.
* {{I|Technology 2}}: The laser does not contribute in generating orbiting tears.

sections.Effects:
* {{dlc|nr}} -0.2 [[speed]] and maximum speed.
* {{dlc|na+}} -15 [[range]].
* {{dlc|a+nr}} -17 [[range]].
* {{dlc|nr}} +2.0 [[tear falling speed]].
** {{dlc|na+}} The increased tear falling speed and decreased range results in slightly increased firing distance.
** {{dlc|a+nr}} The increased tear falling speed and decreased range results in nearly identical firing distance.
* Occasionally, Isaac will become unable to fire tears. He must charge an attack, indicated by his head turning red, that launches a [[piercing]], [[spectral]] kidney stone when released, followed by a rapid, inaccurate spray of tears.
** This effect occurs approximately every 25 seconds.
** {{dlc|nr}} The kidney stone does 5x Isaac's damage and has approximately twice the range of normal tears.
** {{dlc|r}} The kidney stone does 10x Isaac's damage and has approximately twice the range of normal tears.
** The barrage grants a decaying 6x fire rate multiplier that can exceed the normal cap and forces Isaac to fire for the duration.
** The barrage will continue for its full length between [[room]]s, as will the state of charging the attack.
sections.Notes:
* Tints tears red. This is only a cosmetic change.
* The kidney stone can still be fired by [[blindfolded]] characters, but not the tear barrage. This includes {{c|Lilith}}.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Incubus}}: Fire tears normally while Isaac is charging, and copies the barrage but not the stone. The barrage from the Incubus will be in a straight line instead of an inaccurate burst.
* {{i|Maw Of The Void}}: Whenever the kidney stone is fired, the tear barrage will continuously charge and activate Maw Of The Void until Isaac can fire normally.
* {{I|Montezuma's Revenge}}/{{i|Revelation|n}}: Whenever the kidney stone is fired, the tear barrage will continuously charge and activate these items' effects until Isaac can fire normally.
* {{I|Rock Bottom}}: The temporary tears up from the kidney stone burst becomes a permanent x6 fire rate multiplier.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|20/20}}/{{i|The Inner Eye}}/{{i|Mutant Spider}}: Only fires one stone.
* {{i|Anti-Gravity}}: The stone will not hover and will travel regardless.
* {{C|Azazel}}/{{i|Brimstone}}: Overrides Kidney Stone. {{Dlc|nr}} Speed and range downs still apply.
* {{i|Chocolate Milk|dlc=nr}}: When Kidney Stone activates, it fires one kidney stone and then no more tears until tears stat is under a certain value (unknown).
* {{i|Cursed Eye}}: Charging the barrage pauses the Cursed Eye charge bar - if the bar is not full and Isaac is hurt, he will teleport. Firing during the barrage will neither fire tears, nor show the charge bar, but will still charge Cursed Eye. Being hit while the invisible charge bar is not full will teleport Isaac.
* {{i|Compound Fracture}}/{{i|Cricket's Body}}/{{i|The Parasite}}: The stone cannot split into smaller stones.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}}: Overrides Kidney Stone. {{Dlc|nr}} Speed and range downs still apply.
* {{i|Epic Fetus}}: Overrides Kidney Stone. {{Dlc|nr}} Speed and range downs still apply.
* {{C|The Forgotten|a+}}: The Forgotten will swing his club rapidly instead of shooting the burst of tears (The Forgotten still fires the stone normally).
* {{Dlc+|a+nr}} {{i|Haemolacria}}: Overridden by Haemolacria. Only stat changes apply.{{dlc-}}
** {{Dlc|r}} Fires a barrage of Haemolacria tears upon activation
* {{i|Jacob's Ladder}}: The stone will only spawn sparks when hitting enemies.
* {{i|Libra}}: Stats are greatly increased during the barrage. {{dlc|nr}} The harsh speed and range down make Libra a large stats down.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: Overrides Kidney Stone.
* {{i|A Lump of Coal}}: The stone will not grow bigger as it travels, but it will increase in damage.
* {{i|Marked}}: Occasionally, Isaac will stop automatically firing, and an attack key must be held to release the kidney stone and continued firing.
* {{i|Mom's Knife}}: Overrides Kidney Stone. {{Dlc|nr}} Speed and range downs still apply.
* {{i|Monstro's Lung}}: Overrides Kidney Stone. {{Dlc|nr}} Speed and range downs still apply.
** {{dlc|r}} '''Monstro's Lung''' + {{I|Technology}}: Kidney Stone can activate, but the barrage does not work correctly (see bugs).
* {{i|Number One|dlc=nr}}: Number One's range down overrides Kidney Stone, for an additional -0.62. The stone is not affected by the range decrease.
* {{i|Spirit Sword}}: Overrides Kidney Stone.
* {{c|Tainted Lilith}}: Kidney Stone has no effect.
* {{i|Technology|dlc=nr}}: Overrides Kidney Stone.
** {{dlc|r}} Fires the stone like normal, followed by a barrage of Technology lasers.
* {{i|Tech X|dlc=anr}}: Overrides Kidney Stone.
* {{i|Urn of Souls}}: Firing the urn counts as fire time but the urn must be put away for Isaac to charge and shoot the kidney shot. Switching to the urn while auto-firing from Kidney Stone forces the urn to fire as well.

sections.Synergies:
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Using Jar of Flies summons wisps instead of [[Blue Fly|Blue Flies]]; the wisps do not summon the flies when destroyed. Up to five flies at a time are consumed to summon one wisp, with stacking health and damage. The damage of the wisps decreases as they take damage. Enemies killed by wisps’ tears will not add flies to the jar.}}
* {{T|Fish Tail}}: Doubles the number of flies that spawn.
* {{i|Hive Mind}}: Flies are bigger and deal double damage.
* {{i|Schoolbag}}: Flies will be gained even while the Jar of Flies is in the inactive slot.
sections.Interactions:
* {{dlc|r}}[[Cards and Runes|Ace Cards]]: Enemies that are turned into [[pickup]]s do not grant extra flies.
* {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.
* {{i|E. Coli}}/{{i|Flush!}}: Enemies that are turned into poop do not grant extra flies.
* {{i|Void}}: Flies will not collect when absorbed by Void, making the interaction worthless.
* {{I|Infestation 2}}: Blue Spiders spawned by Infestation 2 grant extra flies, and Blue Flies spawned by Jar of Flies spawn Blue Spiders.

sections.Effects:
* Upon use, spawns a random [[pickup]] or [[item]], which must be bought for its normal {{R|Shop}} price.
** Items generated will always be [[Shop (Item Pool)|shop items]] and pickups will only be those that can appear for sale in shops.
*** The only exception to this is {{e|Black Sack}}s, which can replace Grab Bags despite not being able to do so in shops.
** There is an an equal ~11.1% chance to spawn a card, pill, bomb, key, battery, item, soul heart, red heart, or sack.
sections.Notes:
* The pickup/item will be surrounded by spikes/cost hearts if the box is used in a {{R|Devil Room}}, a {{R|Black Market}}, if Isaac has {{I|A Pound of Flesh}} or is in a boss room after using {{I|Satanic Bible}}.
** While playing as {{C|Tainted Lost}} /{{C|The Lost}} pickups that would cost health are free.
sections.Synergies:
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns glowing coin wisps on the middle ring. Enemies killed by the wisps' tears have a 20% chance to drop a random [[coin]].}}
* {{I|Coupon}} / {{I|Mr. ME!}} / {{I|Crooked Penny}} + {{I|Schoolbag}}: Spawned pickups/items can be made free.
* {{I|D20}} + {{I|Schoolbag}}: Rerolled pickups have a chance to reroll into an item from the current room's [[item pool]].
* {{I|Keeper's Sack}}: Stat upgrades from the spawned pickups/items can be gained even when shops become unavailable (Floors after the {{e|Mom}} fight excluding {{S|???}}).
* {{I|Restock}}: Buying spawned pickup or item in {{R|Shop}} will always restock into the same thing as what's being sold in the upper left of the shop and their prices will never increase. This still works even if the top left slot was already bought before having Restock. This does not work outside of the shop. It also works in Greed and Greedier modes, respawning them as {{e|Key}}s (since the leftmost pickup is always a key).
* {{I|Steam Sale}}: Spawned pickups/items will be on sale.
sections.Interactions:
* {{T|Adoption Papers}}: Does not affect Keeper's Box items.
* {{I|Chaos}} / {{I|Sacred Orb}} / {{I|TMTRAINER}}: Affects items spawned by the box.
* {{i|Glitched Crown}} / {{C|Tainted Isaac}}: The alternate item(s) will be from the pool of the room it is used in.
* {{T|Store Credit}}: Cannot be used on consumables or items spawned by Keeper's Box outside of the Shop.
* {{e|Shop Restock Machine}}: Using a Restock Machine in a {{R|Shop}} will remove every spawned pickup/item. Using the machine outside of the shop will only reroll items.

sections.Notes:
* After all five familiars have been spawned, a {{E|Soul Heart}} will still drop every 15 hearts collected.
* All types of hearts except {{E|Gold Heart}}s and {{e|Blended Heart}}s count.
* Items that directly add health such as {{i|Yum Heart}}, {{i|Book of Revelations}}, {{i|Satanic Bible}}, and {{i|The Nail}} do not count towards spawning a familiar.
* {{C|The Lost}} can pick up Soul Hearts and Black Hearts despite having no health and thus can activate Immaculate Conception.
* {{dlc|nr+}} {{C|Keeper|n}} and {{c|Tainted Keeper|n}} cannot encounter hearts, thus the item is useless for them.{{dlc-}}
** {{dlc+|r+}} Healing {{c|Keeper}} and {{c|Tainted Keeper}} with coins counts for Immaculate conception.{{dlc-}}
* As the short-lived {{E|Half Red Heart}}s dropped by {{C|Tainted Magdalene}} also count, it is an excellent choice for her since she will constantly be picking up hearts and gain all five familiars quickly.
* Familiars spawned by the item do not affect item pools, so multiple copies of one familiar can be obtained. For example, a second Seraphim can be purchased after Immaculate Conception spawns one.
* As with {{i|Cambion Conception}}, if this item is removed in any way (such as with a {{P|XVII - The Stars?|r}}), the familiars from Cambion Conception will be removed upon updating familiars, including picking up items that don't add familiars but update its cache, such as {{i|Brimstone}}.
** If the item is re-obtained after being removed (e.g. by dropping the item as {{C|Tainted Isaac|r}}), any familiars that were removed will return once familiars are updated.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Hypercoagulation}}: By intentionally taking damage with something like a fire and grabbing the half-red hearts, Isaac can easily generate powerful familiars for free.
* {{i|The Jar}}: Hearts collected in the jar do not count towards activation.

sections.Effects:
* +0.3 [[damage]].
* Adds a chance to shoot [[Status Effects#Confusion|concussive tears]], causing enemies to walk around randomly.
sections.Notes: * Concussive tear effect depends on the [[luck]] stat, and goes up to 100% at 27 Luck.
sections.Synergies:
* {{dlc+|a+nr}} {{I|Finger!}}: Finger can also apply the confusion effect.{{dlc-}}
* {{dlc|r}} {{I|Notched Axe}}: Picking up Iron Bar will refill Notched Axe's charge bar.

sections.Effects: * Adds a chance to shoot red fist-shaped tears that deal extreme knockback and cause [[confusion]] for 2 seconds. ** Enemies will take 10 + 2 * (floor - 1) damage when they are knocked into a wall/[[obstacle]] or when hit by another knocked back enemy.
sections.Notes:
* The chance to fire fist tears depends on the [[luck]] stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: <math>\frac1 { 10 - \left \lceil \mathit{Luck}  \right \rceil}</math>
** At base luck (0), the chance is 10%, maxing out at 100% at 8.01 luck.
* Bosses are also affected by all of Knockout Drops' effects.
* Fist tears play a unique punch sound effect when they hit enemies.
* Knockout Drops can be dangerous in {{E|The Beast}} battle, as the Ultra Harbingers may get knocked so far off the screen they become hard to damage further and their attacks cannot be seen properly.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Aquarius}}: The trail of tears has a chance to knockback enemies.
* {{I|Brimstone}}: Gives the lasers high knockback.
* {{I|Jacob's Ladder}}: Enemies that are shocked by a knockback tear will also be knocked back.
* {{I|The Ludovico Technique}}: Hovering tear alternates between a normal tear and a fist.
* {{I|Technology}}: Laser receives knockback effect as with normal tears.

sections.Effects: * Upon [[death]], respawns Isaac as {{c|Black Judas}} with two {{e|Black Heart}}s in the previous room.
sections.Synergies: * {{c|Tainted Judas}}: Revived as Tainted Judas instead of Black Judas.

sections.Effects:
* {{dlc|nr+}} Grants two empty Red [[Heart container]]s and restores half a red heart.
* {{dlc|r+}} Grants two full Red [[Heart container]]s.
* -0.3 [[Speed]].
* Standing still causes Isaac to build up [[speed]] at a rate of +0.25 per second, up to a +0.5 speed bonus.
* Isaac charges up while standing still. Moving releases a fart cloud behind Isaac, damaging and inflicting [[Status Effects#Poison|Poison]] on enemies that pass through it and draining the speed buff at a rate of -0.25 speed per second. The fart clouds are left behind for the duration of the speed buff.
** The fart clouds deal 0.5× Isaac's [[damage]] per tick (1.5× Isaac's damage per second), and last ~2.5 seconds.
* Isaac is immune to Poison from enemies, such as {{E|Gasbag}} or [[Mushroom (Obstacle)|Mushrooms]].
sections.Notes: * The fart clouds are mechanically independent of the speed increase. Even while at max speed, the fart cloud must be charged by standing still.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Camo Undies}}: Damaging enemies with the fart clouds will not take away Isaac's camouflage.
* {{I|Dark Arts}}: Stays in effect even while using Dark Arts, allowing Isaac to deal more damage to nearby enemies while invulnerable.
* {{t|Gigante Bean}}: Greatly increases size of fart clouds.
* {{C|Tainted Forgotten}}: Gives a flat +0.20 speed boost and +2 soul hearts with no other effects.

* {{i|Compost}} : Will double the current amount of [[blue spider]]s.
* {{i|D12}}: Due to the high tendency of replacing rocks with {{g|TNT}}, it allows for easy destruction of nearby rocks, resulting in lots of blue spiders.
* {{i|Leo}} / {{i|Mega Mush}} / {{i|Notched Axe}} / {{tf|Stompy}} / {{i|Sulfuric Acid}} / {{i|Terra}} / {{i|Thunder Thighs}}: As Isaac can break all reachable rocks, he can amass a lot of [[blue spider]]s.
* {{i|Mega Mush}} : When Isaac destroys [[block]]s it will produce [[blue spider]]s.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a wisp that orbits Isaac, fires tears, blocks enemy shots, and deals contact damage to enemies, much like the ones spawned by {{I|Book of Virtues}}.
** The jar initially spawns only {{dlc|nr+}} one / {{dlc|r+}} two wisps, but spawns an additional wisp each time the jar is used, up to a maximum of 12 per use. The number of wisps that will be spawned by the jar is indicated by both a counter and the jar visually filling up with wisps.
** The wisps spawned by the jar can be ones created by any Book of Virtues synergy, although basic wisps are much more common than special variants.
* Isaac can have up to 3 rings of wisps; an inner, counter-clockwise spinning ring of 6 wisps, a center, clockwise-spinning ring of 8 wisps, and an outer, counter-clockwise spinning ring of 12 wisps, for a total of 26.
sections.Interactions: * {{i|Void}}: Will spawn only one wisp per use.
sections.Notes:
* While most wisps that can be given act similarly to normal wisps, there are some with effects that can potentially harm Isaac.
** {{i|Anarchist Cookbook}} Wisps look like bombs and spawn {{e|Troll Bomb}}s when destroyed.
*** {{I|Mama Mega!}} wisps look like gold tinted bombs, and will spawn {{e|Golden Troll Bomb}}s.
*** Bomb wisps with a gray tint are not dangerous; {{I|Doctor's Remote}} wisps only invoke their special effect when said item is used.
** Wisps that look like gray cubes will invoke the effect of the {{i|D7}} when they take damage.
** {{I|Teleport!}}/{{I|Teleport 2.0}} Wisps fade into and out of existence and have a chance to teleport non-boss enemies to a random spot in the current room when their tears hit them.
* Switching the jar with other active items and then picking it up again does not reset the number of wisps that will be spawned on use.

sections.Effects:
* Gives Isaac an extra life. Upon [[death]], Isaac respawns in the current room with half of a {{E|Red Heart}}, a massive size down, and +0.2 [[Speed]].
** If Isaac doesn't have any [[Red Heart Container]]s, he will respawn with a {{E|Half Soul Heart}}  instead of a {{E|Half Red Heart}}.
* When Isaac respawns as the inner child, he emits a blood explosion that deals 35 flat damage to all nearby enemies.
sections.Notes:
* Resurrection items activate in a [[:Category:Revival items|set order]]. Inner Child is 5th in this order after {{p|Soul of Lazarus}}, {{i|1up!}}, {{c|Lazarus}}' inherent extra life, and {{i|Dead Cat}}.
* Once this item has been unlocked, if the current character's [[Tainted Characters|Tainted]] version was already unlocked or the current character is a Tainted character, it is guaranteed to spawn in the hidden closet in {{s|Home}}.
** This item will appear even if Inner Child had been obtained earlier in the run, allowing Isaac to have two copies of the item.
** Despite being hard-coded not to appear anywhere else for him, this specific occurrence of Inner Child will still spawn for {{c|Tainted Lost}}.
** If this item is obtained in Home, a viable strategy is to intentionally die towards the end of the fight with {{E|Dogma}}. Isaac will be respawned with the size down and Speed up, and these effects will carry over to the Beast fight along with the healing provided by {{i|Dogma}}, making Isaac much harder to hit for the fight. 
*** If Isaac's health consists of only {{e|Red Heart}}s, a safer strategy may be to use bombs to die in the starting room of Home to trigger the item's effects and then use the bed in that room to recover all {{e|Red Heart}}s back.
* The size down from being revived by Inner Child is the same as if Isaac had collected {{i|Pluto}}.

sections.Effects:
* Replaces tears with explosive and [[poison]]ing projectiles fired in an arc.
* {{dlc|nr}} Tears down − (Delay × 2) + 10
* {{dlc|r}} 1/3 Fire Rate
* {{dlc|nr}} [[Tear Falling Speed]] is set to 13.
* {{dlc|r}} 0.8× [[range]] multiplier.
* {{dlc|r}} 0.8× [[shot speed]] multiplier.
* +40 flat [[damage]] (See [[Damage#Effective Damage|Effective Damage]])
* Tear size multiplier: 0.4×
* {{transformation contribution|Bob}}
sections.Notes:
* Enemies within the blast radius of an Ipecac explosion will also be [[poison]]ed.
* The damage boost mitigates the very small tear size multiplier.
* Ipecac's damage bonus does not apply to [[Burn]] or [[Poison]] fully; only {{Dlc|nr}} +4/{{Dlc|r}} +2 is applied to their damage per tick.
* Character damage multipliers do not apply to Ipecac's flat bonus.
* Since explosions that deal less than 85 damage hurt Isaac for half a heart, Ipecac shots usually hurt Isaac for half a heart.
** Self-damage is increased to a full heart with 85 or higher damage stat.
* If Isaac's damage is above {{dlc|nr}} 100 / {{dlc|r}} 166, Ipecac's explosions will shake the screen. This is just a visual effect.
** {{dlc|r}} A big enough tear size (~827 damage with no other tear size modifiers) will cause the explosion sound to change to the one used by {{i|Mama Mega!|n}}.
* {{dlc|r}} The height of the shots scales with range. At base stats, Ipecac shots won't be able to fly over obstacles, but the more range ups Isaac gets, the higher shots will be launched.
* {{dlc|r}} It is possible that with low shot speed and high range/tear height, Isaac won't be able to hit obstacles up close with Ipecac shots.
* {{dlc|nr}} The range of the explosion is a circle roughly 3 blocks in diameter, regardless of damage.
** As Ipecac's explosion range does not scale with tear size, with enough tear size increasing items (e.g. {{I|Death's Touch}}), it can become nearly impossible to hit enemies with Ipecac's explosions.
* {{dlc|r}} Ipecac's explosion range increases with tear size.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Abyss}}: When Isaac uses Abyss to absorb Ipecac it turns into a larger slow moving green locust that deals x1.5 Isaac’s damage per tick and poisons enemies.
* {{T|Brain Worm}}: The Ipecac tears will snap 90 degrees and rain down at nearby enemy should the shot miss, completely eliminating the shortcoming of having too much range and causing Ipecac tears to fly over enemy's head, missing them.
* {{dlc+|ana+}} {{i|Brimstone}} / {{c|Azazel}}: No explosive beam or stat change. Beam poisons enemies.{{dlc-}}
** {{dlc|a+nr}} Isaac shoots Ipecac tears while charging Brimstone. Both Brimstone and Ipecac shots modify Isaac's damage and tear delay stat, meaning that Ipecac fires slower and Brimstone charges slower, but Brimstone does an extra 40*13 damage.  Take care to pre-charge Brimstone so that the Ipecac shot is on cooldown as Isaac enters a room.
** {{dlc|r}} Blood beam now does poison damage and will explode on connection with an enemy which can damage the character if close enough. The character doesn't gain the Damage Up or Tears Down effects. The flat damage bonus is reduced to +2, but Isaac's tear rate stat is not modified. The beam explodes on the first enemy or obstacle it hits every other tick, dealing 10 + twice of Isaac's Damage. The explosions do not occur when the beam narrows, meaning that they occur only twice per shot without {{I|Soy Milk}} / {{I|Almond Milk}}. The beam and its explosions poison enemies.
* {{i|Cricket's Body}}: The main tear splits into four explosive splash tears. The splash tears can still damage Isaac.
** {{dlc|r}} Ipecac's x0.8 range multiplier does not stack with Cricket's Body's own x0.8 range multiplier.
* {{I|C Section}}: The fetuses explode once they touch an enemy, poisoning and dealing damage equal to Isaac's Damage.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}}: Bombs explode on contact, do no damage to Isaac and become {{I|Bob's Curse}} bombs.
** {{dlc|nr}} The damage is massively increased, as the +40 damage from Ipecac is run through the damage multiplier of Dr. Fetus.
** {{dlc|r}} The flat damage bonus is reduced to +2. Bombs leave a poison cloud that damages enemies. With {{C|Jacob and Esau}} only the character with the items is immune to the explosions.
** '''Dr. Fetus''' + '''Monstro's Lung''': Renders Isaac no longer immune to his shots. {{dlc|r}} The flat damage bonus is increased back to +40.
** '''Dr. Fetus''' + '''Sad Bombs''': Isaac is not immune to the explosive shots created by the Sad Bombs' effect.
* {{i|Epic Fetus}}: Missiles turn green and are poisonous. Damage greatly increases as the flat damage bonus stacks with Epic Fetus' explosive multiplier.
* {{i|Flat Stone}}: The Ipecac shots cause full-damage explosions instead of lesser splash damage when they bounce off the floor, though they can also harm Isaac.
** {{Dlc|r}} Each bounce creates an explosion that deals half Isaac's damage as well as dealing the regular splash damage. The bounce explosion radius is slightly larger than the splash radius.
* {{c|The Forgotten|nr}}: The flat damage bonus is reduced to +4. Melee attacks become poisonous and explosive; he cannot be hurt by the blasts but is pushed back by them. The explosions deal 1.5x damage. The charged throwing attack is only poisonous. The Soul uses Ipecac as normal.
** {{Dlc|r}} The flat damage bonus is reduced to +2. The thrown bone club can explode once on enemy contact while being sent out, but not while returning. These explosions deal from 10 + 2.8x to 10 + 6x Damage based on how much the attack is charged, and do no self-damage.
** {{Dlc|r}} When the skeleton form has {{i|Technology}}, the thrown bone club constantly explodes and deals damage to The Forgotten.
* {{i|Haemolacria}}: Tear delay is increased by 1/3 compared to either of the items on their own, but Isaac now fires Ipecac shots that release poisonous, high-damage but non-explosive split tears on impact.
** {{dlc|r}} Ipecac's x0.8 range multiplier does not stack with Haemolacria's own x0.8 range multiplier.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: Tear damage is increased by 4, explodes when killing an enemy, and comes back to Isaac.
** {{dlc|a+nr}} +4 flat damage bonus, no explosion.
** {{dlc|r}} +2 flat damage bonus, no explosion.
* {{i|Maw Of The Void|r}}: The ring becomes poisonous and explodes on the first enemy or obstacle contact it hits every other tick, dealing 10 + twice of Isaac's Damage. The explosions do not occur for the first four ticks.
* {{i|Mom's Knife}}: Knife turns green, may poison enemies, and removes Ipecac's damage increase.
** {{dlc|a+nr}} Also adds +4 flat damage bonus.
** {{dlc|r}} Also adds +2 flat damage bonus. The thrown knife can explode once on enemy contact while being sent out, but not while returning. These explosions deal from 10 + 2.1x to 10 + 6x Damage based on how much the attack is charged.
* {{i|Monstro's Lung}}: Isaac fires a barrage of Ipecac shots, with no increase in charge time compared to Monstro's Lung alone.
** {{dlc|r}} Charge time increases by 3x.
* {{i|Montezuma's Revenge}}: The poop beam gets only a +2 flat damage bonus instead of +40. The beam explodes 10 times, either on the first enemy or obstacle it hits or at the very end otherwise, dealing 10 + twice of the beam's damage.
* {{i|Mysterious Liquid}}: Leaves a massive pool of [[creep]] on the floor on impact.
* {{i|The Parasite}}: The Ipecac tear will spawn two smaller explosive tears when it collides with a solid object, but not with an enemy. These tears can spawn tears on their own as well, potentially leading to huge chain reactions.
* {{i|Revelation}}: The laser gets only a +2 flat damage bonus instead of +40. The laser explodes on the first enemy or obstacle it hits every other tick. The explosions occur 8 times and deal 10 + twice of the laser's damage.
* {{i|Tech X}}: The flat damage bonus is reduced to +4. The laser ring becomes poisonous.
** {{dlc|r}} The flat damage bonus is reduced to +2. The laser ring becomes poisonous and explodes every other tick on contact, deal 10 + twice of the ring's damage. Knockback from the blasts will push enemies along the path of the ring, prolonging damage. The ring will not open {{R|Secret Room}}s if the entrance is on the bottom wall since the ring will never explode against the bottom wall.
* {{i|Technology}}: Removes the flat damage bonus, poisonous laser.
** {{dlc|a+nr}} +4 flat damage bonus, poisonous laser.
** {{dlc|r}} +2 flat damage bonus, poisonous laser that explodes on enemy or obstacle contact, deal 10 + twice of Isaac's damage. Keeps Ipecac's stats other than damage.
*** Note: This combination is not advised if the player has the {{I|Multidimensional Baby}} familiar. When the ipecac technology laser passes through the {{I|Multidimensional Baby}}, it instantly explodes, damaging the player and likely being fatal for the run.{{dlc-}}
* {{i|Trisagion}}: Trisagion blasts do not explode on hit. The explosion happen once the blast runs out of range or hits a wall and deals damage equal to Isaac's Damage.
** {{Dlc|r}} Trisagion blasts are poisonous and explode upon impact with an enemy or obstacle, dealing 10 + twice of the blast's damage. When the base of the blast reaches an enemy or obstacle, it explodes and deals damage equal to Isaac's Damage.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|120 Volt}}: The zaps get only a +2 flat damage bonus instead of +40. The 0.75x-1.5x damage multiplier applies afterwards.
* {{i|Crown Of Light}} / {{i|Polyphemus}} / {{i|Proptosis|nr}} / {{i|Sacred Heart}} / {{i|Bloody Lust|nr}}: The damage multipliers from these items do not apply to Ipecac's +40 bonus, resulting in much lower damage increase than expected.
* {{i|Chocolate Milk}}: Charged up Ipecac deals expectedly high damage. Rapid-fire can be used against weaker enemies or to clear obstacles when necessary.
* {{i|Cricket's Head}} / {{i|Eve's Mascara}} / {{i|Magic Mushroom}}: The damage multipliers from these items apply to Ipecac's +40 bonus, unlike others.
* {{i|Death's Touch|nr}}: Although damage is increased, the tears' hitboxes also grow larger, which may be detrimental.
* {{I|Fire Mind}}: Due to the nature of the Ipecac, all shots will have a 100% chance of leaving a fire at the center of the explosion. {{dlc|nr}} It will also no longer leave behind green creep and the explosion will be of normal color instead of green.
* {{i|Ghost Bombs}} / {{i|Hungry Soul}}: The ghosts get only +1 flat damage from Ipecac, instead of the expected +20.
* {{i|Ghost Pepper|nr}}: If a fire is generated at the same time as an Ipecac shot, the Ipecac shot will explode instantly.
* {{i|Glass Cannon}}: As the Glass Cannon tears are so large, even a modest damage increase or a single tear size increasing item is likely to render the tear unable to damage enemies.
* {{I|Holy Light}}: A beam of light will spawn on top of any enemy within the explosion's radius.
* {{i|Jacob's Ladder}}: The sparks spawn only when they hit a wall.
* {{i|Little Horn|nr}}: If an Ipecac shot has the Little Horn effect, after destroying an enemy, it loses its explosive property and effectively is just a normal Little Horn tear.
* {{i|Lost Contact}}: Ipecac shots will explode on contact with enemy shots.
* {{i|Mom's Eye}} / {{i|Loki's Horns}}: Occasionally shoots backwards or in all 4 directions, with high risk of self-damage.
* {{i|Number One|r}}: '''Not recommended.''' Unlike other similar items, Ipecac's x0.8 range multiplier does stack with Number One's own x0.8 range multiplier, making self-damage more likely.
* {{i|Parasitoid|nr+}}: Only extra range applies on egg sack tears and they will not spawn flies or spiders.
* [[Piercing tears]]: Tears will still explode on enemy contact, nullifying piercing.
* {{i|Rubber Cement}}: Tears will bounce off walls and rocks and won't explode until they hit the ground. '''Not recommended''', as self-damage is likely.
* [[Spectral tears]]: Ipecac shots no longer explode on contact with obstacles or walls, making accidental self-damage less likely but more difficult to open doors.
* {{c|Tainted Forgotten}}: Tainted Forgotten's melee attacks will explode. Tainted Soul is immune ''only'' to those explosions, so any further explosions caused by synergies will damage it.
* {{i|Technology 2|nr}}: The +40 damage bonus is not affected by the Technology 2 multiplier, making the laser very high powered, but only every other Ipecac shot is fired.
* {{i|Technology Zero}}: High fire rate needed for explosive shots to be connected.
* {{i|Tiny Planet}}: Ipecac tears orbit around Isaac for a very long time. They land far enough to not cause self-damage, but that can be relied on only if Isaac is not moving and do not hit enemies.
* {{i|Tractor Beam}}: The Ipecac tear will travel in an arc along the beam, even if Isaac is moving forward as well. When Isaac changes direction, the tear will snap to the beam, making it very easy to accidentally hit close objects blocking its new path.
* {{i|Brimstone}} + {{i|Monstro's Lung}}: The erratically fired lasers can easily hit rocks or enemies near Isaac, damaging him. This affect is worsened by [[Azazel]]'s need to be close to enemies to damage them. Be wary of this synergy without explosion immunity.

sections.Effects:
* Each tear shot by Isaac increases item charge by one.
* Upon use, fires 8 tears around Isaac, which retain the [[damage]], [[range]], [[shot speed]], and most special [[Tear Effects|tear effects]] of his tears.
** {{dlc|r}} Tears from this item have a +5 flat damage bonus.
sections.Notes:
* The effect of {{i|Tammy's Head}} is similar to Isaac's Tears, but Isaac's Tears will not benefit from tear-replacing items like {{i|Brimstone}}.
* {{dlc|na+}} It takes 1.3 seconds to use, during which time Isaac cannot shoot tears normally. Because of this it is only worth it to use Isaac's tears DPS-wise if 4 or more tears successfully land.
** {{dlc|a+}} It takes 0.4 seconds to use, during which time Isaac cannot shoot tears normally.
** {{dlc|r}} It takes 0.1 seconds to use, short enough that it usually will not interrupt shooting tears normally.
sections.Interactions:
* {{dlc|nr}} {{i|Brimstone}} / {{i|Mom's Knife}}:
** {{dlc|na+}} The item fires normal tears, although it will charge nearly instantly while the attack charges.
** {{dlc|a+}} Fires normal tears. Charges at the same rate as Isaac's fire rate while charging Brimstone/Mom's Knife.
** '''Brimstone''' + {{i|Lachryphagy}}: When tears burst, they will shoot out Brimstone lasers in a fashion similar to {{i|Tammy's Head}}.
* {{i|Brimstone|r}}: Adds up to 4 charges for the duration of the laser. (If the player cancels the laser early, less charges will be given)
* {{I|Car Battery|anr}}: No effect.
* {{i|Chocolate Milk|nr}}: The size and damage of tears fired depend on how far Isaac has charged up his shot. For example, if Isaac has completely charged his shot, the tears fired by the item will be fully charged.
* {{i|Cursed Eye}} / {{i|Neptunus}}: Adds one charge per each shot.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}}: Fires normal tears.
* {{i|Epic Fetus}}:
** {{Dlc|nr}} The item fires normal tears, but charges very quickly as the crosshairs are moved.
** {{dlc|r}} The item charges even while the crosshair is not moving, with the speed based on Isaac's [[tears]] stat.
* {{I|Eye of the Occult}}: Makes the tears controllable and able to be made most use of.
* {{dlc|r}} {{i|Mom's Knife}} / {{i|Tech X}} / {{i|Chocolate Milk}}: Adds one charge per shot regardless of how much the tear was charged up.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}:
** {{dlc|nr}} The item charges based on the tear's movement.
** {{dlc|r}} The item charges even while the tear is not moving, with the speed based on Isaac's tears stat.
* {{I|Spirit Sword}}: The item fires normal tears and can be charged as fast as the sword can be swung. Doing a spin attack will fully charge Isaac's Tears.
* {{i|Technology}} / {{i|Technology 2}}: Fires normal tears.
* {{i|Trisagion}}: Fires Trisagion beams. {{dlc|r}} Does not gain the additional +5 damage.

sections.Effects:
* Enemy shots that hit Isaac have a 20% chance to be blocked. When a shot is effectively blocked, Host Hat fires 3 projectiles similar to the {{E|Host}}'s.
** Projectiles fired from Host Hat use Isaac's [[Damage]] and [[Range]], and copy Isaac's [[Tear effects]].
*** The bullets do not use Isaac's [[Shot Speed]].
** Can block:
*** Fireballs (e.g. from {{E|Crackle}}), but their lines of fire harm Isaac.
*** Fire projectiles (e.g. from {{E|Mega Satan}}).
*** Obstacles thrown by {{E|Polty}} or {{E|Kineti}}.
** Does not block:
*** Lasers or beams.
*** Lines of fire from fireballs.
*** Projectiles from {{E|Big Bony}}, {{E|Coal Boy}}, {{E|Danny}}.
* Grants immunity to explosions.
* {{Dlc|r}} Grants immunity to bullets falling from above.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|r+}} This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|The Gate}}.{{dlc-}}
* Does not protect against exploding [[Rocks#Mushrooms|mushrooms]].
* Does not protect against {{E|Hush}}'s vertical beams in the final phase.
* {{Dlc|nr}} Isaac becomes immune to {{E|Mom}} and {{E|Satan}}'s stomp attacks, as they are considered explosions. This makes the item very valuable if trying to unlock {{C|The Forgotten}}, as it will protect Isaac from the effects of the {{I|Broken Shovel 1}}.
* {{dlc|a+}} This item is invaluable in [[Greedier Mode]] as nearly all of {{E|Ultra Greedier|n}}'s attacks are considered explosions.
* One of only two items that grant full immunity to explosive damage, the other being {{I|Pyromaniac}}.
* Although Host Hat has firing animation that expose itself after it blocks a tear, it can still block tears in this state, firing bullets as it blocks.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Dr. Fetus}} / {{I|Epic Fetus}} / {{I|Ipecac}}: Isaac becomes immune to his explosives.
* {{T|Walnut}}: Walnut will only require 1-5 explosions to open. As Isaac is immune to explosions, he can safely open Walnut without taking any damage.

sections.Effects:
* Taking damage causes Isaac to release a ring of 10 tears and gain [[tears]] up for the current room. {{dlc|r+}} For the rest of the room, Isaac's tears, including the initial ring of tears, leave pools of [[red creep]] where they land.
** The first hit taken increases Isaac's tears fired per second by 1.2, then by 0.4 for every subsequent hit in the same room. This ignores the tears cap and can stack indefinitely.
** Each tear in the ring deals 10 damage and doesn't use Isaac's tear effects.
sections.Interactions: * {{i|Varicose Veins}}: Two rings of tears are released at once.

sections.Effects:
* Combines with {{i|Knife Piece 1}} to form a knife familiar that launches itself in the direction Isaac shoots, dealing 25 damage to and piercing enemies it hits.
* Launching it at the red door at the end of {{s|Mausoleum}}/{{s|Gehenna}} II will open the door, destroying the knife in the process.
sections.Notes:
* Obtaining Knife Piece 2 without {{I|Knife Piece 1}} will spawn a knife blade familiar that follows Isaac but has no other effect.
* The door to the abandoned area can be opened with two explosions or items like {{i|Dad's Key}}; however, Isaac will not be able to reach the door unless he has flight or all three buttons have been pressed anyway. If the door is already open, the minecart cannot be ridden but the path can be walked along.
* While in the abandoned area, all of Isaac's items and consumables are removed. Extra Life items will not activate despite still visually appearing beside the health bar. However, any items with reroll protection will still function as normal. (This includes {{I|Knife Piece 1}} itself.)
* If a character has inherent [[flight]], they will retain it in the abandoned area, making it significantly easier.
* This room, as well as the buttons to reach it, will only be generated if Knife Piece 1 was already collected.
* The buttons can be bypassed with flight and 2 bombs to destroy the door. Upon exiting the room, the rail pathway will be built in order to prevent softlocks from using temporary flight methods such as {{I|The Bible}}.
* The red door can alternatively be opened using {{i|Cracked Orb}}, {{i|Sharp Key}}, or {{p|Soul of Cain}}.
* If Isaac takes Knife Piece 2 and is somehow able to immediately leave the room before {{E|Mother's Shadow}} fully activates (usually by using {{i|Mama Mega!}} earlier in the floor), the rest of the sub-area will not have reset, and the doors leading to the exit will all be locked. This forces the player to re-enter the Knife Piece 2 room, which triggers ''another'' activation of {{E|Mother's Shadow}}, causing two instances of Mother's Shadow to pursue the player during the escape sequence.
* It is possible to find a {{r|Crawl Space}} as normal in this area, which will be the same crawlspace as any other generated on the normal floor. Entering the crawlspace will allow Isaac to use his normal items and consumables, but Mother's Shadow will also be present. Using any teleport card or item will teleport Isaac to a random room on the abandoned area map. Any items obtained while in this crawlspace will remain upon leaving the area, but will not be able to be used while in the abandoned area.
** It is possible to softlock the run by entering a crawlspace with the key needed to escape the room. Upon leaving the crawlspace, the key will be gone.
** The {{r|Black Market}} or {{r|I AM ERROR}} room can potentially be entered from the crawlspace. Going through the trapdoor there will end the pursuit and lead to Depths II (or alternatives). Isaac will keep all his items, including those bought in the market.
* The knife familiar created from both knife pieces takes 5th priority on the line of following familiars.
* '''Knife Piece 2''' takes 6th priority on the line of following [[familiar]]s while the knife familiar created from both knife pieces takes 5th priority.
* It's possible (though useless) to acquire another Knife Piece 2 using {{i|Forget Me Now}} or {{i|R Key}}.
* {{C|Tainted Eve}} retains her ability to create clots, but loses access to {{I|Sumptorium}}. Caution should be used if entering with low health as clots cannot be reabsorbed until exiting.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns an {{E|Old Chest}} at the start of each floor.
* Old Chests are similar in appearance to {{E|Locked Chest}}s and likewise require a {{E|Key}} to unlock, but have the color of a normal Chest and a worn-down appearance. When opened, they contain one of the following:
** 1-3 {{E|Soul Heart}}s (43% chance)
** 3 [[trinkets]] (42% chance)
** An [[Old Chest (Item Pool)|Old Chest item]] (10% chance)
** An [[Angel Room (Item Pool)|Angel Room item]] (5% chance)
sections.Notes:
* The chest also spawns in the mirrored floor of {{s|Downpour}} II and {{s|Dross}} II if picked up before entering.
* During the [[Ascent]], the chest spawns in the original starting room of each floor, right above the beam of light to the floor above.
* The chest does not spawn in {{s|Home}}.
* Does nothing on {{C|Tainted Lazarus}} if the new floor is entered by the character without Isaac's Tomb.
sections.Synergies: * {{i|Death Certificate}} : An Old Chest will appear in the Death Certificate area, unless Death Certificate is used on the floor where Isaac's Tomb was obtained.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Crooked Penny}} / {{i|Diplopia}}: Additional copies of Isaac's Tomb have no effect. Only one chest is spawned at the start of the floor.
* {{t|Gilded Key}} / {{t|The Left Hand}} / {{i|Mom's Key}} / {{t|Poker Chip}}: No effect.

sections.Effects:
* Isaac has a chance to fire a glowing blue tear that, after colliding with an enemy, spawns a damaging beam of light (similar to {{i|Crack the Sky}}).
** {{Dlc|nr}}Each beam of light deals quadruple (4×) Isaac's tear damage.
** {{Dlc|r}}Each beam of light deals triple (3×) Isaac's tear damage.
** The beam of light will damage all enemies in a small radius around it.
* {{Dlc|r}}{{transformation contribution|Seraphim}}
sections.Notes:
* The chance to fire a holy tear depends on the [[luck]] stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: <math>\min(\frac1 { 10 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \times 0.9 \right \rfloor},50\%)</math><ref>https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/15K8Xgxoxdx68AIaxuLXgZoJJlG36UPgy3_aeDpAM5tU/edit?usp=sharing</ref>
** At base Luck (0), the chance is 10%, maxing out at 50% at 8.89 Luck.
* Its damage is multiplied from the tear's damage, not directly from Isaac's [[Damage]].
** This means that, if the tears' damage has been multiplied from effects such as {{I|Proptosis}} or {{I|Tough Love}}, the beam's damage is also multiplied.
* Light beams can destroy {{e|Shopkeeper}}s if a holy tear hits an enemy nearby.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Abyss}}: When Isaac uses Abyss to absorb Holy Light it turns into a glowing cyan locust. Every tick of damage it deals has a chance to call down a beam of light dealing triple Isaac’s damage.
* {{I|Bob's Rotten Head}}: Has a chance to throw a Holy Light head that spawns a damaging beam of light dealing ({{Dlc|nr}}4×) {{dlc|r}}3× the explosion damage when it hits an enemy.
* {{I|Compound Fracture}} / {{I|Cricket's Body}} / {{I|The Parasite}}: Holy Light tears will have split tears with Holy Light effect; normal tears will not have split tears with Holy Light effect.
* {{I|Lachryphagy}}: If Holy Light tears feed normal tears, fed normal tears will not gain Holy Light effect; however if normal tears feed Holy Light tears, it will just increase the size of fed Holy Light tears.
* {{I|The Ludovico Technique}}: The controlled tear will sometimes glow and trigger the beam.
* {{I|C Section}}: Glowing shots will rapidly strike light beams on contact, making short work of most enemies.

sections.Synergies: * {{i|BFFS!}}: The chance to spawn a pickup increases to 31.25%, and the chance to spawn a trinket increases to 12.5%.

sections.Effect: * Spawns a crawling Leech [[familiar]] that follows Isaac. If an enemy comes near, the Leech will attack and chase it, doing 1.5 damage per tick or about 3.2 damage per second. If an enemy is killed by the Leech, Isaac will be healed by a {{e|Half Red Heart}}.
sections.Synergies:
* {{R|Arcade}}s: The player can let the Leech eat {{E|Fly|text=Flies}} from the {{e|Shell Game}} and use the resulting health to gamble on the {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}.
* {{i|BFFS!}}: Leech grows bigger and does double damage. Still only heals for a Half Red Heart.
* {{i|E. Coli|nr}}: Enemies can be turned into {{g|Poop}} at the cost of a Half Red Heart, then consumed by the leech to regain health. Utilization of temporary immunity when hit can allow multiple enemies to be turned into poop, resulting in a net gain of health. However, when combined with Gnawed Leaf (see below), the player can simply stand still and let Leech do the dirty work.
* {{i|Flush!|nr}}: The leech still can attack the enemies turned into poop and gain health.
* {{i|Gnawed Leaf}}: The player can stand still and allow the Leech to clear a [[Rooms|room]], granting simple clears and easy health.
* {{C|Tainted Bethany}}: The leech can grant blood charges by killing enemies.
* {{c|Tainted Magdalene|r}}: Leech restores a full {{e|Red Heart}}.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|E. Coli|r}}/{{i|Flush!}}: Enemies that are turned into poop are now treated as regular poop and can't be damaged by Leech.
* {{i|Maggy's Bow}}: No effect on healing.

sections.Effect:
* Spawns a [[familiar]] who follows Isaac around and fires [[homing tears]] {{dlcalt|once per second|r=1.36 times a second}} that each do 3.5 damage.
* {{transformation contribution|Conjoined}}
sections.Notes:
* Little Steven is the more common of the two items that can drop by defeating {{e|Steven}}.
* {{dlc|r}} [[Familiar]]s that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Little Steven having {{dlcalt|5th|r+=7th}} priority.
sections.Synergies: * {{I|Mongo Baby}}: Will copy Little Steven’s tears.

sections.Effects:
* Pickups (e.g. hearts, coins, keys, bombs, etc.) are attracted to Isaac.
** The attraction enables the item to pass/fly over pits or rocks, but not through Key Blocks.
** {{e|Red Heart|text=Hearts}} are only attracted if Isaac could pick them up with his existing Red Heart containers.
** {{E|Lil' Battery|text=Batteries}} act similarly to hearts in that they will only be attracted to Isaac if his active item isn't fully charged.
** {{E|Chest|r}}s roughly 2 or fewer tiles away from Isaac open automatically. {{E|Spiked Chest|n}}s are opened without damaging Isaac. {{E|Locked Chest}}s and {{e|Bomb Chest}}s are not opened and still require a key/bomb, though Locked chests ''will'' be opened from a distance if Isaac possesses the {{t|Paper Clip}}.
sections.Notes:
* Magneto can attract {{E|Scared Heart}}s, but they still run away from Isaac.
* {{e|Grab Bag}}s are not attracted by Magneto.
** {{dlc|r}} They are also not opened by Magneto.
* {{dlc|r}} If Magneto opens the chests in {{r|Challenge Room}}s, the waves won't start spawning unless you touch the empty chests, nor will the way out be closed.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|Hypercoagulation}}: Magneto cuts the momentum of the hearts, allowing for easy pickup and, in turn, making Isaac very tough to kill.
* {{i|Options?}}: If a chest is presented as a choice and opened by Magneto, the other reward won't disappear unless the empty chest is then touched. Chests with items disappear or make the other reward disappear, though.
** {{dlc|r}}Options? + {{i|Broken Modem}}: If Broken Modem duplicates a chest that was spawned by Options?, using Magneto to immediately open the chest while in its glitched form will create a {{i|TMTRAINER}} item if the chest contained an item.{{dlc-}}
* {{C|Tainted Magdalene}}/{{C|Tainted Keeper}}: Attracts hearts and coins dropped by enemies, allowing for easier survival and/or coin-gathering, respectively.
* {{C|Tainted ???}}: Poop pickups are not attracted.
* {{T|Paper Clip}}: Allows locked chests to be opened from a short distance.
* {{T|Broken Magnet}}: Does not increase the pull speed of coins.

sections.Effects:
* Creates a ghostly [[familiar]] that closely follows behind Isaac. It dies in one hit, respawning at the start of the next floor.
* If Lost Soul survives until the start of the next floor, it rewards Isaac with one of the following:
** 3 {{e|Soul Heart}}s.
** 2 {{e|Eternal Heart}}s.
** A [[Treasure Room (Item Pool)|Treasure Room item]] or an [[Angel Room (Item Pool)|Angel Room item]].
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|r+}} This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|Blighted Ovum}}.{{dlc-}}
* Lost Soul hides behind Isaac, opposite to the direction he is firing tears.
** Also, if Isaac is moving to the opposite side he's shooting, then his hitbox will completely absorb Lost Soul's hitbox, making it significantly harder for enemies to hit it.
* Floors completed during the [[Ascent]] count.
* Waiting until after the floor is cleared before picking up Lost Soul nearly guarantees a reward payout on the next floor.
* The ghost can take explosive damage from Isaac, e.g. via placing a {{e|Bomb}}.
* Lost Soul's position behind Isaac can overlap with other [[Familiar]]s.
* Leaving the {{E|Mother's Shadow}} chase sequence respawns Lost Soul.
* Swapping the item as {{C|Tainted Isaac}} and picking it up again respawns Lost Soul.
* [[Rocks#Spiked Rocks|Spiked Rocks]] will kill Lost Soul.
* {{dlc|nr+}} If Lost Soul is hit, this will invalidate the conditions for spawning {{t|Perfection}}, even if Isaac hasn't been hit.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|BFFS!}}: Gives Lost Soul a once-per-room shield, similar to {{i|Holy Mantle}}.
** If BFFS! is dropped, the shield will still remain active until taking one hit of damage, acting similarly to {{p|Holy Card}}.
* {{i|Forget Me Now}} / {{i|R Key}}: Restarting a floor/run causes Lost Soul to give a reward if it's alive when used.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Box of Friends}}: Cannot duplicate the ghost and won't spawn a {{i|Demon Baby}}, even when the ghost is dead.
* {{i|Bursting Sack}} / {{i|Skatole}}: Does not provide immunity to contact damage from spiders/flies to Lost Soul.
* {{i|Chaos}}: Items dropped by Lost Soul are drawn from a random pool.
* {{t|Child Leash}} / {{t|Duct Tape}} / {{t|Friendship Necklace}} / {{I|King Baby}} / {{T|RC Remote}} / {{t|The Twins}}: No effect.
* {{i|Diplopia}} / {{i|Crooked Penny}}: Picking up multiple Lost Souls has no effect, even if one died previously.
* {{i|Missing No.}}: If a new floor is entered and {{i|Missing No.}} rerolls into this item, it will immediately give a reward.
* {{c|Tainted Forgotten}}: The ghost follows {{c|Tainted Forgotten}}, making it very difficult to protect.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a [[familiar]] that can be launched in the direction that Isaac is firing after a short charge-up period.
** {{dlc|nr}} At full charge, it initially deals 6 damage per tick or 90 damage per second, but quickly drops towards 0 the slower the familiar moves.
** {{dlc|r}} No longer deals damage per tick, instead deals a fix amount of damage depending on charge level, at lowest being ~5 and at max being ~20.
* It bounces off walls multiple times, much like {{E|Gurdy Jr.}}
** {{dlc|r}} It will also bounce off enemies.
sections.Notes: * {{dlc+|r+}} This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|Gurglings}}, {{e|Gurdy Jr.}}, {{e|Gurdy}} or {{e|Mama Gurdy}}.{{dlc-}}

sections.Effect:
* Spawns a small flying {{E|Monstro}} [[familiar]] that charges up and fires a large cluster of tears, similar to Monstro's main attack.
** It fires between 12 and 14 tears that do 3.5 damage each.
*** It can do a minimum of 3.5 damage to 49 damage, depending on how many shots are fired and how many hit.
sections.Notes: * {{dlc|r}} [[Familiar]]s that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Lil Monstro having {{dlc|nr+}} 3rd / {{dlc|r+}} 5th priority.

sections.Effects:
* Upon taking damage, Isaac gains a body part as an [[Familiar#Orbital Familiars|orbital]], which blocks enemy shots and deals 7 damage per tick (35 damage per second) to enemies it comes in contact with.
** A maximum of three body parts can be active at once.
** The body parts will be destroyed after dealing 30 ticks of damage and/or blocking 3 shots.

sections.Effects:
* Continually balances Isaac's primary [[attribute]]s - [[damage]], [[range]], [[tears]], and [[speed]] (has no effect on [[luck]], [[shot speed]], {{dlc|nr}} or [[tear falling speed]]).
** This effect is ''NOT'' one time only - Libra will rebalance Isaac's attributes whenever they are changed by an item, effect, etc. including temporary effects such as the {{i|The Book of Belial}}.
* Grants 6 {{e|Penny|text=Coins}}, 6 {{e|Bomb}}s, and 6 {{e|Key}}s.
sections.Notes:
* The balancing is based on [[Isaac]] as the character himself; he gains no bonuses or penalties to any stats from simply having Libra on its own.
* The game calculates Isaac's speed, range, tear delay, and damage before using them in Libra's balancing formula. This has the following notable effects:
** {{dlc|nr}} If Isaac's Speed or Tear delay are already at their internal soft caps (2.00 and 5 respectively), items that increase them specifically will give no stats.
*** The only exception would be items that decrease tear delay, and then only if Isaac's tear delay isn't at the hard cap of 1.
** {{dlc|r}} If Isaac's tears stat has reached the soft cap corresponding to 5 [[fire rate]], basic tears ups no longer add bonuses, only direct tear delay upgrades will. Likewise, direct fire rate increases have no effect if the absolute maximum of 120 has been reached.
*** Speed adjustments, despite the stat being bounded between 0.1 and 2.0, always have an effect.
** {{Dlc|r}} Speed and range will positively scale as they increase; the higher these stats already are upon receiving a boost to either one, the bigger the boost to the rest of Isaac's stats. Range scales especially quickly, making large range upgrades like {{I|My Reflection}} and {{I|Tiny Planet}} very powerful with Libra.
** Items that apply multipliers to Isaac's tear delay ({{i|Mutant Spider}}, {{i|Brimstone}}, {{i|Dr. Fetus}}, etc.) can be fired more rapidly with less damage.
** Damage upgrades become less effective. In return, speed and range upgrades now increase damage and tears.
** Items that affect the stats of Isaac's tears after they're fired ({{i|A Lump of Coal}}, {{i|Blood Clot}}, {{i|Proptosis}}, etc.) do not go through the balancing formula and work as normal.
* {{dlc|nr}} Libra's balancing formula values tear delay higher than the other stats and damage less than the other stats. This makes standard tears ups give more stats than a standard range or speed up, and standard damage ups give less stats than a standard range or speed up.
* {{dlc|r}} Generally speaking, if an item increases Isaac's damage per second, Isaac will receive a stat bonus. If the item lowers fire rate and increases damage, or vice versa, in a way that results in loss of DPS, Isaac's stats will go down.
* {{dlc|nr}} Since tear falling speed is not involved in the calculations, items such as {{i|Mini Mush}} or {{i|Kidney Stone}} that increase tear falling speed but lower range are mostly detrimental.
* Stat upgrade [[pills]] have more utility, providing bonuses long after their stat could be usefully increased.
** In order of effectiveness, the pills are: ''Range'', ''Tears'', then ''Speed Up''.
** {{I|Placebo}} with stat upgrade pills provides a constant source of stat increases.
* Damage from [[poison]] and [[burning]] status effects is based on Isaac's damage before the balancing. The same is true for temporary familiars (such as [[blue fly|blue flies]].)
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Berserk!}}: Because of Berserk giving you +0.4 speed with every kill, Libra would instead steadily increases the damage, tears, and range stat with seemingly no limit, allowing massively high DPS, but targets are much more difficult to hit as the range of the swing gradually extending outwards more and more with each kill.
* {{I|Soy Milk}}: As tear delay is valued very highly by the formula, greatly increases all stats.
** {{dlc|r}} Soy Milk is only a minor DPS upgrade, and as such a very minor all stats up.
* {{I|Ipecac}}: Can be rapidly fired with decreased damage.
* {{I|Rock Bottom}}: Stats will increase as a result of items, get locked at the highest point, and then be balanced out via Libra allowing items like Ipecac and Soy Milk to have higher damage/shot speed respectively.
* {{I|Taurus}}: Gradually increases all stats in an incomplete room. Libra prevents Isaac from becoming invincible (unless with high stats), and stat increases will remain until the end of the fight.
* {{T|Tape Worm}}: As range is valued very highly by the formula, greatly increases all stats. Synergizes well with {{I|Mom's Box}}.
** {{dlc|r}} Tape Worm is a flat +3 range instead of x2, resulting in only a small all stats up.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|120 Volt}} / {{i|Ghost Bombs}} / {{i|Hungry Soul}} / {{i|Montezuma's Revenge}} / {{i|Revelation}}: The attacks from these items ignore Libra: the unbalanced damage value is used.
* {{i|Almond Milk}}: Almond Milk is only a minor DPS upgrade, and as such a very minor all stats up.
* {{i|Cricket's Body|nr}}: Due to how Libra values tear delay, Cricket's Body gives an overall stat downgrade or upgrade depending on Isaac's internal base tear delay: At 7 or less it increases stats, at 8 or more it decreases stats.
* {{i|D8}}: D8's stat changes depend on which stats end up with which multipliers and their base values. Range has a high weight and is uncapped, and thus can result in a massive boost if it scores a high multiplier. Damage is also uncapped but, on the other hand, has a low weight.
** {{dlc|r}} The changes in Libra's formula and the uncapping of speed bonuses beyond 2.0 mean D8 has a good chance of giving a strong all stats up, its magnitude depending on Isaac's other items and which stats were emphasized.
* {{i|Dark Arts}}: Libra is extremely detrimental to how Dark Arts works, and should not be used together: The speed boost during the invincibility phase is transferred into attack bonuses (Which are useless as tears cannot be used), and afterwards, the temporary damage boost is divided across all of Isaac's stats, resulting in very negligible stat boosts.
* {{i|Epiphora}}: The stat bonus for continuously firing in one direction applies to all stats. The accuracy penalty is unaffected.
* {{i|Eve's Mascara}}: Gives an overall stat downgrade, due to tears being weighted heavier than damage.
** {{dlc|r}} Eve's Mascara is a DPS up with no other relevant stats, and as such is a small all stats up.
* {{i|Experimental Treatment}}: The greater number of stat upgrades compared to stat downgrades results in an effectively guaranteed all stats up. Health, Shot Speed, and Luck are still subject to chance.
* {{i|Purity}}: At base stats, the tear delay and damage aura give a greater stat bonus than the range or speed aura.
** {{dlc|r}} All the auras grant a small all stats up of similar magnitudes.
* {{I|Succubus}}: When in the aura, affects re-balanced stats rather than just damage.
* {{i|Technology 2|nr}}: Doubled tear delay due to firing out of only one eye is unaffected by the balancing formula.
* {{I|Tiny Planet}}: The significant range increase results in a large stat boost to speed and tears and a small boost to damage. However, the decrease in range causes orbiting tears to no longer complete a full 360° lap around Isaac, instead dropping off at about half that.

sections.Effects:

** {{dlc|r+}} The damage starts equal to Isaac's tear damage, dealt roughly 5 times per second. The damage will gradually decrease, while the cloud gradually increases in area size.
*** Each cloud lasts for 10 seconds; the damage decreases to around 43% for the duration of the cloud.
** The clouds can be moved by shooting them.
