sections.Effects:
* +0.16 [[shot speed]].
* Upon pickup, drops a random [[tarot card]] near Isaac.
* {{dlc+|r}} Adds an additional 15% chance for the first {{R|Planetarium}} to appear.
** This effect doesn't stack with additional copies of the item.{{dlc-}}

* Upon use, destroys all [[obstacle]]s in the current room and deals 200 damage to every enemy (including [[boss]]es). This effect also applies to every room for the remainder of the floor.
** {{dlc|r}} Also destroys all [[Machine]]s, {{e|Beggar}}s, {{E|Shopkeeper}}s, and {{E|Fire Place}}s.
** {{dlc|r}} Also destroys all obstacles in rooms that have already been cleared.
** {{dlc|r}} Will destroy {{e|Donation Machine}}s as well, reducing donated coin count and removing them for the rest of the run.
* Opens all {{r|Secret Room}} and {{r|Super Secret Room}} doors on the current floor.
* Mama Mega! opens the paths to {{r|Boss Rush}} and the {{s|???}} even after the time limits expire.
sections.Notes:
* While Mama Mega! opens the paths to {{r|Boss Rush}} and the {{s|???}} after the time limits expire, there are still some things to be aware of:
** The Boss does not need to be defeated before entering these doors.
** It will also open the Boss Rush / {{s|???}} entrance room door if it is activated after {{E|Mom}} or {{E|Mom's Heart}} / {{E|It Lives!}} has already been defeated.
** Leaving the {{r|Boss Room}} (via teleport or entering a {{r|Devil Room}}/{{r|Angel Room}}) will close the doors.
** Leaving the {{r|Boss Rush}} room or {{s|???}} entrance room will also close the doors.
** Does not open the Boss Rush door from the inside.
** {{Dlc+|r}} Does not open a path to {{s|???}} if used in the room on the other side of the flesh door in {{s|Mausoleum}} / {{s|Gehenna}} II.{{dlc-}}
* Entering a room with an angel statue while the effect is active automatically initiates a fight with an [[Angel]].
* Does not kill enemies that are immune to damage while entering the room, such as {{e|Lil' Haunt}}s.
* If used before the {{E|Ultra Greed}} fight begins, it will deal no damage to Ultra Greed, as he is invulnerable for the first few seconds upon first entering his room. However, it will still break obstacles as usual.
* When used in [[Greed mode]], it will only activate once for the main room (as opposed to once per wave, in a similar fashion to a standard run). Therefore, its damage potential is maximized if used after all the monster waves have spawned for the current floor.
* Does not open the door to {{E|Mega Satan}} in {{s|Dark Room}} or {{s|Chest}}, nor does it open {{dlc+|r}}the flesh door at the end of {{s|Mausoleum}} / {{s|Gehenna}} II{{dlc-}}.
* {{dlc+|r}} If used in {{s|Downpour}} / {{s|Dross}} II, the entrance to the [[Mirrored World]] will be destroyed, making it inaccessible.
** If used in the [[Mirrored World]], it will destroy the exit, which, on top of making it impossible to leave, will then cause Isaac to take damage and die.{{dlc-}}
* {{dlc+|r}} Only works on a single floor of the [[Ascent]].{{dlc-}}
* This item can be crafted from {{i|Bag of Crafting}} with eight {{e|Giga Bomb}}s, or six {{e|Bomb}}s and two {{e|Golden Bomb}}s.

It may be used again for free on another floor if yet another golden bomb is collected, and so on. {{dlc|r}} Using Mama Mega once will remove the golden bomb from Isaac's consumables. Mama Mega! also receives a unique golden sprite in the HUD.

sections.Effects: * Adds a chance to shoot tears in four cardinal directions, similar to {{E|Loki}}.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|r+}} This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|Loki}}.{{dlc-}}
* {{dlc|nr}} The chance to shoot extra tears depends on the [[luck]] stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: <math>\frac1 { 8 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck}   \right \rfloor}</math>
** At base luck (0), the chance is 12.5%, maxing out at 100% at 7 luck.
* {{dlc|r}} The chance to shoot extra tears depends on the [[luck]] stat and is based on this formula: <math>25\% + (5\% * \mathit{Luck})</math>
** This means that the chance starts at 25% at 0 luck, minimizes at 0% at -5 luck, and maximizes at 100% at 15 luck.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Mom's Eye}}: Each time Mom's Eye would activate, Loki's Horns activates instead. If Mom's Eye fails to activate, Loki's Horns' activation rate is still checked for afterwards.
* {{i|Eye of the Occult}}: Extra tears will fire in the same direction.
* {{i|Sprinkler}}: The sprinkler eye turns into four eyes and alternates shots between the cardinal and ordinal directions.
* {{i|Technology 2}}: All additional tears are affected by the item but are replaced with {{i|Technology}}'s lasers, effectively dealing 100% of Isaac's damage, and with 16 [[luck]] uses 100% of Technology 2's fire rate.
* {{i|Tiny Planet}}: Effectively grants a great tear multiplier, as on item activation the extra tears will follow the trajectory given by the Tiny Planet.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|20/20}}/{{i|The Inner Eye}}/{{i|Mutant Spider}}: No effect on the tears fired in the other 3 directions. The chance to activate is checked per shot, not for each tear fired.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}}: '''Not recommended without immunity.''' Adds a chance to fire four bombs in cardinal directions.
* {{I|Epic Fetus}}: Adds a chance to spawn four crosshairs in cardinal directions. Isaac controls one and the others will mirror the movement keeping their space.
* {{i|Incubus|anr}}: Not affected by Loki's Horns.
* {{i|Ipecac}}: Adds a chance to fire four explosive shots in cardinal directions. Caution is advised, though it is easier to avoid damage than Dr. Fetus.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique|a}}: Adds a chance for 4 [[piercing]] + [[spectral]] tears to be fired in cardinal directions from the main tear. This chance scales with [[luck]] and goes up to 100% at 20 Luck.
* {{i|Mom's Knife}}: Adds four knifes on the cardinal directions around Isaac that can be rotated but all of them will be thrown when four tears would shoot with only Loki's Horns.
* {{i|Monstro's Lung|nr}}: Only one red tear will be fired in the other directions.
** {{Dlc|r}} Fires 14 tears in each of the four directions.
* {{i|Tech X}}: Overridden by Tech X.
** {{dlc|r}} The laser rings will only fire forwards and backwards, with 2 stacked on top of each other in both directions, shooting at an angle will shoot the stacked rings at different angles.
* {{i|Tractor Beam}}: Extra tears are not affected by Tractor Beam.

sections.Effects:
* Gives Isaac's tears a shield surrounding them, allowing the player to block enemy shots.
** Isaac's shots are destroyed upon contact with an enemy's shot.
** {{dlc|ana+}} Affects familiar's tears.
* -0.15 [[shot speed]].
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Anti-Gravity}}: Placing many tears around Isaac creates a safe zone, especially with larger tears.
* {{i|Brimstone}}/{{i|Maw Of The Void}}/{{i|Technology}}/{{i|Technology 2}}: Beam/ring/laser destroys projectiles, although only during its damage tick interval. The projectiles are not instantly destroyed when they touch the beam/ring/laser.
* {{i|Compound Fracture}}/{{i|Cricket's Body}}/{{i|The Parasite}}: Split tears will be shielded. The Parasite's split tears will not appear to have shields.
* {{i|Eye of Belial}}: Piercing through a projectile will trigger Eye of Belial's double damage and homing effect. Belial tears will still block shots.
* {{C|The Forgotten|r}}: Enemy shots may be reflected with melee attacks. The damage of the reflected shots depends on their size and properties, with standard enemy shots dealing 6 damage, champion and homing shots dealing 7 and explosive ones dealing 50.
* {{I|Jacob's Ladder|r}}: Destroyed tears via shot-blocking will trigger the electric arc effect.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: Can block an infinite amount of enemy shots if the tear is placed on top of a monster. The projectiles that they attempt to shoot will be immediately destroyed.
* {{i|Mom's Knife|nr}}: The knife will destroy projectiles in its path without being affected.
** {{Dlc|r}}The knife does not destroy projectiles.
* [[Piercing tears]]: The tears can pass through multiple enemy projectiles. This means that one tear can hurt the enemy and block its projectiles.
* {{i|Polyphemus}}: Enemy shots are treated like enemies with 10 health, which are deducted from the Polyphemus tear. If it has strength remaining afterward, it will continue.
* {{i|Sinus Infection}}/{{I|Mucormycosis}}: Tears that stick to enemies will block shots, and will not be destroyed in the process.
* {{i|Soy Milk}}: The constant stream of tears will cut through any complex attack patterns with ease.
* {{i|Spirit Sword}}: Sword swings reflect projectiles.
* {{i|Almond Milk}}: The random tear effects can allow more shots to be blocked, as effects such as {{t|Ouroboros Worm}}, {{i|My Reflection}}, and {{i|Tiny Planet}} can cause tears to wander outside of the main stream of tears. However, this, in combination with the lower fire rate of Almond Milk compared to Soy Milk, makes Almond Milk slightly less effective than Soy Milk at blocking shots in the direction Isaac is shooting.
* {{i|Tech X|anr}}: The rings block enemy shots.
** {{dlc|r}} The rings sometimes block enemy shots. <sup>[more testing/debugging required]</sup>
* {{i|Trisagion}}: Beams will block shots and continue on.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}}: Bombs will not destroy or block shots. Stat effects apply.
* {{i|Epic Fetus}}: Missiles will not destroy or block shots. Stat effects apply.
* {{dlc|na+}} {{i|Fire Mind}}: Lost Contact will remove the chance to explode on impact effect.
* {{i|God's Flesh}}: Tears with the shrink effect do not appear to be shielded, but will still block enemy shots.
* {{i|Godhead}}: Auras will not block shots but tears will.
* {{i|Haemolacria}}: Main tears will block shots but burst tears cannot.
* {{i|Ipecac}}: Ipecac shot will explode upon contact with an enemy's shot.
* {{i|Lachryphagy}}: Tears often block shots before they can burst; however, burst tears can also block shots.
* {{i|Kidney Stone}}: The stone will not block shots.
* {{dlc|na+}} {{i|Mysterious Liquid}}: Overridden by Lost Contact.
* {{i|Rubber Cement}}: Tears will bounce off of enemy tears and destroy them.
* {{i|Tough Love}}: Teeth will not appear to be shielded but will still block enemy shots.

sections.Effects:

* Increases the chance of a reward from a {{e|Beggar}}s or {{e|Devil Beggar}} after each of their first payouts.

sections.Notes:
* {{C|Cain}} starts with this item by default.
* For [[Room Clear Awards]], the Lucky Foot works by first applying a decimal multiplier to the room-clearing drop RNG, and then by raising its ''minimum'' value. All of this happens before the luck stat modifies the RNG's ''maximum'' value by adding another random number.
** With zero luck, your chance to get '''nothing''' from a room clear is 22%; with Lucky Foot's modifiers (other than luck), it's reduced to around 13.33%. The effect on its own is similar to having 6.5 extra points of luck, though with a much lower likelihood of getting [[Chests]].
** Lucky Foot also slightly increases the likelihood of running into Chests, though this effect is most noticeable if your luck isn't very high.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|False PHD}}: Pills can both be good or bad again. Taking a bad pill still applies the benefits from False PHD.
* {{t|Lucky Toe}}: The extra luck-independent chance of room clearing drops from Lucky Toe applies only in a diminished form, unless at zero or negative luck. This bonus from Lucky Foot is still retained.

* {{dlc+|r}} {{C|Tainted Lilith}} : When the baby is launched, it permanently fires at the crosshair. Pressing the "drop" key or button (Keyboard default: left Control key; Controller default: right trigger) will make the crosshair disappear and cause the baby to return to Tainted Lilith.{{dlc-}}
* {{C|The Forgotten}} / {{C|Tainted Forgotten}} : Gives stats up without any drawbacks, and allows the bone to be angled in any direction, similar to {{i|Analog Stick}}.
* {{i|Anti-Gravity}}: The tear hover effect is nullified, though the tear delay down is applied.
* {{dlc|nr}} {{i|Brimstone}}/{{i|Mom's Knife}}/{{i|Monstro's Lung}}/{{i|Technology}}/{{i|Tech X}}: Overrides Marked, stat bonuses still apply.
* {{I|Chocolate Milk}} + {{I|Neptunus}}: '''Not recommended.''' Isaac will not be able to fire any tears, effectively becoming softlocked and forcing the player to restart the game.
* {{i|Dead Tooth}}: The green aura only activates when pressing the buttons to fire Isaac's tears.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus|r}}: Continuously fires bombs towards the marked spot.
* {{i|Epic Fetus}}: Continuously fires missiles at the marked spot.
** {{dlc|r}}If the crosshair is dismissed before the next missile is dropped, it still drops in the crosshair’s last position.
* {{i|Epiphora}}: Both items work as normal, with tear rate gradually increasing until Isaac turns his head, which can happen via him or the crosshair moving too out of parallel.
* {{I|Eye of the Occult}}: Tears will always attempt to land on the crosshair, changing direction mid-air to do so.
* {{I|GB Bug|r}}: Unaffected by Marked.
* {{dlc|nr}} {{i|Gnawed Leaf}}: Tears will stop auto-firing once Isaac is invulnerable.
** {{dlc|r}} Gnawed Leaf cannot activate while Isaac is auto-firing.
* {{dlc|nr}} {{i|Lil Brimstone}}: Lil Brimstone only charges while moving the mark.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: Overrides Marked, but stat bonuses still apply.
* {{I|Mr. ME!}}: The Mr. ME! crosshair will move constantly in the direction of the Marked crosshair relative to Isaac. It will not attempt to match with where Marked is aiming, making it difficult to control. Pressing the drop button will stop the Mr. ME! crosshair.
* {{i|My Little Unicorn}}/{{i|Unicorn Stump}}/{{i|Taurus}}: Isaac's tears will still fire, but he will be unable to move the crosshair while invincible.
** {{dlc|r}} The crosshair can still be spawned while invincible.
* {{dlc+|r}} {{I|Spirit Sword}}: Overrides Marked, but stat bonuses still apply, and allows the sword to be angled in any direction, similar to {{i|Analog Stick}}.{{dlc-}}
* {{i|Sprinkler}}: No effect on the sprinkler.
* {{dlc|nr}} {{i|Technology 2}}: Laser only fires while the crosshair is moving, and only in cardinal directions.
* {{dlc|nr}} {{i|Tractor Beam}}: Tears are fired automatically but only in cardinal directions.
* {{I|Tiny Planet}}: The tears' center of orbit can be slightly modified using the crosshair.

sections.Effects:
* Adds an extra {{r|Secret Room}} and {{r|Super Secret Room}} to each floor.
* Reveals one random Secret Room on the map on pickup and at the start of each floor.
* Each newly discovered Secret Room has a shining beam of light that will raise [[tears]] for the current floor and gives Isaac a {{e|Half Soul Heart}} when walked under.
** The first light gives Isaac +1 tears fired per second, and all subsequent ones give +0.5 tears fired per second.
** This gives a potential +2.5 tears per second for a given floor, on top of 2 soul hearts.
** The tears up breaks the default 5 tears per second cap.
* Once the effect is triggered for the floor, a silver-bluish shine will appear around Isaac. This light will be strengthened for every beam of light "gathered".
** While this effect is mostly cosmetic, it also partially counteracts both the {{Curse|Darkness}} and the "dark rooms" in the {{s|Mines}}/{{s|Ashpit}}.
sections.Notes:
* The beams of light appear in both Secret Room types but not in {{r|Ultra Secret Room}}s.
** The beams of light also appear in Secret Rooms and Super Secret Rooms that appear as a result of {{I|Red Key}}.
* The beams of light appear even in unopened Secret Rooms on the same floor the item was acquired on.
* The effect can also be obtained in the [[Mirrored World]].
* The tears up bonuses still apply while in the special area of {{S|Mines}}/{{s|Ashpit}} II.
* No new Secret Rooms are added in [[Greed Mode]] or [[Chapters#Chapter 1|Chapter 1]] (if it's a starting item for {{C|Eden}}), but the beam of light is still added to current Secret Rooms.
* No new Secret Rooms are added in {{s|???}}, The [[Ascent]], or {{s|Home}}.
* If kept after using {{I|Birthright}} with {{C|Tainted Eden}}, upon taking damage, the additional tear rate is lost. More beams of light will have to be found or used for the tears to be regained (assuming not all of them were used).
* If playing [[Co-op]] or as {{C|Jacob and Esau}}, characters that did not pick up Luna will still gain full benefit from stepping within the beam of light. However, this will only benefit one character.
* {{C|Tainted Lazarus}}: The opposite form of Tainted Lazarus can stand in the beam of light and receive its benefits but the fire rate bonuses are independent of each other and does not carry over between forms. 
* Multiple copies of Luna will not cause additional Secret Rooms or Super Secret Rooms to be generated.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|X-Ray Vision}}: Opens every Secret Room generated for free, allowing for the maximum tear bonus every floor.
* {{T|Fragmented Card}}: The effects stack, spawning three Secret Rooms on the floor. All three Secret Rooms will contain beams of light.
* {{I|Glowing Hourglass}}: If Glowing Hourglass is used while Isaac touches the beam of light but before the animation where he raises Luna above his head is complete, the bonuses will be granted after time is rewound, allowing the same beam of light to be used multiple times.
* {{p|XVIII - The Moon}}: The Moon will always teleport to an unexplored secret room. If one has already been explored, it will teleport to the other one. If both have been explored, it will teleport randomly in one of the two.

sections.Effects:
* Each time an enemy is killed, Isaac gains a [[damage]] boost for the current room.
** Each kill increases damage by 0.5, up to a maximum of 5 damage after 10 kills.
sections.Notes:
* Some summoned enemies like {{E|Rag Man's Ragling}}s do not trigger the effect when killed.
* {{E|Mr. Maw}} does not trigger the effects of Lusty Blood, even after splitting.
* Blowing up a {{e|Shopkeeper}} will grant Isaac a damage bonus as well.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Meat Cleaver}}: Both of the smaller enemies produced by Meat Cleaver add to the damage bonus, allowing rooms with few enemies to grant much more damage.
* {{T|Samson's Lock}}: Both the item and the trinket stack, granting 1 damage per kill. With 100% proc rate on the Lock, Isaac may gain up to 10 damage after 10 kills.
sections.Interactions:
* {{dlc|r}}[[Cards and Runes|Ace Cards]]: Enemies that are turned into [[pickup]]s don’t count towards the Lusty Blood counter.
* {{i|E. Coli}}/{{i|Flush!}}: Enemies that are turned into poop don't count towards the Lusty Blood counter.
* {{dlc|r}}[[Freeze|Freeze Effects]]: Enemies that are frozen don't count towards the Lusty Blood counter.
** Because of this interaction, when Isaac has {{i|Uranus}}, only enemies killed by icicles from statues, bombs, familiars and other sources will increment Lusty Blood's counter, thus rendering Lusty Blood quite difficult to use.
** {{dlc|r+}} Frozen enemies do increase damage.

sections.Effect:
* Grants Isaac one Red [[Heart Container]].
* +0.3 [[Damage]].
* x1.5 damage multiplier.
* {{dlc|nr}} +5.25 [[Range]].
* {{dlc|r}} +2.5 [[Range]].
* +0.3 [[Speed]].
* {{dlc|nr}} +0.5 [[Tear Falling Speed]].
* Restores all [[Health]].
* Isaac grows in size.
* {{transformation contribution|Fun Guy}}
* {{transformation contribution|Stompy}}
sections.Notes:
* This item can rarely drop from destroying [[Rocks#Mushrooms|mushrooms]].
* The x1.5 damage multiplier does not stack with the x1.5 damage multiplier from {{i|Cricket's Head}}, from the combination of {{i|The Book of Belial}} and {{i|Blood of the Martyr}}, or itself (by using an item such as {{i|Diplopia}}, for example). However, it will stack with any other multipliers, such as {{i|Sacred Heart}}.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Haemolacria|dlc=r}}: Both 1.5x damage multipliers stack as expected.
* {{C|Tainted Bethany}}: On pickup, grants 12 blood charges.

sections.Effects: * Summons a portal familiar that launches itself in the direction Isaac shoots to deal contact damage to enemies. ** {{dlc|r+}} The portal will launch itself forward after double-tapping. * The portal will consume all pickups and trinkets in its path, converting them into [[blue fly|blue flies]] and causing the familiar to become larger and deal more contact damage. * {{dlc|nr+}} When the familiar consumes 4 pickups, it will summon a portal that leads to an unexplored room on the current floor and its damage bonus is reset. * {{dlc|r+}} When the familiar consumes 1 + (stage number) pickups, it will summon a portal that leads to a unique purple {{r|Clean Bedroom}} and will disappear for the rest of the floor, respawning upon entering a new floor. ** The room contains a random {{e|Chest}} in the top left corner, a chance for a random [[Batteries|battery]] in the bottom left corner, and a chance of {{p|Dice Shard}}, {{p|Soul of Eden}}, {{t|Butter!}}, or {{i|Moving Box}}, in the bottom right corner. In the center of the room is the portal exit, which will bring Isaac back out through the portal he entered. ** This room, and any contents within, will remain constant for the rest of the player's run, accessible by any portal. * {{dlc|nr+}} Lil Portal deals damage equal to 2 + 2 * (consumables destroyed) and ticks up to 10 times per second. * {{dlc|r+}} Lil Portal deals damage equal to 2 * (familiar size) and ticks up to 10 times per second. ** There are 4 distinct sizes, the amount of consumables required to increase size depending on the stage Isaac is in. It is not possible to reach the maximum size in earlier stages before the familiar summons a portal.
sections.Notes:
* Lil Portal doesn't consume pickups or damage enemies it passes over while trailing behind Isaac; it only does so while being launched.
* Lil Portal doesn't consume poop pickups when playing as {{c|Tainted ???}}.
* {{dlc|nr+}} The portal cannot lead to the {{r|Devil Room}}, {{r|Angel Room}}, {{R|Ultra Secret Room}}, entrance to the alt-path, {{r|Black Market}}, {{r|I AM ERROR}} Room, or {{E|Mega Satan}} fight.
** In the [[Mirrored World]], the {{R|Ultra Secret Room}} is accessible via the portal.
* {{dlc|nr+}} The room portals take Isaac to is determined at the time they're created; if Isaac clears the room the portal would take him to, he will still be taken to that room if he uses it.
* {{dlc|nr+}} If every room has been explored, portals summoned by the familiar will do nothing and Isaac will jump up and down in them. This effect appears to be cosmetic only, but it will provide brief invincibility frames equivalent to two {{i|Ventricle Razor}} portals stacked on top of one another.<ref>https://youtu.be/An0IFYflYDc</ref> Same effect occurs if a portal is summoned in rooms that don't appear on map, as Mom's Heart room in {{s|Mausoleum}}/{{s|Gehenna}} II.
* {{dlc|nr+}} Portals can lead to {{r|Curse Room}}s, forcing Isaac to take damage in order to leave.
* {{dlc|nr+}} {{r|Secret Room}}s and {{r|Boss Challenge Room}}s can be entered for free by making a portal after all other rooms on the floor are cleared.
* {{dlc|r+}} A trapdoor created in the Lil Portal bedroom with {{i|We Need To Go Deeper!}} or {{p|Ehwaz}} will always lead to the {{r|I AM ERROR}} room.
** A {{r|Crawl Space}} can be made as normal, but leaving the Crawl Space takes Isaac to the room the portal was created in, rather than the Lil Portal bedroom.
** Unlike other changes to the room, all trapdoors will disappear on the next floor.
* If Lil Portal consumes enough pickups to create a portal, but Isaac enters a trapdoor which leads to the next floor before the portal spawns, then Lil portal will instead spawn a portal on the next floor.
* Portals will persist after Isaac uses them or leaves the room, and will always lead to the same room.
** Portals do not respect pathing rules, and can spawn on single-tile walkways and in front of doors, forcing Isaac to use them and preventing him from leaving the room through that door. This can cause a softlock depending on what door it blocks and where the portal leads.
*** As Isaac cannot enter a portal while in another animation, picking up a trinket/consumable, or taking damage will allow him to pass over the portal.
*** Alternatively if the player has items like {{I|Pluto}} or has consumed enough "One Makes You Small" [[Pills]] then it is possible to avoid being softlocked as pushing up against walls of any kind will still allow passage through doors and with enough speed, pitfalls and obstacles as well.
* {{dlc|rnr+}} [[Familiar]]s that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Lil Portal having the lowest priority at 6th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.
** {{dlc|r+}} Lil Portal has the fourth-highest priority.
* If Lil Portal consumes a {{e|Golden Penny}}, the penny will still reappear.
sections.Interactions: * {{dlc|r+}} {{I|R Key}}: The special room's contents will be reset after using R Key.

sections.Effects:
* Isaac shouts, damaging and pushing away nearby enemies. The item can be used when not fully charged, and deals more damage and has increased range the more charges it has when used.
** The initial shout deals 20 damage + 28 per charge and destroys enemy shots, [[obstacles]], {{e|Shopkeeper}}s, {{e|Beggar}}s, and [[machines]], and opens bombable doors in range.
** A number of extra pulses are released equal to half the charges used (rounded up) that deal 2.5 damage + 3.5 per charge.
* Larynx gains 1 charge whenever Isaac takes damage, as well as through normal means.
sections.Notes:
* Larynx only has 1 charge when initially picked up.
* Larynx will gain charges if Isaac is hit during the {{e|Mother's Shadow}} escape sequence.
* Obstacles destroyed by the shout don't bridge gaps.
sections.Synergies: * {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns red wisps on the middle ring. The wisps deals contact damage equal to 30% of Isaac's damage * Charges Used. Charges Used equals the number of charges Larynx had at the time it was used. Health {{=}} 1 * Charges Used. Tear Damage {{=}} 1.5 * Charges Used.}} * {{i|Habit}}: Both on-hit charge effects stack, charging 2 points per hit.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|9 Volt}}: The first bar gains an automatic timed recharge, but the further bars will not be affected.
* {{i|The Battery}}: Larynx can hold up to two full charges. Only up to 12 charges will be used at a time.
* {{i|Void}}: If Larynx is absorbed, its effect is only replicated at 1 charge.

sections.Effects:
* Upon use, spawns an [[item]] pedestal from the current room's [[item pool]].
* Consumes one of Isaac's [[Health#Red Heart Containers|heart containers]], one {{e|Bone Heart}}, or two {{e|Soul Heart}}s, replaced by a [[Health#Broken Hearts|broken heart container]].
** The priority order of hearts that will be consumed is: one heart container, one bone heart, and two soul hearts.
* After using Magic Skin, if Isaac is not currently holding it, Magic Skin has a chance to replace any item that spawns in the future.
** The original item that was replaced is considered seen and, depending on the pool, possibly can't be found again.
** The chance is 33% after one use, 50% after two uses, and 100% after three uses.
** If Magic Skin is on a pedestal somewhere on the current floor, the replacement chance is reduced to 1% per use. Unpurchased Shop and Devil Deal items do not count.
** Each new Magic Skin is fully recharged.
* If Isaac's entire health bar is filled with broken heart containers by using Magic Skin (which kills him, but an extra life will remove one broken heart container), this item will disappear and future items won't be replaced.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|r+}} This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|The Scourge}}.{{dlc-}}
* For most characters, the limit of broken hearts before Magic Skin disappears is 12.
** If using {{c|Magdalene}} with {{I|Birthright}}, Magic Skin will not disappear until you have 18 or more broken heart containers.
** {{c|The Lost}} and {{c|Tainted Lost}} will be able to use the item once, after which it disappears. The item's chance of replacing later items does not trigger, making it similar to {{I|Mystery Gift}}.
*** An extra item cannot be spawned when used with {{I|Car Battery}}.
*** Temporary The Lost forms from the {{E|White Fire Place}} in {{S|Downpour}} II/{{S|Dross}} II, or by using the {{p|Soul of the Lost}}, have no effect. A heart container is still replaced by a broken heart container, and Magic Skin does not disappear and will still replace future pedestal items if dropped. If Isaac runs out of health in this way as The Lost, he dies immediately.
** {{c|Keeper}} and {{c|Tainted Keeper}} gain a [[Health#Coin Hearts|broken coin container]] which are functionally identical to broken hearts. {{c|Keeper}} can use it up to 3 times, and {{c|Tainted Keeper}} can use it up to 2 times before Magic Skin disappears.
*** If they have {{I|Deep Pockets}} and {{I|Greed's Gullet}}, or {{T|Mother's Kiss}}, they can use it more than 2~3 times.
*** Although they can have 13 or more coin hearts under some conditions, they can only have a maximum of 12 broken coin heart containers. They will die only once all coin hearts are gone, causing Magic Skin to disappear.
** If either {{c|The Forgotten}} or {{c|The Soul}} has 6 broken hearts by using Magic Skin, this item will disappear and they will instantly die. However, swapping characters right after one of them reaches 6 broken hearts can prevent them from dying, but permanently disable the one using it.
* Reaching the broken heart limit by using {{P|? Card}} or {{p|Wild Card}} won't cause Magic Skin to disappear.
* {{c|Tainted Lazarus}} is able to find Magic Skin while {{c|Dead Tainted Lazarus}} is carrying it, and vice versa.
* {{I|Heartbreak}} or {{P|VI - The Lovers?}} will add broken hearts, lessening maximum use of Magic Skin.
* Broken heart containers can be removed by donating to a {{e|Confessional}}.
* In Treasure Rooms with a blind item, if the known item is Magic Skin, it is almost guaranteed the blind item is not.
sections.Synergies:
* {{Book of Belial synergy|description=Grants a permanent +0.5 damage up on use in addition to the temporary +4 damage up given to it by Birthright. This bonus is not lost if the broken hearts are removed.}}
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns pink wisps in the inner ring, looking like skin. Wisps have a large amount of health and fire [[piercing]] tears.}}
* {{I|Car Battery}}: Spawns 2 items and adds 2 broken hearts (removing 2 heart containers or 4 soul hearts) with each use. Two broken hearts are added regardless of Isaac's remaining health. If Isaac already has 11 broken hearts and uses Magic Skin, it will only be used once.
* {{I|Damocles}}: Spawns 2 items on every use instead of 1.
* {{I|Esau Jr.}}: Since Esau Jr.'s health is separate from Isaac's, one character can use Magic Skin at no cost to the other. Future items will still be replaced when playing as the character that hasn't used Magic Skin.
* {{i|Schoolbag}}: Isaac can keep Magic Skin in the inactive slot to prevent its respawning while still being able to use another active item.
* {{I|Spindown Dice}}: Using Spindown Dice on Magic Skin 6 times turns it into {{I|R Key}}.
** '''Spindown Dice''' + '''Schoolbag''': Allows Isaac to keep Spindown Dice between runs, allowing a theoretically infinite run with enough luck.
*** '''Restock:''' If Isaac can find a Battery in the shop, as long as one has enough coins, runs can actually be infinite.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Alabaster Box}}: Magic Skin can use Soul hearts from the box, and will prioritize them over those in health.
* {{I|Binge Eater}}: Will still offer a food item even if Magic Skin replaced an item.
* {{I|Dream Catcher}}: If Magic Skin has replaced the item in the {{R|Treasure Room}}, it will be shown in the dream sequence.
** Holding Magic Skin or having a pedestal with it on the same floor can cause the item in the Treasure Room to not be replaced by Magic Skin.
* {{I|Genesis}}: Removes all broken hearts as well as items. Magic Skin can still replace items in the Genesis room.
* {{I|Glowing Hourglass}}: Recovers a broken heart when used after using Magic Skin. Using Magic Skin in the same type of room will spawn the same item, it must be used in a different room type first to spawn a different item in the previous room type.
* {{I|Lemegeton}}: Magic Skin can be spawned by Lemegeton if it has been used in the current run. As long as Isaac has this flame, Magic Skin will not respawn/replace items.
* {{I|Metronome}}: Getting Magic Skin from Metronome has a chance to instantly apply the item replacement and spawn Magic Skin as an item pedestal.
* {{I|Mystery Gift}}: Does not replace {{I|A Lump of Coal}} or {{I|The Poop}}.
* {{T|NO!}}: Does not prevent Magic Skin from replacing items, despite it being an active item.
* {{c|Tainted Eden}}: Broken hearts persist even after Magic Skin is rerolled.
* {{I|TMTRAINER}}: Prevents Magic Skin from replacing items, since future Magic Skins will be glitched.
* {{I|R Key}}: Magic Skin still replaces items after using R Key.
* {{I|Void}}: Absorbing Magic Skin does not prevent future items from being replaced, including items spawned by the absorbed Magic Skin. Additional Magic Skins can be absorbed, allowing multiple items to be spawned per use at the cost of adding more broken hearts.

sections.Effect:

* {{Dlc|r}} Heals 1 additional {{e|Red Heart}}.
sections.Notes:
* This item has a 12.6% chance to spawn from paying out a {{e|Beggar}} in addition to being in the [[Beggar (Item Pool)|Beggar item pool]]. Multiple copies can be obtained through this method.

* {{dlc|r}} The familiar has an exceptionally higher detection range than most other familiars that chase down enemies.
sections.Notes: * {{dlc+|r+}} This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|The Haunt}}.{{dlc-}}

sections.Effects:
* Gives Isaac the chance to fire tears that [[Status Effects#Magnetized|magnetize]] enemies they hit, giving them properties similar to tears fired by Isaac when he has {{i|Strange Attractor}}:
** Enemies and [[pickup]]s that are near magnetized enemies are pulled towards them. This includes live {{e|Bomb}}s.
** All tears/enemy shots (from Isaac, his familiars, and all enemies, including the magnetized one) will be strongly pulled towards magnetized enemies.
*** Enemy shots that get pulled in will now also damage enemies other than the ones that fired them.
sections.Notes: * The chance to fire magnetizing tears depends on the [[luck]] stat. The activation rate is equal to 1/(6 - Luck). At 0 luck, the chance is 16.67%, maxing out at 100% at 5 luck.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Book of Virtues}}: The wisps' tears are attracted to the magnetic enemy, making it much easier to connect all of the wisps' tears on an enemy.
* {{I|E. Coli}}: If an enemy is hit by a lodestone tear perfectly simultaneously with it being turned into poop, the resulting poop will be tinted black and have a lodestone aura that sucks in enemies. This poop will return to normal after a few seconds.
* {{I|Pop!}}: Magnetizing an enemy causes all active eyeball tears to rush to the enemy.
* {{I|Rotten Tomato}}: Enemies affected by Lodestone and Rotten Tomato will be quickly swarmed and killed by other enemies.
* {{i|Tech X}}: Changes the color of rings to gray. They still apply the magnetized effect, but the effect being applied is random for each enemy damaged with the same ring. Has increased chance of magnetizing enemy.
** {{i|Tech X}} + {{i|Dr. Fetus}}: Only the explosions from Dr. Fetus' bombs can magnetize enemies.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: Isaac's tear has a chance to magnetize and stick to enemies or bosses, making it impossible to move the tear until the enemy dies or until the magnetization effect somehow doesn't get reapplied long enough for the effect to end.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Brimstone}}: Changes the beam to gray, can still apply the magnetized effect. The beams are not attracted to enemies with the magnetized effect.
* {{I|Technology}}: Changes the laser to gray, can still apply the magnetized effect. The lasers are not attracted to enemies with the magnetized effect.

sections.Effects:
* {{dlc|nr}} Adds a chance to fire [[Tear Effects#Piercing|piercing tears]] which will instantly kill any non-boss enemy.
* {{dlc|r}} Adds a chance to fire a tear that summons {{E|Big Horn}}'s hand. It will grab and crush any non-boss enemy, killing them instantly, and attacks bosses 3 times for 12 damage each hit (even {{E|Big Horn}} himself).
** If the tear kills an enemy, it will be [[fear]]ed for a moment before being crushed.
* Running into enemies deals 3.5 damage to them.
** Damage is dealt up to twice per second per enemy.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|r+}} This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|Little Horn}} or {{e|Big Horn}}.{{dlc-}}
* The chance to fire special tears depends on the [[luck]] stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: <math>min(\frac1 { 20 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck}  \right \rfloor}, 20\%)</math>
** At base luck (0), the chance is 5%, maxing out at 20% at 15 luck.
* The special tears will kill some normally invulnerable monsters, such as {{E|Death's Head}}s, {{E|Stoney|text=Stonies}}, and {{E|Peep}}'s floating eyeballs.
* {{dlc|nr}}The special tears can also destroy {{E|Blue Fire Place}}s and {{E|Purple Fire Place}}s.
* The special tears can destroy the various spiked blocks ({{E|Wall Hugger}}, {{E|Slide}}, and {{E|Poky}}) as well as the variants of {{E|Stone Grimace}}. All of these won't respawn if Isaac leaves and re-enters the room.
* {{dlc|nr}}The contact damage effect overrides the superior contact damage from {{i|Aries}}, {{i|The Gamekid}}, {{i|My Little Unicorn}} / {{p|VII - The Chariot}}, and {{i|The Nail}}. Only {{i|Midas' Touch}} still works and deals an additional 3.5 damage.
** {{dlc|r}} The contact damage adds to other contact damage sources.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Angelic Prism}}: Little Horn tears can be split by the prism and will be quadrupled when they pass through it.
* {{dlc|r}} {{i|Brimstone}}/{{i|Mom's Knife}}: Each damage tick may trigger Little Horn's effect.
* {{i|Evil Eye}}: Eyes can fire Little Horn tears. Little Horn tears won't destroy other eyes.
* {{i|Jacob's Ladder|dlc=r}}: Enemies hit by Jacob's Ladder's arcs produced by a Little Horn tear will be hit by Big Horn's hand.
* {{i|Kidney Stone}}: The stone can have the Little Horn effect.
* {{i|Soy Milk}}: Due to its high tear rate, the effect will trigger very often, even with average luck stats.
* {{i|Saturnus}}: Little Horn tears can orbit around Isaac upon entering a room.
* {{dlc|r}}{{i|Tech.5}}/{{i|Technology}}/{{i|Tech X}}: Occasionally fires a Little Horn laser beam.
* {{dlc|r}}{{i|Technology 2}}: The laser can also trigger Little Horn’s effect with the laser’s chance to apply the effect being determined rapidly every tick.
sections.Interactions:
* {{dlc|nr}}{{i|Brimstone}}/{{i|Mom's Knife}}/{{i|Technology}}/{{i|Tech X}}: Overrides Little Horn’s tear effects.
* {{dlc|nr}}{{i|Dr. Fetus}} / {{i|Epic Fetus}}: Overrides Little Horn’s tear effects.
** {{dlc|r}} Black-tinted bombs can summon Big Horn's hand to instantly kill non-boss enemies or to deal damage against bosses.
* {{i|Lachryphagy}}: If Little Horn tears are fed, they will burst into split tears with the same effect. If Little Horn tears feed normal tears, however, the effect is lost.
* {{dlc|nr}}{{i|Tech.5}}/{{i|Technology 2}}: The laser is unaffected by Little Horn.
* {{i|Technology Zero}}: Electricity connected to Little Horn tears will not instantly kill enemies.

sections.Synergies:
* {{t|Tick}}: Lets you gain the benefits of the item without losing your only trinket slot.
** {{dlc|a}} You cannot replace the {{t|Tick}} with The {{t|Match Stick}} once it is picked up, as it will only occupy the second trinket slot.
sections.Interactions: * {{i|Belly Button}}: No effect; Isaac can still only hold two trinkets.

sections.Effects:
* Upon use, splits enemies in the current room into two smaller versions with ~40% health each.
** Normal enemies can be split twice, while [[champion]]s and bosses can be split three times. If an enemy cannot be split, they instead take 25 damage.
** If the enemy splits as part of their mechanic, such as {{E|Squirt}}, {{E|Teratoma}}, or {{E|The Fallen}}, they will instead take the damage required to split them.
** If the enemy has segments, such as {{E|Larry Jr.}} or {{E|Buttlicker}}s, they will have their segments cut down to half, rounding down. There are several exceptions listed in the notes section.
** If the enemy has a cable between them, such as {{E|Mr. Maw}}, it will immediately be cut. Mr. Maws specifically will be left with just their head.
sections.Notes:
* Invincible enemies, such as {{E|Stone Grimace}}s and lowered {{E|Host}}s, will not be split.
* Multi-segmented enemies will only take damage on one segment.
* {{e|Pin}}, {{e|Mom's Heart}}, {{e|It Lives!}}, {{e|Isaac}}, {{e|Satan}}, {{e|???}}, {{e|The Lamb}}, {{e|Mega Satan}}, {{e|Hush}}, {{e|Ultra Greed}}, {{e|Mother}}, {{e|Dogma}}, {{e|Ultra Famine}}, {{e|Ultra Pestilence}}, {{e|Ultra War}}, {{e|Ultra Death}}, and {{e|The Beast}} cannot be split.
* Unlike other enemies, {{e|Delirium}} has no limit on how many times it can be split with Meat Cleaver.
** If used enough times, Delirium will die.
* {{E|Gemini}} will immediately separate in two, resulting in Suture being enraged even if no damage has been dealt otherwise.
* Using it on {{E|Loki}} will turn him into {{E|Lokii}}.
* Using it on {{E|Grub}}s will instantly kill them.
* Using it on {{E|Carrion Queen}}, {{E|Chub}}, or {{E|C.H.A.D.}} will split them into two one-segmented pieces, instantly killing both halves.
* {{dlc|nr+}} Using it on {{E|Gabriel}} or {{E|Uriel}} will cause them to drop {{i|Key Piece 1}} and {{i|Key Piece 2}} (killing them both without picking up a key piece can result in getting the same key piece twice).
** {{dlc|r+}} Only one key piece will drop.
* Using it on {{E|The Horny Boys}} will turn them into {{E|Loki}} and {{E|Hornfel}}. Hornfel will be in his "fleeing" state, but will never exit the room and will only drop extra rewards if Loki is killed first.
* Using it on {{E|The Scourge}} will instantly kill it instead of splitting.
* {{dlc|nr+}} In daily runs, using this item on enemies, especially angel statues increases a part of exploration bonus by quite a bit.
** {{dlc|r+}} Each half enemy give half the points the normal enemy gives.
sections.Synergies:
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns one red wisp on the middle ring on use. Before spawning wisps, Meat Cleaver divides all of Isaac's wisps into two wisps that deal half tear damage. Wisps will be destroyed if they try to divide a third time.}}
* {{T|Filigree Feather|nr+}}: Each split angel will drop an item.
* {{I|Lusty Blood}}: Each split enemy killed grants a damage boost.
* {{T|Sigil of Baphomet}}: Split enemies will allow the shield to activate and stack up more easily.
sections.Interactions: * {{i|Blood Puppy}}: If Blood Puppy is angry, splits it into two copies. One copy can level up and be tamed like normal, but the other cannot level up and dies instead of being tamed.

sections.Effects:

** Though Isaac can still collect coins if he already has 99, he will not gain any damage bonus from them.
sections.Synergies:

* {{i|A Dollar}}: Immediately maxes out damage bonus.

sections.Interactions:

sections.Notes: * If no Runes or Soul Stones have been unlocked, it does not drop anything.

sections.Effects: * Gives Isaac a large pulsing aura around him that deals damage to enemies inside of it. ** The aura deals more damage the closer enemies are to Isaac, ranging from 0.4 on the edge up to 3.9 + 0.3 * floor damage. ** The aura deals damage up to 7.5 times per second.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Camo Undies}}: Enemies won't target Isaac, thus he can safely damage enemies while standing near them. However, this won't work with bosses.
* {{i|Isaac's Heart}}: Monstrance becomes much safer to use offensively as Isaac's body no longer takes damage.
* Items granting [[invulnerability]] or a [[shield]]: Monstrance damages enemies while Isaac is invincible.
** This includes {{i|Gnawed Leaf}} / {{p|VII - The Chariot?}} allowing Isaac to clear most rooms without moving.
** {{i|Dark Arts}}: Enemies will still be damaged while Dark Arts' effect is active, allowing Isaac to safely deal damage while invulnerable in this way.
* {{i|Pause}}: Monstrance will not stop the pause effect allowing Isaac to kill or chip bosses easily by standing near them for the duration of the pause effect.
* {{c|Tainted Forgotten}}: The aura surrounds Tainted Forgotten allowing {{c|Tainted Soul}} to damage enemies from a safe distance.

sections.Notes:
* Mom's Key cannot change the contents of a chest; it will only cause it to spawn extra pickups.
* All other chest rewards (such as [[pill]]s, [[card]]s, [[item]]s, etc.) will not cause the chest to spawn additional pickups.
* {{dlc|r}} Does not affect {{e|Old Chest|n}}s.
sections.Synergies: * {{i|Sharp Key}}: Doubles the amount of pickups dropped by enemies.
sections.Interactions: * {{i|Mom's Key}}: Does not further increase the amount of pickups spawned when multiple copies of the item are acquired.

sections.Effects:
* Increases [[luck]] by 1 and doubles the effects of certain [[trinket]]s while held. When used, drops a random trinket on the ground.
* {{dlc|r}} {{transformation contribution|Yes Mother?}}
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|nr}} Most trinkets [[Mom's Box#No Effect|are not affected]].
** {{dlc|r}} Of the 188 trinkets in Repentance, only 72 have a doubled effect.
* {{dlc|r+}} All trinkets have some added effect, either simply a doubled effect or a specifically enhanced one.
* {{dlc+|r}} This effect stacks additively with {{a|Golden Trinket}}s; holding one with Mom's Box will cause applicable trinkets to have triple the regular effect.{{dlc-}}
* Holding a second Mom's Box by using {{I|Schoolbag}} only increases [[luck]], the effects of trinkets are not affected further.
sections.Synergies: * {{dlc+|a+}} [[Gulp!]] Pill / {{i|Marbles}} / {{i|Smelter}}: Trinket effects are still doubled when permanently applied to Isaac.{{dlc-}}
sections.Interactions:
* {{t|Mother's Kiss}}: Grants double the heart containers but only one of them is filled.
* {{i|Void}}: Passive effects of Mom's Box are lost if absorbed.
* {{i|Book of Virtues}}: Spawns a normal wisp with no unique effect.

The following trinkets have a different benefit than their effect being doubled:
* {{t|Broken Remote|r}}: Triggers the {{I|Teleport 2.0}} effect whenever an [[activated item]] is used.
* {{t|NO!|r}}: Prevents items with quality 0 from appearing.
* {{t|Rosary Bead|r}}: Adds 4 [[Rosary|Rosaries]] to all item pools, 6 if the trinket is golden. Upon picking up a Rosary, the effect ends.
* {{t|'M|r+}}: The new item has a 10% chance to be fully charged, 20% chance if the trinket is golden.
* {{t|Adoption Papers|r+}}: Familiars are always on sale. Shops are also able to sell {{p|Soul of Lilith}} if the trinket is golden.
* {{t|Apple of Sodom|r+}}: All types of hearts can be converted to spiders. No further benefit if the trinket is golden.
* {{t|Baby-Bender|r+}}: Familiars gain the {{t|Brain Worm|n}} effect. Familiars gain the {{t|Tape Worm|n}} effect on top if the trinket is golden.
* {{t|Beth's Essence|r+}}: The wisps spawned by the trinket have a 50% chance to be special wisps, 100% chance if the trinket is golden.
* {{t|Blessed Penny|r+}}: Proc chance increases, but less than 2× or 3× if the trinket is golden.
* {{t|Bloody Crown|r+}}: Treasure rooms in the Womb have an item choice, as if Isaac had {{i|More Options}}. No further benefit if the trinket is golden.
* {{t|Bloody Penny|r+}}: Proc chance increases, but less than 2× or 3× if the trinket is golden.
* {{t|Blue Key|r+}}: Makes the blue rooms drop double rewards when cleared. If the trinket is golden, the reward is tripled.
* {{t|Brain Worm|r+}}: Shots have a 25% chance to be piercing, 50% chance if the trinket is golden. 
* {{t|Broken Ankh|r+}}: Proc chance increases, but less than 2× or 3× if the trinket is golden.
* {{t|Broken Padlock|r+}}: Challenge rooms, arcades and {{e|Mega Satan}} door can be opened with bombs. Boss rooms can be opened with bombs as well if the trinket is golden.
* {{t|Callus|r+}}: Damage from sacrifice spikes is reduced to 1/2 hearts. If the trinket is golden, all damage is reduced to 1/2 hearts
* {{t|Crow Heart|r+}}: Adds a 25% chance that taking red heart damage does not reduce Devil room chances, 50% if the trinket is golden.
* {{t|Daemon's Tail|r+}}: Blue and purple fires drop {{e|Black Heart}}s instead of {{e|Soul Heart}}. No further benefit if the trinket is golden.
* {{t|Cursed Skull|r+}}: Teleports Isaac to a random special room instead of any room. Golden trinket triggers if Isaac has 1 full heart or less after taking damage.

sections.Effects:
* Grants {{dlcalt|50%|r=33%}} of converting any non-specific {{E|Red Heart}} pickups that spawn into {{e|Soul Heart}}, {{e|Black Heart}} or {{e|Bone Heart|n}} instead.
* {{transformation contribution|Seraphim}}
sections.Synergies:
* {{C|???}}, {{C|Tainted ???}}, {{C|Black Judas}}, {{C|Tainted Judas}}, and {{C|Tainted Forgotten}}: Decreases the chances of useless red heart drops, which these characters can't pick up.
* {{C|Bethany}}: Sacrifices potential healing for more charges. Usefulness depends on active item.
* {{C|Eve}}/{{I|Whore of Babylon}}: Decreases the chance of useless red heart drops when trying to maintain the half a heart (full heart on Eve) of red heart health required to keep Whore of Babylon's ability active.
* {{C|Tainted Bethany}}: Sacrifices potential blood charges for more health. Overall, still a beneficial pickup.
* {{C|Tainted Magdalene}}: Due to the "in your face" gameplay of Tainted Maggy, soul hearts will not be as useful up until the later floors.
sections.Interactions: * {{C|Keeper}}/{{C|Tainted Keeper}}: Nearly useless, since all hearts are converted into blue flies anyway. The only use is contributing to the Seraphim transformation.

sections.Effects:
* Continuously shooting for 2.35 seconds allows Isaac to fire a short-ranged brown {{i|Brimstone}} laser and corn shots behind himself when he stops shooting.
** The laser deals Isaac's [[damage]] per tick (15x Isaac's damage per second), ticks up to 19 times and lasts ~1.28 seconds (77 frames).
** Corn shots deal 6 damage, and a random amount are created each blast.
* {{transformation contribution|Oh Crap}}
sections.Notes: * {{dlc+|r+}} This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|Dangle}}.{{dlc-}}
sections.Synergies:
* Montezuma's Revenge, {{I|No. 2}}, {{I|Maw Of The Void}} and {{I|Revelation}} all have the same charge time, allowing Isaac to easily utilize them at same time.
* {{T|Brain Worm}}: Can cause the poop beam to hook to a target anywhere in the room, potentially hitting a target far outside of its usual range.
* {{I|Dark Arts}}: The corn Isaac poops out can be sliced, giving Isaac an insane damage up in seconds.
* {{i|Hemoptysis}}: Enemies hit by the sneeze will gain a curse that increases the damage the poop beam deals to 2x and +3 flat damage. Enemies who die to the poop beam under the curse will damage and spread the curse to nearby enemies.
* {{i|Ipecac}}: The poop beam gets only a +2 flat damage bonus instead of +40. The beam explodes 10 times, either on the first enemy or obstacle it hits or at the very end otherwise, dealing 10 + twice of the beam's damage.
* {{I|Jacob's Ladder}}: The brown laser Isaac fires will produce random arcs of electricity at the end of the laser. The corn Isaac poops out does not interact with the electricity.
* {{i|Lachryphagy}}: Spawns a large amount of tears at the end of the poop beam, heavily increasing Isaac's damage output.
* {{I|My Reflection}}: Causes the poop beam range behind Isaac to become significantly increased as well as having a short range similar to Azazel's beam in front of him. This greatly eases the use of this item allowing for high DPS.
* {{I|The Parasite}}: The poop beam splits into two horizontal beams meaning less risk for Isaac and a bigger area for enemies to be hit.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Censer}}: The corn shots are slowed by the aura.
* {{i|Eye of the Occult}}: No effect.
** '''Eye of the Occult''' + {{i|Brimstone}}/{{i|Technology}}: The poop beam also automatically fires at the crosshair and becomes a lasso. The loop starts where the beam would normally end and extends out to the cross-hair.
* {{i|Libra}}: The poop beam ignores damage modification from Libra, both positive and negative: the actual unbalanced damage value is used.

sections.Effects:
* {{dlc|nr}} +1.25 [[range]].
* {{dlc|r}} +2.5 [[range]].
* {{dlc|nr}} +0.5 [[tear falling speed]].
* +1 [[luck]].
* {{dlc|r}} Grants one {{E|Soul Heart}}.
* {{transformation contribution|Yes Mother?}}
sections.Notes: * {{dlc+|a+}} This item has a 1% chance to spawn when bombing {{e|Mom's Dressing Table}}. Multiple copies can be obtained through this method.{{dlc-}}

sections.Effects:
* Grants one full Red [[Red Heart container|Heart container]].
* +0.3 [[damage]].
* {{Dlc|r}} Heals 1 additional {{E|Red Heart}}.

sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|a+}} This item has a 1% chance to spawn when bombing {{e|Mom's Dressing Table}}. Multiple copies can be obtained through this method.{{dlc-}}
* The blue spider spawning chance depends on the [[luck]] stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: <math>\frac{1}{20 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} * 2 \right \rfloor}</math>
** At base luck (0), the chance is 5%, maxing out at 100% at 9.5 luck.
* The spiders are spawned when Isaac is shooting, and up to 5 spiders can be spawned at the same time. More spiders can be spawned if the previous ones died.
* {{dlc|nr}} This item does not work for Lilith since {{i|Incubus}} tears do not count as her tears.
* Spiders can still be spawned in rooms without enemies.
sections.Synergies:
* {{dlc|na+}} {{i|Brimstone}} / {{i|Chocolate Milk}} / {{i|Cursed Eye}} / {{i|Mom's Knife}} / {{i|Monstro's Lung}} / {{i|Tech X}}: Charging an attack spawns spiders in rapid succession.
* {{i|Epic Fetus}} / {{i|The Ludovico Technique}} / {{i|Marked}}: Moving the tear/crosshair around will spawn spiders rapidly.
* {{t|Fish Tail}}: Doubles the total amount of spiders that can be spawned at the same time, up to a total of 10.
* {{i|Hive Mind}}: Doubles the limit to 10 spiders, in addition to boosting the damage of spiders per the item's base effect.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns 4 random [[pill]]s near Isaac.
* {{transformation contribution|Yes Mother?}}
sections.Interactions: * {{i|Starter Deck}}: Drops four cards/runes rather than pills.

sections.Effects:
* Petrifies and turns enemies into gold upon contact with Isaac.
** Enemies killed while in this state will drop 1-3 {{E|Penny|text=Pennies}}.
** When held by  {{C|Keeper}} or  {{C|Tainted Keeper}}, enemies will drop 0-1 pennies instead.
* Enemies that make contact with Isaac take damage equal to the number of [[coin]]s he has.
** {{dlc|r}} The damage is 3.5+0.2 * the number of Isaac's coins. The damage caps at 23.30 with 99 coins and 203.3 with 999 coins.
** Damage is dealt up to twice per second per enemy.
sections.Notes:
* With Midas' Touch, some effects that create {{g|Poop}} may instead create {{g|Golden Poop}} (see Synergies for details).
* If an enemy doesn't deal contact damage, Midas' Touch can safely be used on it to create extra Pennies. {{E|Fly|text=Flies}}, {{E|Bulb}}, {{E|Mulligan}}, and {{E|Host}} are the most common enemies this can be applied to.
** If Isaac has 13 coins or more when using Midas' Touch on {{E|Mulligan|text=Mulligans}}, they will die and release flies, hurting Isaac.
** With {{i|Skatole}}, {{E|Hive}}s and {{E|Swarmer}}s will constantly spawn black flies, meaning they can create endless amounts of coins.
** {{dlc|nr}} As {{E|Mom}}'s foot and {{E|Satan}}'s feet don't deal contact damage, Midas' Touch can be used against them to great effect.
* Spawning Multiplayer [[Babies]] while the player has Midas' Touch will give the Midas' Touch effects (freeze on touch + damage) to the baby itself. This can be abused, considering the baby's invincibility frames upon spawning:
** Spawn the baby using the Enter key. It is invincible for a short period.
** During this period, stay in contact with enemies to freeze them and damage them.
* This can be used to gather 99 [[coin]]s very quickly, and in turn, deal massive damage with Midas' Touch damage component.
* {{dlc|r}} Petrified enemies that are [[Freeze|frozen]] will not drop any coins on death.
* {{dlc|r}} Midas' Touch can be a great item with {{C|Tainted Keeper}}, as you can run into enemies and get even more coins. Just be careful to not kill yourself.
* {{dlc|r}} Both Midas' Touch and {{i|E. Coli}} affect {{C|Tainted Forgotten}}'s body, causing enemies that touch the body to freeze and turn into poop respectively.
* {{dlc+|r+}} If a [[Champions|violet champion]] monster is killed while it is gold-petrified, the trinket it drops is guaranteed to be a golden one. Rainbow champions still drop normal trinkets.{{dlc-}}
sections.Interactions:
* {{dlc|r}}[[Cards and Runes|Ace Cards]]: Petrified enemies that are turned into [[pickup]]s don’t also drop coins from the petrification effect.
* {{dlc|r}}[[Freeze|Freeze Effects]]: Petrified enemies that are frozen don’t drop coins.
* {{i|Mine Crafter}}: Has a chance to petrify the TNT block when placed, damaging Isaac in the process if he touches the golden TNT Block.

sections.Effects:
* Upon activation, creates a trapdoor that leads to the next floor or to a {{r|Crawl Space}}, identical to {{i|We Need To Go Deeper!}}.
* Using this on a dirt patch that appears in [[Grave Room]]s in {{s|Dark Room}} will unlock {{c|The Forgotten}}.
** Once the Forgotten is unlocked, digging into dirt patches will instead spawn a random type of {{E|Chest}}.
* {{dlc|r}} {{transformation contribution|Yes Mother?}}
sections.Notes:
* It is possible to unlock {{c|The Forgotten}} even if {{i|The Negative}} has not yet been unlocked by teleporting straight to the dark room via a {{r|Sacrifice Room}}.
* Does nothing when used on {{s|???}}, {{s|Sheol}}, {{s|Cathedral}}, {{s|Dark Room}} (except in a [[Grave Room]]), {{s|Chest}}, {{s|The Void}}, or {{s|Home}}.
* Once Mom's Shovel is complete, the stomping caused by {{i|Broken Shovel 1}} stops.
* Unlike the Broken Shovel, Mom's Shovel will not disappear if it is left on a pedestal, and Isaac leaves and re-enters the room it was left in.
* Like {{i|We Need To Go Deeper!}}, this item can be used to destroy rocks if used while Isaac is flying over a rock.
* {{dlc+|r}} This item can be obtained by using {{i|Spindown Dice}} on {{i|Mucormycosis}} without obtaining the Broken Shovels.{{dlc-}}
* {{dlc+|r}} The full Mom's Shovel can be found within the area of {{i|Death Certificate}}. Even without unlocking the item, its effect can potentially be activated by {{i|Metronome}}.{{dlc-}}
sections.Synergies: * {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Creates two wisps on the middle ring: one looks like {{c|The Forgotten}}, which has increased HP but does not fire tears, and the other looks like {{c|The Soul}}, which fires tears that have a 10% chance of invoking {{P|II - The High Priestess}} on enemies.}}
sections.Interactions: * {{I|Car Battery}}: In most cases, no extra effect. When used near the entrances to a room, the item can occasionally open 2 trapdoors at once, {{Dlc|nr}} increasing the chance of opening a {{r|Crawl Space}}.

sections.Effects:
* [[Status Effects#Petrification|Petrifies]] all enemies in the current room for about 1.5 seconds.
* Deals 5 damage and [[Status Effects#Poison|poisons]] any enemies near Isaac.
** The poison deals Isaac's damage per tick and lasts for 6 ticks.
* {{dlc|nr+}} Sends out a wave of rocks across the room in the direction Isaac is facing, dealing 10 damage to any enemies it comes in contact with.
* {{dlc|r}} The fart deflects enemy projectiles which deal 6 damage if they would've hurt Isaac for half a heart, and 7 for a full heart.
* {{dlc|r+}} The fart creates a {{i|Mama Mega!|n}} explosion that deals 100 damage.
sections.Notes:
* It can be used to open {{R|Secret Room}}s.
* {{dlc|nr+}} The rock wave can break rocks to fill in gaps.
* {{dlc|r+}} As Mega Bean creates a {{i|Mama Mega!|n}} explosion, it can be used to open the entrances to {{r|Boss Rush}} and the {{s|???}} if they are closed.
sections.Interactions: * {{t|Second Hand}}: Doubles the petrification duration but not the poison duration.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a [[familiar]] who follows Isaac around and cycles between the tears of Isaac's other familiars.

sections.Interactions:

sections.Effects:
* Randomizes passive items and [[attribute]]s on pickup and at the start of every floor.
** Regarding stats, this randomness is not dependent on the run's [[Seeds|seed]].
** Stats gain a random modifier. These modifiers do not stack between levels and are instead rerolled every time.
*** [[Speed]] -0.2, 0 or +0.2.
**** {{dlc|nr}} Also affects maximum speed, may never exceed 2.0.
*** {{dlc|nr}} [[Range]] -0.5, 0 or +0.5.
*** {{dlc|r}} [[Range]] -2.5, 0 or +2.5.
*** {{dlc|nr}} [[Tears]] -0.5, 0 or +0.5.
*** {{dlc|r}} [[Fire rate]] -0.5, 0 or +0.5.
*** [[Shot speed]] -0.2, 0 or +0.2.
*** [[Damage]] flat -1, 0 or +1.
*** [[Luck]] -1, 0 or +1.
** Does not affect [[trinket]]s, [[card]]s, [[pill]]s, [[Pretty Fly|Pretty Flies]], {{i|The Polaroid}} / {{i|The Negative}}, {{i|Key Piece 1}} / {{i|Key Piece 2}}, {{i|Knife Piece 1}} / {{i|Knife Piece 2}}, or active items.
sections.Interactions: * {{I|The Stairway}}: When getting the Stairway at the start of a floor, the ladder doesn't spawn. It will spawn at the start of the next floor even if rerolled.

sections.Notes: * It can spawn familiars not yet unlocked. * If {{i|Cube of Meat}} or {{i|Ball of Bandages}} are spawned and Isaac already has either of those items, the level of these items will increase while the effect is active. * Using Monster Manual is a good method to unlock achievements related to Super Meat Boy and Super Bandage Girl. ** Using Monster Manual and enough {{E|Lil' Battery|text=Lil' Batteries}}, Super Meat Boy and Super Bandage Girl can both be achieved in the same run. ** If Isaac does not already have the Cube of Meat or Ball of Bandages, Monster Manual can spawn a level 2 Cube of Meat or Ball of Bandages in one use. * {{i|Mongo Baby}} will not copy familiars spawned by Monster Manual. * Familiars spawned by Monster Manual cannot be rerolled into other items by {{I|D4}} or {{I|D100}}. * {{I|Box of Friends}} will not duplicate familiars spawned by Monster Manual. * {{i|Tinytoma}} orbitals will persist between floors until they are all destroyed. They will not respawn outside of the floor they were generated in. * {{dlc|r}} The familiars summoned by Monster Manual are items with a [[Item Tags monstermanual|monstermanual]] [[Item Tags|item tag]]. * {{C|Tainted Lazarus|r}}: If dead Tainted Lazarus has used Monster Manual, but living Tainted Lazarus progresses to the next floor (or vice versa), familiars from the previous floor are not removed. Upon exiting the game, or moving to the next floor as either character, any familiars retained this way are lost, meaning familiars cant be kept at most 1 extra floor.
sections.Synergies: * {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns wisps in the inner ring. The given wisps function similarly to familiars given by {{I|Buddy in a Box|n}}.}}
sections.Interactions: * {{I|Sacrificial Altar|dlc=r}}: Summoned familiars can be sacrificed since they persist for the entire floor, even if Monster Manual isn't currently being held.

sections.Effects: * Grants a razor familiar that [[Familiar#Orbital Familiars|orbits]] Isaac. Enemies that touch the razor take damage equal to 20% of Isaac's tear damage per tick or 300% of Isaac's damage per second ({{dlc|r}} 150% of Isaac's damage per second) and start to [[bleed]]. ** {{dlc|nr}} Bleeding enemies take damage equal to 10% of their maximum health every 5 seconds. Bosses cannot bleed and won't take any damage from the razor. ** {{dlc|r}} Bleeding enemies repeatedly take 2.8 + (floor * 0.3) damage based on how quickly they move; the faster the enemy, the more damage they take. While moving, a bleeding enemy leaves behind [[Creep#Red Creep|red creep]] that can damage other enemies. ** {{dlc|nr}} The razor does not block enemy shots. ** {{dlc|r}} The razor blocks enemy shots. * {{transformation contribution|Yes Mother?}}
sections.Notes: * {{dlc|nr}}It may not always be a good idea to take Mom's Razor if Isaac has one or more [[Familiar#Pretty Fly|Pretty Flies]] as orbitals, as Mom's Razor can override Pretty Flies without giving protection from enemy shots.
sections.Synergies: * {{i|BFFS!}}: Increases razor's size and contact damage. No damage increase on bleed effect.

sections.Effect:
* Upon use, spawns a {{E|Movable TNT}}.
* If used a second time while the created TNT is still active, it will explode. {{dlc|nr}} This will consume a charge to remotely detonate the TNT instead of creating another TNT.
** {{dlc|r}} The remote detonation can be used while the item is uncharged.
sections.Notes: * {{dlc|r}} The Movable TNT has a unique cubic appearance, but it functionally identical to a regular Movable TNT.
sections.Synergies: * {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns one glowing green wisp that cannot take or deal damage in any way, and bounces around the room in a random direction, instead of following Isaac. If the wisp is shot by Isaac or his familiars, it explodes, dealing 100 damage to nearby enemies. The wisp does not persist between rooms. Explosions and enemy shots do not detonate it, and the wisps' explosions are unaffected by {{I|BFFS!}} and bomb synergies.}}
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|120 Volt}}: The TNT is spawned and may be instantly hit by 120 Volt's electric shock, which usually wont detonate it unless Isaac is near some enemies.
* {{C|Tainted Magdalene}}: Tainted Magdalene may immediately attempt to hug the TNT upon holding it up, instantly detonating it and dealing damage to her.
* {{dlc|na+}} {{i|Car Battery}}: The TNT will be spawned and then instantly explode, dealing a full heart of damage.
** {{dlc|a+}} Spawns two TNT barrels instead.
* {{i|Midas' Touch}}: Occasionally spawns a golden TNT barrel which turns into a regular movable TNT after 3 seconds. While in its gold state, Isaac cannot collide with the barrel nor push it, although it can be pushed by enemies. In some cases, the golden barrel will explode immediately after spawning, dealing damage to Isaac. Apart from that, it doesn't give any benefits.
* {{i|Spider Mod}}: The TNT can be inflicted with a random [[Status Effects|status effect]] if the spider comes into contact with it.

sections.Effects:
* {{dlc|nr}} +1.0 [[damage]].
* After firing tears for 2.35 seconds, if Isaac stops shooting, he unleashes a black {{i|Brimstone}} ring around Isaac that expands and contracts, dealing damage at a rapid rate to all enemies touching it.
** The black ring deals damage equal to Isaac's current damage per tick, and ticks a total of 30 times. It lasts ~1.97 seconds (118 frames).
** {{dlc|nr}} Enemies killed by the black ring have a 5% chance to drop {{E|Black Heart}}s.
* {{transformation contribution|Leviathan}}
sections.Notes:
* The charge is completed when a red upside-down cross appears on Isaac's forehead.
** {{dlc|a+}} With charge bars enabled, there is also an indicator that displays the charge.
* {{dlc|nr}} This item does not work while playing a [[blindfolded]] character, as it requires tears to charge.
** This restriction can, however, be bypassed by picking up {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}.
** This item's effect will not fully activate if picked up by {{c|Lilith}}; its stat ups will still apply to her {{i|Incubus}} familiar, but the ring will not appear unless she also has the Ludovico Technique.
* {{dlc|r}} This item will still work while playing as a [[blindfolded]] character.
* The ring will apply any tear status effects such as [[poison]] if Isaac has them.
* This item can begin to be recharged again immediately after activating it, effectively cutting its charge time in half in situations where it may be needed again quickly.
sections.Synergies:
* Maw Of The Void, {{I|No. 2}}, {{I|Montezuma's Revenge}} and {{I|Revelation}} all have the same charge time, allowing Isaac to easily utilize them at same time.
* {{i|Dark Arts}}: Extremely powerful. Isaac will unleash a black Brimstone ring while using Dark Arts, letting Isaac do crazy damage while invincible.
* {{tf|Guppy}}: Damaging enemies with Maw Of The Void allows flies to spawn from the Guppy transformation. Flies are spawned at a rate of approximately one fly per tick of damage for each enemy it hits. This causes a lot of flies to spawn very quickly. The spawned flies will also move to attack the nearest enemy immediately.
* {{i|Hemoptysis}}: Enemies hit by the sneeze will gain a curse that increases the damage the black ring deals to 2x and +3 flat damage. Enemies who die to the black ring under the curse will damage and spread the curse to nearby enemies.
* [[Homing tears]]: The ring curves towards enemies.
* {{i|Ipecac}}: Massively increases ring damage and poisons enemies.
** {{dlc|r}} The ring also explodes on enemy or obstacle contact.
* {{i|Jacob's Ladder|r}}: The ring sends out electric currents when it hits something.
* {{i|Lost Contact}}: Ring can destroy projectiles.
* {{I|Mysterious Liquid}}: Occasionally spawns a pool of creep where the ring makes contact with an enemy.
* {{I|Pisces}}/{{I|8 Inch Nails}}: Ring obtains knockback effect.
* {{i|Proptosis}}: {{dlc|na+}} The ring is much larger and deals 1.5x damage per tick.
** {{dlc|a+nr}} The ring is larger but deals normal damage.
** {{dlc|r}} No effect.
* {{i|Strange Attractor}}: Ring attracts pickups and enemies towards it.
* {{t|Wiggle Worm}}: The ring has wavy edges.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: Tear must be moved before the ring activates.
* {{i|A Lump of Coal}}: {{dlc|na+}} The ring damage is halved.
** {{dlc|a+}} The ring deals normal damage.
* {{i|Marked}}: {{dlc|nr}} Crosshair must be moved for 4 seconds before the ring activates.
** {{dlc|r}} While firing, the ring charges automatically and activates immediately upon full charge.
* {{i|Soy Milk}}: No effect on charge time but massively reduces damage.
* {{i|Diplopia}}: Having multiple copies has no effect

sections.Effects:
* Grants one {{E|Soul Heart}}.
* Enemy shots that hit Isaac have a 25% chance to be reflected.
** Isaac does not take damage from the reflected tears, but gets pushed a bit.
** The reflected tears are [[homing]] and [[Status Effects#Confusion|concussive]], and use Isaac's [[Damage]] and [[Tear effects]].
*** Projectiles that create other projectiles (e.g. {{E|Shady}}) can harm Isaac and be reflected.
** Can reflect:
*** {{dlc+|r}} Fireballs (e.g. from {{E|Crackle}}), but their lines of fire harm Isaac.{{dlc-}}
*** Fire projectiles (e.g. from {{E|Mega Satan}}).
*** {{dlc+|r}} Obstacles thrown by {{E|Polty}} or {{E|Kineti}}.{{dlc-}}
** Does not reflect:
*** Explosive projectiles (e.g. from {{E|Gurgle}}).
*** Lasers or beams.
*** {{dlc|r}}Lines of fire from fireballs.
*** {{dlc+|r}} Projectiles from {{E|Big Bony}}, {{E|Coal Boy}}, {{E|Danny}}.{{dlc-}}

sections.Effect:
* Gives Isaac a chance to shoot a tear out of an eye on the back of his head.
* {{transformation contribution|Yes Mother?}}
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|nr}} The chance to shoot an extra tear depends on the [[luck]] stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: <math>\frac1 { 2 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} * 0.5  \right \rfloor}</math>
** At base luck (0), the chance is 50%, maxing out at 100% at 2 luck.
* {{dlc|r}} The chance to shoot an extra tear depends on the [[luck]] stat and is based on this formula: <math>50\% + (10\% * \mathit{Luck})</math>
** This means that the chance starts at 50% at 0 luck, minimizes at 0% at -5 luck, and maximizes at 100% at 5 luck.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Continuum}}: Tears shot out of the back reappear on the opposite side of the screen.
* {{I|Eye of the Occult}}: Mom's Eye tears follow the direction in which Isaac is shooting.
* {{i|Loki's Horns}}: Any time Mom's Eye would activate, Loki's Horns activates instead.
* {{i|Rubber Cement}}: Tears bounce around, making the backward tear more likely to hit enemies.
* {{i|Mom's Knife}}: Another knife is permanently behind Isaac, able to deal contact damage. The fire chance is still affected by luck as usual.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|20/20}}/{{i|The Inner Eye}}/{{i|Mutant Spider}}: No effect on the tears fired out of the back of Isaac's head. The chance to activate is checked per shot, not for each tear fired.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}}: Occasionally shoots a bomb backward. Not recommended, as self-damage is likely.
* {{i|Doctor's Remote}}/{{i|Epic Fetus}}: Chance for two airstrikes on opposite sides of Isaac.
* {{i|Ipecac}}: Occasionally shoots an explosive shot backward. Not recommended, as self-damage is likely.
* {{i|Incubus|anr}}: No effect.
* {{i|Kidney Stone}}: Adds a chance for each tear from the barrage to fire from the front and back of Isaac. The kidney stone will only fire from the front of Isaac.
* {{i|Lead Pencil|a+nr}}: Adds a chance for the tear barrage to be fired behind Isaac instead of in front.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique|a}}: Adds a chance for [[piercing]] + [[spectral]] tears to be fired in random directions from the main tear. This chance scales with [[luck]] and goes up to 100% at 10 Luck.
* {{i|Monstro's Lung}}: Occasionally fires one red tear out the back of Isaac's head.
* {{i|Tractor Beam}}: The backward tear is not affected by Tractor Beam.
* {{i|The Wiz}}: The backward tear is not affected by The Wiz.

sections.Effects:

* {{transformation contribution|Yes Mother?}}
sections.Notes: * {{dlc|r}} The item will cost 10 cents if found in a {{r|Shop}}
sections.Synergies: * {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns wisps in the inner ring, looking like pills. The wisps spawn [[pill]]s when destroyed. The wisps come in random colors (Blue, Red, White, Pink, Gray, Light Blue, and Yellow). Each color may fire tears that confuse, poison, petrify, burn, or spawn troll bombs. Each tear effect is assigned to one color of pill wisp based on the current seed. The only color pill wisp without a tear effect also spawns a hostile [[Spider]] when destroyed. sections.Interactions: * {{i|Starter Deck}}: Gives [[card]]s instead.

sections.Effects:
* {{dlc|nr}} +5.25 [[range]].
* {{dlc|r}} +2.5 [[range]].
* {{dlc|nr}} +0.5 [[tear falling speed]].
* {{dlc|r}} Spawns 3-6 [[Blue Fly|Blue Flies]] when picked up.
* {{transformation contribution|Yes Mother?}}
sections.Notes: * {{dlc+|a+}} This item has a 1% chance to spawn when bombing {{e|Mom's Dressing Table}}. Multiple copies can be obtained through this method.{{dlc-}}

sections.Effects:
* Upon use, Isaac fires a giant, incredibly powerful {{i|Brimstone}} laser from his mouth, similar to the one used by {{e|Mega Satan}}, for 15 seconds.
** The laser deals Isaac's current damage multiplied by 5 per tick.
** The laser has enough power to push Isaac backward while being fired and will last between rooms, and across multiple floors.
** The laser is not locked to the cardinal directions; it can be aimed freely.
** While Mega Blast is being fired, Isaac cannot:
*** Open {{E|Chest}}s.
*** Pick up a {{E|Lil' Battery}}, collectibles, [[pill]]s, [[trinket]]s, or [[Cards and Runes|cards or runes]].
*** Pick up the trophy or enter the chest that spawns after defeating a final boss.
*** Sleep in a [[bed]].
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|nr}} Picking up a {{E|Lil' Battery}} with this item will add 3 to its charge, meaning that 4 batteries are required to fully recharge the item.
** {{dlc|a+nr}} A {{E|Charged Key|n}} will only add 3 charges.
*** {{E|Lil' Battery|r}} and Charged Key add 6 charges instead of 3.
** {{dlc|r}} Picking up a {{E|Mega Battery|n}} will fully charge it twice.
* Using a [[48 Hour Energy]] pill with this item will fully charge it.
* Mega Blast has an 80% decreased [[Item Pool#Item Weight|item pool weight]], making it less likely to appear than other collectibles.
* {{dlc+|r}} It is not recommended to use Mega Blast in fight with {{E|The Beast}}, because its laser forces you into obstacles on the level.
** This can be mitigated to a degree with {{I|Anima Sola}}, especially with a {{I|Car Battery}} which doubles the Anima Sola's length. The Beast won't be able to spawn obstacles while chained.{{dlc-}}
sections.Synergies:
All synergies and interactions pertaining to {{i|Brimstone}} pertain to Mega Blast, with the following exceptions and additions:
* {{i|4.5 Volt}}: Item will gain charges for dealing damage, which is especially effective when fighting bosses with large health pool.
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns red wisps on the middle ring that utilize a miniature Brimstone as their weapon, which requires charging and releasing as usual. Lasers can hit up to 8 times for a total of 24 damage. If Mega Blast is being used, the wisps will continuously fire their laser outward rather than in the direction Mega Blast is firing.}}
* {{i|Car Battery|r+}} The beam lasts 50% longer, about 23 seconds.
* {{c|Tainted Azazel}}: Enemies hit by the sneeze will gain a curse that increases the damage the laser deals to 10x and +3 flat damage (instead of just 5x). Enemies who die to the laser under the curse will damage and spread the curse to nearby enemies.
** {{i|Hemoptysis}}: The sneeze can be activated while Mega Blast is firing.
* {{i|Schoolbag}}: laser will continue to fire when switching to another active item. Other active items can be used while the laser is firing.
sections.Interactions:

* {{i|Anti-Gravity}}: No effect.
