sections.Notes:
* Bad pills already obtained/dropped will be converted to their "good" counterparts.
* If PHD is lost in any way, such as rerolling by the {{i|D4}} or a {{R|Dice Room}}, or dropping it as {{c|Tainted Isaac}}, pills will remain fully identified, but negative pills will not be converted.
** Rerolling an owned passive item into PHD through effects such as {{i|D4}} will not identify pills, but will convert negative pills into positive ones.
* {{dlc|a+}} Performing a [[RERUN]] with a character that held PHD will still prevent negative pills from spawning, but will no longer identify pills until used.
* As bad pills will turn into good pills, it is possible for two different colored pills to have the same effect.
* Multiple copies of PHD will not yield more coins when using a Blood Donation Machine or IV Bag.
* This item can be crafted from {{i|Bag of Crafting}} with eight [[pills]].
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|False PHD}}: Pills can both be good or bad again. Taking a bad pill still applies the benefits from False PHD.
* {{C|Keeper|r}} / {{C|Tainted Keeper}}: {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}s will not produce more coins and they will still have a chance to fail.
* {{c|Jacob and Esau}}: Pills will be identified for both characters, but pills with negative effects will only have their effects reversed when used by the character holding PHD.

sections.Effects:
* Grants 5 {{e|Bomb}}s.
* Causes Isaac's bombs to gain the effects of 1-4 random bomb synergies (most commonly 1).
** Aside from normal bomb synergy items, this also includes {{t|Bob's Bladder}}, {{i|Strange Attractor}}, and {{e|Golden Bomb}}s (golden bombs will not be free).
sections.Notes:
* Nancy Bombs cannot give the effects of {{i|Mr. Mega}}, {{i|Rocket in a Jar}}, or {{E|Giga Bomb}}s.
* Even though Nancy Bombs can grant the {{i|Fast Bombs}} synergy, this will have no effect on the bomb placement speed. It will, however, disallow that bomb to knock back other bombs.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}} / {{I|Epic Fetus}}: Bombs have a chance to be affected by Nancy Bombs.
* {{I|Kamikaze!}}: Gains the effect of a random bomb synergy each time it is used.
* {{i|Scatter Bombs}}: Extra bombs will copy the bomb synergies of the original bomb.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a [[familiar]] that follows Isaac's path with a 2-second delay.
** {{dlc|r}} The delay is 0.66 seconds instead.
* When a friendly tear passes through Multidimensional Baby, the tear splits into two parallel tears that gain a 1.33x shot speed boost, {{dlc|nr}} x1.5 range /{{dlc|r}} x1.5 [[tear height]] (which also increases effective range), and also a visual black and white flashing effect.
* {{dlc|r}}{{transformation contribution|Conjoined}}
sections.Notes:
* It is possible to crash the game when combining this item with rapid-fire or multi-shot laser tears.
* Duplicated tears will deal the same damage as Isaac's tears.
* If other familiars that move with a similar pattern such as {{i|Shade}} have been collected before the Baby, it will follow them instead with further delay.
* Standing perfectly still with the Multidimensional Baby inside of Isaac will activate its effect, as the tears will pass through it as they spawn.
** This does not work with attacks such as Brimstone, as it is fired in front of Isaac.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Brimstone}}: If a brimstone laser is shot through the baby, it will double the laser.
** {{C|Azazel}}'s short-ranged Brimstone attack will also be "fired again" from the baby, increasing the range.
* {{i|Cricket's Body}}/{{i|The Parasite}}: Tears that pass through Multidimensional Baby will duplicate and their split tears will duplicate. Half of the tears fired through Multidimensional Baby retain The Parasite's look and the other half have the flashing appearance.
* {{t|Duct Tape}}: If properly positioned, Isaac's tears will always be doubled.
* {{i|Haemolacria}}: Haemolacria shots will be duplicated and more burst tears will spawn. Burst tears that pass through Multidimensional Baby will also be duplicated.
* {{dlc|r}} {{I|Papa Fly}}: Papa Fly will always shoot two shots due to both familiars having the same movement delay.
* {{i|Revelation}}: If a revelation laser is shot through the baby, it will double the laser.
* [[Shooting familiar]]s: Duplicates familiar's tears.
* {{i|Sprinkler}}: Tears fired by the sprinkler can be duplicated.
* {{i|Technology}}: When the laser passes through Multidimensional Baby, it doubles the laser.
sections.Interactions:
* {{t|???'s Soul}}/{{i|Abel}}/{{i|Cain's Other Eye}}: Familiar tears will be duplicated if they pass through the baby. However, due to their independent movement pattern, it can be hard to achieve duplication.
* {{i|Anti-Gravity}}: Multidimensional Baby will travel the same path as the Anti-Gravity tears, easily doubling any stationary shots. Any moving tears that hit it will produce a normal moving copy, however stationary tears will spawn a copy that will eventually fall to the ground even after the direction is released.
** {{dlc|a+}} Stationary duplicated tears will release normally.
* {{t|Baby-Bender}}: No effect as Multidimensional Baby only duplicates Isaac's tears.
* {{i|BFFS!}}: The baby is larger, but tears shot through it will not do more damage.
* {{i|Box of Friends}}: Each copy of Multidimensional Baby follows the previous copy with a 2-second ({{Dlc|r}}0.66-second) delay.  Tears shot through multiple babies will only be duplicated once.
* {{i|Compound Fracture}}: Tears that pass through Multidimensional Baby will be duplicated and cosmetically look like normal tears. Bone shards will not duplicate unless they pass through Multidimensional Baby separately.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}} / {{i|Epic Fetus}} / {{i|Tech X}} / {{i|Trisagion}}: No effect.
* {{I|Eye of the Occult}}: Makes it more easy to use Multidimensional Baby, as Isaac can simply stand while the familiar stays on top of him.
* {{i|Lachryphagy}}: Duplicates tears, which tend to merge after traveling a certain distance, making it easier to feed tears. Burst tears can only be duplicated if the tear they come from didn't pass through the baby already.
* {{i|Lil Brimstone}}/{{i|Robo-Baby 2.0}}: Familiar lasers that pass through the baby will not be duplicated.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: Spawns another tear that will slowly follow Isaac but cannot be controlled.
** {{dlc|r}} Spawns a stationary tear where Multidimensional Baby first appeared in the room. The tear does not follow Isaac.
* {{i|Mom's Bracelet|nr+}}: Throwing any obstacles through Multidimensional Baby will transform it into two 40 damage tears. Throwing obstacles that can drop pickups like mushrooms through Multidimensional Baby will cease the possibility of anything dropping from such tears. Crawl spaces, though, appear right after picking up an obstacle.
* {{Dlc|nr}}{{i|Mom's Knife}}: No effect.
** {{Dlc|r}}Fired knife is doubled when passing through Multidimensional Baby. No effect on held knife and returning knife.

sections.Effects:
* Grants an empty Red [[Heart container]].
** If the character cannot hold red heart containers they will simply be given a normal HP up.
* Adds a chance of dropping a {{E|Red Heart}} after taking damage.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|nr}} The chance for Old Bandage to spawn a Red Heart depends on the [[luck]] stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: <math>\min(\frac1 { 10 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} * 0.3 \right \rfloor},50\%)</math>
** At base luck (0), the chance is 10%, maxing out at 50% at 26.67 luck.
* {{dlc|r}} The chance for Old Bandage to spawn a Red Heart depends on the [[luck]] stat and is based on this formula: <math>20\% + (\mathit{Luck}\ * 1\%)</math>
** This means that the chance starts at 20% at 0 luck, minimizes at 0% at -20 luck, and maximizes at 100% at 80 luck.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Blood Oath}}: For each half heart damaged by Blood Oath, Old Bandage has a chance to drop a heart. Synergy further improves with luck.
* {{I|IV Bag}} + {{i|Humbleing Bundle}} / {{i|Maggy's Bow}}: The damage from IV Bag has a chance to spawn 2 hearts, which can be picked up to create further coins and possibly even heal hearts with enough Luck.
** {{dlc|r}} Humbleing Bundle only has a 50% chance to double the hearts dropped, but Old Bandage may still drop 1 heart.

sections.Effects:
* Every tear has a different color and different corresponding effect. One of the following effects can be granted:
** Brown: None
** Red: 2x damage, {{I|Fire Mind}},  or [[Petrification|Petrify]]
** Pink: [[Charm]]
** Purple: [[Homing]] or {{T|Brain Worm}}
** Dark Blue: chance for {{I|Proptosis}} tears
*** Does not gain 3x damage, effectively making it a damage down.
** Light Blue: [[Slow]], and [[Freeze]] on kill
** Green: [[Poison]]
** Yellow: [[Fear]]
** Orange: [[Bait]]
sections.Notes: * The color of the tears from Playdough Cookie are not based on luck, but their individual effects are. (e.g. Red {{I|Fire Mind}} tears will always explode at 13 Luck.)
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Aquarius}}: Each individual puddle will grant a different effect, and will copy the corresponding color.
* {{i|Brimstone}} (including {{C|Azazel}}'s and {{C|Tainted Azazel}}'s) / {{I|Trisagion}} / {{i|Technology 2}} / {{i|Tech X}}: Beam(s) apply a different effect every tick, and have an RGB filter. This can be used to rapidly apply different effects.
** All of {{I|Trisagion}}'s lasers will share the same color at any given moment, regardless of when they were fired. The same is true for {{i|Tech X}}'s rings.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}} / {{I|Epic Fetus}}: Explosions still use the effects the tears give them, while also inheriting their synergies with the items they're based on and (for {{i|Dr. Fetus}}) visually resembling them. (e.g. Dark Red becomes {{I|Hot Bombs}}, Green becomes {{I|Bob's Curse}}).
** They don't gain damage from Red, or lose damage from Blue, however.
* {{i|Spirit Sword}}: Every swing gains a different color and effect based on that color. This can be used to rapidly apply different effects.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|120 Volt}}: No effect.
* {{I|Compound Fracture}} / {{I|The Parasite}} / {{I|Lachryphagy}} / {{I|Haemolacria}}: All split shots copy the color and effect of the first shot.
* {{C|The Forgotten}} / {{C|Tainted Forgotten}} / {{I|Notched Axe}}: Every swing gains a different color and effect based on that color. It lacks the ability to be spammed that {{i|Spirit Sword}} has, however.
* {{I|Ipecac}}: {{I|Fire Mind}} tears drop a fire pit upon exploding.
* {{I|Jacob's Ladder}}: Lasers use the same effect as the tear.
* {{C|Tainted Lilith}}: The whip attack will apply different effects normally.
* {{I|The Ludovico Technique}}: The tear changes color at your tear rate and gives the corresponding effects.
* {{I|Maw Of The Void}}: No effect.
* {{I|Mom's Knife}}: Applies a different effect every tick.
* {{I|Revelation}} / {{I|Montezuma's Revenge}}: Applies the RGB filter, but does not gain its effects.
* {{I|Technology}}: Beam applies a different effect every hit, and gains the RGB filter.
* {{I|Varicose Veins}}: Each one of the 10 tears spawned on hit has one of the available random effects applied to it.

sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Anti-Gravity|r}}: Melee attacks will generate a hovering tear in the shape of the swing of the pickaxe.
* {{i|The Battery|r}}: Causes remaining charge from the previous floor to carry over to the next one.
* {{c|Bethany|r}}: Breaking Notched Axe and using a Soul Charge to activate it again will allow for a single use before immediately breaking.
* {{Book of Belial synergy|description=The axe receives a purplish glow and receives the following upgrades:
** '''Increased durability''': Each use of the axe has a very high chance not to use a charge.
** '''Faster usage''': The axe can be swung up to four times per second, regardless of Judas' tears stat.
** '''Higher knockback''': Enemies are [[knock-back|knocked back]] when hit, receiving ''8 + 0.2 × floor'' damage if they collide with a wall, obstacle, or other enemies.
** '''Fire effect''': The axe will set enemies on fire. The burn deals damage equal to Judas' damage, and ticks up to 5 times.
** '''Increased luck''': destroying obstacles with the axe has an increased chance to spawn pickups.
*** Destroying {{g|Poop}}s will spawn pickups much more frequently. When combined with {{t|Petrified Poop}}, the chance becomes 100% and will often result in multiple pickups from a single poop.
*** Destroying [[Tinted Rock]]s will drop more consumables than usual, similarly to [[Rocks#Super Special Rocks|Super Special Rocks]].
*** Destroying [[Rocks#Urns|Props]] (such as [[Urn]]s, [[Mushroom]]s, [[Skull]]s, and [[Polyp]]s) gives the prop an extra chance to drop its rewards. This can result in a single prop giving multiple drops.
*** Destroying [[Fool's Gold]] rocks will drop significantly more coins.}}
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=When used with the Book of Virtues, breaking obstacles has a chance to generate wisps that have different effects based on the "mineral" mined, from most common to least common:
** Dip wisp (can only be obtained from poop): Fires brown tears that deal 1.5 damage and has extremely low health.
** Black wisp: Fires black tears that have the effect of {{I|A Lump of Coal}} and deal 2.5 damage.
** Silver wisp: Fires metallic tears that have the effect of {{I|Iron Bar}} and deal 4 damage.
** Gold wisp: Fires penny tears that can turn enemies gold similar to {{I|Midas' Touch}} and deal 3.5 damage.
** Red wisp: Fires laser tears similar to the ones fired by {{I|Technology}} and deal 3.5 damage.
** Blue wisp: Fires diamond tears similar to the ones fired by {{I|Crown Of Light}} that deal 7 damage.}}
* {{t|Broken Padlock}}: Allows the Notched Axe to open locked chests and doors. The opening of chests does not use durability, however it will consume a key if Isaac has any.
* {{i|Ipecac|r}}: Melee attacks will trigger an explosion when they makes contact with an enemy; unlike with the Forgotten's bone club, Isaac ''will'' take damage from these Ipecac explosions.
* {{i|Iron Bar|r}}: Fully recharges the axe when picked up.
* {{i|Technology|r}}: Melee attacks will cause a technology laser ring to appear around Isaac, damaging enemies.
sections.Interactions:

* {{T|Found Soul}}: Found Soul gets a Notched Axe that breaks after a single use. If Notched Axe is dropped and picked up again, Found Soul will be able to use it again.

* {{i|Technology}}/{{i|Technology 2}}: Allows the laser to go through objects.

sections.Effects:
* On pickup, fully [[Health#Red Heart Containers|heals]] Isaac and gives him a temporary +21.6 [[damage]] up.
** The damage upgrade scales down to 0 over the course of three minutes. Due to how the [[Damage#Effective Damage|damage formula]] works, the damage upgrade scales down faster over time, starting at -~0.015 per half second and increasing to -~.1 per half second as the bonus approaches 0.
** While Red Stew is active, Isaac gains an effect similar to {{i|Lusty Blood}}, gaining a small damage bonus every time he kills an enemy. This damage bonus persists between rooms and floors, allowing Isaac to sustain the temporary damage up for longer than he otherwise would if he manages to kill many enemies. This effect disappears once Red Stew's damage bonus completely runs out.
sections.Notes:
* Due to the high amount of damage you temporarily gain, this item is extremely effective in [[Greed Mode]], as all fights are done within the same room and you are easily able to make the most out of it.
* The damage bonuses on kills can exceed the damage increase given from picking up Red Stew.
* The default length of Red Stew is 5390 game frames, which is just short of 3 minutes. (This will be the length if no enemies are killed during the effect.)
sections.Synergies: * {{i|Rock Bottom}}: The damage up becomes permanent and if Isaac kills enemies fast enough it can increase even further. It would be difficult to gain further damages 3 minutes later, but the first damage up is so high that this isn't a real problem.
sections.Interactions:
* [[Cards and Runes|Ace Cards]]: Turning enemies into [[pickup]]s doesn’t grant the damage bonus.
* {{i|E. Coli}}/{{i|Flush!}}: Turning enemies into poop doesn’t grant the damage bonus.
* [[Freeze|Freeze Effects]]: Enemies that die from being frozen don't grant the damage bonus.
** {{dlc|r+}} Frozen enemies do grant the damage bonus.
* {{i|Red Stew}}: Picking up another stew will reset the bonus to its full amount.
* {{C|Tainted Bethany}}: Grants 12 blood charges.

sections.Effects:
* Grants a random aura around Isaac that grants a boost depending on the aura's color:
** '''Red''': +4 [[damage]].
** {{dlc|nr}} '''Blue''': -4 [[tear delay]].
** {{dlc|r}} '''Blue''': +2.0 [[fire rate]].
** '''Yellow''': +0.5 [[speed]].
*** {{dlc|nr}} Also affects maximum speed (may never exceed 2.0).
** {{dlc|nr}} '''Orange''': +7.5 [[range]], +1.0 [[tear falling speed]].
** {{dlc|r}} '''Orange''': +3.0 [[range]].
* Taking damage causes the aura to disappear. When the next room is entered, the aura will reappear with a random color.
sections.Notes:
* The tear delay boost can allow the player's tears to go over the normal maximum [[tear delay|rate of fire]].
* {{dlc+|r}} If {{C|Tainted Isaac}} swaps Purity for another item and picks it back up again, it will have a different aura.{{dlc-}}
sections.Interactions: * {{i|Diplopia}}/{{i|Crooked Penny}}: Holding multiple copies of Purity will still only grant one aura, providing no additional benefit.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a {{E|Mulligan}} [[familiar]] that walks around the [[room]] and acts as a decoy for [[monsters]].
* If the monsters are closer to the decoy than Isaac, they will attack the decoy.
* {{dlc|r}} Homing shots from enemies will always be attracted to the decoy if they are closer to it than Isaac.
* {{dlc|nar+}} Punching Bag will also block enemy shots.
* {{dlc|ana+}} Punching Bag will die after taking too much damage and eventually respawn after a long time. Exiting and continuing the run will cause it to reappear right away.
** {{dlc|ana+}} Punching Bag will reappear instantly each time a familiar or orbital item is picked up.
sections.Notes:
* The Punching Bag will be targeted by enemies if it is closer to them than Isaac, for up to 6 seconds. Then they will target Isaac for 6 seconds regardless of distance, before acknowledging the Punching Bag again.
* {{dlc|ana+}} The Punching Bag will die instantly by enemies' beam-type attacks, such as {{i|Brimstone}} or by {{E|Uriel}}'s and {{E|Gabriel}}'s beam. This also includes enemies' {{i|Technology}} lasers such as {{E|Eye}} and {{E|Camillo Jr.}}
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Box of Friends}}: Adds another Punching Bag. This may cause enemies to become unpredictable, so use with caution.
** If the Punching Bag has died, it can be forced to respawn with a double upon using the Box of Friends.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a special set of spikes in the {{r|Devil Room}}. They deal 1 full heart of damage per use.
* Taking damage from the spikes has a chance to grant a reward.

sections.Notes:
* The spikes will appear in the current {{r|Devil Room}} upon picking up Sanguine Bond.
* The spikes will deal damage to enemies that walk or fly over them, including {{E|Krampus}}.
** As Krampus often spawns in the center of the room, it will deal a significant amount of damage to him, almost killing him completely.
* The item causes all other spikes in the {{r|Devil Room}} to retract.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Goat Head}}: Allows Isaac to enter and leave the Devil Room at will, making this item substantially more powerful, as red hearts can be collected throughout the floor.
** {{I|Goat Head}} + {{I|Scapular}}: The spikes generated by Sanguine Bond can be farmed infinitely.
*** Quitting and reloading the game will also reset the soul heart regeneration provided by {{I|Scapular}}, thus negating the need for {{I|Goat Head}}.
* {{c|Keeper}} / {{c|Tainted Keeper}} / {{i|Strawman}}: The pennies that are spawned when stepping on the spikes can be used to heal Keeper and infinitely farm rewards.
* {{I|Placenta}}: With a lot of time, the spikes can be farmed infinitely.
* {{I|Portable Slot}}: The pennies that are spawned can be gambled to give hearts, allowing more uses.
* {{I|The Wafer}} / [[Pills|Percs]]: Hearts will last twice as long, allowing more uses. Further uses may be obtained by sacrificing the black hearts given, and any hearts added from devil room items.
sections.Interactions:
* {{t|Callus}}: Will not prevent the damage from spikes created by Sanguine Bond.
* {{t|Flat File}}: Retracts the spikes. The trinket must be dropped and the Devil Deal re-entered for the spikes to appear again.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a fly [[orbital familiar]] that chases and blocks enemy shots.
** After a certain amount of shots are blocked, it enters a short cooldown period where it still blocks shots, but does not actively chase them.
* Psy Fly also deals 1 contact damage to enemies per tick (15 per second).
* Instantly kills some [[Fly]] enemies upon contact.
** Flies affected include: {{E|Army Fly}}, {{E|Attack Fly}}, {{E|Fly}}, {{E|Ring Fly}}, {{E|Swarm}}, and {{E|Willo}}.
* {{transformation contribution|Beelzebub}}
sections.Notes:
* While Psy Fly is an effective means of projectile protection, it is not immunity, and recklessly wading into a barrage of shots can easily result in taking damage.
* Psy Fly will block most types of projectiles, not just red bullets. This includes the fires from {{E|Mega Satan}} phase 2, the bone projectiles {{E|Bony|text=Bonies}} throw, {{i|Ipecac}} shots from {{e|Gurgle}}s and similar enemies, or even the rocks that the {{E|Kineti}} throws at you.
** {{i|Ipecac}} shots still explode if blocked by Psy Fly.

sections.Effect:
* Grants one full Red [[Heart container]].
* {{Dlc|r}} Heals 1 additional {{e|Red Heart}}.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|r}} This item can rarely drop from destroying [[Rocks#Polyps|polyps]] in {{s|Corpse}}.{{dlc-}}
* This item has a 12.6% chance to spawn from paying out a {{e|Beggar}} in addition to being in the [[Beggar (Item Pool)|Beggar item pool]]. Multiple copies can be obtained through this method.
sections.Synergies: * {{i|Binge Eater}}: When Isaac picks up Rotten Meat it now grants: a permanent +1.0 [[Damage]] and +2.5 [[Range]], a temporary +3.6 [[Damage]] (which diminishes to 0 in 30 seconds), heals 1 additional red heart, and takes a permanent -0.03 [[Speed]] reduction.

sections.Effect:
* Spawns a [[familiar]] that shoots [[spectral tears|spectral]] {{i|Technology}} lasers that deal 3.5 damage each.
** {{dlc|nr}} Robo-Baby shoots once per second.
** {{dlc|r}} Robo-Baby shoots 1.36 times a second.
* {{transformation contribution|Conjoined}}
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|r}} [[Familiar]]s that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars. 
** {{dlc|nr+}} Robo-Baby has 5th priority.
** {{dlc|r+}} Robo-Baby has 7th priority.
sections.Synergies: * {{I|Mongo Baby}}: Will copy Robo-Baby’s tears.

sections.Effects:
* {{dlc|nr}} Doubles Isaac's [[damage]] stat.
* {{dlc|r}} +0.5 damage.
* Tear size multiplier: 2x.
* {{dlc|nr}} The tears shrink and lose damage the farther they travel.
* {{dlc|r}} The tears shrink and lose damage the more time they stay airborne, starting at 3x damage at point blank range. After 0.8 seconds, they deal no damage at all.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|nr}} Effective range of Isaac's tears now also depends on the damage, as they can shrink out of existence before their air time runs out.
* {{dlc|r}} Since tears run out of damage after 0.8 seconds (48 frames), shot speed is the only stat that determines the effective range of Isaac's tears. Damage and range don't affect the travel distance at all.
* {{dlc|r}} Approximately 2.08% damage is lost per frame. This means at approximately 0.53 seconds (32 frames) Isaac's tears will deal the normal amount of damage.
* {{dlc|nr}} Tear size increasing items also increase the maximum distance before its disappearance, but the damage dealt can go below original at the extreme.
* {{dlc|nr}} The damage decrease does not affect {{C|Azazel}}'s short-ranged {{i|Brimstone}} unless the range stat is ''extremely'' high.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Anti-Gravity}}: The tears will not decrease in size or damage until they start moving, making this excellent against enemies that chase Isaac.
** '''Anti-Gravity''' + {{i|Eye of the Occult}}: Lets Isaac maintain the full 3× damage multiplier while controlling his tears.
** '''Anti-Gravity''' + {{i|Spoon Bender}}: Tears will move towards enemies while maintaining the full 3× damage multiplier, negating both the need to release tears and the power decrease with distance.
* {{i|Brimstone}}: Retains the double damage effect without losing damage over range.
** {{dlc|a}} Damage is doubled again for a total of 4x next to Isaac, but quickly drops further along the beam, at about 0.8x per tile of distance, reaching its minimum of 0.1 per tick roughly at 8 tiles.
** {{dlc|r}} The beam does 6x damage at point blank range. 
* {{i|C Section}}: Fetuses deal triple their usual damage (2.25× Isaac's damage) at point blank, but shrink and deal less damage over time.
** '''C Section''' + {{i|Mom's Knife}}: The knives shrink along with the fetuses, but they retain their tripled damage.
** '''C Section''' + {{i|Tech X|n}}: The rings shrink along with the fetuses, but they retain their tripled damage.
** '''C Section''' + {{i|Technology}}: Although the laser's damage diminishes along with the fetus, it does not lose its damage over range.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}}/{{i|Epic Fetus}}: {{dlc|nr}} Doubles damage with no penalty for distance.
** {{dlc|r}} Triples/quadruples damage respectively.
* {{i|Godhead}}: The damaging halo shrinks with the tears.
* {{i|A Lump of Coal}}: Proptosis scales with Isaac's damage while the Lump of Coal does not. At base damage, the Lump of Coal will approximately negate the damage lost over distance, but with increased damage, tears still do more damage up close.
** '''A Lump of Coal''' + {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: The controlled tear has full Proptosis damage buff, {{dlc|nr}} no matter how far it is from Isaac. {{dlc|r}} Very slightly decreases damage from far away.
** {{dlc|r}} If the damage stat is extremely low through methods such as combining {{i|Soy Milk}} with {{i|20/20}}, it can cause the tear to gain Proptosis's triple damage while still having the tear grow from A Lump of Coal's effects.
* {{i|Mom's Knife}}: The Knife damage is {{dlc|nr}} doubled ({{dlc|r}} tripled), regardless of range.
* {{i|Polyphemus}}: Tears do massive damage and carry with leftover damage while still shrinking.
* {{i|Technology}}/{{i|Technology 2}}: Doubles damage.
** {{dlc|a}} The beam decreases in damage and width the farther it travels. Tears become virtually powerless across large rooms like the Boss Rush and the Hush fight, reaching its minimum of 0.1 roughly at 8 tiles.
** {{dlc|r}} The beams do 6x damage at point blank range.
* {{i|Tech X}}: Ring size and damage is substantially increased, but decreases as the ring travels further from Isaac.
* {{i|Trisagion|a+nr}}: Base damage is doubled and beam damage is boosted to about 65%. Blasts lose no power as they travel further, though the tips of the blasts deal very slightly less damage.
** {{dlc|r}} Damage slightly increased, beam damage is doubled. Blasts lose no power with distance.
* {{I|Bird's Eye}}: Size and damage of fires is increased, but does not decrease with range.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Athame}}/{{i|Maw Of The Void}}: The ring is much larger and deals 1.5× damage.
** {{dlc|a+}} The ring deals normal damage.
** {{dlc|r}} The ring is now normal size.
* {{dlc|r}}{{i|Broken Watch|n}}: The speedup effect applies to tears and increases the effective range.
* {{i|Compound Fracture}}/{{i|Cricket's Body}}/{{i|The Parasite}}: Tears will often disappear before they can burst. Tears created from bursts will also shrink, but due to their already low range, the difference may not be noticeable.
* {{dlc|r}}[[Era Walk]] card/[[I'm Drowsy...]] pill/{{i|Stop Watch|n}}: The slowdown effect applies to tears and reduces the effective range of Proptosis.
* {{i|Flat Stone}}: At base range and tear size, tears will bounce twice against the floor and then disappear.
* {{I|Immaculate Heart}}: Tears that appear around Isaac disappear quickly.
* {{i|Ipecac}}: Tears almost disappear completely but are still able to do massive damage.
** {{dlc|r}} Tears no longer deal massive damage at the end of the arch. Damage decreases rapidly with range.
* {{i|Isaac's Heart}} is a very good item to have, as you can run up to most enemies to deal maximum damage to them with little downside.
* {{i|Lachryphagy}}: Tears disappear too quickly to be fed.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: The closer the tear floats to Isaac, the larger it is. The farther away, the smaller it becomes.
* {{i|Monstro's Lung}}/{{i|Lead Pencil}}: Tears will disappear at different distances depending on how big they were when fired.
* {{i|My Reflection}}: Tears disappear before they can return to Isaac.
* {{i|Pop!}}: Tears will disappear extremely quickly after being fired.
* {{i|Saturnus}} The ring tears from Saturnus disappear nearly instantly upon entering a room.
* {{i|Soy Milk}}: '''Very poor combination.''' Tears disappear nearly instantly in front of Isaac, decreasing his range and damage to nearly nothing.
** {{dlc|r}} Tears no longer disappear instantly. Range is only minimally shorter.

sections.Effects: * Grants Isaac 99 {{E|Bomb}}s on pickup.
sections.Notes:
* Rerolling this item with the {{i|D4}}, etc., will not remove 99 Bombs.
* This item can appear when using the {{P|0 - The Fool?}} with 99 bombs in inventory.
* {{dlc|r}} As {{C|Tainted ???|n}} cannot use bombs, this item has no effect. No extra poop pickups are granted.

{{cit|p|a}} All characters start with '''Restock''' in [[Greed mode]].

sections.Effects:
* Upon purchasing an item from the {{R|Shop}}, a new purchasable item is added to the store's inventory.
** [[Collectible]]s created correspond to the [[Shop (Item Pool)|shop's item pool]].
* {{dlc|nr}} Drops 3 random pickups around Isaac.
* {{dlc|r}} Outside of [[Greed Mode]], the restocked item's cost is increased after each purchase.
** For [[items]], the price increase is 2 coins times the number of purchases. For example, an item starting at 15 cents would next be +2 to 17, then +4 to 21, +6 to 27, etc. The cost follows the formula 15+n(n+1) with n being the number of times restock has triggered.
** For everything else, the price increase is 1 coin times the number of purchases. For example, a heart starting at 3 cents would be +1 to 4, +2 to 6, +3 to 9 etc. This follows the formula (original price)+(n(n+1))/2
** The increase is not affected by discounts occurring naturally or through {{i|Steam Sale}}: costs will increase at the same rate, though the base price is still discounted. Once the item's cost goes over what it would naturally be, the price is no longer highlighted red.
** The maximum price is 99 cents.
* A small restock icon appears under the map, just like {{I|Treasure Map}}, {{I|Blue Map}}, {{I|The Compass}} {{dlc|r}} and any active [[curses]].
sections.Notes:
* All characters start with a permanent copy of this item in [[Greed Mode]]. It cannot be removed or rerolled by any means.
* {{dlc|nr}} If used with {{i|IV Bag}}/{{e|Blood Donation Machine}} and an item which can spawn additional coins ({{t|Counterfeit Penny}}, {{t|Swallowed Penny}}, {{i|Humbleing Bundle}}, etc.), infinite money can be produced by buying hearts for 3 coins and getting more than 3 coins back after donating health.
* When purchasing Restock from a Shop, the slot that Restock was purchased from will not be restocked.
* Restock does not affect {{R|Black Market}}s, purchasable items generated via {{i|The Stairway}} and purchasable items generated by {{i|A Pound of Flesh}} that cost coins.
* {{dlc|a+}} Purchasing an item that is on sale will replace it with another that is on sale.
sections.Synergies:
* {{p|2 of Diamonds}} + {{i|Blank Card}}:
** {{dlc+|anr}} [[Coins]] can be infinitely generated by buying {{E|Lil' Battery|text=Lil' Batteries}}. As Lil' Batteries only cost 5 coins, as long as Isaac starts with at least 11, the maximum of 99 coins can be quickly reached.{{dlc-}}
** {{dlc+|r}} This cannot be repeated infinitely outside of Greed Mode, as '''Restock''' now increases the price of a shop slot each time something is purchased from it.
*** {{i|Deep Pockets}} allows this to once again be repeated infinitely, as the price will cap at 99 coins, while up to 999 coins can be obtained.{{dlc-}}
* {{dlc|nr}} {{i|Steam Sale}} x2: Items can be infinitely bought from shops.
* {{i|Blank Card}} + {{p|2 of Diamonds}}: {{dlc|nr}} If a {{E|Lil' Battery}} is on sale, items can be bought infinitely.
** {{dlc|r}} If a {{E|Lil' Battery}} is on sale, Isaac can buy a lot of items before the prices become too high in that shop.
* {{i|Chaos}}: Restock is affected by Chaos, and can be used to obtain otherwise rare items.
** {{dlc|nr}} '''Chaos''' + {{i|Steam Sale}} x2: Items can be bought infinitely, allowing Isaac to theoretically obtain every item in the game.
* {{i|Keeper's Box}}: Buying spawned pickup or item in {{R|Shop}} will always restock into the same thing as what being sold in the upper left of the shop and their prices will never increase. This still works even if the top left slot already brought and allowed to change the top left spot with restock machine to items or your desired pickups. This does not work outside of the shop.
* {{i|Member Card}}: Items bought in the separate shop will also be restocked.
* {{i|A Pound of Flesh}}: Restocked items in a shop will still require hearts to be bought. 
** If playing as {{c|The Lost}}, {{c|Tainted Lost|n}}, or if currently affected by {{p|Soul of the Lost|n}} / {{e|White Fire Place|n}}, items can be bought indefinitely.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Coupon}}/{{P|Credit Card}}: Items made free will not be restocked, even while playing [[Greed Mode]].
* {{i|Mr. ME!|r}}: Items stolen by Mr. ME! will be not restocked, even while playing [[Greed Mode]].

sections.Effects:
* Greatly increased [[damage]]: <math display="inline">{(Damage + 4) \times 2}</math>
* {{dlc|nr}} [[Tears]] down: <math display="inline">{(Delay \times 2.1) + 3}</math>
* {{dlc|r}} Tears fired per second * 0.42.
* If a tear kills an enemy and has left over damage, the tear travels on with the remaining damage.
sections.Notes: * {{dlc|nr}} Polyphemus is a [[special item]].
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|20/20|r}}: Damage is reduced and tear rate is increased.
* {{i|Abyss}}: When Polyphemus is picked up instead of being converted into a locust, it grants all of Abyss's locusts the high damage up without suffering the tears down allowing Isaac to increase his damage rate substantially the more items he uses Abyss on.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}}: Increases tear delay, and after the first bomb explodes, a second bomb appears where the first one exploded, doing roughly half the damage of the first.
* {{i|The Inner Eye}}/{{i|Mutant Spider}}/{{I|C Section}}: The tear rate is not lowered further, but the effect on damage becomes a flat +5 bonus instead.
* {{C|The Forgotten}}: The Forgotten's bone club becomes massive. It deals very high damage but has a very low swing rate.
* {{i|Rock Bottom}}: Allows Isaac to keep his previous fire rate in addition to the massive damage boost.
* {{i|Shard of Glass|r}}: The rapidly spawning red tears do full damage.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Haemolacria}}: The main tear retains the semi-piercing ability and may not burst when hitting a weaker enemy. Split tears do not semi-pierce.
* {{i|Lachryphagy}}: Greatly increases how big the fed tear can grow.
* {{i|Lost Contact}}: Isaac's tears will block enemy shots and continue, but lose 10 damage. If the tear had less than 10 damage left, it disappears.
* [[Piercing tears]]: Semi-piercing is replaced by proper piercing, with no loss of damage on any enemy contact.
* {{i|Polyphemus}}: No further effect when multiple copies are acquired.

sections.Effect:
* Gives Isaac a sideways dagger that [[orbital familiar|orbits]] him, dealing high damage to enemies on contact and blocking enemy shots.
** {{dlc|nr}} The knife deals 15 damage every 1/15th of a second (every 4 frames) or 225 damage per second.
** {{dlc|r}} The knife deals 15 damage every 2/15ths of a second (every 8 frames) or 112.5 damage per second.
sections.Notes: * The dagger orbits further away from Isaac than many other orbital familiars (minus {{i|Big Fan}}), making it easier to use both offensively and defensively.

sections.Effects:
* Replaces Isaac's tears with eyeballs that can bounce off of each other.
* Isaac's tears are no longer limited by [[range]], and will instead dissipate when they stop moving or when hitting an enemy or obstacle.
* {{dlc|r}} Eyeball tears will start to fall to the ground after bouncing off of each other 8 times.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Anti-Gravity}}: Tears will force each other out of the way if placed on top of another tear. Releasing the trigger button propels the tears in the direction Isaac was firing at the time before slowing down to a stop.
* {{c|Azazel|r}}/{{i|Brimstone}}/{{c|Tainted Azazel}}/{{i|Technology 2}}: Fires out multiple Pop! tears at the end of the laser, which is dramatically shortened.
** {{i|Brimstone}} + {{C|Tainted Azazel}}: The beam is shortened to around double the range of Azazel's, while a constant stream of red eyeballs come out of the end.
* {{i|Continuum}}: The tears will bump into each other, increasing in speed as they go through the room until they dissipate or hit an enemy.
** {{i|Tractor Beam}} + '''Continuum''': Occasionally, some tears will glitch out of their position for a short while. Contact with an enemy while a glitched tear is on-screen will fling Isaac to a corner of the room. This can potentially cause a softlock if Isaac is blocked by obstacles and does not have {{i|How to Jump}} or flight to escape. Bombs will not work either, as the explosion will not trigger despite the sound of one playing once the bomb sets off.<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=miHh3IdfNM4</ref>
* {{i|Compound Fracture}}/{{i|Cricket's Body}}: Split tears can also be knocked around.
* {{I|Eye of the Occult}}: Tears will continuously try to follow the crosshair, virtually extending their lifespan ad infinitum until they hit an enemy or obstacle. This can cause tears to quickly fill the room.
* {{i|Godhead}}: Tears gain a damaging aura and become damaging aura fields.
** '''Godhead''' + {{i|A Lump of Coal}}: Tears will quickly fill up the screen and increase in damage, easily killing any enemy.
* {{i|Haemolacria}}: Tears fire a burst of smaller tears in random directions when hitting an obstacle or stopping and falling to the ground.
* {{i|Immaculate Heart}}: Tears that orbit Isaac will be constantly moving and therefore will never disappear until they hit an enemy or Isaac leaves the room. Filling the orbit with enough tears can potentially cause a chaotic, vibrating ring of eyeballs enveloping Isaac as the tears constantly collide with one another.
* {{i|Ipecac}}: Tears do not arc and will instead shoot straight. They retain their explosive abilities on impact with enemies or obstacles, or when they eventually fall.  Tears also do not explode when bouncing off of each other, which can be used to propel the high-powered tears to other enemies.
* {{i|Lead Pencil}}/{{i|Monstro's Lung}}: Removes the arcing effect from the tears, greatly increasing air time. The tight cluster the tears are shot in will cause unpredictable spread, however.
* {{i|A Lump of Coal}}: Tears will increase their damage and size as they travel, and they are not limited by range.
* {{i|My Reflection}}: Tears constantly swarm around Isaac, quickly filling the room.
* {{i|The Parasite}}: When tears hit an enemy, obstacle, or wall, they split into many smaller tears that have the same behavior as eyeball tears.
* {{i|Rubber Cement}}: Allows tears to never disappear when hitting enemies and objects, increasing the uptime of tears greatly.
** '''Rubber Cement''' + '''A Lump Of Coal''': Tears continuously increase in size and damage as they bounce endlessly around the room. Eventually the damage can be enough to kill bosses in a single frame.
* {{dlc|r}} {{i|Tech.5}}/{{i|Technology}}/{{i|Technology 2}}: The laser's range is drastically reduced, and an eyeball is created at the end of the laser each shot.
** {{dlc|r}}{{i|Technology}} + {{i|Monstro's Lung}} Lung will fire laser beams as normal, but Pop eyeballs will appaear at the tail end of every shot, including obstacles hit by the beams.
* {{dlc|r}} {{I|Tiny Planet}}: With enough tears and/or fire rate, the Pop! tears can constantly collide with each other, causing them to orbit Isaac indefinitely.
* {{i|Trisagion|r}}: Every damage tick will shoot out a Pop! tear making this synergy a potent combination. Trisagion shots will also hover in the air longer than normal.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Angelic Prism}}: The Prism will split eyeballs that it passes over.

sections.Effects:
* Adds a chance to fire tears that mark enemies with the [[Status Effects#Bait|Bait]] status effect. Enemies marked as bait will move slower and be attacked by other enemies until it is killed or the effect wears off.
* Tears that apply the effect are red.
sections.Notes:
* The chance to fire marking tears depends on the [[luck]] stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: <math>\frac1 { 6 - \left \lceil \mathit{Luck}  \right \rceil}</math>
** At base luck (0), the chance is 16.67%, maxing out at 100% at 4.01 luck.
* Causes pathing issues with segmented bosses, as they attempt to attack their own segments.
* Most enemies will ignore Isaac in order to attack a baited enemy, making Rotten Tomato an item with both offensive and defensive applications.
* With a high enough luck stat and piercing effects, the uptime of the bait effect can be enough to render some bosses harmless, such as {{E|Ultra Pestilence}} or {{E|The Duke of Flies}} who spawn a multitude of flies that it will then focus on.
* This item is very effective during {{R|Boss Rush}}. Boss enemies affected by this item will deal massive amounts of damage to each other and Isaac will be less likely to get hurt by their attacks.
* Due to the nature of [[Mother]]'s hitbox, the bait effect will cause Mother to often shoot herself in her second phase causing a lot of her attacks to be nullified.
* Enemies and entities normally non-affected by status effects like the {{e|Stone Grimace}} or {{e|Red Fire Place}} will target the baited enemies.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Brimstone}}: Firing can mark enemies as bait.
* {{I|Dr. Fetus}}: Fired bombs can mark enemies as bait.
* {{I|Jacob's Ladder}}: Chaining electricity arcs can mark enemies as bait.

sections.Effects:
* Prevents Isaac's [[attributes]] from falling below their highest values reached.
** Attributes continue to be calculated normally internally. Rather than use Isaac's current stats, items and effects will impact Isaac the same way they would as if he did not have Rock Bottom.
sections.Notes:
* Health downs do not count as stat downgrades for Rock Bottom.
* Temporary buffs work normally, though they may make reaching new best values harder after the buff has worn off.
** For example, using {{i|The Book of Belial}} to gain +2 damage will stay in effect indefinitely, but while it's not currently activated, Isaac must earn more than +2 damage from other items to see a difference. The Book of Belial can then be used once again to stack on top of that new floor, so the damage "lost" to make up for the original temporary bonus isn't really wasted.
** Stacking as many temporary buffs at once as possible may be helpful to reach particularly high values.
** Temporary positive multipliers are ''not'' retained, only the values reached through them are.
* Stat penalties are accounted for, causing increased difficulty of reaching new best values.
** Optimally, any available increases to a particular stat should be taken before taking the item that lowers it.
** Permanent negative multipliers, such as {{i|Soy Milk}}, work as expected: after the internal damage value is dropped to 0.2×, it would require over 5× increase in damage from other items and effects afterwards to start increasing the best value again.
* If Rock Bottom is removed, Isaac's stats will no longer be locked and return to match his current items/effects.
sections.Synergies:
Refer to the articles on [[Damage]], [[Tears]], [[Range]], [[Shot Speed]], [[Speed]], and [[Luck]] for lists of items granting otherwise temporary boosts.

* {{t|Azazel's Stump}}: Isaac will keep Azazel’s base stats after transforming back. This includes 1.25 base speed, +0.5 tears per second, and a 1.5× damage. The tear delay multiplier will not be given, including while Isaac is Azazel.
* {{i|Berserk!}}: +3 flat damage and +0.4 speed last indefinitely. Will also give a tears up if (½ tears fired per second + 2), unless Isaac’s tears fired per second is already 4 or higher.

* {{i|Brimstone}} / {{i|Chocolate Milk}} / {{i|Monstro's Lung}}: Charged shot can be fired at Isaac’s normal fire rate.
* {{p|VII - The Chariot?}}: The 4x fire rate bonus from the card makes it possible to reach and keep extremely high values.
* {{i|Clicker}}: Will keep stat bonuses from items removed, and will retain the best stats of all characters that are cycled through.
* {{i|D8}} / {{t|Cracked Dice}}: With repeated use, 1.5-2× higher values can be applied to Isaac’s speed, tears, range, and damage.
* {{i|Dataminer}}: If one overflows Isaac's tear rate to 120 before picking up Rock Bottom, the tear rate stays at 120.

* {{c|The Forgotten}} / {{c|The Soul}}: Allows transfer of stat-ups between the two. For example, collecting Ipecac as The Forgotten doesn't give him the +40 damage boost, but it does give it to The Soul. Switching to the Soul, then switching back to the Forgotten prevents him from losing the +40 damage.
* {{i|Ipecac}}: Gives Isaac a massive damage up without the tears down.

Picking it up again will not give the stats back.

* {{Dlc|nr}} There is no limit to the number of fires that can be active. This is useful in situations where mob spawning can be controlled: for example, beating {{R|Boss Rush}} or [[Greed Mode]] as {{C|The Lost}}. This is time-consuming but can be viable if other sources of damage are weak or unreliable.
* {{Dlc|nr}} It will block Isaac's tears but won't burn him. Isaac's tears can also shrink the size of the flame.
* {{dlc|r}} Flames do not block Isaac's shots, nor are they put out by them.
* Flames will destroy {{e|Shopkeeper}}s.
* {{dlc|r}} Flames will turn certain enemies (such as {{E|Hopper}}s and {{E|Clotty|text=Clotties}}) into their flaming variants, making them stronger. The flame is unable to damage these monsters.
sections.Synergies: * {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns red wisps in the middle ring. The wisps shoot small flames instead of tears, with a very high tear delay; flames last for 5 seconds or until they block 2 shots and/or deal 2 ticks of damage. The wisps do not persist between rooms, and the damage they deal does not increase with {{I|BFFS!}} or scale up on later floors.}}
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Car Battery}}: {{dlc|r+}} Spawns a second flame that travels a shorter distance.
* {{dlc+|nr}}{{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: When the fire hits the tear, the tear resets and appears again on the player.{{dlc-}}

sections.Effects: * Grants [[flight]]. * {{dlc|nr+}} Grants 2 {{E|Soul Heart}}s on pickup. * Continuously firing for 2.35 seconds allows Isaac to fire a powerful holy laser when Isaac stops shooting, similar to the attacks used by the [[Angel]] bosses. ** The laser deals Isaac's [[damage]] per tick (up to a maximum of 15 times) and can be aimed diagonally. It lasts for ~1.28 seconds (77 frames). *** With the EnableMouseControl enabled or an analog controller, the laser can be aimed in any direction, similarly to {{I|Analog Stick}}. * {{transformation contribution|Seraphim}}
sections.Notes:
* Tear delay has no effect on the charge time of the laser; it is fixed at 2.35 seconds.
* This item's effects will still work while [[Blindfolded]], which makes it extremely valuable for {{c|Lilith}} and in [[challenges]] such as {{chal|BRAINS!}} or {{chal|Hot Potato}}.
* Many of '''Revelation''''s [[#Synergies|synergies]] are similar to {{I|Brimstone}}'s.
* Having any charged tear effects like {{I|Monstro's Lung}} or '''Brimstone''' will lower their DPS if their charge time is under 2.35 seconds, in order to use Revelation's laser.
sections.Synergies:
* Revelation, {{I|Maw Of The Void}}, {{I|No. 2}}, and {{I|Montezuma's Revenge}} all have the same charge time, allowing Isaac to easily utilize them at the same time.
* {{I|Angelic Prism}}: When the laser hits the prism, it will split in four.
* {{T|Brain Worm}}: The laser can bend completely to hit an enemy, effectively acting as a better form of homing on single enemies and bosses.
* {{I|Continuum}} The laser loops around. The laser cannot hit the same enemy twice.
* {{I|Cricket's Body}}: Spawns 4 split tears on the first enemy or obstacle the laser hits every other tick. The tears are [[Piercing]] and deal half damage of the laser. They can hit the same enemy the laser hit.
* {{I|Eve's Mascara}} / {{I|Polyphemus}}: As the laser deals Isaac’s damage, but is not affected by tear delay, the DPS of the laser is greatly increased.
* [[Homing tears]]: The laser will home in on enemies in a very effective way.
* {{I|Lachryphagy}}: The laser has reduced range, but spawns a red Lachryphagy tear per tick. The tears are Piercing and deal the damage of the laser. They can hit the same enemy the laser hit.
* {{I|Marked}}: The laser is fired automatically upon reaching full charge in the direction of the mark. Combined with charged attacks, this allows them to keep their DPS.
* {{I|Multidimensional Baby}}: The baby can duplicate the laser.
** Multidimensional Baby + {{I|Lachryphagy}} / {{I|Pop!}}: Lasers modified by Multidimensional Baby are no longer affected by Lachryphagy or Pop!, being normal length and not firing additional tears/eyes out the end.
* {{I|The Parasite}}: Spawns two perpendicular lasers on the first enemy or obstacle the laser hits. The laser and its split lasers cannot hit the same enemy.
** {{dlc|r+}} Also spawn small split tears.
* {{I|Pop!}}: The laser has reduced range, but shoots out an eyeball per tick. The tears are Piercing and deal the damage of the laser. They can hit the same enemy the laser hit.
* {{I|Proptosis}}: The beam deals ~2.47× Isaac's Damage at point blank range.
* {{I|Rubber Cement}}: The laser will bounce off the walls for a short distance.
* {{I|Tiny Planet}}: The laser will wrap around Isaac once and then shoot straight forward.
* {{I|Jacob's Ladder}}: Upon hitting an enemy, wall or obstacle, the beam generates sparks that home in on enemies.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|Anti-Gravity}}: The laser fires in place, not following Isaac.
* {{I|Almond Milk}}: Unlike charged attacks, the laser cannot be fired automatically. As the laser deals Isaac’s damage, but is not affected by tear delay, the DPS of the laser is greatly decreased. The laser do not gain worm trinket effects.
* {{I|Diplopia}}: Multiple copies of Revelation have no extra effect.
* {{I|Explosivo}} / {{I|Mucormycosis}} / {{I|Sinus Infection}}: No effect.
* {{i|Eye of the Occult}}: No effect.
** '''Eye of the Occult''' + {{i|Brimstone}}/{{i|Technology}}: The Revelation beam also automatically fires at the crosshair.
* {{I|Ipecac}}: The laser will poison enemies and repeatedly explode on contact with an enemy or obstacle. Despite its high damage increase, Ipecac only adds +2 damage to the beam, similarly to {{I|Brimstone}}.
* {{I|Kidney Stone}}: The laser can be fired as normal while the kidney stone is charging. The laser is charged and fired automatically after the kidney stone is fired.
* [[Luck]]-based tear effects: No effect.
* {{i|Libra}}: The laser ignores damage modification from Libra, both positive and negative: the actual unbalanced damage value is used.
* {{I|My Reflection}}: The laser makes a thin loop in front of Isaac and then shoots straight backwards.
* {{I|Mysterious Liquid}}: The laser leaves a creep for each enemy and obstacle the laser hits per tick.
* {{I|Playdough Cookie}}: The laser rapidly flashes between different colors while firing, with a chance to inflict status effects.
* {{I|Soy Milk}}: Unlike charged attacks, the laser cannot be fired automatically. As the laser deals Isaac’s damage, but is not affected by tear delay, the DPS of the laser is greatly decreased.
* {{I|Sulfuric Acid}} / {{I|Terra}}: The laser will occasionally break obstacles.
* {{I|Tech X}}: If the Revelation beam and the Tech X are both charged, it will sometimes fire the Revelation beam first and the Tech X ring at the end of it.

sections.Effects:
* On use, damages Isaac for a full heart of [[health]] and grants +1.2 [[damage]] for the current [[room]].
** Razor Blade takes {{e|Red Heart}}s before other heart types.
** {{dlc|r}} When used more than once in the same room, damage taken is lowered to half a heart.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|a}} {{C|Eve}} starts with this item after unlocking it and donating 439 [[coins]] to the {{e|Greed Donation Machine}}.{{dlc-}}
** {{dlc|nr}} Both conditions must be met for Eve to hold it; donating 439 coins before defeating {{E|Satan}} with Eve will wrongly state on Eve's profile on the Character Selection Screen that she has it equipped.
** {{dlc|r}} Eve starts with the Razor Blade if unlocked from the Greed Machine, even if [[Satan]] has not been defeated with Eve.
* {{dlc|nr}} If Isaac has half a red heart left, Razor Blade will damage other heart types.
* It is possible to die using Razor Blade if Isaac does not have enough hearts.
* The effect stacks with itself and {{t|Red Patch}}, which provides a similar benefit.
* Using this item does not affect {{R|Devil Room}}/{{R|Angel Room}} chances.
* Using the Razor Blade grants immunity frames; this allows access to {{r|Curse Room}}s without losing soul hearts.
* {{dlc+|a}} Using this item in the {{E|Ultra Greed}} boss room will remove 2-4 coins and drop 1-3 pennies on the floor, as if Isaac was hit by an enemy attack.{{dlc-}}
* Using this item as {{c|The Lost}} will kill The Lost, even if the protective effect from {{i|Holy Mantle}} is still active.
** {{dlc|r}} This interaction will kill Isaac while temporarily transformed into The Lost by a {{e|White Fire Place|n}}, even when he would otherwise have enough hearts to survive.
sections.Synergies:
* {{dlc|nr}} [[Invulnerability]] / [[Shield]]: The Razor can be used at no cost while invulnerability / shield is active, allowing damage to be significantly increased for the room.
* {{Book of Belial synergy|description=Invokes the effect of {{i|The Necronomicon}} effect along with the original effect.}}
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns red wisps in the middle ring. Wisps have higher health.}}
* {{dlc|nr}}{{i|Isaac's Heart}}: Isaac cannot take damage from the Razor Blade, allowing for infinite uses of the item.
* {{i|Old Bandage}} / {{i|Shard of Glass}}: Isaac has a chance to drop a red heart while using the item.
* {{T|Panic Button}}: Self-damage occurs before enemy damage, making it almost impossible to lose Angel or Devil chance.
* {{dlc|nr}} {{i|The Polaroid}}: Isaac takes no damage while invincible, allowing for repeated free uses of the item.
* {{i|The Wafer}}: Isaac loses half a heart instead of a full heart.
* {{i|Whore of Babylon}}/{{i|Dark Prince's Crown}}: Can lower Isaac's health on demand to activate the bonus.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.
* {{i|Holy Mantle}} / Similar effects: The shield is not broken, but Razor Blade still damages Isaac.
* {{dlc|r}} [[Shield]] / [[Invulnerability]]: Will not protect against this item's damage.
* {{dlc+|r}} {{C|Tainted Samson}} / {{I|Berserk!}}: The Razor Blade can be used in order to gain a massive damage boost in a room as long as there's a source of HP within reach.{{dlc-}}

sections.Effects:
* Prevents low-quality [[items]] from appearing, greatly increasing the [[Item quality|quality]] of items received from all [[item pools]].
** Items with a quality of 0-1 are automatically rerolled.
** Items with a quality of 2 have a 33% chance to be automatically rerolled.
** [[Item Tags quest|Quest items]] cannot be rerolled.
* {{transformation contribution|Seraphim}}
sections.Notes: * Due to being quality 0, {{I|Skatole}} cannot be obtained from {{e|Shell Game}}s after Sacred Orb has been picked up.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Bag of Crafting}}: Sacred Orb prevents crafting quality 1 and 0 items, typically resulting in them being replaced by quality 2 items. If a recipe that can only result in a quality 0-1 item is put in the bag, it will replace the item with Breakfast instead.
* {{i|Binge Eater}}: The food item is not re-rolled.
* {{I|Death Certificate}}: Death Certificate's item generation ignores Sacred Orb's changes to item availability.
* {{t|Dice Bag}}: The one-time-use dice given by this trinket are not affected.
* {{t|Expansion Pack}}: The random effects generated by this trinket are affected by Sacred Orb.
* {{I|Genesis}}: If obtained from one of the Genesis room pedestals, no effect on future pedestals spawned in the room. Will function normally upon leaving.
* {{i|Lemegeton}}: Generated items are affected by Sacred Orb.
* {{t|Modeling Clay}}: Temporary items generated by this trinket are affected by Sacred Orb.
* {{i|Sacred Orb}}: Additional copies of this item provide no benefit. The chance of quality 2 items being rerolled does not increase.
* {{I|Spindown Dice}}: Spindown Dice ignores Sacred Orb's changes to item availability.

sections.Effects:
* Adds 5 {{e|Bomb}}s.
* If any firing input is given when placing a bomb, a fast-moving, explosive rocket will be shot in the direction corresponding to the input.
** The rockets accept analog firing input. This means they can be shot diagonally or in any other angle with a mouse or joystick.
** Isaac will place a regular bomb if no firing input is received.
sections.Notes:
* Rockets use Isaac's bomb synergies like his bombs normally would.
* Rockets are unaffected by Isaac's [[shot speed]].
* Rockets can be boosted by {{i|Brimstone}} lasers and {{I|Hemoptysis}} sneezes.
* Bosses such as {{E|Chub}} or {{E|Carrion Queen}} can swallow the rockets just like regular bombs.
sections.Synergies:
* {{t|Bob's Bladder}}: Rockets leave creep, albeit slowly.
* {{i|Bobby-Bomb}}: Rockets become homing.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}}: Shoots rockets as normal tears. All synergies that would normally apply are given to the rockets.
* {{E|Giga Bomb}}s: Fires a giant rocket that moves slower and has the same effects as a normal Giga Bomb.
* {{t|Ring Cap}}: Fires two rockets simultaneously.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Best Friend}}/{{i|Bob's Rotten Head}}/{{i|Epic Fetus}}/{{i|Mr. Boom}}: No effect.
* {{t|Blasting Cap}}: Rockets can drop bomb pickups.
* {{i|Marked}}: Rockets will fly to the location of the crosshair.
* {{i|Sticky Bombs}}: Rockets will not stick onto enemies.
* {{I|Remote Detonator}}: Rockets do not explode on impact with surfaces, requiring manual detonation.
** '''Remote Detonator + Dr. Fetus:''' Rockets fired with Dr. Fetus will still explode on impact, but can be manually detonated.
* Worm [[trinket]]s: Rocket's trajectory is unaffected.
** {{T|Wiggle Worm}} '''+ Dr. Fetus''': Rocket will wiggle from side to side mid-flight. This is the only worm trinket that affects Rocket in a Jar.
* {{I|My Reflection}}: No effect.
** '''My Reflection + Dr. Fetus:''' Rockets fired with Dr. Fetus will turn back at Isaac, but will not explode in contact with the player. However, it will explode after a duration, possibly damaging Isaac.

sections.Effects:
* +0.2 [[speed]]
** {{dlc|nr}} +0.2 maximum speed (may never exceed 2.0).
* Grants [[piercing tears]].
sections.Synergies: * {{I|Lost Contact}}: Tears will pierce right through enemy projectiles, deleting them. A very strong offensive/defensive combo.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|8 Inch Nails}}: Knockback overridden by Sagittarius.
* {{t|Blister}}: Overridden by Sagittarius.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}}: Bombs travel through enemies. When combined with {{I|Ipecac}}, bombs do not explode upon hitting enemies.
** {{Dlc|r}} Bombs also deal 2.5x Isaac's damage to enemies when passing through them.
* {{i|Pisces}}: Knockback overridden by Sagittarius.

sections.Notes:
* If playing as {{c|Lilith}}, the {{i|Incubus}} familiar cannot be sacrificed.
** Other starting familiars, such as those granted by {{I|Eden's Blessing}} or a challenge, can be sacrificed as normal.
* [[Charm]]ed and [[friendly]] enemies cannot be sacrificed.
* Any [[Pretty Fly|Pretty Flies]] are counted as a single sacrifice.
* Familiars spawned from [[Trinkets]] like {{t|Isaac's Head}} can be sacrificed, destroying the trinket in the process.
* {{dlc|r}} Upon use may remove [[Transformations]].
sections.Synergies:
* {{p|Berkano}}: Locust summoned for the room can be sacrificed as regular {{i|Abyss}} locust, allowing to use the item even if no familiars have been yet obtained.
* {{Book of Belial synergy|description=Grants +10.8 temporary damage up for every sacrificed familiar. The damage bonus scales down to 0 over time, similarly to {{i|Red Stew}}. Sacrificing blue flies or blue spiders has no special effect.}}
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Converts each wisp into a {{e|Half Red Heart}}. Spawns a single red and black wisp in the middle ring after the sacrifice.}}
* {{I|Brown Nugget|nr}}: Spawned fly turrets count as familiars for sacrificing; although dropping the Brown Nugget will despawn the last fly turret, older ones will remain and can be sacrificed.
** {{dlc|r}} Spawned fly turrets count as regular blue flies for sacrificing, and thus are converted to pennies.
* {{i|Cambion Conception}} / {{i|Immaculate Conception}}: Familiars can be sacrificed without consuming the item. The sacrificed familiars will also respawn upon entering a room.
* {{i|Guardian Angel}} / {{i|Seraphim}} / {{i|Sworn Protector}}: 2 Black Hearts will also drop.
* {{i|Isaac's Heart|nr}}: Can remove the Isaac's Heart familiar while the item remains, making Isaac invulnerable.
* {{i|Lemegeton}}: Created familiars can be sacrificed. Additionally, converts each wisp into a {{e|Half Soul Heart}}. The passive item effects granted by the familiars is retained for the duration of the floor.
* {{I|Plum Flute}}: Using Plum Flute, then using Sacrificial Altar will remove the Baby Plum spawned and spawn an item. The Plum Flute is not removed upon doing this, and subsequent usage of Plum Flute still summons Baby Plum normally.
* {{i|Quints}}: The item will be lost only if Isaac has at least 1 spawned familiar in the room used, and each spawned familiar counts as one sacrifice. If Quints is sacrificed first (or is the only item available to sacrifice) and at least two familiars are summoned, two Devil Room items will be spawned while only losing one item.
* {{i|Void|nr}}: When absorbed by Void, the one time use no longer applies, unlike other one time use active items. Familiars can be sacrificed with every activation of Void.
* {{dlc|r}} Pretty Fly [[Horse Pill]]: Sacrificing the {{i|Big Fan}} spawned by the pill gives Isaac two Pretty Flies.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|7 Seals|nr}}: Cannot be sacrificed in itself, but [[Locust]]s can be sacrificed.
** {{dlc|r}} Can now be sacrificed as usual.
* {{I|Abyss}}: Locusts created from Abyss are counted as familiars and can be sacrificed as normal.
* {{i|Ball of Bandages}} / {{i|Cube of Meat}} : The altar consumes the whole familiar, up to 4 cubes or balls at a time. If more than 4 are available, they count as other familiar(s) that may be separately chosen for sacrifice.
* {{i|Best Bud}} / {{i|Dead Bird}} / {{t|Eve's Bird Foot}} / {{I|Bird Cage}}: These familiars can be sacrificed only when they're active.
* {{i|Box of Friends}} / {{i|Monster Manual}} / {{t|Umbilical Cord}} / {{t|The Twins}} / {{p|Soul of Lilith}}: The familiars generated by these items can be sacrificed and turned into items.
* {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.
* {{i|Chaos}}: The Altar ignores the effects of Chaos, always spawning items from its usual drop pool instead of a random pool.
* {{dlc|r}} {{tf|Conjoined}}: The transformation will be lost if Isaac has less than three items needed after using Sacrificial Altar.
* {{I|Dirty Mind}} / {{t|Dingle Berry}}: Each Dip spawned by these items or from a {{g|Charming Poop}} is turned into a coin, regardless of type.
* {{I|Giant Cell}}: Converts all Minisaacs into one coin each.
* {{i|Halo of Flies}}: Both flies created by this item are counted as a single sacrifice each, due to the fact that they are counted as Pretty Flies. The item is taken away if either of the flies are sacrificed.
* {{i|The Intruder}}: The Intruder can be sacrificed even while it's in Isaac's head.
* {{i|Lil Delirium|nr}}: Lil Delirium may be sacrificed, but the item is not removed. The familiar will return once another familiar is gained or lost, or the run is quit and resumed.
* {{i|The Pinking Shears}}: Body familiars that are spawned by this item can be sacrificed by switching between the Pinking Shears and Sacrificial Altar. {{dlc|nr}} However, the body familiars reappear when picking one of the spawned items up.
* {{i|The Swarm}}: Each fly will be turned into a coin without consuming the item.
* {{i|Star of Bethlehem}}: Although not readily apparent as a familiar, the Star can be sacrificed. It will be destroyed even if it is not currently in the same room.
* {{I|Sumptorium}} / {{t|Lil Clot}}: Each Clot is turned into a coin, regardless of type. Trinket {{t|Lil Clot}} wont be destroyed
* {{tf|Super Bum|nr}}: Super Bum may be sacrificed, but none of the items will be removed. The familiar will return once another familiar is gained or lost, or the run is quit and resumed.
** {{dlc|r}} Super Bum may be sacrificed but only one of the items will be removed.
* {{i|Vengeful Spirit}}: Wisps will be sacrificed for one coin each.
* {{i|Zodiac}}: The {{i|Gemini}} familiar granted by Zodiac can be sacrificed without consuming the item.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a [[familiar]] that drops a random [[Cards and Runes|rune]] after clearing enough rooms.
** {{dlc|nr}} Runes are dropped alternating every 5 or 6 rooms.
** {{dlc|r}} Runes are dropped alternating every 7 or 8 rooms.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|nr}} If there are no runes unlocked, it will drop [[Cards and Runes|cards]] instead.
* {{dlc|r}} Rune Bag will also drop Soul Stones if any have been unlocked.
* {{dlc+|r}} If less than 6 runes are unlocked, it can drop a {{p|Rune Shard}} instead of a rune.{{dlc-}}
* {{dlc|r}} [[Familiar]]s that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Rune Bag having the lowest priority at {{dlc|nr+}} 6th / {{dlc|r+}} 8th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|BFFS!}}: The drop rate is improved to every 4-5 rooms.
** {{dlc|r}} The drop rate is improved to every 6 rooms.

sections.Effects:
* Isaac receives an angelic halo around him.
* When an enemy comes in contact with the halo, a beam of light starts to form above them. If they stay in the halo for about a second, a beam of light will strike down on them, dealing 3.5 damage and creating 4 more beams that shoot out in all cardinal directions.
** The initial beam of light does 3.5 damage per tick (up to 15 times) and the others deal 1.75 damage per tick (up to 15 times).
*** If an enemy is standing in the center of all the light beams, they will take a total of 152.5 damage.
* Each time Isaac takes damage, the halo will grow in size, up to a maximum of 10 times. This isn't damage scaled, but allows Isaac to trigger the Salvation effect from further away. The halo size will reset after leaving the floor.
* {{transformation contribution|Seraphim}}
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Camo Undies}}: Damaging enemies with Salvation will not take away Isaac's camouflage.
* {{I|Dark Arts}}: Stays in effect even while using Dark Arts, allowing Isaac to deal more damage to nearby enemies while invulnerable.
* {{I|Gnawed Leaf}}: The light beams trigger even when Isaac is a statue.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and drops a {{e|Grab Bag}} once every few [[rooms]] cleared.
** {{dlc|nr}} The rate alternates between every 5 or 6 rooms.
** {{dlc|r}} The rate alternates between every 7 or 8 rooms.
sections.Notes: * {{dlc|r}} [[Familiar]]s that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Sack of Sacks having the lowest priority at {{dlc|nr+}} 6th / {{dlc|r+}} 8th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.
sections.Synergies:
* {{dlc|nr}} {{i|BFFS!}}: The drop rate is improved to every 4-5 rooms.
** {{dlc|r}} The drop rate is improved to every 6 rooms.

sections.Effect: * Gives Isaac 2 Red [[Health|Heart containers]] and fully restores Isaac's [[health]].
sections.Interactions: * {{C|Tainted Bethany}}: Grants 12 blood charges.

sections.Effects:
* Grants 3 {{e|Soul Heart}}s.
* Items in [[item pool|all pools]] have a <math display="inline">\frac{1}{\mathit{SumOfPoolItemsWeight}}</math> chance to be replaced by {{i|The Bible}}.
** The original item that was replaced is considered seen and, depending on the pool, possibly can't be found again.
* {{dlc|r}} +0.5 [[tears]].
* {{transformation contribution|Seraphim}}
sections.Notes:
* If The Bible has been picked up before collecting the Rosary, it will not replace other items.
* The Bible can be encountered multiple times even in the same pool if it is not picked up; however, once picked up, it cannot appear again anywhere.
* {{dlc|r}} Collecting more than one Rosary will further increase the chance of finding The Bible. The above limitations still apply, and it can be collected only once no matter the number of Rosaries.
* This item stacks with {{t|Rosary Bead}}, further increasing the chance to find The Bible in the {{R|Library}} and {{R|Shop}}.
* {{dlc|na}} The approximate chances of finding {{i|The Bible}} in each item pool are:
** [[Treasure Room (Item Pool)|Treasure Room]]: 2.26%
** [[Shop (Item Pool)|Shop]]: 12.82%
** [[Boss (Item Pool)|Boss]]: 11.36%
** [[Devil Room (Item Pool)|Devil Room]]: 12.82%
** [[Angel Room (Item Pool)|Angel Room]]: 20.83%
** [[Secret Room (Item Pool)|Secret Room]]: 20.83%
** [[Library (Item Pool)|Library]]: 45.45%
** [[Golden Chest (Item Pool)|Golden Chest]]: 55.56%
** [[Red Chest (Item Pool)|Red Chest]]: 71.43%
** [[Beggar (Item Pool)|Beggar]]: 27.78%
** [[Devil Beggar (Item Pool)|Devil Beggar]]: 45.45%
** [[Curse Room (Item Pool)|Curse Room]]: 38.46%
** [[Key Master (Item Pool)|Key Master]]: 71.43%
*** The probabilities after Rebirth have not been computed, though the chances are pretty similar to the ones shown above. This is because the smaller the item pool, the more likely the Bible is to appear, and this effect is far more pronounced than the Bible simply being added to each pool. So, for example, the Bible is much more likely to appear from a Red Chest compared to the Treasure Room.

* Killing the heads thrown by {{E|Rag Man}} before they turn into a {{E|Rag Man's Ragling}} is not counted as a kill and will not spawn a baby.
* The same familiar can spawn multiple times.
* Despite being stationary, tear-shooting babies will still inherit Isaac's movement, angling their tears accordingly.
* Enemies killed by {{E|Dark Esau}} count as yours and will spawn a baby.
* During {{E|The Beast}} fight, familiars spawned by Quints stay on screen throughout the chase sequence.
* {{dlc|nr+}} When playing as {{C|Tainted Lazarus}}, Quints will not disappear on {{i|Flip}} but instead give the ability to spawn more Quints if Flip is used again. This is very effective in Greed mode and Boss rush because the automatic flip triggers when completing a wave, giving more Quints for every other wave.
sections.Synergies:
* {{T|Baby-Bender}}: All shooting familiars spawned are affected, save for Little Steven and Seraphim.
* {{I|BFFS!}}: Affects Quints familiars, doubling their damage.
* {{I|Quints}}: Lets you spawn an additional 5 Quints familiars per copy.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Sacrificial Altar}}: The item will be lost, and each spawned familiar counts as one sacrifice. If Quints is sacrificed first (or is the only item available to sacrifice) and at least two familiars are summoned, two Devil Room items will be spawned while only losing one item.
* {{dlc|r}}[[Cards and Runes|Ace Cards]]: Enemies that are turned into [[pickup]]s don’t leave familiars behind.
* {{I|Box of Friends}}: Existing Quints familiars will not be duplicated, nor more will be created. If Isaac has no other familiars, the generated Demon Baby will hover with the Quints instead of following Isaac.
* {{i|E. Coli}}/{{i|Flush!}}: Enemies that are turned into poop don't leave familiars behind.
* {{I|King Baby}}: Familiars do not follow King Baby, nor do the familiars aim independently at enemies.

sections.Effect:

sections.Synergies:

sections.Effects:

Walking over the crack summons a [[Familiar#Ghosts|ghost]] that homes in on the nearest enemy, exploding when it hits it. After the ghost is summoned, cracks will keep showing up in the room until it is cleared.

sections.Notes:

* The explosion does not hurt Isaac.

sections.Effects: * Returns Isaac to the beginning of the run in [[Chapter 1]], with all [[Attributes|stat]] boosts, [[items]], [[pickups]], and [[trinkets]] intact, similar to a [[Victory Lap]]. Unlike a Victory Lap, however, no effects are applied after a certain number of uses, and the timer is not reset.
sections.Notes:
* {{R|Angel Room}}s once again become possible to appear even if the player has made a previous [[Devil Room|devil deal]].
* The chance for a {{R|Planetarium}} to appear can once again be increased above 1% without a {{T|Telescope Lens}}, even if the player has previously entered a Planetarium.
* If the {{e|Donation Machine}} was jammed before usage, it will no longer be jammed.
* True Co-Op players can be spawned at the first room after using the R Key.
* If used in a run while achievements and character unlocks are enabled, they will still be enabled after use. Similarly, if these are disabled because the player is in a [[Victory Lap]] or seeded run, they will remain disabled after use.
** Beware that using R Key during a Victory Lap will reset the lap counter to 0, as though every Victory Lap is considered part of the same run. Shops will appear as normal, and no items will be removed upon starting the next lap. However, the character will remain {{C|The Lost}} if it had been changed, and the game will remain on Hard difficulty.
* The timer and score do ''not'' reset.
** This means that the timer requirements to access {{R|Boss Rush}}, {{s|???}}, and {{i|Broken Shovel 1}} do NOT reset.
* Item pools are ''not'' reset. This means that another R Key can't spawn (and neither can any other items that were already encountered).
* The 13 pill pool does ''not'' reset, unlike with a victory lap.
* Due to the acquisition of {{I|Key Piece 1}} and {{I|Key Piece 2}} being dependent on whether or not the items are currently in Isaac's possession, R Key may be used to revisit previous floors and collect the pieces again after already consuming them in the {{s|Chest}} or {{s|Dark Room}} to unlock {{E|Mega Satan}}'s door.
* Since {{I|Knife Piece 1}} and {{I|Knife Piece 2}} will spawn any time their respective floors are visited, R Key may be used to revisit these floors and obtain multiple copies of the items.
* In scenarios where R Key can be purchased, it uniquely costs 99 [[coins]] instead of 15.
** This rule does not apply to the extra shop created by {{i|Member Card}}.
** This rule also does not apply to devil deals spawned by {{i|A Pound of Flesh}}.
** Despite this, using {{P|IX - The Hermit?}} on R Key will still only spawn 15 coins.
* In Greed mode, using the item after jamming the {{e|Greed Donation Machine}} will fix the machine, while also preserving the coin total the machine had before jamming.
* R Key cannot be obtained in the [[Daily Challenge]].
** This includes through use of a {{i|Death Certificate}}.
* If an achievement is obtained in the final room of a floor, e.g defeating Delirium for the first time, the achievements are awarded to the player once they complete the first floor of the new run.
sections.Synergies: * {{p|? Card}}: Activates R Key without consuming it, allowing for multiple run restarts.

* {{i|Dad's Note}}: Using R Key during the [[Ascent]] sequence will end it.
