sections.Effects:
* Upon use, creates a {{r|Red Room}} next to a wall where there would be no conditions that could prevent a room from spawning there (i.e., the same conditions for a {{r|Secret Room}} to spawn). This is indicated by red door outlines on walls.
* These rooms are most commonly normal rooms, but have a 10% chance<ref>[https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/15K8Xgxoxdx68AIaxuLXgZoJJlG36UPgy3_aeDpAM5tU/edit?usp=sharing (contains information about room type/spawn chance)]</ref> to be a [[special room]] instead, even including Red {{r|Devil Room}}s or {{r|Angel Room}}s.
** Red special rooms of any kind can appear on every floor.
* These rooms use a special Red Room icon on the map.
sections.Notes:
* The types of special rooms that a {{r|Red Room}} can be are the following:{{column list | width = 15em | content =
** {{r|Angel Room}}
** {{r|Arcade}}
** {{r|Clean Bedroom}}
** {{r|Curse Room}}
** {{r|Devil Room}}
** {{r|Dice Room}}
** {{r|Dirty Bedroom}}
** {{r|Library}}
** {{r|Mini-Boss Room}}
** {{r|Planetarium}}
** {{r|Sacrifice Room}}
** {{r|Secret Room}}
** {{r|Shop}}
** {{r|Super Secret Room}}
** {{r|Treasure Room}}
** {{r|Vault}}
}}
* All rooms made by Red Key will be 1x1 rooms that can have doors available on all sides.
* All doors within a Red Room will be unlocked or opened, regardless of the room type they lead to. This can open {{r|Secret Room}}s, and normally inaccessible {{r|Challenge Room}}s if they are adjacent to a Red Room. Red Room doors will also stay permanently open in the case of Challenge Rooms.
* In {{s|Home}}, Isaac can create a "Red Room" on the left side of the map right under Mom's room. This room will actually be a closet containing a non-tainted character's [[Tainted Characters|Tainted]] form.
** If the respective Tainted character has already been found or a Tainted character is played, the room will contain {{i|Inner Child}} instead. If Inner Child has not been unlocked, the room will contain a {{e|Shopkeeper}}.
** {{dlc|r+}} In [[Online Co-Op]], each player will unlock the Tainted version of the character they are playing as, regardless of whether they are alive or not, and if they are alive, they will also see the correct character, else seeing the host's character. However, if the host is playing as a Tainted character, the room will not contain any Tainted characters even if other players have not found their respective Tainted character, and the character will not be unlocked for anyone.
* If a door created by Red Key takes Isaac outside of the 13x13 area of the floor, he will be taken to the {{r|I AM ERROR}} room.
** The starting room of a floor is always in the center of the 13x13 area.
** This does not occur in {{s|Corpse}} II, {{s|Dark Room}}, {{s|Chest}}, {{s|The Void}}, or the special version of  {{s|Mausoleum}} / {{s|Gehenna}} II containing {{i|Dad's Note}}. No door outlines will appear at any boundary walls.
*** Additionally, this doesn't work during {{Chal|Red Redemption}}.
** The I AM ERROR room door can only be created while already inside a Red Room. Normal rooms will not show the red outline if they are at the map's boundary.
* Special Red Rooms can be versions that aren't normally encountered without a specific item or character.
** These include:
*** {{c|Tainted Keeper}}'s {{r|Shop}}s, which can additionally contain items from the [[Boss (Item Pool)|Boss]] and [[Treasure Room (Item Pool)|Treasure Room pools]], and offer trinkets for sale.
*** {{i|Voodoo Head}}'s {{r|Curse Room}}s.
*** {{c|Cain}}'s {{i|Birthright}} {{r|Arcade}}s.
*** {{i|More Options}}' double item {{r|Treasure Room}}s.
*** {{t|Pay to Win}}'s {{e|Shop Restock Machine}} {{r|Treasure Room}}s.
*** {{i|More Options}}' and {{t|Pay to Win}}'s combined double item {{r|Treasure Room}}s with a {{e|Shop Restock Machine}}.
** These do not include:
*** {{t|Number Magnet}}'s {{r|Devil Room}}s.
*** {{i|The Stairway}}'s {{r|Angel Room}}s.
*** {{t|Devil's Crown}}'s {{r|Devil Treasure Room}}s.
* Red Key can't overwrite {{r|Secret Room}}s or {{r|Super Secret Room}}s. This can be used to discern their locations by finding walls that don't have red door outlines that would otherwise be valid Red Room spots.
* Red Key can't create a room adjacent to the {{r|Boss Room}} on most floors, with some exceptions:
** Red Key can create a room adjacent to {{E|Hush}}'s room in the top right where the room that leads to {{s|The Void}} usually generates. The door to this looks like a crack. This Red Room can only be created when Isaac is in another Red Room adjacent to it, i.e. from branching off one of the {{r|Treasure Room}}.
*** Isaac can enter Hush's room from this crack, but going the other direction will lead him to the Entrance Portal room.
*** Isaac also can't create Red Rooms adjacent to the {{r|Shop}} on this floor either.
** Red Key can create rooms adjacent to most Boss Rooms in {{s|The Void}}, including {{e|Delirium}}'s room. This can be used to find a Boss Room door leading to what would be an empty space (though this may find {{E|Mr. Fred}} instead).
** Red Key can create rooms adjacent to the {{r|Boss Room}} in the [[Mirrored World]] of {{S|Downpour}} / {{S|Dross}} II.
** Red Key can create rooms adjacent to the first {{r|Boss Room}} if {{cu|Labyrinth}} takes effect on the floor.
* When Isaac enters any Red Room adjacent to the {{r|Ultra Secret Room}}, it immediately appears on the map along with the Secret Room jingle, and its door will automatically open.
* If Isaac encounters a Red [[special room]], all of its doors will be its special theme doors.
** All doors in a Red {{r|Curse Room}} still feature spikes, which will damage Isaac if he decides to enter/exit.
** A Red {{r|Vault}}'s doors or a Red {{r|Dice Room}}'s doors each require two keys to open. The door where Isaac uses Red Key will be automatically unlocked, but the other doors remain locked until Isaac goes through them from inside or unlocks them from outside.
* Multiple Red special rooms of the same type can spawn on one floor.
* All Red {{r|Sacrifice Room}}s will have their own independent use counters and rewards.
* If Isaac has a teleport to a specific room ({{p|XVII - The Stars}}, {{p|IX - The Hermit}}, {{I|Teleport 2.0}}, etc.) and has created a special room such that there are multiple of a certain type on one floor, the teleport will choose randomly between each room.
** However, if Isaac has found a Red {{r|Planetarium}}, XVII - The Stars will always teleport Isaac to it over any {{r|Treasure Room}}s.
* It is possible to obtain {{i|Knife Piece 1}} outside of the intended method by spawning the {{r|Treasure Room}} that contains it in {{s|Downpour}} / {{s|Dross}}.
** Red Rooms in Downpour/Dross can contain {{e|White Fire Place}}s as well.
* Isaac is able to create Red Rooms in the [[Mirrored World]] of {{s|Downpour}} / {{s|Dross}} II. They will be reflections of the original floor's Red Rooms, and special rooms created in this way will still be empty.
* Red Rooms can't be created around the {{r|Mine Cart Room}} of {{s|Mines}} / {{s|Ashpit}} II.
** Red Rooms on these floors can contain the yellow buttons used to build the mine cart track; however, these ones do nothing.
* Red Rooms in [[Chapter 3]] can contain [[Rocks#Marked Skulls|Marked Skulls]] even before the [[Ascent]] is unlocked.
* When in {{s|Dark Room}} or {{s|Chest}}, their spawn room containing their respective chests can be created by Red Key. These will function the same way regular chests of their respective type would on Dark Room/Chest outside the starting room.
** New {{E|Mega Satan}} doors can't be found in these rooms.
* Red {{R|Treasure Room}}s will be present in the [[Ascent]], and will not replace regular {{R|Treasure Room}}s.
* If a red {{R|Sacrifice Room}} appears in the {{s|Dark Room}} and Isaac teleports via the 12th or higher sacrifice, Isaac will be sent back to the starting room without restarting the floor.
* If a red {{R|Sacrifice Room}} appears in {{s|The Void}}, then it is possible to defeat {{e|The Lamb}} after taking the path through {{s|Chest}}. This makes it possible, without the use of [[R Key]], to get up to 8 [[Completion Marks]] in the same run if playing quickly.
* Red Key can be obtained by using {{i|Pandora's Box}} at {{s|Home}}.
* {{e|Greed}}, {{e|Super Greed}}, and {{e|Krampus}} can spawn in red {{r|Mini-Boss Room}}s.
* This item can be crafted from {{i|Bag of Crafting}} with eight {{p|Cracked Key}}s.

sections.Effects:
* Makes tears bounce off walls, [[enemy|enemies]] and [[obstacle|environmental objects]].
** Tears that bounce off of enemies bounce in random directions, whereas tears that bounce off of walls and other objects bounce directly back.
** When tears bounce from enemies, they become able to hit the same enemy again should they bounce off of another enemy or obstacle.
** {{dlc|a+}} Tears bounce off bombs and are unable to push them, making {{e|Troll Bomb}}s more difficult to deal with.
sections.Notes: * Tears will bounce off of walls while fighting {{E|The Beast}}, despite the lack of visible walls.
sections.Synergies:
* {{dlc|a}} {{i|Brimstone}}: The blood laser bounces off of walls, creating a second beam that deals half damage.
** {{dlc|a}} {{C|Azazel}}'s Brimstone laser becomes a full length laser after bouncing, but will deal half of the damage.

* {{i|A Lump of Coal}}: Both effects stack, with tears that bounce off of enemies being able to hit others for more damage.
* {{i|The Parasite}}: Tears will bounce off of walls without splitting, but split and bounce when hitting enemies. The split tears and the original one will bounce off everything.
* {{i|Pop!}}: Significantly increases the uptime of tears, since they are not limited by range and each tear will bounce off of each other. Continuously firing tears will eventually create a positive feedback loop, as the tears will keep bouncing faster and faster while not dropping to the floor.
** '''Pop!''' + {{i|A Lump of Coal}}: Extremely powerful combination; Lump of Coal's tear size increase will make it much easier for tears to bounce off of each other, while they increase in damage very rapidly. Given some time and enough tears, this can kill even final bosses such as {{E|Hush}} and {{E|Delirium}} quickly.
* {{dlc|a}} {{i|Technology}} / {{i|Technology 2}} / {{I|Tech.5}}: Laser bounces off walls, creating a second beam that does half damage.
* {{i|Tech X|r}}: The laser rings bounce off walls.

sections.Interactions:
* {{c|Azazel}}/{{c|Tainted Azazel}}/{{c|The Forgotten}}/{{c|Tainted Forgotten}}: No effect, only has an effect on {{c|The Soul}}.
* {{i|Epic Fetus}}/{{i|Mom's Knife}}/{{i|Tech X}}/{{I|Spirit Sword}}/{{i|Brimstone}}: No effect on those items.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: Only tear appearance changes, no tear size up.
* {{Dlc|r}} {{I|My Reflection}}: Tears will spin like boomerangs. This is a purely cosmetic effect.
* {{dlc|r}} {{i|Technology}}: Lasers are much wider.

sections.Effects:
* {{e|Penny|text=Coin}}s have a 10% chance to be replaced with {{e|Grab Bag}}s. {{e|Bomb}}s, {{e|Key}}s, [[Card]]s, [[Rune]]s, and {{E|Lil' Battery|text=Lil' Batteries}} have a 20% chance.
** This includes pickups spawned by most sources: room rewards, chests, slot machines, special shopkeepers, [[Greed Mode]] waves, etc.
** {{dlc|r}} Coins bombed out of a {{e|Donation Machine}} can become sacks.
** The exception to this are pickups spawned by Isaac himself directly, e.g. with the likes of {{i|IV Bag}} or {{i|Fanny Pack}}, and contents of other sacks.
* Spawns a sack upon pickup.
sections.Notes:
* The item does not replace hearts, pills and chests.
* The item can also replace {{e|Troll Bomb}}s and {{e|Mega Troll Bomb}}s that are not used as attacks, i.e. generated as room rewards, chest contents and such.
* The pickup replacement is applied retroactively when the item is collected: any appropriate pickup already existing on the current level may be replaced by a sack.
* {{dlc|na+}} Sacks on each floor tend to have the same contents, which can be taken advantage of if cards are involved.
* {{dlc|r}} Picking up a {{E|Golden Penny|n}} may spawn a sack instead of another Golden Penny.
* {{p|Cracked Key}} in the [[Ascent]] can be replaced by a sack, thus it is not recommended to take the item if you're going to unlock a tainted character.
sections.Synergies:
* {{t|Equality!|a+nr+}}: Sacks may drop new sacks while Equality! is active, potentially resulting in massive amounts of resources from a single sack.

* {{I|Head of the Keeper}}: Coins spawned from hitting enemies have a chance to become sacks.
* {{C|Tainted Keeper}}: The coins dropped from killing enemies have a chance to be sacks instead. The sacks do not flash and disappear.

sections.Effect: * +1 [[damage]].
sections.Notes: * This item is more likely to be dropped by {{E|Steven}} if {{i|Little Steven}} has already been picked up.

sections.Effects:
* Once per room, when Isaac is reduced to his last half [[heart]] (either red, soul, or black), the aura around his head temporarily vanishes and he is granted one {{E|Soul Heart}}.
** After re-entering a room, the ability can be triggered again.
** With {{E|Bone Heart}}s, the effect triggers on both half-filled and empty ones.
* {{transformation contribution|Seraphim}}
sections.Notes:
* If the Scapular is active and Isaac is already at his last half heart, the effect won't trigger even on fatal damage.
** {{C|Tainted Samson}} / {{I|Berserk!}}: If fatal damage activates Tainted Samson's Berserk, or if it occurs during Berserk!'s effect, it will trigger and grant the soul heart.
* {{dlc|a}} Scapular does not charge between waves in [[Greed mode]], though it can still be recharged by moving between rooms.
* Does not work with {{C|The Lost}} or {{C|Keeper}}, as they cannot reach the required heart value.
* Reaching only half a heart remaining may be more difficult in [[Chapter 4]] onwards, since all half-heart hits are upgraded to a full heart.
* {{dlc+|r}} Damage sources that count as "health donation" no longer activate Scapular. This includes {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}, {{e|Devil Beggar}},  {{e|Hell Game}}, {{e|Confessional}}, {{i|IV Bag}}, {{i|Razor Blade}}, {{i|Blood Rights}}, {{i|Dull Razor}}, {{i|Sharp Plug}}, {{i|Shard of Glass}}, {{i|Blood Bombs}}, and {{i|Blood Oath}}. However, {{r|Sacrifice Room}}s and {{r|Curse Room}} spikes still activate Scapular.
** Scapular can still be exploited by alternating between donating half a heart and taking half a heart of damage from elsewhere.{{dlc-}}
*{{E|Rotten Heart}}s cannot activate Scapular as the whole heart will be depleted by any damage source.
sections.Synergies: * {{I|Kamikaze!}}: Damage from Kamikaze's explosions will activate Scapular, allowing Isaac to trigger on-damage effects infinitely between rooms.
sections.Interactions:
* {{T|Cursed Skull}}: Provided Scapular can always trigger, grants effective immortality, as the soul heart is always given before the teleport takes place.
** +{{I|The Wafer}}: Grants true immortality, plus one hit on the soul heart, allowing the player to get hit once before teleporting.

sections.Effects:
* Allows Isaac to carry two [[Cards and Runes|cards, runes, or soul stones]] at once. Cycle through cards by pressing {{plat|PC}} the Control key, {{plat|PS4, PS5}} R2, {{plat|XboxOne}} RT, or {{plat|Switch, 3DS}} ZR.
* Replaces all [[pills]] with cards, runes, or soul stones. Pills already on the ground will be converted to a card, rune or soul stone upon picking up Starter Deck.
* Spawns a random [[card]].
sections.Notes:
* When picking up Starter Deck in a shop that has a pill for purchase, the pill can still be purchased and used. If the pill is dropped, it will be turned into a card.
* Picking up 2 Starter Decks won't allow you to carry 3 cards at once.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Acid Baby}}: Spawns cards or runes instead of pills. Using cards or runes will not trigger the room-wide poisoning effect.
* {{Dlc|nr}} {{i|Caffeine Pill}}: A pill drops normally, but if it is picked up and dropped, or left on the ground while visiting other rooms, it becomes a card.
* {{i|Little Baggy|nr}}: Overrides the effect of Little Baggy (switch from receiving only pills to only cards).
** {{dlc|r}} Having both items allow both cards and pills to appear again.
*** Picking up Little Baggy while already holding Starter Deck will turn any held cards or {{dlc|nr}}runes into pills for one time.
* {{i|Mom's Bottle of Pills}}: Gives a card instead of a pill, essentially becoming equivalent to a {{i|Deck of Cards}}.
* {{p|XIV - Temperance?}}: Forces Isaac to eat pills even with Starter Deck.

sections.Effects: * Upon use, creates a stationary sprinkler that rotates and fires tears in 8 directions. The tears copy Isaac's stats and most tear effects.
sections.Notes:
* Sprinkler's rate of fire and rotation speed depends on Isaac's [[tears]] stat.
* Sprinkler does not do contact damage.
* It is counted as an [[obstacle]] and will block some enemies movement, e.g.: {{e|Chub}}.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|20/20}} / {{i|The Inner Eye}} / {{i|Mutant Spider}}: The sprinkler fires multiple tears simultaneously.
* {{i|Anti-Gravity}}: Sprinkler tears are affected only while Isaac is firing, and are released at the same time Isaac releases the fire button.
* {{t|Baby-Bender}}: The sprinkler will shoot homing tears.
* {{i|Blood Clot}} / {{i|Chemical Peel}}: The sprinkler will fire either normal tears or tears with the items' effects depending on which tear Isaac fired last.
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns spinning eyeball wisps on the middle ring. The wisps fire 3 times faster than average, and fire in a spiral pattern similar to Sprinkler.}}
* {{i|Brimstone}}/{{c|Azazel}}: The sprinkler fires somewhat short-ranged Brimstone lasers instead of tears.
* {{I|Camo Undies}}: Isaac stays camouflaged after placing the sprinkler.
* {{i|Car Battery}}: Spawns two sprinklers on top of each other.
* {{i|Chocolate Milk|nr}}: The size and damage of the sprinkler's tears depend on Isaac's current charge amount.
* {{i|Dead Eye}}: Sprinklers increase the damage multiplier when hitting an enemy, and do not reduce it when they miss.
* {{i|Kidney Stone}}: Sprinklers will fire a barrage of tears whenever Isaac does, but will not fire the stone.
* {{i|Lead Pencil|nr}}: Sprinkler tears count for activation of the Lead Pencil effect. The tear burst may fire from the sprinkler or Isaac.
* {{i|Loki's Horns}}: The sprinkler has four eyes and simultaneously fires tears in four directions.
* {{i|Mom's Eye}}: The sprinkler has two eyes and simultaneously fires tears forwards and backward.
* {{i|Mom's Knife}}: The sprinkler fires knives instead of tears. The knives fire straight outwards, deal {{dlc|nr}} double / {{dlc|r}} 1.5x Isaac's tear damage and do not return.
** {{dlc|r}} '''Mom's Knife''' + {{i|BFFS!}} The knives deal triple Isaac's tear damage.
* {{i|Monstro's Lung}}: The sprinkler fires disorganized clusters of tears.
* {{I|Star of Bethlehem}}: When Isaac is in the aura, the Sprinkler will rotate faster and its tears will be affected by the Star of Bethlehem. The Sprinkler does not need to be in the aura for this to work, just Isaac.
* {{i|Tech X}}: The sprinkler fires laser rings that are smaller than the central spark and have a correspondingly small hit area, which deal 100% of Isaac's damage.
* {{i|Technology}}: The sprinkler fires lasers instead of tears.
* {{i|Tiny Planet}}: Tears will travel toward and orbit Isaac, wherever he is in the room.
* {{i|Tractor Beam|nr}}: The sprinkler's tears will not fire from the sprinkler itself, and will simply appear within the beam.
* {{i|Trisagion}}: Sprinklers will shoot beams.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|BFFS!}}: Sprinkler increases in size but does not do extra damage.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}}: The sprinkler fires bombs which can damage Isaac.
* {{i|Epic Fetus}}: The sprinkler fires crosshairs; missiles will strike the crosshairs after a short delay. This can damage Isaac.
* {{i|Eye of the Occult}}: Sprinkler's tears travel a very short distance in their original direction and can be controlled afterwards.
* {{i|Ipecac}}: The sprinkler fires explosive shots which can damage Isaac.
** '''Ipecac''' + '''Dr. Fetus''': The bombs fired by the sprinkler will not damage Isaac.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}} / {{i|Spirit Sword}}: The sprinkler will not fire tears at all.
* {{i|My Reflection}}: Tears fired from the sprinkler will boomerang towards Isaac instead of the sprinkler.

sections.Effects: * Gives Isaac 99 {{E|Key}}s.
sections.Notes:
* Rerolling this item with the {{i|D4}}, etc., will not remove the 99 keys.
* This item can appear when using the {{P|0 - The Fool?}} with 99 keys in inventory.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a star [[familiar]] that slowly travels toward the {{R|Boss Room}}, fading through doors as it travels towards it. Once it reaches the boss room, the familiar stands in the center of the boss room for the rest of the floor.
* The familiar emits an aura that, while Isaac stands inside it, gives him a {{dlc|nr+}} 1.8× / {{dlc|r+}} 1.2x damage multiplier, a 2.5× [[Tears|fire rate]] multiplier, and [[Tear Effects#Homing|homing tears]]. It also gives Isaac a 50% chance to ignore damage similarly to {{I|Cone Head}}'s effect except with a higher chance.
sections.Notes:
* In {{s|The Void}}, the familiar will travel to the boss room that contains {{E|Delirium}}.
* In [[Greed Mode]], the star will travel directly to the position where Isaac spawns upon entering a new floor.
** On the last floor, it will move to the upper part of {{E|Ultra Greed}}'s room.
* Once the star settles down in the boss room, the damage preventing aura can be used to play {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}s and {{e|Devil Beggar}}s for free, provided they are spawned via {{P|XIV - Temperance}} or {{P|XX - Judgement}} cards, respectively.
* The star may travel through {{R|Secret Room}}s and {{R|Curse Room}}s on its path to the boss room.
* The star will travel through {{R|Red Room}}s if they create an optimal path to the boss room.
** The star can backtrack into rooms it already went into if a more optimal path is created by a Red Room.
* During the [[Ascent]], the star will linger in the boss room of each floor, and will not progress backwards through the stage.
* The star will travel through the hole to the {{e|Mother}} fight and be present in the fight. It will be centered on the top half of the room, and will not move when the arena expands.
* The star will be present against {{E|Dogma}}, but does not follow for {{E|The Beast}}.
* If the door to {{E|Mega Satan}} is opened, the Star of Bethlehem will enter it instead of the boss room containing {{E|???}} or {{E|The Lamb}}.
** The Star will move backwards towards {{E|Mega Satan}}'s door if the door is opened later during the floor (such as by using {{i|Dad's Key}}).
* For {{c|Tainted Forgotten}}, the bonuses from the star are only applied if Tainted Forgotten is within its aura, not {{C|Tainted Soul}}.
* If either {{C|Tainted Lazarus}} or {{C|Dead Tainted Lazarus}} have picked up the star, the familiar will spawn in the room where the character holding it becomes active, which may not be the starting room. It will only move while the character holding it is active, effectively making it take twice as long to travel to the boss room unless Tainted Lazarus also has {{i|Birthright}}.
* During {{chal|Backasswards}}, the star acts as usual; originating in the starting room and gradually moving towards the boss room.
* The star will be copied in the [[Mirrored World]] and will simultaneously travel in both worlds.
* Entering and leaving the {{i|Knife Piece 2}} area will reset the star and make it reappear in the room with the minecart.
* The star exhibits a "rubber banding" effect in its movement. If it is in a room that is closer to the Boss Room than the one Isaac is in, it will move slower; if the opposite is true, it will move faster.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Blood Rights}}/{{i|IV Bag}}/{{i|Kamikaze!}}/{{i|Razor Blade}}: The aura has a chance to block the damage inflicted, but the effects will still occur.
* {{I|Rock Bottom}}: Isaac will keep the stat upgrades even after leaving the aura. However, it won't keep the homing effect outside of the aura.
* {{I|Sprinkler}}: The tears that the Sprinkler shoots will also be buffed, along with its rotation speed.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|BFFS!}}: The star appears larger, but the aura's size does not increase and neither do the stat gains.
* {{i|Adrenaline|nr+}}: Isaac's damage before Adrenaline's flat damage increase is increased by 1.2×, then damage after is increased by 1.5×.
* {{i|Bloody Lust|nr+}}: Isaac's damage before Bloody Lust's flat damage increase is increased by 1.2×, then damage after is increased by 1.5×.
* {{i|Hallowed Ground}}: The damage multiplier from the aura does not stack with white poop.
* {{i|Immaculate Heart}}: The damage multiplier {{dlc|nr+}} is reduced to 1.5× while in the aura / {{dlc|r+}} does not stack.
* {{i|Ipecac|nr+}}: Isaac's damage before Ipecac's flat damage increase is increased by 1.2×, then damage after is increased 1.5×.

sections.Effects:
* Detaches Isaac's head from his body and turns the head into a stationary [[familiar]] that fires tears for the current [[room]].
** The player still controls Isaac's headless body, which also shoots tears.
*** {{dlc|r}} The body constantly spews a controllable fountain of blood shots, dealing about 0.66x-1.01x damage.
**** The blood fountain can be aimed in any direction like {{i|Analog Stick|n}}.
** {{dlc|nr}} The tears fired by the head do not scale with Isaac's damage and always do 3.5 damage.
*** {{dlc|r}} The head's tears are affected by Isaac's stats and attack modifiers.
sections.Notes:
* Can spawn multiple heads if used in the same room more than once.
** {{dlc|r}} Only the most recent head is able to fire.
* {{Dlc|nr}} {{i|Brimstone}} and {{i|Technology}} are not fired from the stationary head.
* If Isaac has an invisible body due to the cosmetic effect of {{i|Transcendence}}, only a shadow will be seen after using the Scissors.
* {{dlc|nr}} If Isaac is [[Blindfolded]], the floating head can still fire tears.
* {{dlc|r}} The floating head does nothing as {{c|Lilith}}, {{c|Tainted Lilith}}, and {{c|Tainted Forgotten}}.
** As {{c|The Forgotten}}, the floating head will only fire tears when the Soul is active.
** The floating head will not fire tears as {{c|Tainted Samson}} while he is enraged.
* {{dlc|anr}} Each wave of {{R|Boss Rush}} fully recharges the item, allowing many heads to be spawned.
* Only deaths which end runs (i.e. Isaac is not revived by a revival item such as {{i|1up!}}) count towards unlocking the Scissors.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|The Pinking Shears}}: If Scissors and Pinking Shears are used together, control is given back to an invisible head with only a shadow visible as both the head and body are mobilized to attack.
* {{i|BFFS!}}: The loose head won't become larger, but will deal double damage.
* {{i|Box of Friends}}: No effect.
* {{I|Car Battery}}: No effect.
* {{i|C Section}}: C Section tears are fired from the body instead of the head. This makes the head do nothing, but the item still provides a benefit as the body will fire both the C Section tears and the blood fountain from Scissors.

sections.Notes: * {{dlc|r}} [[Familiar]]s that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Seraphim having {{dlcalt|5th|r+=7th}} priority.
sections.Synergies: * {{i|Sacrificial Altar}}: This familiar will also reward 2 {{e|Black Heart}}s when sacrificed.

sections.Effects:
* Grants a 15% chance to fire [[poison|poison tears]], each tick dealing damage equal to Isaac's.
** Poison from the shots will tick 2 times.
* Inflicts [[poison]] on enemies who make contact with Isaac.
** Contact poison will tick 6 times.
* {{dlc|nr}} Enemies who are killed after they have been inflicted with this type of poison have a 20% chance to drop {{e|Black Heart}}s. Enemies can still drop black hearts after the poison has worn off.
** {{dlc|r}} Enemies that make contact with Isaac have a 20% chance to drop a {{e|Black Heart}}. Enemies can still drop black hearts after the poison has worn off.
sections.Notes:
* Not affected by [[luck]].
* Enemies and bosses with multiple segments, such as Chub and Larry Jr., have a chance to drop multiple Black Hearts.
* If a boss would have been poisoned, but negates it with status immunity, they can still drop a black heart.
* Contact poisoning enemies that don't deal contact damage can be an easy way to generate black hearts (e.g. all variants of {{E|Pooter}}, {{E|Host}}, {{E|Boil}}, {{E|Cod Worm}}, and any of {{E|Ultra Greed}}'s non-blank coins).
* {{dlc|nr}} Although {{E|Stoney|text=Stonies}} and {{e|Shopkeeper}}s can't be visibly poisoned, they still can drop Black Hearts if destroyed after being touched.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Godhead}}: The Godhead aura cannot inflict poison but the tears themselves may poison enemies on contact.
* {{Dlc|nr}} The following interactions are trivial in Repentance:
** {{i|Athame}} / {{i|Maw Of The Void}}: The black rings may poison enemies but do not generate black hearts.
** {{i|Brimstone}}: The blood barrage may poison enemies but does not generate black hearts.
** {{i|Tech.5}} / {{i|Tech X}} / {{i|Technology}} / {{i|Technology 2}}: The lasers may poison enemies but do not generate black hearts.
** {{i|Trisagion}}: May poison enemies but does not generate black hearts.

sections.Effects:
* Gives Isaac one of the following [[Attributes|stat]] boosts per half heart gained by picking up {{e|Soul Heart}}s or {{e|Black Heart}}s:
** +0.04 [[speed]].
** +0.1 [[tears]].
** +0.2 flat [[damage]].
** +0.5 [[range]].
** +0.04 [[shot speed]].
** +0.20 [[luck]].
* Spawns a {{e|Soul Heart}} when picked up.
sections.Notes:
* Black Hearts give the same stat boosts as normal soul hearts.
* If a character can only have soul hearts for health (such as {{c|???}}), picking up two {{e|Eternal Heart}}s will count as giving one soul heart's worth of stat boosts.
* Soul Locket only activates when picking up actual Soul Hearts, not if they're directly added to Isaac's [[health]] (such as by a [[Pills|Balls of Steel pill]] or {{i|Book of Revelations}}).
* This item gives stats when adding to {{c|Bethany}}'s soul charges.
* {{C|The Lost}} and {{C|Tainted Lost}} can use this item normally, despite not having health.
** Unlike {{i|Alabaster Box}}, {{e|Black Heart}}s still work with these characters
* This item is useless for {{c|Keeper}} and {{c|Tainted Keeper}}, since they cannot encounter soul hearts.
* Hearts acquired prior to picking up Soul Locket will not provide stat boosts.
* The stat bonuses are [[seed]]ed, meaning the same stat ups will apply in the same order in the same seed.
* {{dlc|nr+}} The stat bonuses are "stored" on the Soul Locket. Dropping or losing it in any way won't immediately revert the bonuses gained, only when Isaac's stats are updated again. The respective stat changed is the one that loses the Soul Locket bonuses.
** The bonus stats will be lost if Isaac's stats are updated by dropping out of the game or if the game crashes.
* This item can be crafted from {{i|Bag of Crafting}} with eight {{e|Soul Heart}}s.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a bone [[familiar]] that circles around Isaac and reflects enemy shots.
** {{Dlc|nr}} The reflected projectiles deal 5 damage if they would've hurt Isaac for half a heart, and 10 for a full heart.
** {{Dlc|r}} The reflected projectiles deal 6 damage if they would've hurt Isaac for half a heart, and 7 for a full heart.
** Enemy damage modification from item effects or by stage does not affect the reflected damage.
** Reflected projectiles do not gain [[Tear effects]] from Isaac.
* The familiar does not deal contact damage, but kills the same types of [[flies]] on contact as [[Pretty Fly]] orbitals do.
sections.Notes:
* Projectiles that create other projectiles (e.g. {{E|Shady}}) can harm Isaac and be reflected.
* Homing projectiles (e.g. from {{E|Psychic Horf}}) do not retain their homing effect after being reflected.
* Slipped Rib can reflect:
** Explosive projectiles (e.g. from {{E|Gurgle}}), which explode as normal.
** Fireballs (e.g. from {{E|Crackle}}), and their lines of fire do not harm Isaac.
** Fire projectiles (e.g. from {{E|Mega Satan}}).
** Obstacles thrown by {{E|Polty}} or {{E|Kineti}}, dealing a flat 35 damage.
* Slipped Rib does not reflect:
** Lasers or beams.
** Lines of fire from fireballs.
** Projectiles from {{E|Big Bony}}, {{E|Coal Boy}}, {{E|Danny}}.
sections.Interactions: * {{I|BFFS!}}: Increases its size but does not increase the hitbox or the reflected damage.

sections.Effects:
* Upon use, any [[trinket]]s that Isaac is holding are destroyed, and their effects are permanently applied to him.
** {{dlc|r}} Trinkets that are absorbed show up on the HUD's item tracker.
* Increases the chance for a trinket to drop after clearing a room. (Has a 2% chance to turn the pickup variant into a trinket.)
sections.Notes:
* While held, {{i|Mom's Box}} will double the effect of all absorbed trinkets (if their effects can be doubled).
* Absorbing the {{t|Tick}} will allow Isaac to pick up other trinkets again.
* Trinkets whose effects only activate once, such as {{t|Store Credit}}, {{t|Missing Poster}}, and {{t|Walnut}}, will still only activate once after being absorbed.
* {{t|Perfection}} is still removed if Isaac takes damage from regular sources.
* {{dlc+|r}} {{T|Faded Polaroid}} cannot be used to open {{A|A Strange Door}} if smelted.{{dlc-}}
* It is possible to find previously smelted trinkets during a [[Victory Lap]], or if the trinket Item Pool is exhausted.
* {{dlc|nr}} Picking up a copy of a trinket which was already absorbed will not duplicate that trinket's effect.
* {{dlc|nr}} The trinket will not be absorbed if Smelter is activated during the pickup animation.
sections.Synergies:
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns yellow wisps on the middle ring. The wisps have a chance to spawn [[trinket]]s when destroyed.}}
* {{I|Glyph of Balance|r}}: Allows a trinket to appear every time there's a room clear drop as long as the other room clear drop criteria aren't satisfied, as it empties the trinket slot.
* {{C|Tainted Eden|r}}: Absorbed trinkets are not rerolled by Tainted Eden's passive effect.
* {{C|Tainted Isaac|r}}: Absorbed trinkets do not take up an item slot.
sections.Interactions: * {{I|Car Battery}}: No effect.

sections.Synergies: * {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns white wisps in the middle ring, looking like a spider. Wisps' tears have a 7.5% chance to inflict [[slow]] on enemies.}}
sections.Interactions: * {{i|Car Battery}}: Deals 10 damage to enemies twice but does not increase slow effect.

sections.Effects:
* Grants [[poison]] tears, dealing damage over time when inflicted.
* {{dlc|na}} The poison randomly hits either 2 or 3 times, dealing a total of 4 or 6 damage.
* {{dlc|a}} The poison hits twice, dealing a total of double Isaac's damage.
sections.Notes:
* This item has the same effect as {{i|The Common Cold}} on every shot. As such, all synergies with that item also apply to Scorpio at a 100% chance.
** This includes the same effect when absorbed by {{i|Abyss}}.

sections.Effects:
* +1 [[Damage]]
* Prevents Isaac from firing tears from his left eye, similar to {{C|Cain}}.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|20/20}}: Isaac will still fire from both eyes.
* {{I|Blood Clot}}/{{I|Chemical Peel}}/{{I|The Peeper}}/{{I|Stye}}: Isaac has a 50% chance of firing tears with respective effect each shot.

* {{I|Technology 2}}: Isaac no longer fires tears, he instead fires {{I|Technology}} lasers out of his right eye, alongside the Technology 2 beam.

sections.Effects:
* {{dlc|nr}} Spawns 1-2 friendly [[Blue Spider|Blue Spider(s)]] upon taking damage.
** This has a 1500 ms cooldown.
* {{dlc|r}} Spawns 2-5 friendly [[Blue Spider]]s upon taking damage.
* {{transformation contribution|Spider Baby}}
sections.Notes: * {{dlc+|r+}} This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|Widow}}.{{dlc-}}
sections.Interactions: * {{i|Hive Mind}}: Increases spider size and doubles damage.

sections.Effects:
* Damages Isaac in exchange for fully recharging Isaac's current activated item.
** {{dlc|nr}} Sharp Plug costs two hearts of health to use.
*** {{dlc|r}} Sharp Plug's heart cost is one half-heart per charge slot filled. The health cost is not increased in later stages where half-heart damage is upgraded to full heart.
** If the item has no charges, the Sharp Plug will not activate.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|nr}} If Isaac has less than two Black or Soul Hearts, it will remove them but will not remove any Red Hearts.
* {{dlc|r}} Sharp Plug attempts to draw from Red Hearts first.
* {{dlc|r}} Sharp Plug cannot deal fatal damage. If used at half a heart, it will not work.
sections.Synergies:
* {{dlc|r}} [[:Category:Damage-triggered items|Damage-triggered items]]: Each half heart used up by activating Sharp Plug triggers damage effects separately, allowing multiple payouts.
** {{i|Habit}}: Each damage taken triggers the extra charge, which can be seen when Isaac has {{i|The Battery}}, or when using Sharp Plug without having enough health to fully charge the active.
* {{i|Glowing Hourglass|anr}}: As long as Isaac has more than 2 full hearts, time can be rewinded indefinitely since the health used to recharge the item is refunded upon use.

Tainted Isaac's reroll ability applies to this new item, and the player can choose between the original active item or a new item. Picking up the original active item again will count as another item towards any transformation.

sections.Effects:
* If Isaac were to take fatal damage, rather than dying, he instead transforms into a ghostly form, resembling {{c|The Soul}}, with half a heart. The ghost has [[flight]], [[Tear Effects#Spectral|spectral tears]], and is chained to Isaac's immobile corpse. Isaac's soul returns to his corpse' position after 10 seconds, if he doesn't die while in ghost form.
** Isaac will have invulnerability frames for 1/3rd of a second after reviving.
** After activation, Spirit Shackles is disabled until Isaac gains a half or full {{E|Soul Heart}} or {{E|Black Heart}} from any source. HP that is used to charge Spirit Shackles will not be added to Isaac's health.
sections.Notes:
* When the effect is ready, the chains on Isaac's costume are light blue. When they are drained and cannot protect from death, they are grey.
* The Soul form functions near identically to when playing as the {{c|The Forgotten}}.
* If Isaac has any red heart containers, the ghost form will always spawn with half a red heart. If he has no heart containers, he will always spawn with half a Soul Heart.
** {{c|The Forgotten}} will spawn with an empty {{e|Bone Heart}}.
** {{c|Keeper}} / {{c|Tainted Keeper}} will spawn with one coin heart container.
* Recharging Soul Shackles will always consume a full Soul Heart if possible, even though a half Soul Heart can still charge the item.
** {{e|Blended Heart}}s will only recharge the item if the Blended Heart would give Isaac soul health.
** Items that add Soul/Black Hearts directly to Isaac’s [[health]] ({{i|Rosary}}, {{i|Guppy's Paw}}, {{i|Satanic Bible}} etc.) will recharge Spirit Shackles and give one less Soul Heart. 
** Spirit Shackles can be recharged by picking up Soul Hearts while in the ghostly form, but it cannot re-activate until its effect ends.
* If Isaac leaves the room while in ghost form, he will not be chained to anything and can move freely. He will also come back to life at his current location rather than where his body was left.
** Isaac can be trapped if he's in the middle of a pile of rocks when this happens. This can be fixed by quitting, then continuing the run.
* Spirit Shackles is not considered a respawn item as Isaac does not actually "die", and will activate prior to all other respawn effects.
** If Isaac dies while in ghost form and is brought back to life by a respawn item, he will respawn, unshackled, in ghost form for the remainder of the duration.
* Spirit Shackles cannot activate in the [[Mirrored World]], nor can the ghost form given by it be used to enter the Mirrored World.
* Spirit Shackles will trigger if a fatal [[Devil Room#Deals with the Devil|Devil Deal]] is taken.
sections.Synergies:
* {{t|Found Soul}}: Spirit Shackles activates for Found Soul, functioning as normal. However, it cannot be recharged, and can only be activated again after Found Soul dies and respawns.
* {{C|The Lost}}: Effectively acts as a rechargeable extra life, granting additional defensive measures on top of his inherent {{i|Holy Mantle}} and granting a use to normally useless Soul Hearts.
* {{I|Magic Skin}}: When all hearts are converted to [[Health#Broken Hearts|Broken Hearts]], Isaac will be revived with half a soul heart, allowing many more uses with low health.
* {{I|Scapular}}: Can activate at the same time. When this happens, the soul heart granted by Scapular will immediately charge Spirit Shackles.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Ankh}} / {{t|Broken Ankh}} / {{i|Judas' Shadow}}: Soul hearts given on respawn cannot recharge Spirit Shackles.
* {{c|Bethany}}: Soul charges cannot be used to recharge Spirit Shackles. Picking up soul hearts recharges it as normal.
* {{i|Damocles}} / {{I|Plan C}} / {{P|Suicide King}}: Ignores Spirit Shackles and fully kills Isaac.
* {{c|The Forgotten}}: Spirit Shackles can activate for both characters. They can toggle between The Forgotten and The Soul as normal while it's active, and the form that didn't "die" will have their normal health. Toggling from The Forgotten to The Soul will also create another body of The Forgotten that The Soul will be chained to in addition to the original body.
* {{c|Jacob and Esau}} / {{c|Tainted Lazarus}}: The character that has Spirit Shackles must die for it to activate; if the other character dies, it will not activate. Only the character that has Spirit Shackles can recharge it.
** In the case of Jacob and Esau, the brother that has Spirit Shackles will be chained to their dead body, while the one that doesn't can move freely. If either brother dies while Spirit Shackles is active, the other dies with them as normal.
* {{c|Keeper}} / {{c|Tainted Keeper}}: As Hearts cannot spawn or be collected, Spirit Shackles can only be recharged from effects that add Soul Hearts to health directly.
* {{c|Tainted Forgotten}}: The ghost will spawn from Tainted Forgotten instead of Tainted Soul; it will be invulnerable, unable to move, and use the bone club instead of Tainted Forgotten. It can also be thrown, but will rapidly return to Tainted Forgotten due to being chained to them. Tainted Soul is unaffected, and can take damage as normal.
* {{c|Tainted Jacob}}: will not activate during Lost Form, or when killed by {{E|Dark Esau}}.

sections.Effects:

* {{dlc|anr}} After obtaining 2 Steam Sales, all shop prices are set to 0 coins.
* {{dlc|r}} Multiple Steam Sales only further reduce prices, with each additional copy lowering prices less.

sections.Effects:
* Replaces Isaac's tears with a sword he can swing in front of him.
** The swing does 3x Isaac's [[damage]] +3.5 and deals knockback to both enemies and Isaac if it hits.
** The sword can be swung as rapidly as the fire button can be tapped.
** The sword swing can collect [[pickups]] and open chests.
* If Isaac's total health is equal to or greater than his number of {{E|Red Heart|text=Red Heart Containers}} (same rule as regular {{R|Challenge Room}}s), the sword fires a projectile when swung.
** The projectile deals damage equal to Isaac's damage +2, and has a cooldown equal to 2x Isaac's normal [[Tears|tear rate]].
* Holding an attack button charges a spin attack, ready when the sword flashes, which damages all enemies around Isaac. It also deflects enemy projectiles, which can damage enemies who get hit, and launches a projectile with higher [[Shot Speed|shot speed]] regardless of Isaac's current health.
** The circular swing deals 8x Isaac's damage +10, and the projectile created from it deals 4x Isaac's damage +4. It can also collect pickups and open chests.
** The charge time is based on Isaac's tears stat, at ~4x Isaac's normal tear rate.
** While charging, the sword will damage the first enemy that contacts it. This will cancel the spin attack.
** Swinging the sword normally while performing the circular swing cancels it.
sections.Notes:
* Unlike most charge attacks, the direction of the attack can't be changed by pressing and holding a different attack button then releasing the old one. Instead, it will stay pointing the same direction until all attack buttons are released, either doing nothing or using the spin attack, or the sword touches and damages an enemy, dealing sword slash damage.
* Spirit Sword can be used to open {{E|Spiked Chest}}s and {{e|Mimic Chest}}s without taking damage.
* Range upgrades move the hitbox of the sword forwards, including the spin attack. Enough range upgrades can leave a large blind spot directly in front of the sword.
* Only the projectile and spin attack are affected by tear rate, not the normal sword swing, meaning that items that increase damage but decrease tear rate, such as {{i|Polyphemus}} and {{i|Eve's Mascara}}, are much more effective when only using the swing. Additionally, items that do the inverse, such as {{i|Soy Milk}} and {{i|Almond Milk}}; are not as effective when only using the swing.
* Spirit Sword will deflect {{E|Mother}}'s Fistula attack and will send it right back at her, entering a short sequence that allows to deal bonus damage, if executed correctly; see this [[Mother#Phase 1|page]] for more details.
* Spirit Sword is overridden by the [[Blindfolded]] effect, as seen while playing as {{c|Lilith}} or in challenges like {{chal|Cat Got Your Tongue}}.
* Having 30 or more tear rate performs the swing attack automatically.

* {{i|Cricket's Body}}: The fired projectile will burst into multiple swords.

* {{i|Eye Sore}}: Random chance to swing extra swords in random directions.

* {{I|Holy Light}}: Both the sword swing and the projectile can trigger Holy Light.
* [[Tears|Homing tears]] (e.g. {{I|Spoon Bender}}): The projectile will be homing.
* {{I|Isaac's Tears}}: The item fires normal tears but can be charged as fast as the sword can be swung. Doing a spin attack will fully charge Isaac's Tears.
* {{I|Lachryphagy}}: The fired projectiles will combine and split.
* {{i|Loki's Horns}}: Random chance upon swinging to have a sword in all 4 cardinal directions. Performing a spin attack when this occurs results in a 4-way spin.
* {{i|Lost Contact}}: Sword swings reflect projectiles.
* {{I|Maw Of The Void}}: An additional ring will appear upon fully charging it. Spin is delayed by a bit.
* {{i|Mom's Eye}}: An additional sword is added to Isaac's back, and can be swung as normal.

* {{i|Polyphemus}}: The sword and fired projectile become gigantic. Charge time is increased, but swing rate remains the same. Swings will also shake the screen.
* {{I|Proptosis}}: The swing attack deals 9x Isaac's [[damage]] instead of 3x. Fired projectiles behave as expected.
* {{I|Rubber Cement}}: The fired projectile bounces.
* {{i|Technology}}: Sword becomes a lightsaber. Surrounds Isaac with a laser on every swing. Enemy projectiles are deflected by both normal and charged attacks.
* {{i|Technology 2}}: Laser fires when the sword is being swung or charged.
* {{i|Trisagion}}: The fired projectile is a Trisagion blast.
* {{i|The Wiz}}: Beams and sword swings are fired straight instead of diagonally. Isaac spins an additional time on a charged attack.

sections.Effects:
* Damages all enemies in the room.
** The damage dealt is equal to Isaac's current [[Damage|tear damage]] plus 10% of the enemy's max health.
* Has a 15% chance to drop {{e|Half Red Heart}}s when it damages an enemy.
** {{dlc|nr}} May also drop {{E|Half Soul Heart}}s. Half red hearts will always drop when Isaac has at least one red heart container; otherwise, half soul hearts will drop.
** The amount of enemies damaged does not improve the chance.
sections.Notes:
* When used on {{e|Delirium}}, this item should be used when it isn't transformed to deal the most damage, as Delirium doesn't have his [[Damage Scaling|armor]] up when in his true form.
* For enemies that can disappear or go underground, it only affects them if they are visible.
* The Sharp Straw works exceptionally well with {{c|Samson}}, giving the chance to collect large amounts of health per floor, allowing more damage to be taken resulting in more damage being dealt per use.
sections.Synergies:
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Enemies have a chance to spawn wisps in the outer ring upon use, although they sometimes extinguish instantly. Using it in a room with no enemies does not grant a wisp. Despite Sharp Straw having a timed charge, the wisps persist between rooms.}}
* {{i|Car Battery|n}}: Damage is doubled and two half hearts may be dropped.
sections.Interactions: * {{dlc|r}} {{I|Ipecac}}: Only provides a +2 damage bonus instead of +40.

sections.Effects:
* Adds a 20% chance to fire a booger tear that stick to the first enemy that they come in contact with and deals damage over time.
** Each booger deals damage equal to Isaac's tear damage every second.
** {{Dlc|nr}} The booger lasts for 60 seconds or until the enemy dies.
** {{Dlc|r}} The booger lasts 10 seconds.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|r}} This item can be spawned by {{e|Bumbino}} if he picks up 12 cents.{{dlc-}}
* The booger tear chance is not affected by [[Luck]].
* Boogers tears cannot pierce through enemies.
* Multiple boogers can stick to one enemy to deal extra damage.
* Booger tears pass through fireplaces and bombs even without piercing shots.
* Boogers cannot inflict [[status effect]]s, even if the booger's appearance changes.
* The booger falls off the enemy after they die. If it hits another enemy before it touches the ground, it will stick to them and deal damage.
* Sinus Infection is extremely effective against bosses. If each booger tear lasts for the full 10 seconds, this item effectively triples Isaac's DPS against bosses.
* Jumping enemies or bosses like {{E|Monstro}} and {{E|Leaper}}s and burrowing enemies like {{E|Round Worm}}s and {{E|Lump}}s can get rid of the booger when they leap or burrow.
** Bosses like [[The Harbingers]] or {{E|Dark One}}, or enemies like {{E|Oob}} that have dash attacks do not lose the booger when they go off-screen.
* The tear-sticking effect is similar to {{i|Explosivo}} and {{i|Mucormycosis}}'s.
* The {{t|Nose Goblin}} trinket's effect is almost identical to Sinus Infection, with an added [[homing tears|homing]] bonus but half the activation chance.
** When Isaac is holding both Nose Goblin and Sinus Infection each booger tear created by the item has a 50% chance to also have homing.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Brimstone|r}}/{{i|The Ludovico Technique}}/{{i|Tech X}}/{{i|Trisagion}}: Every tick of damage Isaac’s tears deal have a chance to attach a separate booger tear on a hit enemy.
* {{i|Cricket's Body}}: Booger tears will split into split booger tears that can attach to enemies.
* {{i|Explosivo}}: Explosivo tears can also be booger tears which damage the enemy over time while stuck to them before exploding.
* {{i|Godhead}}: Shots retain their aura while stuck to an enemy, but the aura can damage only enemies other than the booger victim. If the enemy dies before the booger’s maximum duration, it will resume homing and will often stick to a second enemy.
* {{tf|Guppy}}: Damage instances from boogers attached to enemies have a 100% ({{dlc|r}} 50%) chance to spawn a [[Blue Fly]].
* {{i|Lachryphagy|nr}}: All tears have a chance to burst into boogers. Boogers will always burst into more boogers, though some of the boogers may incorrectly appear to be normal tears. When a booger sticks to an enemy, it will burst into 8 boogers which have a high chance of sticking again to the same enemy.
* {{i|Lost Contact}}: Boogers that stick to enemies will block shots, and will not be destroyed in the process.
* {{i|Polyphemus}}: Booger shots lose the Polyphemus pierce effect, but stick to enemies while dealing the full damage of the Polyphemus shot. Damage does not degrade.
* {{i|Spirit Sword}}: Swings and projectiles have a chance to apply boogers on enemies.
* {{I|Tech.5|r}}: The laser also has a chance to apply boogers on enemies.
* {{i|Technology|r}}: Hit enemies have a chance for a booger to be applied to them.
* {{I|Technology 2|r}}: The laser can also apply boogers with the laser’s chance to apply boogers being determined rapidly every tick.
* {{I|Technology Zero}}: Boogers can be connected with electricity while being attached dealing large amounts of damage to the booger victim.
sections.Interactions:

** {{i|Ipecac}}: Booger tears will still appear, but will act identically to other Ipecac shots.

sections.Effects:
* While the item is held, grants a spinning top [[Familiar#Orbital Familiars|orbital]] that blocks enemy shots and deals contact damage (3.5 per tick, or 35 per second).
* While the item is being used, gives Isaac +0.5 [[speed]] and increases the contact damage on Isaac's [[familiar]]s, even if they do not normally deal any. Additionally, [[orbital familiar]]s spin much faster and knock back both enemies and Isaac when they deal damage.
** The contact damage improves to (1.5 x contact damage + 6). If a familiar has no contact damage naturally, it still receives the +6.
** Blue flies and blue spiders are also affected, and don't disappear while the item is in use.
* The recharge timer is gradually drained over 3 seconds while the item is being used.
** Isaac can stop using Spin to Win at any time by releasing the use item button, at which point Spin to Win starts recharging.
** Spin to Win can be used while it is not fully charged, gradually draining however much charge there is.
sections.Notes: * Isaac's effective speed can be higher than 2.0 while the item is active, even if the stat is capped.
sections.Synergies:
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Generates up to eight wisps in the middle ring while charging the item, which are immediately extinguished once the charge runs out. These wisps shoot six times faster than an average wisp and deal 3 damage.}}
** All wisps, including those produced by {{i|Lemegeton}}, become invulnerable while using Spin to Win, regardless of whether the Book of Virtues is active.
* {{t|Duct Tape|n}}/{{t|RC Remote}}: Allows Isaac to use familiars' contact damage without getting close to enemies.
* {{c|The Forgotten}}: While playing as {{C|The Soul}}, channeling Spin to Win will cause the Forgotten's skeleton to deal contact damage.
* {{I|Gnawed Leaf}}: Gnawed Leaf will activate while using Spin to Win, as long as Isaac is stationary. This allows for a brief moment of high damage against enemies that chase Isaac. Activating or deactivating Spin to Win will remove Gnawed Leaf's invincibility.
* {{i|Guardian Angel}}: The orbital speed boost from Guardian Angel can be combined with that of Spin to Win, causing all the orbital familiars to spin extremely fast around Isaac.
* {{t|Panic Button}}: Has a chance to spawn additional wheels upon taking damage that last only for the current room. This is most likely a bug.
* {{I|Pluto}}: The exceedingly high speed and small hitbox enables Isaac to clip into obstacles such as rocks or pits, allowing him to effectively fly over them. Isaac can potentially get stuck, which can be fixed by exiting and continuing the run.
* {{I|Taurus}}: Spin to Win's speed boost can instantly trigger the item's invincibility effect if it puts Isaac at 2.0 speed.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|BFFS!}}: The damage bonus of BFFS! is removed while Spin to Win is active. Most notably, this means familiars without natural contact damage do not gain additional damage, and others gain less than expected. Familiars that deal over 12 damage per hit before BFFS!' damage bonus is applied will deal reduced damage with Spin to Win active.
* {{i|Bob's Brain}} / {{i|BBF}} / {{i|Holy Water}} / {{i|GB Bug}}: While Spin to Win is active, prevents the familiar from exploding/being destroyed on enemy contact.
** GB Bug wont reroll enemies on contact while Spin to Win is active.
* {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.
* {{I|Metronome}}: When Metronome chooses Spin to Win, Isaac gains two orbitals with no other benefits of Spin to Win.
* {{i|Mom's Razor}}: Mom's Razor deals a fixed 16.5 contact damage, instead of its usual damage-scaled value, while Spin to Win is active.
* {{c|Tainted Forgotten}}: Unlike the non-tainted counterpart, Tainted Forgotten's body gains no extra contact damage while Spin to Win is active. Additionally, Tainted Forgotten's contact damage familiars have only 80% of their usual damage.
* {{i|Void}}: After absorbing Spin to Win, using Void spawns a temporary, passive Spin to Win familiar for the room. It cannot be activated further for the damage and speed bonuses.

sections.Effect:

** The spear does twice Isaac's [[damage]] per 7 frames.
*** In Challenge 30: The Guardian, the spear does one times Isaac's [[damage]] per 2 frames and damage range increased by 7/13.
** Instantly inflicts the [[Status Effects|fear]] effect on any boss it comes into contact with. This is subject to the boss's resistance.
sections.Notes:
* Spear Of Destiny does not replace tears.
* The item is similar to {{I|Mom's Knife}}, although it cannot be fired.
* {{dlc|nr}} Despite its size, the spear's hitbox is only located on the silver part and the handle, making it only effective at very close range.
* {{dlc|nr}} The spear can kill permanently charmed enemies.
* {{dlc|na+}} Spear Of Destiny does not work while [[Blindfolded]], except in {{chal|The Guardian}}.
sections.Synergies: * {{I|Proptosis|r}}: Triples the damage. Has no penalty with range.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|BFFS!}}: No effect on size or damage.
* {{I|Sacrificial Altar}}: No effect.

sections.Effects: * Grants [[homing tears]].

sections.Effects:

** {{dlc|nr}} The laser hits up to 13 times.

sections.Synergies:
* {{i|4.5 Volt}}: Allows the item to be charged and used multiple times in a room, which can help with dealing extra damage in enduring fights like most endgame bosses.
* {{i|9 Volt}}: Can be used once every room, and more frequently in {{R|Challenge Room}}s.
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns white wisps in the outer ring that resemble Shoop da Whoop!. The wisps will not fire tears, but will each fire a thin Shoop da Whoop! laser whenever Isaac uses it (including the wisp that was just summoned). The lasers deal 7 damage per tick (BUG: 3.5 if Isaac has {{I|BFFS!}}), and can hit up to 10 times for a total of 70 damage.}}

sections.Interactions: * {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.
