* Does not activate with bosses killed during {{R|Boss Rush}}.
* Despite being on a different floor, Sol's effect persists for {{s|???}} and thus contributes to the {{E|Hush}} fight.
* Upon defeating a multi-segment boss where all pieces die at the end (Chub, C.H.A.D, Carrion Queen, etc.), the effect activates once per segment, leading to an effective +3 luck and +9 damage until leaving the room, after which, the extra bonuses will be removed. It's probably a bug.
* Sol will not activate upon clearing the [[Mirrored World]]'s Boss Room.
* If Sol is obtained in [[Greed Mode]], through {{i|Spindown Dice}} or as a starting item for {{c|Eden}}, the effects will activate when entering the main room for the first time. In addition, it will activate each time a boss wave is completed.
** Sol will not activate during the final stage in the mini-boss fight before {{E|Ultra Greed}}.
* If Isaac manages to die at the same time he kills a boss, Sol will not save him. Instead, Isaac will die with full [[health]].
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|The Battery}}: Provides an extra level of charge if the item was fully charged when the boss was defeated.
* {{p|IV - The Emperor?}}: Clearing the extra boss room does not trigger the effect.
* {{I|Mega Blast}}: Only grants 3 charges.
* {{C|Tainted Lazarus}}: The item recharge, full heal, map reveal, and curse removal only occur if the character with Sol defeats the boss. If the boss is defeated by the character without Sol, the character with Sol still gets the damage and luck bonus for the rest of the floor.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a grey spider [[familiar]] that wanders around and allows Isaac to see tear damage and the health bars of all enemies.
** The spider will inflict a random [[Effects#Status Effects|status effect]] on any enemies it comes into contact with.
** The spider has a 10% chance to spawn a [[Blue Spider]] (2/3 chance) or drop a {{E|Lil' Battery}} ({{E|Micro Battery}}) (1/3 chance) when a [[Rooms|room]] is completed.
* {{transformation contribution|Spider Baby}}
sections.Notes:
* {{Dlc|nr}} For the sake of simplicity, all damage values shown are multiplied by 10 and rounded up to the nearest number.
** {{Dlc|r}} Damage values are no longer multiplied or rounded.
* {{dlc|r}} If a hit would deal 10000 or more damage, it will be displayed as 9999.
* All status effect damage dealt by Spider Mod is based on Isaac's damage stat.
* Spider Mod reveals {{E|Mega Satan}}'s health bar and is the only way to see his health.
** {{Dlc|r}} In Repentance, doesn't reveal {{E|Mega Satan}}'s life bar during his second phase anymore.
** {{Dlc+|r}} Spider Mod also reveals the health bar for {{E|Mother}}, the [[Harbingers (Bosses)#Ultra Harbingers|Ultra Harbingers]], and {{E|The Beast}}.{{dlc-}}
* {{dlc|nr}} Spider Mod shows the health of invincible enemies, holes created by {{E|Little Horn}}, and the golden statue of {{E|Ultra Greed}}.
* Spider Mod doesn't show if a segmented enemy has individual segment health like {{E|Larry Jr.}} or a health pool like {{E|Chub}}. Against enemies with invulnerable segments such as {{E|Carrion Queen}} and {{E|Scolex}}, its indicators will show under their head and not under the vulnerable segments.
* Spider Mod's damage doesn't account for [[damage scaling]], {{dlc|nr}} enemy damage reduction, or invulnerability, which means that the damage indicators for some bosses, {{E|Mushroom|nr}}s, {{E|Stone Grimace|nr}}s, and similar enemies will be inaccurate.
* {{dlc+|a+}} If Isaac transforms into {{tf|Spider Baby}}, it spawns a spider familiar who works similarly to Spider Mod.{{dlc-}}
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|BFFS!}}: Makes Spider Mod bigger and increases the chance to 12.5% for Spider Mod to spawn a battery or blue spider. No effect on status effect damage.
* {{I|Hive Mind}}: Makes Spider Mod bigger. No effect on status effect damage.

sections.Effects:
* Gives five {{e|Key}}s.
* On use, Isaac holds a key above his head. Pressing a fire button removes one key and throws it as a [[Tear Effects#Effects|piercing]] projectile. The key damages enemies, as well as opens locked doors and {{E|Locked Chest}}s it hits.
** The key will also break the first [[rock]] it hits, as well as [[Blocks|Key Blocks]].
** The thrown key does damage equal to 5× Isaac's [[damage]] + 30.
** Enemies killed by Sharp Key have a chance to spawn the contents of a chest; the contents they can drop includes the rewards of any possible chest contents, including items.
<!--* The chance for this to occur is somewhere between 1/10 - 1/15: Proper testing or looking into the code will be necessary to determine the exact chance.-->
sections.Notes:
* Sharp Key gives Isaac five keys for the price of three when bought at a {{R|Shop}}, making its purchase a good value if the player is low on keys.
* Thrown keys follow almost the same unlocking rules as {{i|Dad's Key}}. They can open:
** {{R|Secret Room}}s
** The doors to access {{s|Mines}}, {{s|Mausoleum}}
** {{E|Mega Satan}}'s door
** {{A|A Strange Door}}
** The flesh door to {{e|Mom's Heart}} in Mausoleum / Gehenna
*** Unlike others, this cannot be unlocked with Dad's key.
* The only rooms Dad's Key can open that Sharp Key cannot are {{R|Challenge Room}}s and {{R|Boss Challenge Room}}s.
* The entrance to {{R|Boss Rush}} and the gate leading to {{e|Hush}} can both be opened from the inside by throwing a key on where the entrance was.
* It cannot be used as a substitute for {{i|Red Key}} or to open the doors to Boss Rush or {{s|???}} past their timer.
* Doors will be opened in one thrown key, even if they require multiple keys or bombs to open.
* Thrown keys can also destroy [[Angel]] statues, but not {{E|Blue Fire Place}}s.
* Thrown keys cannot pierce or destroy {{E|Stoney}}s.
* Destroying a rock will create a bridge at the opposite side the thrown key hit the rock from.
* Despite being a substitute to bombs, thrown keys will not destroy {{e|Shopkeeper}}s.
* Thrown keys will open all the locked chests they move through, allowing multiple chests to be opened with a single key.
** Only locked chests (such as {{E|Locked Chest}}s, {{E|Eternal Chest}}s, or {{E|Old Chest}}s) can be opened by Sharp Key; all other chests are unaffected.
*** In the case of Eternal Chests, thrown keys will only count toward opening the chest one time.
*** Despite {{e|Mega Chest}}s requiring keys to unlock, Sharp Key has no effect on it.
** Opening locked chests with thrown keys in Challenge rooms will not cause the challenge room to start spawning enemies.
* Thrown keys will retain Isaac's [[tear effects|tear]]/[[Status Effects|status effects]], but are unaffected by items that replace Isaac's tears (such as {{i|Dr. Fetus}}, {{i|Brimstone}}, or {{i|Mom's Knife}}).
* Whether or not an enemy gives chest contents when killed by Sharp Key is seeded per enemy. As such, rooms can be re-entered (using Sharp Key itself or with {{t|Door Stop}} / {{i|Mercurius}} etc.) before they're fully cleared to repeatedly get rewards from the same enemy.
* The type of chest that enemies will give the contents of is determined by standard chest generation rules. This makes the contents of standard chests more common, and prevents enemies from giving the contents of {{E|Old Chest}}s or {{e|Mom's Chest}}.
* The pickups that enemies killed by Sharp Key can drop are affected by items/trinkets that modify chest spawns/rewards. 
** This includes the {{s|Chest}} and {{s|Dark Room}}'s effect of causing chests to contain [[Treasure Room (Item Pool)|Treasure Room items]].
* Sharp Key can open the chests in {{R|Challenge Room}}s without triggering them. However, picking up an item dropped from a chest will trigger them.
sections.Synergies:
* {{t|Ace of Spades}} / {{t|Child's Heart}} / {{t|Lucky Toe}} / {{t|Match Stick}} / {{t|Rusted Key}} / {{t|Safety Cap}}: If an enemy drops pickups, it has a ⅓ chance to drop an extra pickup; the pickup will be the one the trinket is associated with (random in the case of Lucky Toe).
* {{i|Angelic Prism}}: A thrown key will duplicate into 4 keys, which can be used to open multiple rooms or chests with only 1 key. If Isaac stands at the middle far left or middle far right of the first room in {{S|Chest}}, a thrown key can open all 4 chests.
* {{Book of Belial synergy|description=Invokes the effect of {{i|Razor Blade}} without dealing damage to Judas along with the original effect.}}
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns white wisps in the shape of keys, on the middle ring. Despite the wisps' appearance, they cannot unlock anything, and act as normal wisps.}}
* {{i|Continuum}}: Thrown keys can unlock multiple doors it passes through.
* {{t|Gilded Key}}: Enemies will only give the contents of locked chests. The pickups they can drop will also include [[Cards and Runes#Runes|runes]] and {{E|Lil' Battery|text=Batteries}}.
* {{t|The Left Hand}}: Enemies will only give the contents of red chests.
** As locked/red chests are able to give Items whereas normal chests cannot, the previous two trinkets also allow items to be obtained through Sharp Key more consistently.
* {{i|Mom's Key}}: Doubles the amount of pickups dropped by enemies.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|Car Battery}}: No effect.
* {{t|Daemon's Tail}}: Enemies are much less likely to drop hearts; these hearts will still be {{e|Black Heart}}s.
* {{I|Dead Eye}}: Keys thrown will contribute to Dead Eye's damage modifier.
* {{e|Golden Key}}s: Ignored by Sharp Key; it will still require and consume keys to use.
* {{i|Guppy's Eye}}: There will be no overlay on enemies that would drop pickups on death.
* {{I|Haemolacria}}/{{i|The Parasite}}: Split tears from thrown keys are normal tears.
* {{i|Kidney Stone}} / {{i|Number One}} / {{i|Pluto}} / {{i|Inner Child}}'s revive: Sharp Key loses almost all of its range, and can only be improved with [[tear height]] ups.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: No effect.
* {{i|Multidimensional Baby}}: Keys passing through the baby turn into normal tears and loses all of its effects.
* {{i|Pay To Play}}: The key cannot unlock doors that originally were accessible by keys, but can still open chests and open secret room doors.
* {{t|Poker Chip}}: Enemies have a 50/50 chance to spawn extra pickups or an {{E|Attack Fly}}: The attack fly will be instantly killed by the thrown key.
* [[Tear Effects#Spectral|Spectral Tears]]: Rocks that thrown keys pass over have a chance of being destroyed.
* {{I|Trisagion}}: Thrown keys become Trisagion blasts and no longer cause enemies to drop chest contents on kill.

sections.Effects:
* {{dlc|nr}} Reduces [[tear delay]] by the formula: (delay / 4) - 2
* {{dlc|r}} Multiplies [[fire rate]] / divides [[tear delay]] by 5.5x
* 0.2x [[damage]] multiplier.
* {{Dlc|nr}} 0.5x tear size multiplier.
* {{Dlc|r}} -0.3 tear size.
* {{dlc|r}} Drastically reduces [[knockback]] from Isaac's tears.
sections.Notes:
* Due to the high fire rate, items that cause tears to inflict [[status effect]]s activate more frequently.
** This makes Soy Milk very powerful with characters that start with higher luck such as {{C|Cain}}, or those who can avoid damage to obtain {{T|Perfection}} such as {{C|The Lost}} / {{C|Tainted Lost}}.
* {{dlc|nr}} At base tear rate, Soy Milk sets the player's tear delay to the game's minimum value of 1, for 15 tears per second. This is much lower than the normal minimum tear delay; see [[tear delay|the tear delay explanation page]].
* {{dlc|nr}} At base damage, Soy Milk is a very small DPS up. With a tear delay of 8 or lower, Soy Milk becomes a DPS down. The more tears per second before obtaining Soy Milk, the greater the decrease in DPS.
* Soy Milk's damage down stat also significantly decreases tear size.
* {{dlc|nr}} The endless stream of tears effectively increases directional knockback.
* {{dlc|na}} Soy Milk is a [[special item]].
* {{dlc+|r+}} Soy Milk's quality is treated as 1 for the purposes of {{I|Bag of Crafting}}.{{dlc-}}
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|20/20}}: The shot pattern may help in controlling enemy knockback, in addition to dealing up to {{Dlc|nr}} double damage {{dlc|r}} 60% more damage.
* {{i|Blood Clot}}: +1 damage bonus on the left eye. Blood Clot tears are unaffected by the damage penalty.
* {{dlc|r}} {{i|Brimstone}}/{{c|Azazel}}: Beam can be fired continuously after charging. The beam can change its direction while being fired, and can be aimed in any direction with joystick controls.
* {{i|Chemical Peel}}: +2 damage bonus on the left eye. Chemical Peel tears are unaffected by the damage penalty.
* {{i|Chocolate Milk|nr}}: Shots cannot be charged, but Isaac gains a flat +1 damage up after the Soy Milk penalty.
** {{dlc|r}} Shots cannot be charged, but Isaac shoots moderately charged shots at a quick pace.
* {{i|Cursed Eye|r}}: Fires automatically upon reaching full charge. This may be riskier than Cursed Eye alone because Soy Milk prevents Isaac from holding a fully charged shot.
* {{i|Euthanasia}}/{{i|Little Horn}}: Allow Isaac to quickly execute non-boss enemies.
** {{dlc|r}} '''Little Horn's''' damage to bosses is not affected by the penalty, resulting in significantly higher damage output.
* {{i|Explosivo}}: Despite the tiny appearance of the bomb tears, the explosions will do normal explosion damage. Due to the massive fire rate, many bombs can be applied in extremely quick succession, decimating anything after a short delay.
* {{i|Godhead|r}}: The damage of the tears' aura is not affected by the reduction.
* {{I|Head of the Keeper}}: The barrage of tears makes it much more likely for coin drops.
* {{i|Ipecac}}: The very fast rate of fire fills the screen with low damage explosions.
** '''Ipecac''' + {{I|Technology}}: The lasers will explode when they hit a rock, wall, or enemy. This combined with Soy Milk's fire rate and Ipecac's damage makes for an extremely safe method of clearing most rooms.
* {{i|Lead Pencil}}: The extra tear burst is fired very often.
* {{i|Libra|nr}}: Decreases fire rate slightly, but massively increases damage, range, and speed. Tear height is also massively increased, meaning tears can hit enemies through obstacles without spectral effect.
** {{dlc|r}} Resets stats to slightly higher than base level.
** {{dlc|r}} '''Libra''' + {{i|Brimstone}}: Constant Brimstone beam at normal/higher damage.
* {{i|Lost Contact}}: Extremely effective at blocking shots.
* {{i|A Lump of Coal}}: Significantly increases tear damage as they get further away.
* {{I|Monstro's Lung|r}}: Continuously fires tear barrages without the need to be charged.
* {{I|The Mulligan}}: Will generate an enormous wave of blue flies given that each tear has a 1/6 chance of spawning one.
** The same applies to {{tf|Guppy}} since each tear {{dlc|nr}} is guaranteed to spawn a fly {{dlc|r}} has a 2/3 chance of spawning one.
* {{i|Mysterious Liquid}}: Each shot creates creep that deals reasonable damage but stacks with every shot, causing hefty damage.
* [[Piercing tears]]: Causes tears to affect enemy movement less for better accuracy, though also removes the advantage of rapidly knocking back enemies.
* {{i|Pisces}}: Greatly increases knockback, allowing tears to pin enemies against walls.
* {{i|Rock Bottom}}: Grants a huge fire rate up without lowering Isaac's current damage. However, the damage multiplier and damage down still apply behind the scenes, making it very difficult to gain additional damage.
* {{I|Strange Attractor}}: Enemies get pulled towards Isaac's tears, allowing for higher accuracy and a way to work around the reduced knockback.
** Despite the tears having a stronger magnetic quality as they travel, it is still possible for enemies to get knocked wildly around the room. It is advised to play the long-range game when utilizing this synergy.
* {{i|Tech X|r}}: Automatically charges and fires fully charged Tech X rings. Non-fully charged rings can still be fired by releasing the fire key during charging, but much harder due to the high fire rate and removal of charge bar.
* {{i|Technology Zero}}: The near-constant stream of tears will have electricity chained between them, providing an electrical net of damage making it almost impossible to not hit an enemy.  This can greatly help offset the lowered damage by increasing the number of hits.
* {{t|Torn Card}}: Unlike the normal Ipecac synergy, Torn Card shots ignore the damage down multiplier and always deal +40 damage, '''significantly''' increasing DPS.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Almond Milk}}: Overrides Soy Milk (no additional effect on tears or damage).
* {{dlc|na}} {{I|Dr. Fetus}}: Rapidly shoots very low damage bombs. Can create a line of bombs which can knock each other back, which can be difficult to avoid taking damage from.
** {{dlc|anr}} Rapidly shoots medium damage bombs. Can create a line of bombs which can knock each other back, which can be difficult to avoid taking damage from.
** {{dlc|r}} Rapidly shoots low damage mini-bombs. Bombs don't knock each other back.
* {{i|Epic Fetus}}: Damage of missiles will be decreased accordingly, but unlike normal tears, there is still a fixed timed delay between firing missiles.
* {{i|Kidney Stone}}: Charge time is not affected.
* {{i|Maw Of The Void}}: Charge time is not affected, but damage is still reduced.
* {{dlc|r}} {{i|Mom's Knife}}: No special synergy; charge bar still disappears, but the knife will not be automatically released upon full charge.
* {{Dlc|nr}}{{i|Proptosis}}: The low-damage, lowered size tears disappear extremely quickly, greatly reducing effective range.
** {{Dlc|r}} The damage reduction causes tears to disappear more quickly, slightly reducing effective range.
* {{i|Revelation}}: Charge time is not affected, but damage is still reduced.
* {{dlc|nr}} {{i|Technology 2}}: Half of the Soy Milk tears are replaced by a constant laser, but damage down compounds.
** {{dlc|r}} Half of the Soy Milk tears are replaced by a constant laser and there is no further damage down on it.

sections.Effects:
* A circle surrounds Isaac. When entering a room, the circle is filled with 7 orbiting tears that copy Isaac's tear properties.
** The tears will deal 1.5× Isaac's damage +5 flat damage.
** After 13 seconds, the tears will automatically fall to the ground.
** Orbiting tears are [[spectral tears|spectral]], although they don't visually appear to be.
** The room does not have to be a new room to renew the 7 orbiting tears.
* Enemy tears have a chance to be caught in the orbit, making them able to damage enemies.
** Captured tears deal damage based on their size rather than how much they would've hurt Isaac: basic enemy shots deal 3.5 damage, and most champion shots deal 4.9 damage, but there is further variance.
** Enemy tears caught disappear after a short time or upon leaving the current room.
sections.Notes:
* Any new effect on tears provided by an item or a trinket won't affect ring tears until getting to a new room.
** This is the same for lost effects (e.g. by dropping a trinket).
* When using a teleporter in {{s|Mausoleum}}/{{s|Gehenna}}, the tears won't teleport and instead travel back towards the ring.
* Saturnus tears deal no damage to "grid entities", such as {{g|TNT}} and {{g|Poop}}.
* When Isaac spawns in the center of a room, or away from the door he should have entered through (for example, against {{e|Mom}} or {{e|Gurdy}} or on the first room of each floor), Saturnus' tears will spawn by the door and move towards Isaac.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|A Lump of Coal}}: The tears grow in size and damage as they orbit around Isaac.
* {{i|Angelic Prism}}: The prism and tears share the same orbit, making them easy to split.
* {{i|Blood Clot}}/{{i|Chemical Peel}}/{{i|Stye}}: Orbiting tears will be the same as the last fired tear before leaving the previous room.
** Having an item that randomly applies the bonus ({{i|Mom's Knife}}, {{i|Brimstone}}, {{i|Stapler}}, etc), will give each tear a 50% chance to have the bonus.
* {{i|Cricket's Body}}: The orbiting tears will split as normal, but the tears produced by the split will orbit Isaac instead of spreading out.
* {{i|Godhead}}: The orbiting tears have Godhead's damaging aura without the homing effect.
* [[Homing tears]]: Tears will break orbit to home into nearby enemies. With [[piercing tears|piercing]], tears will return to the orbit after dealing damage.
* {{i|Kidney Stone}}: It's possible for one of the tears surrounding Isaac to be the stone.
* {{i|Multidimensional Baby}}: Because both the orbiting tears and multidimensional baby start on top of Isaac when entering a room, all of the tears are immediately doubled.
* {{i|The Parasite}} + [[piercing]] tears: The tears continuously create two smaller tears as they hit enemies, all of which in turn orbit and pierce enemies as well, resulting in far higher damage.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|Brimstone}} / {{I|C Section}} / {{I|Dr. Fetus}} / {{I|Epic Fetus}} / {{I|Mom's Knife}} / {{I|Technology}} / {{I|Tech X}}: No unique interactions; regular tears are generated which orbit Isaac normally.
* {{I|Crown Of Light}}: Functions as intended, but the tears surrounding Isaac will appear normal.
* {{i|Explosivo}}/{{t|Nose Goblin}}/{{i|Sinus Infection}}/{{i|Mucormycosis}}: Orbiting tears that stick to an enemy will return to the ring if the enemy cannot be stuck to anymore before the tear's duration ends.
* {{I|Friend Finder}}: Bullets fired from friendly enemies can still get caught in the orbit.
* {{T|Hook Worm}}: No effect upon ring's tear.
* {{i|Ipecac}}: Tears surrounding Isaac will not cause self damage if at maximum distance until high tear size. If Isaac enters a room and his Saturnus tears have not spread out, they could hit an entity and cause self damage.
* {{i|Lachryphagy}}: Orbiting tears are Lachryphagy tears, including enemy tears caught in orbit. Tears will still burst after a set duration, greatly the reducing the amount of time the tears orbit for. Burst tears will remain in an orbital path instead of spreading out.
* {{i|Proptosis}}: Causes the tears to immediately fall, making Saturnus almost irrelevant. Enemy tears caught in the orbit will not fade away, and its defensive benefits helps slightly to maintain the aggressive playstyle required by Proptosis.
* {{T|Ring Worm}} / {{t|Ouroboros Worm}}: The trinkets cause the ring tears to move with a very anarchistic movement in and out of the circle.
* {{I|Sulfuric Acid}} / {{I|Terra}}: As the orbiting tears can destroy rocks, Isaac can unintentionally detonate [[Rocks#Bomb Rocks|Bomb Rocks]], causing self damage.
* {{i|Tractor Beam}}: No effect on surrounding tears.

sections.Effects:
Upon taking damage, activates the following effects:
* 25% chance to drop a full {{E|Red Heart}}.
* {{dlc|nr}} 10% chance to gain the {{i|Anemic}} effect (+5 [[range]], red creep trail) for the current room upon taking damage.
* {{dlc|r}} Causes Isaac to bleed, spewing blood tears around him constantly.
** The sprayed tears vary in damage, roughly in range of 67% to 101% of Isaac's base damage.
** Holding a direction of fire focuses the bleeding tears to that direction, with slightly increased range.
*** The bleeding tears can be aimed at any direction just like having {{i|Analog Stick}}.
** After bleeding for 20 seconds, Isaac's Red Hearts or Rotten Hearts will take damage (bypassing other Hearts); this is indicated by Isaac slowly turning red after and eventually blinking. This damage also has a 25% chance to drop a full Red Heart. The damaging effect will continue to occur every 20 seconds until the bleeding effect ends.
*** The damage amount is always half a {{E|Red Heart}}, a [[Health#Coin Hearts|Coin Heart]], or a {{E|Rotten Heart|n}}, even in later [[chapters]] where most damage is now a full Heart or two Rotten Hearts.
** The bleeding effect ends when Isaac receives any form of {{E|Red Heart}} or {{E|Rotten Heart|n}} healing, if he has no more Red or Rotten Hearts, if he fills an {{E|Eternal Heart}}, or if the next hit would kill him.
** If Isaac has no Red or Rotten Hearts, the bleeding effect of Shard of Glass will not activate.
sections.Notes:
* Red Hearts spawned by this item may become different hearts in certain {{R|Super Secret Room}}s.
* {{dlc|r}} Regarding the bleeding effect:
** Taking bleed damage does not affect {{r|Devil Room}} or {{r|Angel Room}} chances.
** Bleeding blood tears will not keep any [[Tear Effects|tear effects]] or special tears that Isaac has.
** The bleeding effect persists between floor transitions.
** If Shard of Glass is re-rolled or lost while Isaac is bleeding, the bleeding will continue, but {{E|Red Heart}}s will no longer spawn when Isaac takes damage.
** {{C|The Forgotten}} can end the bleeding by switching to {{C|The Soul}}.
** The bleeding effect works with {{C|Keeper}} {{dlc+|r}}(and {{C|Tainted Keeper}}){{dlc-}}. They will bleed and lose a coin heart until only one coin is left. Receiving coins will stop the bleeding effect. Due to Tainted Keeper only having two coin hearts in most circumstances, bleeding will rarely apply to him.
** Rotten Hearts will take bleeding damage only when Isaac has no red hearts remaining. Picking up Rotten Hearts will also end the bleeding.
** Using a [[bed]] or a Full Health [[Pills|pill]] to heal Isaac's red hearts will not stop the bleeding.
** Turning into The Lost via the {{E|White Fire Place|n}} or {{P|Soul of the Lost|n}} will stop bleeding effect.
** Using the {{I|Yum Heart}} will stop the bleeding effect.
sections.Synergies:
* {{dlc|r}} {{I|Epic Fetus}} / {{I|Marked}}: Bleeding tears will aim at the crosshair.
* {{dlc|r}} {{I|The Ludovico Technique}}: Bleeding tears will aim at the controlled tear.
* {{i|Cambion Conception}} / {{i|Candy Heart}} / {{i|Immaculate Conception}} / {{i|Fanny Pack}} / {{i|Piggy Bank}}: Isaac can get the rewards from items that give items/resources on hit by intentionally taking damage with something like a fire and grabbing the hearts, for essentially half the cost (as every 4 hits generates 1 full heart on average, which let isaac take 2 more hits)
* {{I|IV Bag}}: Lets Isaac generate large amounts of money
* {{i|Maggy's Bow}}: Doubles the healing received from the hearts spawned, letting isaac effectively take infinite red heart damage (on average) if each hit takes half a heart.
** {{i|Humbleing Bundle}} generates 3 hits of health on average for every 4 taken.

sections.Effect:
* Spawns a [[familiar]] that wanders around the room and occasionally spawns friendly [[Familiar#Blue Spiders|Blue Spider]]s.
** Blue Spiders are spawned once every 10-15 seconds, as long as there are enemies in the room.
** Only up to 5 Blue Spiders can be spawned at a time.
* {{Dlc|r}} [[Charm]]s enemies briefly on contact.
* {{Dlc+|r}}{{transformation contribution|Spider Baby}}{{dlc-}}
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|BFFS!}} / {{i|Hive Mind}}: Spawn delay is decreased to 7-11 seconds.
* {{i|Mom's Wig}}: The maximum number of Blue Spiders is increased to 10.

sections.Effects:
* +0.4 [[tears]].
* Spawns two {{E|Soul Heart}}s.

sections.Effect: * Adds three full [[Red Heart Container]]s.

sections.Effects:
* Gives +2 [[damage]] for the current [[Rooms|room]].
* {{dlc|na}} Guarantees the {{r|Devil Room}} or {{r|Angel Room}} to spawn after killing a [[boss]] while holding it.
* {{dlc|a}} Increases the chance to open the {{r|Devil Room}} or {{r|Angel Room}} after killing a [[boss]] by 12.5% while holding it.
* {{transformation contribution|Bookworm}}
sections.Notes:
* {{C|Judas}} starts with this item by default.
* {{dlc|nr}} While activated, switching items will end the bonus damage effect.
* {{dlc|nr}} If the {{I|Schoolbag}} and a second activated item are held, the book must be equipped in the primary slot to receive the {{r|Devil Room}} / {{r|Angel Room}} bonus.
* {{dlc|na}} Only guarantees Devil/Angel Rooms on floors that they can normally appear on, and, unlike {{i|Goat Head}}, picking up The Book of Belial after killing the boss will not open the Devil/Angel Room door.
* {{dlc|nr}} The damage bonus does not stack with multiple uses in the same room or with {{p|XV - The Devil}}.
** {{dlc|r}} Additional uses in the same room or combined with {{p|XV - The Devil}} give +1 damage per use.

* The damage of the laser scales directly with Isaac's damage.
* Unlike {{i|Technology}} or {{i|Technology 2}}, Isaac can still fire tears from both eyes in addition to firing the laser.
* The laser can be fired independently from tears by slightly tilting the right analog stick, just like shooting familiars.
* {{Dlc|r}} Unlike {{i|Technology}}, Tech.5 Lasers do not have momentum, and fire exclusively in the cardinal directions unless Isaac has an item like {{i|Analog Stick}}, {{i|Eye of the Occult}} or {{I|Marked}}.
sections.Interactions:
* {{Dlc|r}}{{I|Anti-Gravity}}:  Creates floating laser balls that will all fire simultaneously when the fire button is released.
* {{i|Brimstone|na}}: Tech.5 does not fire. However, it will still fire when playing as {{C|Azazel}} with his short-ranged Brimstone. Since the laser scales with player damage, this can be a devastating combination.
** {{dlc|a}} Tech.5 fires normally while Brimstone laser is charging.
* {{dlc|nr}} {{i|Cricket's Body}}: Tear delay down as expected, but no benefit from the splash effect.
** {{dlc|r}} Releases a 4-way spread of tears whenever the laser hits a wall or an enemy.
* {{i|Eye of the Occult}}: Only affects the laser's color.

* {{I|Gello}}: Laser only fires from Isaac.
* {{C|Lilith|anr}}: No effect, as Lilith is inherently Blindfolded.

* {{i|Sprinkler}}: No effect.
* {{I|Urn of Souls}}: Isaac can still fire the laser as normal while using the urn.

sections.Effects:
* Allows Isaac to walk across gaps one square across by automatically placing a ladder between the two walkable sections. Enemies can not walk over the ladder.
* {{C|Jacob and Esau}}: both characters can walk over the ladder, but only the character with the item can place it.

* Adds a chance to shoot [[poison|poison tears]], dealing damage over time when inflicted.
** {{dlc|na}} The poison randomly hits either 2 or 3 times, dealing a total of 4 or 6 damage.
** {{dlc|a}} The poison hits 2 times, dealing a total of 2x Isaac's damage.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Abyss}}: When Isaac uses Abyss to absorb The Common Cold it turns into a green locust that poisons enemies.
* {{i|Compound Fracture}}/{{i|Cricket's Body}}/{{i|Haemolacria}}/{{i|The Parasite}}: Chance for tears and split tears to be poisonous. If the main tear is poisonous, the split tears are too.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}}/{{i|Epic Fetus}}: Chance for bombs/explosions to become poisonous like {{i|Bob's Curse}}.
* {{I|Finger!}}: Finger can also apply the poison effect.
* {{i|Lachryphagy}}: If a poison tear is fed, all burst tears are poisonous. If a normal tear is fed, the burst tears are not poisonous.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: The tear flickers green, capable of poisoning enemies when it does.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Ipecac}}/{{i|Scorpio}}: Overrides The Common Cold.
* {{I|Serpent's Kiss|anr}}: Both poison effects work, but poison caused by Common Cold will not cause {{e|Black Heart}} drops. There is no way to tell which poison is applied.
* {{t|Pinky Eye}}: Activation rates are individually applied to each tear, effectively allowing for higher amounts of poison tears. However at 12 Luck, the trinket will not do anything for Isaac as The Common Cold is guaranteed to make every tear poisoned at that point.

sections.Effect:

sections.Synergies:
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Grants a random wisp based on one of the [[Seven Deadly Sins]]. The wisp spawned isn't linked to the pickup dropped.
** {{e|Pride}}: a blue bomb wisp in the middle ring. When destroyed, a small homing bomb that deals normal troll bomb damage is spawned.
** {{e|Greed}}: 3 yellow coin wisps in the outer ring. Their tears may petrify enemies like {{i|Midas' Touch}}.
** {{e|Wrath}}: an orange bomb wisp in the middle ring, which fire flaming tears. They drop troll bombs when continuously firing, and leave a bomb pickup when they die.
** {{e|Envy}}: a white face-like wisp in the outer ring.
** {{e|Lust}}: a randomly colored pill wisp in the inner ring, with effects that are the same as {{i|Mom's Bottle of Pills}} wisps.
** {{e|Gluttony}}: a heart wisp in the middle ring, with effects that are the same as {{i|Yum Heart}} wisps.
** {{e|Sloth}}: a Bob's Head wisp in the middle ring. Their tears travel in an arc like {{i|Ipecac}} but don't always explode on impact. There is a small chance for an exploding tear.}}

sections.Effects:
* Grants one full Red [[Heart container]].
* +0.3 [[damage]].
* {{Dlc|r}} Heals 1 additional {{E|Red Heart}}.
* Replaces tears with a laser beam with unlimited range and [[Piercing tears|piercing]]. The laser is fired from Isaac's left eye.
sections.Notes:
* Laser rate of fire is determined by the [[tears]] stat. This differentiates the item from {{i|Technology 2}} which fires a continuous beam, and {{i|Tech.5}} which has a random fire rate.
* {{dlc|r}} Laser size scales with tear size.
** {{dlc|r}} The sound emitted by the laser will also change depending on its size. This is purely aesthetic.
* {{dlc|r}} Lasers are affected by momentum, allowing them to be shot diagonally if fired while Isaac is moving.
* {{dlc|r}} When directly adjacent to a wall or [[Obstacles|obstacle]] and firing in the wrong direction the obstacle may block the laser, preventing it from damaging enemies. This can happen on all sides of a given [[Rooms|room]] with the exception of the bottom wall.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Haemolacria}}: Fires arcing Haemolacria tears that release Technology lasers in all directions upon impact.
* {{i|Brimstone|na}}: Overrides Technology.
** {{dlc|a}} The Technology laser coils around the Brimstone beam, granting a 1.5x damage multiplier, which can stack with other multipliers such as {{I|Magic Mushroom}}[[Magic Mushroom|'s]] 1.5x damage multiplier.
*** {{Dlc|r}} Technology's damage multiplier will be overridden if Isaac has the powered up version (from picking up Brimstone twice or using {{I|Sulfur|n}} with Brimstone).
* {{i|Epic Fetus|a}}: Fires lasers in all directions upon impact of a missile.
* {{dlc+|r}}{{i|Eye of the Occult}}: The laser becomes dark purple and automatically fires at a controllable crosshair. The crosshair behaves nearly identically to the one created by {{I|Marked}} (including in its synergies and interactions with other items) with the exception that lasers often arch towards the crosshair rather than traveling towards it directly and any other projectiles affected by Eye of the Occult that are not lasers (such as from {{i|Eye of Greed}} or {{i|Fate's Reward}}) will chase the crosshair and hover above it for the remainder of their range.
** '''Technology''' + {{i|Tech.5}}/{{i|Technology 2}}: Tech.5 and Technology 2 lasers are also affected by the crosshair but cannot create the crosshair on their own.{{dlc-}}
* {{i|Fire Mind}}: Laser lights enemies on fire but loses the ability to explode enemies.
* {{i|The Inner Eye}} / {{i|Mutant Spider}}: Isaac shoots multiple lasers with a decreased rate of fire.
* {{i|Lachryphagy|r}}: Isaac shoots a short-range laser that will form a Lachryphagy tear, which has piercing.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: The laser becomes a large ring that is controllable and looks like a {{i|Tech X}} shot. Enemies inside the ring without touching it are not hurt. The tears stat is ignored and the damage is dealt very rapidly at a rate equivalent to a 1 tear delay. {{dlc|nr}} Shot speed is ignored.
** When {{i|Spoon Bender}} is added to this synergy, the laser ring will morph to target enemies, along with the standard homing effect.
* {{i|Marked|r}}: Isaac can fire lasers at the crosshair.
* {{i|Mom's Eye}}: Fires a laser from the back of Isaac's head as well as the front.
* {{i|Monstro's Lung|anr}}: Several additional lasers fire in random directions. (One beam will always fire straight forward as normal.)
** {{dlc|r}} Fires a barrage of small lasers.
* {{i|Pop!|r}}: Laser loses its unlimited range, but spawns eyeball tears at the end of the laser.
* {{i|Proptosis|na}}: Doubles damage with no damage-decreasing effect on the laser.
** {{dlc|anr}} Doubles the damage stat, the beams deal 2x damage at point blank range but it rapidly decreases with distance, down to 0.1 from about 8 tiles away.
** {{dlc|r}} The beams do 6x damage at point blank range but decreases to 0.1 damage at about 8 tiles away.
* {{i|Spirit Sword}}: Sword becomes a lightsaber. Surrounds Isaac with a laser on every swing. Enemy projectiles are deflected by both normal and charged attacks.
* {{i|Tech X|dlc=anr}}: Both fire at the same time.
** {{dlc|r}} Fires a {{i|Brimstone}} ring coiled by a laser. Hitbox is bigger with no damage increase.
* {{i|Technology|a}}: Adds an additional laser for every extra copy of the item up to a maximum of 16, with no downgrade to damage or tears.
* {{i|Technology 2|nr}}: Equips two lasers that can be fired at the same time. As Technology is always fired from the right eye, it is not affected by the halved normal attack rate.
** {{dlc|r}} Technology is affected by the fire rate multiplier. Holding {{i|Stapler}}, {{i|Lead Pencil}} or playing as {{c|Cain}} will allow Isaac to angle shots with momentum again.
* {{i|Tiny Planet}}: Laser circles around Isaac and then continues its path forward in a straight line. The laser is also spectral.
** {{dlc|a}} {{i|Tiny Planet}} + {{i|A Lump of Coal}}: The extra distance covered by the laser more than doubles damage right in front of Isaac, and it increases as normal further away.
* {{i|Tough Love}} / {{i|Apple!}}: The lasers can gain the damage multiplier from each of the items, although there is no visual difference.
sections.Interactions:
* {{dlc|na}} {{i|20/20}}: Overridden by Technology.
** {{dlc|a}} Shoot 2 lasers.
* {{dlc|nr}} {{i|Anti-Gravity}}: Tears up, but no Anti-Gravity effect.
** {{dlc|r}} Create laser balls that fire technology lasers when released.
* {{dlc|na}} {{C|Azazel}}: Overrides Azazel's Brimstone.

* {{i|Blood Clot}} / {{I|Chemical Peel}} / {{I|The Peeper|r}}: 50% chance to apply the flat damage up/damage increase with each shot.

* {{i|Continuum|dlc=anr}}: Overridden by Technology.

* {{dlc|nr}} {{i|Cursed Eye}}: Overridden by Technology.

* {{dlc|nr}} {{i|Cricket's Body}}: Tear delay down as expected, but no benefit from the splash effect.
** {{dlc|r}} Releases a 4-way spread of tears whenever the laser hits a wall or an enemy.
* {{i|Dead Eye}}: Prior to picking up Technology, the damage multiplier is preserved to where its at, and missing shots will not remove it.  Saving and quitting the game will remove the multiplier. Picking Dead Eye after Technology has no effect.
* {{i|Death's Touch}}: Overridden by Technology, but still grants damage.

* {{i|Eye of Belial}}: Overridden by Technology.
* {{I|Flat Stone}}: Overridden by Technology.
* {{t|Flat Worm}} / {{t|Pulse Worm}}: No effect.
* {{i|Godhead}}: [[Homing tears|Homing]] laser, but the halo is lost.
* {{dlc+|anr}} {{i|Head of the Keeper}}: Overridden by Technology.{{dlc-}}
** {{dlc|r}} The laser is recolored to a bright yellow-orange and keeps the chance to drop coins when hitting enemies.
* {{dlc+|anr}} {{i|Holy Light}}: Holy Light shots will not activate.{{dlc-}}
** {{dlc|r}} Holy Light shots have a chance to activate on hit as expected.
* {{t|Hook Worm}}: Laser follows a square wave, which increases its hitbox.
* {{i|Ipecac}}: Laser doesn't gain Ipecac's flat damage bonus or fire rate decrease, poisons targets.
** {{dlc|a+}} Gives a flat +4 damage instead of +40, poisons targets. Fire rate is not decreased.
** {{dlc|r}} Gives a flat +2 damage instead of +40, laser poisons and explodes on contact, dealing 10 + twice of Isaac's damage. Fire rate decrease applies.
*** {{i|Mom's Knife|r}}: Not reccomended. Isaac will blow himself up consistently whenever he shoots the knife.
* {{i|Isaac's Tears}}: Fires normal tears.
* {{i|Jacob's Ladder|a+nr}}: Overridden by Technology.{{dlc-}}

* {{i|A Lump of Coal|na}}: No effect.

* {{i|Marked|anr}}: Overridden by Technology, stat bonuses still apply.
* {{i|Mom's Knife|na}}: Overrides Technology.
** {{dlc|anr}} Both fire normally.
*** When playing as {{C|Lilith}}, Mom's Knife overrides Technology.
** {{Dlc|r}} The tip of Mom's Knife connects to isaac's body with a laser when launched. This effect is similar to that of {{I|Technology Zero|n}}
** {{dlc|nr}} '''Mom's Knife''' + {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: The laser ring becomes centered on Isaac and cannot be controlled, and the knife can not be fired. This makes some rooms impossible to do without a [[familiar]].
* {{i|My Reflection|na}}: Overridden by Technology.
** {{dlc|anr}} Makes the beam curve the opposite direction while Isaac is moving sideways.
** {{dlc|r}} The laser makes a thin loop in front of Isaac, and fires the normal laser backwards.
*** {{i|Pop!|r}}: The laser ends halfway through the loop. Spawns Eyeball tears like normal.
* {{i|Mysterious Liquid|na}}: Overridden by Technology.
** {{dlc|a}} The laser spawns pools of liquid always when it hits obstacles and occasionally on enemies.
* {{i|Neptunus}}: Overridden by Technology.
* {{i|Number One}}: Expected tears up and the laser's color turns yellow.
* {{t|Ouroboros Worm|a+nr}}: No effect on laser.
** {{dlc|r}} Works as intended.
* {{i|Pupula Duplex}}: Laser becomes spectral.
** {{dlc|r}} Laser beams are thicker in terms of width.
* {{i|Soy Milk}}: Expected high damage down and very high tears up. {{dlc|nr}} Because Technology has no knockback like standard tears, this will generally be a good DPS increase.
* {{i|Technology Zero}}: No effect.
* {{i|The Parasite|nr}}: Overridden by Technology.
** {{dlc|r}} Laser splits into two perpendicular beams upon hitting an obstacle.
** {{dlc|r+}} Also spawn small split tears.
* {{i|Parasitoid|a+nr+}}: Overridden by Technology.
* {{dlc|nr}}{{T|Ring Worm}}: No effect.
** {{Dlc|r}} Laser wraps around itself multiple times, effectively increasing hitbox.
* {{i|Rubber Cement|na}}: Overridden by Technology.
** {{dlc|a}} Lasers bounce off of walls.
* {{i|Tractor Beam|dlc=anr}}: No effect.
** {{Dlc|r}} Lasers are no longer affected by Isaac's momentum.
* {{I|Trisagion}}: Overridden by Technology.
* {{t|Wiggle Worm}}: Laser follows a sine wave, which increases its hitbox.
* {{i|Compound Fracture}}: Overriden by Technology.

sections.Effects:
* Gives Isaac a spider [[familiar]] that burrows in Isaac's head, firing four slowing tears in addition to Isaac's normal tears.
** The slowing tears deal 1.5 damage each, and fired every 1.5 seconds.
** These tears are unaffected by Isaac's damage and tears stats; they have fixed damage and fire rate.
* Upon taking damage, there is a chance that Isaac's head will pop, spawning [[Familiar#Blue Spiders|friendly spiders]], and release the Intruder familiar, who will leap at enemies to deal contact damage, and fires four slowing tears towards nearby enemies instead of Isaac.
** The spider familiar deals up to 4.5 contact damage depending on how fast it's moving and fires slowing tears twice as fast compared to when it's in Isaac's head.
** The chance for activation goes up to 100% at 4 [[luck]].
** The familiar lasts for the current room, and Isaac's head is reattached upon entering a new room.
* {{transformation contribution|Spider Baby}}
sections.Notes:
* The Intruder is treated as a familiar even while in Isaac's head, and benefits from familiar synergies while in it.
* If The Intruder is released after {{i|The Pinking Shears}} are used, control is given back to an invisible head with only a shadow visible. This is due to both the head (the spider) and the body being mobilized to attack.
sections.Synergies:
* {{t|Baby-Bender}}: The shots are homing even while in Isaac's head.
* {{i|Box of Friends}}: Doubles the number of tears fired from Isaac's head (if both copies fire at the same time, the tears will stack perfectly so it can be difficult to tell). If The Intruder is released, then interacts normally and spawns a copy.
* {{i|Hive Mind}}: Increases The Intruder's tear and contact damage.
* {{I|BFFS!}}: Increases The Intruder's tear and contact damage. Does not stack with Hive Mind.
sections.Interactions:
* {{C|Azazel}}: The Intruder's tears come from Azazel while charging his {{i|Brimstone}}.
* {{i|Guillotine}}: The Intruder's tears come from Isaac's body.
* {{C|Lilith}}: The Intruder's tears come from Lilith, despite her blindfold.
* {{i|Sacrificial Altar}}: The Intruder can be sacrificed even while in Isaac's head.
* {{I|Transcendence}}: When The Intruder is released, only Isaac's shadow will be visible.

sections.Effects:
* Isaac fires a spread of three tears at once.
* {{Dlc|nr}} Tears down: (Delay * 2.1) + 3
* {{Dlc|r}} Tears fired per second * 0.51.
sections.Notes:

* {{dlc+|r+}} The Inner Eye's quality is treated as 2 for the purposes of {{I|Bag of Crafting}}.{{dlc-}}
sections.Synergies:
* {{dlc|anr}} {{I|20/20}}: Shoots 5 tears with no further decrease in fire rate.

* {{i|Doctor's Remote}} / {{i|Epic Fetus}}: Replaces the single missile strike with a barrage of three consecutive missiles.
* {{i|The Inner Eye|anr}}: Effects stack, resulting in 6 tears being shot with no further decrease in fire rate.

* {{i|Mom's Knife}}: 3 knives are fired.

sections.Interactions:
* {{i|20/20|na}}: Overridden by The Inner Eye.
* {{i|Brimstone}}: Fires 3 beams. Affects Azazel's short-ranged '''Brimstone''' similarly.
* {{C|The Forgotten|a+}}: Triples bones thrown and swung. Significant decrease in fire rate.
* {{C|Keeper|anr}}: Fires 6 tears with significantly decreased fire rate.

* {{i|Kidney Stone}}: Increase number of tears in tear barrage; however, only fires one stone.
* {{i|Lead Pencil}}: The barrage will activate as normal but Isaac will sometimes fire red tears.
* {{i|Loki's Horns}}: Only occasionally fires one tear in the other three directions.
* {{i|Mom's Eye}}: Only occasionally fires one tear out of the back of Isaac's head.
* {{i|Mutant Spider|na}}: Overrides The Inner Eye.
* {{i|Monstro's Lung}}: Adds 5 tears to barrage with a significant decrease in fire rate.

sections.Effects:
* Once activated, all tears in the air split into 6 more tears in all directions, which retain their damage and shot speed.
** Luck-based effects from items such as {{i|Tough Love}} or {{i|Holy Light}} are applied individually to each tear.
sections.Notes: * {{Dlc|r}} The item only costs 10 coins when found in a {{r|Shop}}.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Akeldama}}: Will bust tears generated by Akeldama into Isaac's current tears.
* {{i|Angelic Prism}}: Tears that are split by the prism can be split again by Tear Detonator.
* {{i|Anti-Gravity}}: All tears currently floating in the air will be multiplied, resulting in a massive amount of tears.
* {{C|Bethany}}/{{C|Tainted Bethany}}: Bethany can use Tear Detonator multiple times in rapid succession at the cost of one Soul/Blood Charge per use, allowing for a huge area of effect that wipes out most rooms.

Created wisps trigger Tear Detonator's effect when destroyed. Despite Tear Detonator having a timed recharge, the wisps persist between rooms.}}
* {{i|Car Battery}}: Splits tears twice, creating 36 tears for every tear currently airborne.

* {{i|Tiny Planet}}: Tears split, and then orbit around where the tear was originally from, three spinning clockwise, three counterclockwise.
* {{i|Trisagion}}: Tears split into six beams.
* {{i|Uranus}}: Tears shot out from frozen enemies when they are destroyed can be split.
* {{i|Urn of Souls}}: Each flame splits into six tears, unlike other fire effects.
sections.Interactions:
