** This effect is identical to {{i|Teleport!}}'s effect with Book of Virtues, albeit with a 10% higher chance of teleporting enemies on hit.}}

sections.Effects:
* [[Items#Activated Collectibles|Activated items]] can be overcharged, allowing them to store up to one extra use.
** Extra charges appear in yellow over the normal charge meter.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|na+}} The Battery does not affect self-recharging activated items.
* {{dlc|nr}} Picking up a {{E|Lil' Battery}} while the held activated item's main charge bar isn't full will only fill the main charge bar without adding overcharge.
* Sworn Protector can be exploited with the help of a {{E|Constant Stone Shooter}} to spawn unlimited eternal hearts.
sections.Synergies:
* {{dlc|nr}}[[Friendly]] enemies: Spawning a friendly enemy that shoots bullets allows Eternal Hearts to be farmed since the friendly enemy will fire at Isaac if no hostile enemies are in the room.
* {{i|Sacrificial Altar}}: This familiar will also reward 2 {{e|Black Heart}}s when sacrificed.
sections.Interactions:
* {{t|Extension Cord}}: Familiar and Isaac are occasionally connected by electricity, but it is very hard to notice because Sworn Protector orbits so close to Isaac.
* {{dlc|r}}[[Friendly]] enemies: Friendly enemy tears are ignored by Sworn Protector.

sections.Effects:
* {{dlc|na}} Automatically inflicts [[slow]] to all enemies in every room, which slows them down to approximately 51.3% of their original movement and attacking speeds.
* {{dlc|anr}} Inflicts slow to all enemies in the current room after the player is hit.
* {{dlc|r}} Slows all enemies to 80% of their original movement speed and attacking speeds. This is separate from the [[slow]] status, and fully stacks with it. Isaac's tears and enemy shots are also slowed.
* +0.3 [[speed]].
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|nr}} The background music is slowed down to 70% of the original speed of the music during the item's effect.
* {{dlc+|r}} The background music is slowed down to about 90% of the original speed. The slowdown makes the music approximately 2 semitones lower.
** If acquired through {{i|Eden's Blessing}}, the starting track will be affected as well.{{dlc-}}
* {{dlc|nr}} Because of the slow effect, champion versions of enemies will be tinted the same color as all other enemies. This makes it much harder to distinguish certain champion types, such as those that explode upon death.
* {{E|Poky|text=Pokies}}, {{E|Slide}}s, minecarts and {{E|Mega Troll Bomb}}s are not affected and will move in their regular speed.
* {{dlc|na}} Stop Watch is a [[special item]].
sections.Synergies:
* {{dlc|anr}} {{i|Holy Mantle}}: Blocking damage with Holy Mantle triggers the Stop Watch effect.
* {{dlc|r}} All [[Slow]] effects: Stacks with the status resulting in enemies moving at about 41% of their original speed.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Broken Watch|na}}: Overridden by Stop Watch; the speed up effect will not occur.
** {{dlc|a}} Both the slow effect and the rarer speed up can trigger at the start of a room.
*** {{dlc|nr}} This results in enemies being slowed to around 71.8% of their original speed.
*** {{dlc|r}} This results in enemies being sped up by 12%.
* {{i|Tech X|r}}: Unlike most shots which are slowed down by Stop Watch, Tech X laser rings move at normal speed and gain no benefit they would get from slower shots.

sections.Notes:
* Using The Bible on {{E|Isaac}}, {{E|???}}, {{E|The Lamb}}, {{E|Hush}}, {{E|Mega Satan}}, {{e|Delirium}}, {{E|Dogma}}, {{E|The Beast}} or {{E|Mother}} has no special effect and does not kill Isaac.
** Will not affect Delirium even if it is transformed into a relevant boss.
* Switching active items while The Bible is active does not remove the flight, allowing continued flight until the room is exited.
sections.Synergies: * {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns white wisps in the middle ring. Wisps' tears have 0.75 shot speed and [[homing]], and deal 6 damage +0.1 per floor.}}
sections.Interactions: * {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.

sections.Effects: * All enemies in the [[room]] are [[Status Effects#Slow|slowed]] for 8 seconds.
sections.Synergies:
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns hourglass-shaped wisps on the middle ring. The wisps [[slow]] all enemies in the room for 3 seconds when destroyed. If the Hourglass is used or extra wisps are destroyed while the slow is in effect, its duration is extended.}}
* {{i|Car Battery}}: Doubles the duration of the effect.

sections.Effects: * Reveals the locations and types of all special rooms on the map, except {{r|Secret Room}}s and {{r|Super Secret Room}}s.
sections.Synergies: * {{i|Book of Secrets|r}}: It is easier to gain {{i|X-Ray Vision}} as Book of Secrets cannot give a mapping effect Isaac already has.

sections.Effects:
* Upon use, transforms Isaac into a [[wikipedia:Pac-Man (character)|Pac-Man]]-like creature for 6.5 seconds and provides the following effects:
** Gives [[Effects#Invulnerability|invulnerability]].
** Inflicts [[fear]] on all enemies.
** Removes the ability to shoot tears.
** {{dlc|nr}} Allows Isaac to deal 40 contact damage to enemies, at the rate of 1 hit per second per enemy.
** {{dlc|r}} Allows Isaac to deal 20 contact damage to enemies, at the rate of 2 hits per second per enemy.
*** If an enemy is at 40 HP or less, the contact damage is increased to 40 for that enemy.
** Each enemy that dies during the duration has a chance to replenish a {{e|Half Red Heart}} even if they weren't killed by Isaac's contact damage.
sections.Notes:
* The invulnerability effect negates almost all forms of damage, including health loss from {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}s and {{e|Devil Beggar}}s.
** This also negates damage from entering or exiting a {{r|Curse Room}}, but the effect is immediately removed upon walking through the door.
* Does not prevent damage from the door to the {{s|Mausoleum}} / {{s|Gehenna}}.
* Does not prevent [[Health#Red Heart Containers|Red Heart container]] loss from [[Health Down]] pills or [[Devil deal]]s.
* This item is very similar to {{i|My Little Unicorn}}, trading the extra speed for the ability to gain health from killing enemies.
* [[Pills|Power Pill!]] has the same effect as The Gamekid, same goes with {{T|Cartridge}} on getting hit.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|4.5 Volt}}: With some damage source while this item is active, it can be permanently invulnerable inside the room while you have enemies.
** If combined with {{I|9 Volt}}, it will be easier to achieve invincibility.
* {{i|???'s Only Friend}}: The fly can still be controlled while invincible.
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns wisps in the inner ring, looking like little Pac-Men. Wisps' tears have the {{I|Anti-Gravity}} effect and can inflict [[fear]] on enemies.}}
* {{i|Car Battery}}: Doubles the length of invincibility, but no effect on damage.
* {{I|Mom's Knife}} does contact damage in the same direction it was being held at the time of using it, giving a massive amount of free damage by ramming into an enemy.
** If you have the [[Yes Mother?]] Transformation, you can basically do the same thing using this item.
* Damage on contact items ({{i|Aries}}, {{i|The Virus}}, etc.) and [[Orbital Familiar]]s ({{i|Cube of Meat}}, {{i|Sacrificial Dagger}}, etc.): Deals damage on top of The Gamekid's damage and invincibility.
sections.Interactions:
* {{dlc|r}}[[Cards and Runes|Ace Cards]]: Enemies that are turned into [[pickup]]s don’t have a chance to heal Isaac.
* {{i|E. Coli}}/{{i|Flush!}}: Enemies that are turned into {{g|Poop}} don’t have a chance to heal Isaac.
** {{I|E. Coli}} Usually turns non-boss enemies into poop when Isaac attempts to deal contact damage making heals off of contact damage kills much harder.
* {{dlc|rnr+}}[[Freeze|Freeze Effects]]: Effects that can still freeze enemies while the item is active do not grant the chance to heal Isaac.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a familiar that bounces around the room and has a dark aura around it.
** Enemies within the radius of the aura take damage.
*** {{dlc|nr}} The aura deals 30% of Isaac's [[damage]] per tick or about 129% of Isaac's damage per second.
*** {{dlc|r}} The aura deals 2.5 damage per tick or about 7.5-10 damage per second.
** If Isaac is within the aura, his tears gain a 1.5× [[damage]] multiplier.
sections.Notes: * The damage boost stacks with other Succubi, as well as other damage multipliers (e.g. {{i|Cricket's Head}}, {{i|Sacred Heart}}, etc.).
sections.Synergies: * {{i|Rock Bottom}}: The damage boost is permanent. Damage is easier to stack, since Isaac can enter the Succubus aura to permanently boost any temporary damage-ups.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|BFFS!}}: Succubus and its damaging aura are visually larger, but the damage multiplier is not increased any further away from the familiar. However, the damaging aura is increased.
* {{I|Libra}}: When Isaac is within the aura, affects re-balanced stats rather than just damage.

sections.Effects:
* While held, spawns a [[familiar]] that moves in the direction Isaac shoots. Activating the item causes Isaac to swap places with Stitches. Isaac is briefly immune to damage after teleporting.
** Stitches deals 1.5 contact damage to enemies per tick (3.0 damage per second).
** If Isaac teleports onto an enemy, they will take 40 + 3x Isaac's damage.
** If Stitches teleports onto an enemy, it deals an additional hit for Isaac's damage.
** Teleporting next to a {{E|Fire Place}} will put it out, including blue fires.
** Teleporting on top of {{E|Shopkeeper}}s will destroy them.
** Teleporting on top of an angel statue in an {{R|Angel Room}} will not break it.
sections.Notes:
* Because of the brief immunity after teleporting, Isaac can move in and out of {{r|Curse Room}}s and open {{E|Spiked Chest}}s and {{E|Mimic Chest}}s free of charge.
* You may also use the immunity frames in greed mode to press the button disabling the waves without taking damage.
* Teleporting on top of an enemy is somewhat risky, as you might take damage from it if you don't move out of harm's way fast enough.
* If timed correctly, the brief immunity can be used to ignore on-hit explosive damage from enemies such as the {{E|Kamikaze Leech}}.
* The familiar can move through any obstacles that can be bypassed with [[Flight]], allowing Isaac to reach otherwise blocked off locations.
** {{R|Crawl Space}} that have an item enclosed by walls can be accessed by teleporting to it with Stitches.
* The familiar is able to be squeezed in between the gap of two diagonally adjacent [[Blocks|Key Blocks]], allowing the reaching of blocked off items without the expenditure of a key.
* While playing as {{C|Jacob and Esau}}, it will only teleport the character who holds the item (if Jacob was holding Stitches and used it, Jacob will swap places with Stitches whilst Esau will stay put).
* While playing as {{C|Tainted Forgotten}}, it will only teleport the body of the Forgotten. Telefrag damage is done to the new location of the body but immunity frames are given to the soul.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|9 Volt}}: Halves Stitches' charge time.
* {{i|BFFS!}}: On teleport, fires 8 tears outwards at Isaac's original location. The tears synergize with Isaac's tear effects and deal Isaac's damage. Stitches' teleport-on-enemy damage is increased to 3 + 2x Isaac's damage.
* {{Book of Belial synergy|description=Creates a shadowy line similar to {{i|Dark Arts}} between Judas and the familiar. Enemies caught in the line take damage equal to 2 × Judas' damage, plus a flat 3.}}
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=When Isaac teleports, he leaves behind a stationary wisp that fires tears in the same direction Isaac does. Up to 6 of these wisps can exist at a time. The wisps do not persist between rooms.}}
* {{i|Serpent's Kiss}} / {{I|The Virus}}: Can poison enemies during the brief immunity granted after teleporting.
* {{i|Midas' Touch}}: Enemies that survive being teleported onto will immediately turn into gold due to contact with Isaac. Thanks to the brief immunity, Isaac will not be harmed by this.
* {{t|Panic Button}}: As long as Stitches is charged, Isaac will teleport right before getting hit, negating damage. This can effectively be used as a 3-second-recharge {{i|Holy Mantle}}.
sections.Interactions: * {{i|Car Battery}}: Swaps places with Isaac twice in quick succession, rendering Stitches useless for collecting pickups & items beyond pits, rocks etc. It will deal telefrag damage in both places (where Stitches is and where Isaac was).

sections.Effects:
* Upon use, for the next three seconds, any enemy shots that come near Isaac are held in place.
** {{dlc|nr}} After a shot has been held for two seconds, it is fired back as a tear.
*** Reflected tears always do 3.5 damage.
** {{dlc|r}} When the effect is about to end, all shots are fired back.
*** Reflected normal tears do 6 damage if they would normally do a half heart damage to Isaac.
*** Reflected normal tears do 7 damage if they would normally do a full heart damage to Isaac.
*** Reflected {{i|Ipecac}} shots do 50 damage, and do not harm Isaac.
*** Reflected rocks thrown by {{e|Polty}} do 35 damage.
* {{dlc|r}} The emanating blue pulse pushes enemies away for the duration of the item's usage.
sections.Notes:
* The tears can be rammed into enemies while they're held by Telekinesis. {{dlc|nr}} They won't disappear until the effect ends but do no further damage.
* {{dlc|nr}} As long as the item is used immediately upon recharging, Isaac is effectively immune to enemy bullets.
* Catching shots from enemies that fire high into the air, like the {{e|Tube Worm}}, is very difficult and not beneficial; in the case of the Tube Worm, shots that are caught will just fall to the ground rather than be fired at enemies.
sections.Synergies: * {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Tears caught by Telekinesis become blue wisps in the outer ring. The wisps are outside the range of Telekinesis, making them vulnerable to shots before they can be converted to wisps. Wisps persist between rooms.}}
sections.Interactions:
* {{p|? Card}}: The cooldown applies even when used through the ? Card.
* {{i|9 Volt|dlc=nr}}: Does not benefit from 9 Volt, unlike other auto-recharge items.
** {{Dlc|r}} 9 Volt grants half charge on use, effectively giving Isaac immunity to enemy bullets as long as the item is used immediately upon recharging.
* {{i|The Battery|nr}}: A {{E|Lil' Battery}} (or other [[battery]]) has to be picked up for another charge. Both charges are expended at once for a longer duration effect.
* {{i|Car Battery|nr}}: Has no effect.
** {{Dlc|r}} Car Battery grants 7 seconds of protection, effectively giving Isaac immunity to enemy bullets as long as the item is used immediately upon recharging.
* {{i|Sharp Plug|nr}}: Charge gained from Sharp Plug is expended immediately and won't stop enemy shots.

sections.Effects:
* Shoots 10 tears in a circle around Isaac.
* The tears retain the [[range]], [[shot speed]], and special [[effects]] (such as [[Effects#Poison|poison]]) of Isaac's tears.
* Each tear will do Isaac's current damage and a flat +25 damage bonus on top.
sections.Notes: The effect of {{i|Tammy's Head}} is similar to {{i|Isaac's Tears}}, but Tammy's Head will benefit from tear-replacing items like {{i|Brimstone}}, unlike Isaac's Tears.
sections.Synergies:
* {{c|Azazel}} / {{i|Brimstone}}: Isaac will fire Brimstone lasers in all directions. {{dlc|nr}} Each laser is given bonus damage.
** This will deal a substantial amount of damage near the center of the effect due to how lasers overlap the closer you get to Isaac.
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns pale wisps in the outer ring. The wisps' tears deal 1.5 damage, but fire twice as fast as standard wisps. Tears are inaccurate and fire in a spread.}}
* {{i|Car Battery}}: Shoots 20 tears in a circle around Isaac.
* {{dlc|nr}}{{i|Chocolate Milk}}: The size and damage of tears shot depends on how far Chocolate Milk is charged.
* {{c|Tainted Azazel}}: Although Tainted Azazel's Brimstone beams do not have a damage bonus, they also do not have the normal damage penalty and still deal double damage to enemies that have been sneezed on.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}} / {{i|Ipecac}}: Tears are replaced by bombs or exploding shots, which may result in self-damage.
* {{i|Epic Fetus}}: Fires only normal tears.
* {{i|Eye of the Occult}}: The tears quickly lose their outward momentum and can now be controlled all at once, making it easy to make the tears hit enemies.
* {{i|Mom's Knife}}: The tears are replaced with knives that deal double Isaac's damage, but move very quickly, have a small hitbox, and don't return to Isaac.
* {{i|Trisagion}}: Shoots Trisagion blasts without any increase to their damage.

sections.Effects:
* Upon activation, Isaac is turned into a demon and gains the effects of {{i|Brimstone}} for the current room.
** If Sulfur has already been used in the current room, it instead gives Isaac a 1.2x damage multiplier, +1 damage, and increases the size of the laser for the current room.
*** Further uses of Sulfur will increase Isaac's damage by 1.
* {{transformation contribution|Leviathan}}
sections.Notes:
* Sulfur functions identically to {{I|Brimstone}}. For a full list of interactions, see that page.
* Sulfur is extremely powerful in [[Greed Mode]], since it can be used multiple times in the same arena.
sections.Synergies:
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns red wisps in the middle ring that fire a short {{I|Brimstone}} laser beam similar to {{C|Azazel}}, but significantly smaller.}}
* {{I|Brimstone}}/{{i|Car Battery}}: Activates twice to give an additional damage bonus and wider laser.

sections.Effects:
* On use, Isaac readies the Boomerang. Pressing a fire key will throw it in the chosen direction, and it will return shortly afterward.
* Any [[pickup]]s hit will return to Isaac with the Boomerang.
* Enemies hit by it will take double Isaac's current damage and are [[Status Effects#Effects|petrified]] for about 2 seconds.
* {{Dlc|r}} Boomerang [[Tear Effects#Effects|pierces]] enemies it hits.
** The Boomerang will only hit a given enemy once during its travel time.
sections.Notes:
* The Boomerang starts to recharge only after it has returned to Isaac.
* The Boomerang can grab [[pickup]]s from afar, even over [[obstacle]]s.
* The Boomerang can be used to destroy any {{e|Shopkeeper}}s.
** If Isaac has low damage, the shopkeeper won’t get destroyed and will instead flash red as if taking damage.
* The Boomerang can damage {{E|Host}} and {{E|Mobile Host}} enemies even while under their shells.
* {{dlc|nr}} The Boomerang's range scales with Isaac's [[range]] stat.
* {{dlc|r}} The Boomerang's range scales with Isaac's [[tear height]].
* The Boomerang can hit and stun {{E|The Haunt}} or {{E|Lil' Haunt}}s even when they are invincible.
* The Boomerang is unable to pick up {{e|Sticky Nickel}}s, or {{E|Chest}}s.
* With enough speed, it is possible to have two Boomerangs in the air at the same time.
* {{dlc|na+}} The Boomerang can grab troll bombs.
* {{Dlc|r}} The item only costs 10 coins when found in a {{r|Shop}}.
sections.Synergies: * {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns wisps in the middle ring. Wisps' tears have the {{I|My Reflection}} effect and do not persist between rooms.}}

sections.Effects:
* Replaces Isaac's right eye tears with an unlimited range [[piercing tears|piercing]] laser which fires continuously, dealing damage 15 times per second.
* {{dlc|nr}} x0.65 Damage multiplier.
* {{dlc|nr}} The laser deals 20% of Isaac's damage per tick.
** This compounds with the damage down for a total of 13% of Isaac's damage per tick.
* {{dlc|r}} Only the laser deals 13% of Isaac's damage per tick.
* {{dlc|r}} Tears fired per second * (2/3).
* {{dlc|r}} Laser is able to knock back enemies.
sections.Notes:
* Tear delay is effectively doubled, as Isaac will do a bit of the animation to fire a right eye tear, but no tear will come out.
** {{dlc|r}} This applies to items that replace Isaac's tears, such as {{I|Mom's Knife}} and {{I|Brimstone}}.
* Charged shots are not affected by the effective tear delay down, as they don't use the alternative left eye/right eye fire scheme.
* {{Dlc|nr}} As {{C|Cain}} can only fire tears from his right eye, Technology 2 will replace his tears altogether unless he has {{i|Technology}} or a charged attack.
** {{dlc+|r}} When used by Cain, or a character that is forced to fire from one eye due to the effects of {{I|Stapler}} or {{I|Lead Pencil}}, they will fire {{i|Technology}} lasers out of their right eye instead of their normal tears, as long as they have no other items that replace their tears ({{I|Neptunus}} or {{I|Number One}} lets them fire tears normally). These lasers cannot be angled with momentum.{{dlc-}}
* {{dlc|nr}} Because {{C|Lilith}} is blindfolded and relies on her {{i|Incubus}}, the only effect gained from Technology 2 is the damage down.
** {{Dlc|r}} Incubus can fire laser and tears as normal; stat effects apply.
* {{dlc|r}} The blood clots spawned by {{C|Tainted Eve}} will all also fire their own individual lasers.
* The laser can apply [[status effect]]s very efficiently due to its high tick rate.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|8 Inch Nails}} / {{t|Blister}} / {{i|Pisces}}: The laser will consistently push back enemies.
* {{i|Blood Clot}} / {{i|Chemical Peel}}: Since Isaac's right eye is replaced by Technology 2, he can only fire tears from his left eye, which gives all his tears higher damage and range.
* {{i|Brimstone|a}}: Laser fires continuously while Brimstone charges at normal rate.
* {{i|Chocolate Milk}}: The laser fires while Chocolate Milk charges at normal rate.
* {{I|Cricket's Body|r}} : The laser will rapidly split into small low damage tears upon impact with an enemy or obstacle.
* {{i|Cursed Eye}}: The laser fires while Cursed Eye charges at normal rate, retaining the teleporting effect.
** {{dlc|r}} Tears are replaced with lasers, fired from the same eye of Technology 2.
* {{i|Epic Fetus}}: The laser fires while the missiles are being aimed.
* {{dlc+|r}} {{i|Euthanasia}} / {{i|Explosivo}} / {{i|Holy Light}} / {{i|Little Horn}} / {{t|Nose Goblin}} / {{I|Sinus Infection}}: Every damage tick from the laser can also apply these tear effects and does so rapidly.{{dlc-}}
** {{i|Explosivo}}’s 60 point explosion damage bonus is unaffected by the laser’s reduced damage making the combination incredibly effective.
* {{dlc+|r}} {{I|Incubus}} / {{T|Lil Clot}} / {{I|Sumptorium}} / {{I|Twisted Pair}}: The familiars fire a continuous laser. {{dlc-}}
* {{i|Ipecac}}: Laser damage increases dramatically while also gaining the poison effect.
* {{i|Lachryphagy|r}}: Significantly shortens the range of the laser. A [[piercing]] Lachryphagy tear spawns at the end of the laser every tick, rapidly feeding off of each other and bursting when standing still. This is an extremely powerful combo that alone can provide enough damage output to challenge any boss in the game.
** A fire rate reduction such as from {{i|The Inner Eye}} or a few [[Tears Down]] pills makes the combo even stronger, as tears will grow even larger before bursting.
* {{i|Lead Pencil|r}}: Replaces tears with lasers similar to {{i|Technology}}. These are shot from the eye that shoots Technology 2, doing damage alongside the Technology 2 beam.
* {{i|Loki's Horns}}: Additional tears are affected by Technology 2 but are replaced by {{i|Technology}}'s lasers, dealing 100% of Isaac's damage and with 16 [[luck]] gives you Technology 2's fire rate.
* {{i|Lost Contact}}: The laser destroys all hostile projectiles that come into contact with it.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: Isaac simultaneously controls a tear and fires the laser; however, Isaac will only fire the Technology 2 laser in the direction that the tear is currently facing.
** {{dlc|r}} The Ludovico Technique also makes the laser spectral.
* {{i|A Lump of Coal|a}}: Damage increases the further away the enemy is, on a multiplier that is roughly +20% per tile of distance.
* {{i|Marked}}: Isaac simultaneously controls a big red target on the ground and fires the laser in the cardinal directions.
** {{dlc|r}} The laser now continuously fires towards the crosshair along with tears.
* {{i|Mom's Knife}}: The laser fires while the Knife charges at normal rate.
* {{i|Monstro's Lung}}: The laser fires while Monstro's Lung charges at normal rate. No reduction in tear burst size.
* {{i|The Parasite|r}}: Laser splits into two perpendicular beams upon hitting an obstacle.
** {{dlc|r+}} Also spawn small split tears.
* {{i|Rubber Cement|a}}: Laser bounces off of walls.
* {{i|Technology|nr}}: Equips two lasers that can be fired at the same time. As Technology is always fired from the right eye, it is not affected by the halved normal attack rate.
** {{dlc+|r}} Technology is affected by the fire rate multiplier. Holding {{I|Stapler}}, {{I|Lead Pencil}} or playing as {{C|Cain}} will allow Isaac to angle shots with momentum again.{{dlc-}}
* {{i|Tiny Planet}}: The laser spirals around Isaac once and then goes straight again.
* {{i|The Wiz}}: Tears are fired diagonally while the laser is fired straight forward.
* {{I|Urn of Souls}}: Isaac can still fire the laser as normal while using the urn.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|20/20}} / {{i|The Inner Eye}} / {{i|Mutant Spider}} / {{i|Sprinkler}} / any multishot item: No effect.
* {{C|Azazel}}: The Technology 2 continuously fires its lesser damage laser as Azazel charges his Brimstone.
* {{i|Brimstone|na}}: Overrides Technology 2, but retains the reduced damage.
* {{dlc+|a+nr}} {{i|Euthanasia}} / {{i|Little Horn}} / {{t|Nose Goblin}} / {{i|Sinus Infection}} / {{i|Sulfuric Acid}}: The laser is unaffected.{{dlc-}}
* {{dlc+|anr}} {{i|Explosivo}} / {{i|Holy Light}}: The laser is unaffected.{{dlc-}}
* {{dlc+|a+}}{{i|Eye of Belial}} / {{i|Parasitoid}}: The laser is unaffected.{{dlc-}}
** {{i|Parasitoid|r+}}: The laser can now rapidly spawn slowing creep and spawns flies or spiders.
* {{i|Eye of the Occult}}: Only affects the laser's color.
** '''Eye of the Occult''' + {{i|Brimstone}} / {{i|Technology}}: The Tech 2 laser also automatically fires at the crosshair.
* {{i|Fire Mind}}: Tears still ignite enemies, but no longer have a chance to explode.
* {{i|Incubus|nr}}: Decreases damage of Incubus' tears; Incubus does not fire a continuous laser.
* {{i|Isaac's Tears}}: Fires normal tears.
* {{i|Lead Pencil|nr}}: Isaac loses the ability to fire tears from the remaining eye, identical to Cain's downside.
* {{i|Mom's Eye}}: Occasionally shoots a laser behind Isaac. With 15+ [[Luck]], fires a new laser on every tick, dealing extremely high damage.
* {{i|My Reflection|anr}}: Laser is bent in the opposite direction as Isaac moves sideways, then gradually becomes straight as he stands still.
** {{dlc|r}} The laser makes a thin loop in front of Isaac, and fires the normal laser backwards.
* {{i|Pop!|r}}: The laser has drastically reduced range, and eyeball tears are rapidly created at the end of the laser.
* {{i|Soy Milk|nr}}: Both damage reductions are applied, along with removing one eye's worth of tears.
* {{i|Technology 2}}: Multiple copies of the item provide no benefit.

sections.Effects:
* {{dlc|nr}} When taking damage, Isaac farts, applying [[poison]] to all enemies in range.
* {{dlc|r}} When taking damage, Isaac farts 5 times in quick succession. The farts [[poison]] and knock back enemies and projectiles, and leave lingering poison clouds. Deflected projectiles deal 7 damage.
* {{dlc|na}} Farts deal 5 damage and the poison deals 21 damage over time.
* {{dlc|a}} Farts deal 5 damage and the poison deals Isaac's tear damage for 6 ticks.
sections.Synergies: * {{I|Ghost Pepper}}/{{i|Bird's Eye}}: Shoots a flame behind Isaac when he farts.
sections.Interactions: * {{t|Second Hand}}: The poison duration is not increased.

sections.Effects:
* Grants the following effects for the current room:
** [[Homing tears]].
** {{dlc|r}} +3 [[range]].
* {{transformation contribution|Bookworm}}
sections.Notes:
* For any item interactions, check the corresponding sections on {{i|Spoon Bender}}'s page.
* {{dlc|r}} The range increase does not stack with repeated uses.
sections.Synergies: * {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns purple wisps in the middle ring. These wisps fire [[homing]] tears.}}
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.
** However, this can unlock {{t|Baby-Bender}} if it isn't unlocked.

sections.Effect:
* [[Monster]]s, [[pickup]]s, and [[trinket]]s are magnetically attracted to the player character's tears.
** {{dlc|a}} This also applies to Isaac's bombs.
** {{dlc|r}} Tears increase in magnetization as they travel, pulling enemies and items with less force at first but becoming stronger when they land.
** The effect may not affect certain immobile enemies; {{e|Round Worm}}s will start to vibrate in the presence of multiple magnetic tears, but will not change their position, {{e|Host}}s will only be attracted when readying to launch an attack.
sections.Notes: * Extra caution must be taken when using this item, as the attraction effect will pull small, lightweight monsters like {{E|Boom Fly|text=Boom Flies}} towards the character very fast and in an unpredictable manner, with the consequent risk of taking damage.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Brimstone}}: Enemies and pickups are sucked towards the beam, increasing accuracy significantly.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}}: Enemies are sucked towards bombs, increasing accuracy and making enemies easier to kill.
* {{i|Explosivo}}: When the shot sticks to an enemy, every enemy near it will be attracted to them.
* {{i|Godhead}}: Enemies will be pulled into Godhead's damaging aura, increasing the aura's effectiveness at causing damage.
* {{i|Ipecac}}: Enemies and pickups are pulled towards the shots, increasing accuracy. The color of shots and their explosive effect is a darker green.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: Enemies, items, and even most bosses will be sucked to the single floating tear, dealing constant damage while keeping Isaac well away from harm, making this combination extremely effective in almost all scenarios.
* {{i|Mom's Knife}}: Enemies are pulled towards the knife. The effect is minor while not firing and much stronger while the knife is launched.
* {{t|Nose Goblin}}/{{I|Sinus Infection}}:  Attraction effect will remain on the booger shot stuck to an enemy. This can drag the enemy across the whole room until they reach one wall and get stuck on it, effectively disabling their normal movement.
* {{dlc|r}} {{c|Tainted Forgotten}}: Tainted Forgotten attracts enemies, putting them in range of his bone club attack.
* {{i|Technology}}/{{i|Technology 2}}/{{i|Tech.5}}: The beam will attract enemies, often sucking them into the beam and holding them there.
* {{i|Tech X}}: Enemies and pickups are attracted to the outer ring, increasing accuracy.
* {{i|Tractor Beam}}: The lack of random spread and momentum-based trajectories on tears makes the way enemies are pulled around more predictable.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Anti-Gravity}}: The magnetic effect is stronger when multiple tears are stacked in the same position.
* {{i|Cricket's Body}}/{{i|Compound Fracture}}: Since tears will split into more tears, all traveling in different directions, enemies will be randomly moved around.
* {{i|Epic Fetus}}: Overrides Strange Attractor.
** {{dlc|a}} Enemies get drawn towards the target mark on the ground, ensuring that the missile will hit.
* {{i|Explosivo}}: Enemies will be pulled toward the stuck on tears, dragging them helplessly or grouping them for the explosion.
* {{i|Haemolacria}}: Enemies and pickups are attracted to the main tear, but not burst tears.
* {{i|Lachryphagy}}: Enemies will often get sucked into tears, making it more difficult to feed tears or let them burst.
* {{i|Monstro's Lung}}: Due to the high concentration of tears, enemies will be pulled towards Isaac at great force; in certain cases, enough force will be generated to pull enemies through rocks. This can greatly increase accuracy but depending on enemies' movements and positions can also damage Isaac.
* {{i|The Parasite}}: Enemies will be pulled towards both fired tears and split tears. However, because they both travel in opposite directions, the split tears' magnetic effects tend to cancel each other out.
* {{i|Rubber Cement}}: Due to tears being reflected, enemies tend to be pulled towards Isaac with much force. Additionally, the random angle of tears being reflected results in erratic enemy movement. '''Not recommended.'''
* {{i|Soy Milk}}: The rapid tears will pull enemies quickly and erratically around the room. '''Not recommended.'''
* {{i|Tiny Planet}}/{{i|Immaculate Heart}}/{{i|Saturnus}}: The orbiting tears will cause enemies to be pulled towards Isaac. '''Not recommended.'''

sections.Effect: * Upon use, replaces every item in the current [[room]] (not [[pickups]] or [[trinkets]]) with other random items corresponding to the current room's [[item pool]].
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|nr}} The D6 is a [[special item]].
* {{c|Isaac}} starts with this item once it is unlocked.
* Since it re-rolls every item in the room, it can be more efficient to use it in rooms where multiple items are in the same room. For instance:
** In the {{r|Shop}}, when multiple items are available for purchase.
** In the {{r|Devil Room}}, when there are multiple deals offered.
** In the {{r|Boss Room}} after the {{e|Mom}} fight, where both {{i|The Polaroid}} and {{i|The Negative}} can be rerolled, at the cost of the opportunity to go to the {{s|Chest}}/{{s|Dark Room}}. Once one item is picked up the other will disappear.
** In the {{r|Angel Room}}, when there is a choice between multiple items.
** In the {{r|Boss Rush}} Room, where all items can be rerolled at once.
** When {{i|There's Options}} or {{i|More Options}} spawn two items.
* Items from {{E|Chest}}s can be rerolled.
** When an item from a chest is rerolled, the item is rolled from the current room's item pool, and not the chest's
* When an [[item pool]] is exhausted, the pool will start to use the {{ip|Treasure Room|text=Treasure Room Pool}}.
** When the {{ip|Treasure Room|text=Treasure Room Pool}} is exhausted, every item in it will be rerolled to {{i|Breakfast}}.
** With {{i|Chaos}}, every fully depleted item pool will only contain {{i|Breakfast}}.
* {{dlc|na}} If Isaac runs out of red hearts in the {{r|Devil Room}}, then rerolls, the prices of the items switch over to soul hearts.
* {{dlc|nr}} Using the D6 on an active item yields different rerolls depending on whether you picked up the active item first.
* Using the D6 to reroll items duplicated with {{i|Diplopia}} will reroll all the items into different items. The copied item will not be rerolled into the same one as the original item.
* Be careful when rerolling, as it will replace the item with another item from the '''current''' room's item pool, even if the item came from a different pool, or is a set drop. This can be used as an advantage in various ways; for example, after defeating {{E|The Fallen}}, the item will be drawn from the {{ip|Devil Room|text=Devil Room item pool}}, so Isaac can safely roll the item into another from that pool. This behavior can also be an advantage in {{r|Angel Room}}s since {{I|Key Piece 1}} and {{I|Key Piece 2}} can be rerolled to get a free Angel Room item.
** Normal rooms use the {{ip|Treasure Room|text=Treasure Room Pool}}.
sections.Synergies: * {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns a D6 wisp in the middle ring. An extra wisp is spawned per item rerolled.}}
sections.Interactions:

sections.Effects:
* Isaac's tears are replaced with ring-shaped lasers.
** Shots can be charged to increase the size of the rings.
** The rings deal damage 15 times per second. Only the outer circumference of the rings will deal damage.
** Rings pass through obstacles and enemies. Rings have infinite range and will travel until they hit a wall.
** {{Dlc|r}} Damage dealt is based on the amount charged, starting at around 25% Isaac's damage and approaches 100% at maximum charge.
*** <math>\text{Charge Time} = \frac{1}{30}(Roundup(\text{Tear Delay} \times 3) + 1) \approx \frac{3}{\text{Fire Rate}}</math>
*** <math>\text{Max Charge Damage per Tick} = \text{Damage} \times \frac{5}{4}(\text{Fire Rate} \times (Roundup(\text{Tear Delay} \times 3) + 1) - 10)</math>
*** <math>\text{Min Charge Damage per Tick} = \text{Damage} \times \frac{5}{4}(\text{Fire Rate} \times (Roundup(\text{Tear Delay}) + 1) - 10)</math>
*** At 30.00 fire rate or above (0 tear delay or lower), charging is no longer needed and fires 30 rings per second. Higher fire rate results in higher laser damage.
**** <math>\text{Damage per Tick} = \text{Damage} \times \frac{5}{4}(\text{Fire Rate} - 10)</math>
**** Damage per Tick is capped at 100% Isaac's Damage, at 90.00 fire rate.
sections.Notes:
* Like normal tears, walking forward makes the rings move faster, and walking backwards makes the rings move slower. Because the ring deals damage for as long as the enemy is inside of it, walking backwards actually increases Tech X's DPS, while walking forward lowers it.
* The rings are similar in appearance to the combination of {{I|The Ludovico Technique}} and {{I|Technology}}.
* The laser rings will linger for a brief moment upon touching a wall, allowing more damage to be dealt to enemies closer to walls.
* The "R U A WIZARD?" pill effect does not work with Tech X.
* Acquiring an extra copy of Tech X will shoot an extra laser ring.
* {{Dlc|nr}} Charging only increases size, not damage. It is useful for hard-to-hit enemies or hitting a wide area at once, but spamming small, uncharged shots will lead to much higher damage output.
** {{Dlc|a+nr}} With the charge bars option enabled, the rings can be released immediately as the charge bar appears for easier gauging of maximum damage output.
* {{Dlc|r}} The maximum ring size is slightly smaller in ''Repentance''.
sections.Synergies:

sections.Effects:
* -0.3 [[speed]].
** {{dlc|nr}} -0.3 maximum speed.
* When in a room with enemies, Isaac gradually gains speed at a rate of +0.065 per tick.
** {{dlc|nr}} This speed boost will be able to go past the lowered maximum.
* Once Isaac's speed reaches 2.0, he gains the {{i|My Little Unicorn}} effect for 5 seconds, becoming [[invulnerability|invulnerable]], and loses the speed bonus from Taurus afterward.
sections.Notes:
* Isaac slowly gains a red tint that becomes more intense as he gains speed.
* The speed boost and invulnerability effect activate only once per room.
* The higher Isaac's base speed, the quicker the effect activates. It can activate immediately upon entering a room if his base speed is already 2.0.
** If Isaac's base speed is 2.0, the effect will activate upon entering '''any''' room (including rooms with no enemies such as {{r|Sacrifice Room}}s) for the first time.
* If Isaac's speed is decreased during the {{i|My Little Unicorn}} effect (e. g. by using a [[Speed Down]] pill), Isaac will continue to gain speed while the effect is active.
* The item doesn't trigger when enemies are spawned, even if the room did not have enemies when first entered. This includes {{R|Challenge Room}}s, {{R|Sacrifice Room}}s when spawning {{E|Uriel}} or {{E|Gabriel}}, and the {{R|Boss Rush}} room.
** {{dlc|r}}{{mode|greed|greedier}} Taurus will trigger each time the button is pressed to start a new Greed or Greedier wave. Since the invincibility allows pressing the button to stop waves for free, it can be used repeatedly without leaving the arena.
* The item doesn't trigger in trap rooms which only contain {{E|Poky}} enemies.
* If Isaac gets teleported out of the room by any source, the {{i|My Little Unicorn}} effect won't trigger if the room is re-entered.
* Bombs can be placed during the charge.
* {{dlc|r}} When playing as {{c|Jacob and Esau}}, the speed changes apply for both, but only the character that is holding Taurus gains invincibility.
sections.Synergies:
* {{dlc|nr}} {{i|Blood Rights}}: While Isaac is invincible, Blood Rights can be freely used without taking damage. This trivializes many rooms, and since Taurus can activate every room, this combination can be game-changing, especially if Isaac has high base speed.
** {{dlc|r}} Isaac will still take damage from Blood Rights during the invincibility.
* {{I|Camo Undies}}: Isaac will be able to move around unnoticed, letting Taurus charge up.
* {{I|Dark Arts}}: Using Dark Arts provides a temporary +1.0 speed boost, allowing Isaac to activate Taurus earlier.
* {{I|Gnawed Leaf}}: Isaac's speed will still increase while he is invincible from Gnawed Leaf, allowing Taurus to activate with only a very small period of vulnerability when first entering a room.
* {{I|Rock Bottom}}: Isaac keeps the maximum speed boost after reaching it once.
* {{I|Serpent's Kiss}}/{{I|The Virus}}: Isaac will poison enemies in addition to dealing damage to them on contact.
sections.Interactions:
* {{dlc|nr}} {{i|Libra}}: Isaac's [[damage]] and [[range]] increases as speed increases. However, if Isaac's base speed is not high enough, the invincibility never activates.
** {{dlc|r}} Damage, Range, and Tear delay increase as speed increases. Speed increases much slower than normal.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: Isaac cannot control the tear while invincible, but any enemies touching it will still take damage from it.
* {{i|A Pony}}/{{i|White Pony}}: The lower limit for Isaac's [[speed]] is lowered from 1.50 to 1.20.
* {{dlc+|r}}{{i|Strawman}}: Taurus will not affect Isaac's [[speed]] if it's held by the Strawman {{c|Keeper}}, effectively rendering the item useless until Isaac is at 2.00 speed naturally.

sections.Effects:

** This inventory is not displayed on the HUD.
** When Keeper dies, the items he obtained are permanently removed.
*** {{dlc|nr+}} This includes quest items like {{i|The Polaroid}}, potentially leaving you unable to progress.

* Keeper is not able to pick up any active items, trinkets, or consumables.
* Keeper cannot pick up any type of [[hearts]], except for {{E|Gold Heart}}s.
** {{e|Eternal Heart}}s can also be picked up, but to no effect, effectively wasting them.
* Keeper's speed syncs with Isaac's, as with {{c|Jacob and Esau}}.
* {{dlc|nr+}} {{r|Devil Room}} items will cost money instead of health as long as Keeper is alive.
*{{dlc|r+}} {{r|Devil Room}} Items costing red hearts can be picked up by Keeper. Items costing red heart containers will remove the corresponding amount of coin hearts from Keeper. Going to zero coins hearts will kill Keeper. Items costing any amount of soul hearts or active items costing red hearts other than {{i|Book of Virtues}} can not be interacted with by Keeper as if they were a shop item that can not be afforded. 
*{{dlc|r+}} {{r|Devil Room}} Items that can be picked up for free via {{c|The Lost}}, {{c|Tainted Lost}}, {{c|Tainted Jacob}} in ghost form, {{p|Soul of the Lost}}, and {{e|White Fire Place}}, can be picked up by Keeper without other items disappearing. Allowing keeper to take the remaining items before Isaac picks up an item. 
* When placing a {{e|Bomb}}, Keeper will place another at no cost.
* Keeper can be used to play {{r|Sacrifice Room}}s at the cost of coins instead of hearts.
* {{r|Boss Challenge Room}}s will be closed unless Keeper is also at 1 coin heart.
* Keeper is not able to walk through doors or into {{r|Crawl Space}}, although he is able to enter the beam of light that takes Isaac to the next floor after the {{e|Mom's Heart}} / {{E|It Lives!}} fight, the one spawned by {{i|Genesis}}, as well as entering the big chest after defeating bosses in later stages.
* Respawn items work as normal for Keeper, but never involve teleporting to the previous room (see [[#Interactions|interactions]]).
* If Keeper plays a {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}, it will pay out with 0-1 coins.
* {{c|Keeper}} unlocks cannot be earned using Strawman.
* Similar to {{c|Jacob and Esau}}, it is possible to take both items between item choice pedestals with careful positioning.
* Even though Keeper is considered a second character, the run ends if Isaac dies.
* Technically, Strawman is marked as a [[familiar]] item in the game's files, although most familiar-modifying items, such as {{i|BFFS!}} don't have any effect on Keeper.
* Unlike Jacob and Esau, invincibility frames are not shared between Keeper and Isaac.
* If collected in a challenge where Isaac is blindfolded, Keeper will be blindfolded too.
* Re-emerging from the part of {{s|Mines}} II where {{i|Knife Piece 2}} is hidden will cause Strawman to be regenerated from scratch. This permanently remove all items the summoned Keeper had collected up until that point.
* If Strawman is picked up during the second lap of a [[Victory Lap]], he will become {{c|The Lost}} alongside Isaac on every subsequent lap.
* {{dlc|nr+}} If Keeper is hit, this will invalidate the conditions for spawning {{t|Perfection}}, regardless of whether or not the main character has been hit.
* This item boosts the exploration bonus in daily runs a lot.
* {{dlc+|r+}} Strawman's quality is treated as 2 for the purposes of {{I|Bag of Crafting}}.{{dlc-}}
*Keeper can not be hit by {{e|Dark Esau}}, only being pushed around by Dark Esau's collision.
sections.Synergies:

* {{i|Crooked Penny}} / {{i|Diplopia}}: Picking up multiple copies of the item will spawn additional Keepers that each have their own inventory.
* {{t|Extension Cord}}: Beams of electricity flow between Keeper and Isaac.
* {{i|Greed's Gullet}}: Keeper gains extra coin hearts at every 25 coin interval.
* {{I|More Options}} / {{I|There's Options}}: With careful positioning, both item choice pedestals can be taken.

If intending to go to {{s|Chest}} or {{s|Dark Room}}, note that the photo held by Keeper will be lost if he dies.

* {{I|4.5 Volt}} / {{I|9 Volt}} / {{I|The Battery}} / {{I|Battery Pack}} / {{I|Car Battery}} / {{I|Habit}} / {{I|Jumper Cables}} / {{I|Sharp Plug}}: Useless on Keeper, unless {{I|Book of Virtues}} is held.

sections.Effects:
* Upon use, Isaac dashes forward a short distance. If Isaac runs into an enemy while dashing, he picks them up and a crosshair spawns under him that can be controlled with tear controls. After one second, Isaac leaps up and slams down on the crosshair with the enemy, dealing damage to them and any enemies he lands on depending on his size. On impact, this move creates circular rock waves that damage nearby enemies and destroy obstacles.
** The damage the slam deals is 50 +/- 10 for each size up/down Isaac has.
** Each spike in the rock wave deals 10 damage, and the range of the rock waves increases/decreases for each size up/down Isaac has.
** Isaac is immune to damage for the duration of the effect, which allows him to use it to get into {{r|Curse Room}}s, open {{e|Spiked Chest}}s, and travel over spikes without taking damage.
*** {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}s and {{e|Devil Beggar}}s will still deal damage while Suplex! is active.
sections.Notes:
* In addition to normal enemies, Isaac is able to suplex:
** {{e|Bomb}}s of any kind
** [[Bosses]]
** [[Friendly]] enemies (this deals no damage to them).
** {{e|Shopkeeper}}s
** {{E|Poky}} type enemies
** {{E|Movable TNT}}
** Stationary or mostly stationary enemies such as a {{E|Stone Grimace}} or {{E|Slide}} (they will move back to their original position after the suplex)
** Fires (including {{e|Fire Place}}s; if Isaac suplexes a fireplace, it will glitch out and leave an invisible damaging fireplace in its original spot)
** Enemies that are normally invincible, such as the ghost of {{E|Blighted Ovum}} (which deals no damage to it) and {{E|The Haunt}} before it moves to the top of the room.
** {{C|Tainted ???}}'s poops, making it easier to break tinted rocks and open secret rooms. After being suplexed, the broken poop can be repeatedly suplexed as well. The broken poop will block the movement of Isaac and enemies, as it is still technically intact, even though it is visually destroyed. If the broken poop is shot at by Isaac, it will be 'destroyed' and is no longer able to be suplexed.
** {{e|Dark Esau}} if playing as {{c|Tainted Jacob}}, although care should be taken to move away after the suplex attack to avoid touching Dark Esau.
** Furniture on the {{s|Home}} floor.
* If Isaac picks up an enemy and then suffers [[fear]], he cannot move the crosshair.
* Despite the description, Isaac cannot suplex angel statues unless the fight has already been started.
* As this item allows Isaac to leap over gaps and obstacle, the player must be careful not to strand him in an inaccessible place without a means to exit, such as teleportation, flight, or another target to Suplex, as that will effectively softlock the game.
* Using suplex on a bomb in the {{R|Crawl Space}} and positioning the cross hair slightly above Isaac propels Isaac with enough force downward to force through the floor and access the error room. Be cautious about this as there's no way to go back to the floor other than teleporting.
sections.Synergies:
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=3 wisps are spawned where Isaac lands after using Suplex!. The wisps rotate around the spot Isaac landed and fire tears in the same direction Isaac does. The wisps do not persist between rooms.}}
* {{i|Berserk!}} / {{p|Soul of Samson}} / {{c|Tainted Samson}}: When used near the end of the Berserk state (any time after the second bell ring), Suplex receives a unique visual effect, and will deal massive damage to the target, while setting off a {{i|Mama Mega!}} style explosion, destroying all [[obstacle]]s in the current room and blowing open all doors. The target being Suplexed, as well as nearby enemies, will receive 300 base damage that scales with Isaac's size. All other enemies receive 200 flat damage. The reason this interaction exists is that prior to a patch, doing this would instantly kill any enemy, including end bosses. It was then nerfed to only produce an explosion.
* [[Freeze]] effects: Isaac can suplex frozen enemies.
* [[Friendly]] enemies: If Isaac uses Suplex! to dash in a room, he will suplex a friendly enemy upon entering the room. This gives more time to react to danger and allows to deal damage to a group of enemies without risk (since the item gives invincibility during suplexes).
* {{t|Panic Button}}: As long as Suplex! is fully charged and Isaac is moving, Panic Button automatically triggers when about to take damage, avoiding the damage and potentially grabbing an enemy in the process. Allows Isaac to grab an enemy by simply walking into them, provided the item is charged.
* {{i|The Virus}}: The nature of suplexing helps to inherently poison enemies without consequences most of the time.
sections.Interactions:

Tainted Forgotten cannot dash, requiring walking into enemies after using Suplex to grab them.

sections.Effects:
* Upon use, Isaac pulls out (or puts away) the urn; holding a fire button when it's pulled out emits a stream of blue flames in whichever direction Isaac is aiming. Each flame deals 22.5-31.5 damage per second, depending on how far it's traveled, plus an additional 4.5 damage per second times floor number. Multiple flames can damage the same enemy simultaneously.
** Isaac is also pushed backwards slightly while using it.
** The flames destroy enemy projectiles, {{g|Poop}}, and other fires, but bounce off rocks.
* Killing enemies grants a soul charge to the Urn, up to a maximum of 20. Killing bosses grants a larger boost. Charges must be used to power Urn of Souls, with each charge being equivalent to 15 flames over the course of half a second.
sections.Notes: * Can be fired diagonally, or in any direction if using a gamepad or mouse controls (the latter being enabled in options.ini). * The Urn can't be used to destroy {{e|Shopkeeper}}s, unlike {{i|The Candle}} and {{i|Red Candle}}. * Multiple Urns share the same charges. * {{c|Bethany}} can use her soul charges to fuel the Urn. Likewise, {{c|Tainted Bethany}} can use her blood charges. * Holding two urns with {{C|Jacob and Esau}} won't charge both at the same time, each enemy will drop the same charges as if only one urn was held.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Angelic Prism}}: Flames can be split into four multi-colored flames.
* {{i|Bird's Eye}} / {{i|Ghost Pepper}}: The urn can emit flames from these items. Ghost Pepper flames are indistinguishable from Urn of Souls flames, but persist on the ground for longer.
* {{Book of Belial synergy|description=The stream of fire is replaced with a controllable {{i|Brimstone}} beam that destroys projectiles and deals more damage the longer it's active. The minimum damage is ''3.37 + 0.361 × floor'', and the maximum damage is ''4.2 + 0.45 × floor'', which it scales up to over the course of 3 seconds of continuous fire. Souls dropped from enemies are colored red, and the Urn displays a red graphic on the HUD when active.This brimstone will not be affected by any synergies, except side ones such as {{i|Angelic Prism}}, {{i|Hemoptysis}} and {{i|Marked}}.}}
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns a wisp in the middle ring for every consecutive second Urn of Souls is fired. The occasional fires shot by the wisps block enemy shots, deal contact damage to enemies, and last for 3 seconds before dissipating. The flames deal 10 damage per tick for the first second they're out, scale down to 5 damage over the next second, and then stay at 5 damage until they dissipate (60-30 damage per second). The damage these fires deal does not increase with {{i|BFFS!}} or scale up on later floors.}}
* {{I|Eye of Greed}} / {{i|Large Zit}} / {{i|Tech.5}} / {{i|Technology 2}}: Tears from these items will still shoot as normal while using the urn.
* {{tf|Guppy}} / {{i|The Mulligan}}: Fires have a chance to spawn [[Blue Fly|Blue Flies]].
* {{i|Immaculate Heart}}: Each individual flame has a chance to cause Immaculate Heart to generate an orbiting tear.
* {{i|Lead Pencil}}: Every 15 flames shot out of the urn will shoot a barrage of Isaac's tears.
* {{i|Multidimensional Baby}}: All flames shot through Multidimensional Baby are doubled, providing a burst of flashing black-and-white tears.
* {{i|Tear Detonator}}: Each flame splits into six tears, unlike other fire effects.
sections.Interactions:
* {{dlc|r}}[[Cards and Runes|Ace Cards]]: Enemies that are turned into [[pickup]]s don’t grant soul charges.
* {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.
* {{i|E. Coli}} / {{i|Flush!}}: Enemies that are turned into poop don't grant soul charges.
* {{i|Kidney Stone}}: Firing the urn counts as fire time but the urn must be put away for Isaac to charge and shoot the kidney shot. Switching to the urn while auto-firing from Kidney Stone forces the urn to fire as well.
* {{i|Void}}: No effect when absorbed by Void.

sections.Effects:
* +0.7 [[tears]].
* +0.16 [[shot speed]].

* When Isaac takes damage, spawns a red wisp that fires spectral tears and deals contact damage to enemies (but does not block projectiles). These red wisps last for the entire floor, and Isaac can have up to 6 red wisps at a time. ** Wisps deal 3 + 0.1 * (current_floor - 1) damage per tear, and fire tears once per second. ** Wisps deal contact damage equal to 0.5x Isaac's damage per tick (15 ticks per second = 7.5x Isaac's damage).
sections.Notes: * The wisps share the first layer of {{i|Book of Virtues}} wisps, and contribute to filling its cap of 8.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|BFFS!}}: Doubles the wisps' size, on-hit and contact damage.
* {{i|Blood Oath}}: For each half heart of damage taken at the start of the room, a wisp is spawned.

sections.Effects:
* {{dlc|nr}} +7 [[tear falling speed]].
* {{dlc|r}} +6.5 [[range]].
* Grants [[spectral tears]].
* Tears now revolve around Isaac at a fixed distance until they hit the ground.
* {{dlc|r}} The tears orbit close to Isaac, offset slightly in the direction fired. Changing the firing direction will redirect all previously fired tears.
sections.Notes:
* Tears will not hit directly in front of Isaac; aiming directly away from enemies is often effective.
* {{dlc|r}} It is possible to control the direction of Tiny Planet with the mouse. On Windows, go to {{code|C:/Users/[username]/Documents/My Games/The Binding Of Isaac [Rebirth/Afterbirth/Afterbirth+]/}} and in the options.ini file, change the line that says {{code|MouseControl{{=}}0}} to {{code|MouseControl{{=}}1}}. Unlike normal controls, the mouse allows diagonal direction.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|20/20}}: Each shot fires two tears in opposing orbital directions.
** This synergy is effectively the same for {{I|The Wiz}}, with the exception of 20/20's damage penalty not being applied.
* {{i|Anti-Gravity}}: Tears orbit around Isaac at a short range while fire button is held. When the fire button is released, tears snap to their normal range.
* {{C|Azazel}}: Increases Azazel's range with Brimstone, and wraps the beam around the character.
* {{t|Brain Worm}}: Tears will home directly towards nearby enemies in a line from the center of the orbit.
* {{i|Brimstone}}: The beam will wrap around the character and shoot straight forward.
** '''Brimstone''' + {{i|Mom's Knife}}: The knives shot after the Brimstone beam similarly wrap around the character and shoot forward.
* {{i|Cricket's Body}}: Tears will split into 2 close groups of 2 tears that follow the orbit. One group travels clockwise and the other travels counterclockwise.
* {{i|Euthanasia}}: Euthanasia's tear bursts will follow the orbit in 2 close groups of 5 tears. One group travels clockwise and the other travels counterclockwise.
* {{I|Eye of Belial|r}}: After piercing an enemy, instead of homing in on enemies, tears will continue to orbit, but each tear can pierce multiple enemies to gain more size and damage multipliers.
* {{I|Eye of the Occult|r}}: Tears struggle to move outside of the pre-set path Tiny Planet gives.
* {{i|Flat Stone}}: Tears will bounce and orbit around the character.
* {{i|Godhead}}: Tears with damaging auras orbit the character, creating a damaging barrier.
* {{i|Ipecac}}: Explosive tears orbit around Isaac. {{i|Host Hat}} or {{i|Pyromaniac}} is highly recommended.
* {{i|Kidney Stone}}: The stone and barrage of tears that follow orbit the character.
* {{i|Lachryphagy}}: {{dlc|nr}} Tears will orbit until they are behind the character. Tears will burst into 8 tears that follow the orbit in 2 close groups of 4. One group travels clockwise and the other travels counterclockwise.
** {{dlc|r}} Tears orbit the player without slowing down, and can be fed as normal. When a tear bursts, the created tears orbit the place of burst.
* {{i|Loki's Horns}}: Effectively grants a great tear multiplier, as the extra tears from Loki's Horns will follow the trajectory given by the Tiny Planet.
* {{i|Lost Contact}}: Shielded tears will orbit Isaac, granting a partially successful 360-degree projectile protection around him. Works better with a faster fire rate or {{i|Anti-Gravity}}.
* {{i|A Lump of Coal}}: This item drastically increases the screen time of tears because it makes them orbit around Isaac for a few seconds. A Lump Of Coal adds a lot of damage to tears in "outer orbit".
** The tears do not fall during {{e|The Beast}} fight, allowing tears to grow bigger and bigger.
* {{i|Marked}}: Isaac will continuously fire orbiting tears, which allows him to not touch the attack keys and focus just on moving (with giant tears it makes it hard to see as he can't stop firing).
* {{dlc|r}}{{i|Mom's Knife}}: Increases range. Causes Mom's knife to orbit around Isaac at very high speeds until it reaching it's maximum range, where it will circle back to Isaac at the same speed.
* {{dlc|r}}{{i|My Reflection}}: After reaching their maximum range, the tears will circle back around to Isaac.
* {{i|Revelation}}: The beam of light wraps around Isaac and shoots forward at a slight angle, similar to Brimstone.
* {{i|Rubber Cement}}: Tears bounce off enemies then keep orbiting Isaac. Very powerful as the tears are not destroyed upon damaging an enemy. When near walls, the orbiting tears tend to get stuck against the walls until Isaac moves away.
* {{i|Spirit Sword|r}}: The sword's melee attack becomes disjointed from Isaac, hitting in an increased range in front of him but creating a blind spot where the strike used to be. Spin attacks also occur in front of Isaac instead of around him. Sword projectiles orbit around Isaac as normal.
* {{C|Tainted Eve}}: Blood clot familiars will each fire tears in their own individual orbits, rather than all orbiting around the character.
* {{C|Tainted Lilith}}: Tears orbit around the {{I|Gello}} instead of the character.
* {{i|Technology}}: A laser creates a circle around Isaac's body before being fired forward normally. The laser becomes spectral.
** {{dlc|a}} '''Technology''' + {{i|A Lump of Coal}}: The extra distance covered by the laser more than doubles damage right in front of Isaac, and it increases as normal further away.
* {{i|Technology Zero}}: Creates moving laser fields that orbit the character.
* {{i|Varicose Veins}}: The ten tears that are fired when the character is hit orbit them closely.
* {{i|Tear Detonator}}: Makes the additional tears go around in a pattern around the location where Isaac used the Tear Detonator, making it much easier to hit enemies with it.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Bob's Rotten Head}}: The thrown bomb orbits around Isaac, making it hard to predict where it will land.
* {{i|C Section}}: Fetuses will rotate around Isaac, but still home in on enemies.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}}: The bombs orbit Isaac, exploding just barely far enough to cause no damage assuming he stays motionless.
* {{i|Epic Fetus}}: Overrides Tiny Planet.
* {{i|Haemolacria}}: Fired tears orbit around Isaac, but burst tears do not.
* {{t|Hook Worm}}: Has no effect.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: Tear orbits around Isaac, however, the orbit can be grown or shrunken, sped up or slowed down by using the firing keys.
* {{dlc|nr}} {{i|Monstro's Lung}}: This item removes the extra tear falling speed bonus, causing the burst of tears to circle and land behind the player after only being airborne for a short time.
** {{dlc|r}} Range isn't as significantly reduced.
* {{i|My Reflection}}: Tears will move to maintain their orbital positions around Isaac as he moves, making aiming much easier.
* {{i|The Parasite}}: Tears only split when hitting objects and enemies.
** {{i|A Lump of Coal}}: Tears glitch out when splitting, remaining for absurdly long times and turning the area around Isaac into an instant-death zone.
* {{i|Pop!}}: Tears tend to clump together behind the character and then disappear after a few seconds.
* {{i|Proptosis}}: At base damage, tears disappear after half an orbit.
* {{t|Ring Worm}}: Every single tear spins uncontrollably fast, making aiming incredibly difficult. However, with large shots ({{i|Death's Touch}} with high damage, for instance) this combo can fill the entire screen with projectiles almost immediately.
* {{i|Sprinkler}}: Tears made by Sprinkler will follow Isaac
* {{i|Tech X}}: Overrides Tiny Planet.
* {{i|Tractor Beam}}: Overrides Tiny Planet but keeps the large range increase.
** '''Tractor Beam''' + {{i|Rubber Cement}}: Tears will travel along the beam until they hit a wall and then orbit Isaac.
** '''Tractor Beam''' + {{i|Dr. Fetus}}: Tractor Beam is ignored and plain Dr. Fetus interaction applies.
** '''Tractor Beam''' + {{i|Haemolacria}}: Tractor Beam overrides Tiny Planet and Haemolacria Tears no longer arc.
* {{t|Wiggle Worm}}: The tear forcefully orbits while spiraling. The orbit amplifies the wiggle.

sections.Effects: * Adds a chance to shoot a tooth instead of a tear, which deals x3.2 Isaac's [[damage]].
sections.Notes:
* The chance to fire a tooth depends on the [[luck]] stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: <math>\frac1 { 10 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck}  \right \rfloor}</math><ref>[https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/15K8Xgxoxdx68AIaxuLXgZoJJlG36UPgy3_aeDpAM5tU/edit?usp=sharing|The Binding of Isaac Item Trigger Testing]</ref>
** At base luck (0), the chance is 10%, maxing out at 100% at 9 luck.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Apple!}}: With 14 [[Luck]], overrides Tough Love. With 13 Luck, Apple and Tough Love each have about an equal chance to trigger.
* {{i|Brimstone|na}}: Overridden by Brimstone.
** {{dlc|a}} Occasionally fires Brimstone beam with damage multiplier of Tough Love.
* {{i|Cricket's Body}} / {{i|Compound Fracture}}: Teeth will split into smaller teeth.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus|nr}}: Bombs explode with the increased blast damage and radius of {{i|Mr. Mega}}.
** {{dlc|r}} Adds a chance for the bombs to deal increased damage. See the page for the specific damage formula.
* {{i|Fire Mind}}: Adds a [[Tears (weapon)#Flaming Tears|flaming]] effect to the teeth, {{dlc|nr}} but without the chance of exploding.
* {{i|Ipecac}}: Teeth explode with the increased blast damage of {{i|Mr. Mega}}.
* {{i|Mom's Knife|nr}}: Overridden by Mom's Knife.
** {{dlc|r}}: Both damage multipliers apply, combined damage multiplier is x6.4.
* {{i|Haemolacria}}: Tears will not appear as teeth but may still gain the damage multiplier.
* {{t|Jawbreaker}}: Activation rates are individually applied to each tear, effectively allowing for higher amounts of teeth. At 9 Luck, the trinket is no longer needed, as Tough Love will already guarantee that every shot is a tooth.
* {{I|The Ludovico Technique}}: Tear occasionally flicks to being a tooth, which deals 3.2x Isaac's tear damage, before immediately returning to being a normal tear. The frequency at which the tear very briefly transforms into a tooth increases with Luck, permanently becoming a tooth at 9 Luck.

* {{i|Papa Fly}}/{{i|Pointy Rib}}/{{i|Linger Bean}}: Can benefit the damage multiplier. 
* {{i|Spirit Sword}}: Both the sword and projectiles can deal increased damage.
* {{i|Technology}}: Damage multiplier applies occasionally.

sections.Effects:

sections.Effects:

* {{dlc|r}} Grants two {{E|Black Heart}}s.

sections.Synergies: * {{t|Black Feather|r+}}: Counts as an evil item, granting a damage up.

sections.Effects:
* Tears that deal more than 1.0 damage split into two tears with half damage and half remaining range on impact with obstacles or enemies.
** Damage less than 1.0 causes the tears to simply disappear.
** The splitting can keep up as long as the tears have range remaining and the damage of the split tears stays above 0.5.
** Split tears are scaled down by 0.5x from the parent one, ignoring damage based size reduction.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Angelic Prism}}: All tears split by the prism will burst into split tears when hitting obstacles.
* {{c|Azazel}}: Two beams that deal full damage are fired perpendicular to the main beam at the end of the laser.
* {{i|Brimstone|r}}: Two beams that deal full damage are fired perpendicular to the main beam at the closest point of intersection with an enemy or obstacle.
* {{i|C Section}}: Fetuses fire short-ranged tears constantly while in contact with an enemy.
* {{i|Compound Fracture}}: Both tear split effects happen simultaneously.
* {{i|Cricket's Body}}: Two groups of this item's four tears, creating eight additional miniature tears on every point of impact instead.
* {{i|Flat Stone}}: Every time tears bounce, burst tears spawn.
* {{I|Holy Light}} / Other similar tear modifiers: As the effect is applied before the split, both split tears will retain it.
* {{i|Jacob's Ladder}}: Split tears can spawn sparks.
* {{i|Lachryphagy}}: Fed tears split into 12 tears. When tears are minimally fed and hit an obstacle, they will split into 5 Lachryphagy burst tears and Parasite burst tears.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: Repeatedly spawns miniature tears when on top of an enemy, greatly increasing damage.
* {{i|Mom's Knife|r}}: Knife splits into two smaller, perpendicular knives that deal full damage on hitting an enemy.
* {{i|My Reflection}}: Split tears boomerang back to Isaac, making it easier to hit enemies with them.
* [[Piercing tears]]: Split tears form for each hit as the tears pass through the enemies.
* [[Spectral tears]]: When tears pass through solid objects, like rocks, they will split, resulting in many tears shooting out from every rock the original tear passed through.
* {{i|Technology|r}}: Laser splits into two perpendicular beams that deal full damage upon hitting an obstacle or enemy.
* {{i|Tiny Planet}}: The split tears will continue to orbit Isaac, increasing damage potential.
* {{i|Tractor Beam}}: The split tears will be forced directly forward, impacting whatever caused the first tear to split. This increases damage immensely.
** If all shots connect, effective damage will be multiplied by 2 + log<sub>2</sub>(damage) rounded up, with the maximum increasing as range increases, with a max of 4x at Isaac's base range.
* {{i|Trisagion}}: When beams hit obstacles, the beam will split; the split beams can split again when hitting other obstacles.
sections.Interactions:
* {{dlc|r}} {{i|Aquarius}}: Creep trail turns dark orange but doesn't affect the creep itself.
* {{i|Bob's Rotten Head}}: Splits into two explosive shots when it blows up on an obstacle or wall, each dealing half the explosion of the head. Doesn't split on hitting an enemy.
* {{i|Brimstone|nr}}: Overrides The Parasite.

** {{dlc|r}} Bombs split into two bombs that deal 40 damage each upon detonation.

* {{i|Technology|nr}}: Overrides The Parasite.
* {{i|Tech X|nr+}}: Overrides The Parasite. Laser rings become orange.
