sections.Notes:
* Many collectibles will produce effects similar to the Necronomicon, such as depleting a {{E|Black Heart}} or blocking projectiles with {{i|Dry Baby}}.
* The Necronomicon deals a considerable amount of damage to bosses that have multiple damageable parts, e.g. {{E|Larry Jr.}} and {{E|The Hollow}}.
* This item also does high enough damage to instantly kill most non-boss enemies; however it is not especially useful against most bosses (with the above exceptions), which will only take minor chip damage.
* {{dlc|a}} Damage from the Necronomicon bypasses [[damage scaling]].
* {{dlc|r+}} With the Necromancer transformation, the Necronomicon gains a unique appearance and 10 free uses per floor. After the free charges are expended, it behaves as normal until the next floor.
sections.Synergies:
* {{T|A Missing Page|r}} / {{I|Missing Page 2|r}}: Necronomicon will deal an additional +40 damage. Effects stack together and with multiple copies.
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns black wisps on the inner ring. The wisps deal 40 damage to all enemies in the room when destroyed. This is not boosted by {{I|BFFS!}}, but is boosted by {{t|A Missing Page}} and {{I|Missing Page 2}}.}}

sections.Effects:
* Upon entering a room, creates a green fog effect and all enemies are [[Status Effects#Poison|poisoned]].
** {{dlc|nrr+}} The poison ticks 2 times.
** {{dlc|rnr+}} The poison ticks 4 times on normal enemies and 2 times on bosses (likely a bug).
* Killing enemies leaves a small, short-lasting pool of [[Creep#Green Creep|green]] [[creep]] on the ground.
** The creep deals 1 damage per tick or 30 damage per second.
sections.Notes:
* High tear damage will cause this item to become very powerful for rooms with a lot of enemies, since they can die instantly and render the room harmless.
* Enemies which spawn after the first few seconds of each room are not affected by this item, e.g. Flies spawned from a {{E|Mulligan}} dying.
* Enemies that spawn with some form of invulnerability such as {{E|Host}}s, {{E|Wizoob}}s, or {{E|Needle}}s are not affected by this item.
* The poison effect only activates upon entering a room and not at the start of a wave. In {{R|Boss Rush}} and most of [[Greed mode]], the item will not poison enemies.
* If Toxic Shock is picked up in the middle of a room with enemies, the mass poison will occur immediately.
sections.Synergies: * {{T|Second Hand|r}}: Extends the poison duration, allowing it to tick 6 times on normal enemies and 4 times on bosses.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Toxic Shock}}: Doesn't stack
* {{i|Red Stew}}: High damage stat makes {{i|Toxic Shock}} clear most rooms instantly, making Red Stew's damage up last almost indefinitely.
* {{dlc|r}} [[Cards and Runes|Ace Cards]]: Enemies that are turned into [[pickup]]s don't leave creep.
* {{i|E. Coli}}/{{i|Flush!}}: Enemies that are turned into poop don't leave creep.
* {{dlc|rnr+}} [[Freeze|Freeze Effects]]: Enemies that are frozen don't leave creep.
** {{dlc|r+}} Frozen enemies do leave creep.

sections.Effects:
* Tears are replaced with [[Tear Effects#Piercing|piercing]] white blasts of light.
** Blasts deal 33% of the regular [[Damage|tear damage]], but can hit each enemy they are in contact with up to 15 times per second.
** Blasts decrease in size until disappearing.
*** Despite the blasts decreasing in size after passing through obstacles, this purely visual as the blast will only damage enemies adjacent to the obstacle.
** {{dlc|nr}} Blasts do not knock back enemies.
sections.Notes:
* Since the blasts can strike one enemy multiple times while they remain in contact, low shot speed can be very beneficial whereas high shot speed may lower effective damage.
** Walking backward while firing can allow tears to move slower, making it useful for increasing damage output.
* Items that grant a high Tears rate, such as {{I|Soy Milk}}, can cause the light beams to significantly obstruct visibility, which can further be exacerbated by items such as {{I|Fruit Cake}} causing rapid color and size change.
* With only Trisagion, Isaac with base stats will deal about 18 damage per second on an unmoving, [[gaper]]-sized enemy, which is almost double Isaac's base DPS of 9.5. 1.32 shot speed will reduce DPS of Trisagion to about 14.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|8 Inch Nails}} / {{t|Blister}} / {{i|Pisces}}: Adds knockback to blasts, which can not only significantly repel enemies when used correctly, it can deal a high amount of damage to enemies unable to escape the knockback.
* {{i|Chocolate Milk}}: Fully charged Trisagion blasts deal 4 times more damage, exceeding Isaac's normal damage.
* {{I|Cricket's Body|r}}: Original blast shoots four white tears in a cross pattern during its travel time and four blast tears in a cross pattern at the end of its range. Only the original blast splits.
* {{Dlc|r}} {{i|Euthanasia}} / {{i|Explosivo}} / {{i|Head of the Keeper}} / {{i|Holy Light}} / {{t|Nose Goblin}} / {{I|Sinus Infection}}: Beams can apply the effects on each damage tick, potentially triggering them in rapid succession.
* {{i|Evil Eye}}: Eyes will fire beams. Occasionally causes Trisagion beams to stay static in the air for a few seconds, dealing damage to enemies that come in contact with them.
* {{i|Godhead}}: Although the damaging aura isn't visible, it still exists and is not affected by Trisagion's damage reduction. Still grants homing effect and shot speed down which can be very beneficial.
* {{tf|Guppy}}: As it hits multiple times, it spawns multiple flies per tear making it very strong.
* {{i|Haemolacria|nr}}: Both Trisagion and Haemolacria fire at the same time; Isaac's tears do not keep the spectral attribute despite the sprite being changed. The tears keeps their piercing effect.
** {{dlc|r}} Haemolacria becomes one big Trisagion beam that splits into more beams when it reaches its max range.
* {{i|Hemoptysis}}: Enemies hit by the sneeze will gain a curse that increases the damage the blasts deal to 0.66x and +3 flat damage (instead of just x0.33). Enemies who die to the blasts under the curse will damage and spread the curse to nearby enemies. Since the flat damage ignores the multiplier, this is a huge increase to Isaac's damage.
** Hemoptysis + {{i|Soy Milk}}/{{i|Almond Milk}}/{{dlc|r}}{{i|20/20}}: The flat damage increase ignores the multiplier reductions, which results in a massive increase in damage.
* [[Homing tears]]: Tears slow down and stay on top of the enemy, doing continuous damage.
* {{i|Jacob's Ladder|r}}: Small electric arcs generate from the blast every tick.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: The beam becomes controllable, still dealing reduced damage but at a very high rate.
* {{i|Mucormycosis}}: The spore effect can stack multiple times on the same enemy.
* {{i|My Reflection}}: In addition to the usual effect, lengthens the Trisagion blasts into short flexible beams for a much larger damage-dealing area.
* {{i|Mysterious Liquid}}: Causes a large trail of creep. The effect stacks, which causes heavy damage (even to {{e|Hush}}).
* {{I|Ocular Rift}}: Creates multiple rifts as the projectile pierces enemies.
* {{i|Pop!|r}}: Every damage tick will shoot out a Pop! tear. Trisagion shots will also hover in the air longer than normal.
* {{dlc|nr}} {{i|Proptosis}}: Base damage is increased by the expected amount and beam damage is boosted to about 65%. Blasts lose no power as they travel further, though the tips of the blasts deal very slightly less damage.
** {{dlc|r}} Blasts now deal 2x Isaac's damage instead of 0.33x. Damage only slightly decreases in the front of the blast.
* {{I|Spirit Sword}}: The sword will shoot Trisagion beams instead of energy beams, with the Trisagion beams having increased damage.

sections.Effects:
* Summons {{i|The Peeper}} for the current room, which also leaves a trail of red [[creep]].
** The Peeper deals 12 contact damage per tick (36 per second) and the creep it trails deals 2 damage per tick (20 per second).
** The Peeper can block enemy shots.
** All tears shot from the right eye will deal 35% more damage, same as with {{I|The Peeper}} affecting the left eye.
sections.Synergies:
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns white-glowing eyeball wisps on the middle ring. They function the same as normal wisps.}}
* {{i|Car Battery}}: Will summon 2 peepers in a bifurcated direction.

sections.Effects:
* When picked up, all future [[items]] become "Glitched", causing them to become random combinations of 2-3 effects based on other items as well as effects that are not normally controlled by the player, such as enemy spawning and other behind-the-scenes effects.
** [[Item Tags quest|Quest items]] do not become glitched. This includes: {{i|The Polaroid}}, {{i|The Negative}}, {{i|Key Piece 1}}, {{i|Key Piece 2}}, {{i|Knife Piece 1}}, {{i|Knife Piece 2}}, {{i|Dad's Note}}.
** Additionally, the currently playing music will fade out. The silence will remain until another music track plays.
** Any enemies in the room will also become simultaneously frozen and set on fire.
* "Glitched" items can be passive or active and are completely randomly generated with practically infinite possibilities. There is a 75% chance that the item will be passive.
* Random effects combine effects that exist on other items, and assign them to a random event (e.g. on enemy death, on room clear, on damage taken etc.).
** These effects may also be derived from installed modded items.
* Glitched items sold for money cost a random amount of pennies up to 99 pennies.
sections.Notes:
* Once {{a|Corrupted Data}} is unlocked, the TMTRAINER effect may be randomly applied to items found in {{r|Secret Room}}s and {{r|I AM ERROR}} rooms.
* Items affected by TMTRAINER may take the effect of rerolling all of your items. This includes TMTRAINER itself, meaning any future items you encounter will not be under its effect, nor will the items obtained by rerolling due to the glitched item.
* All glitched items appear as {{I|Mega Blast}} in [[Isaac's Last Will]] or the In-game Pause Menu.
* If an item held by Isaac is rerolled into TMTRAINER (Either by {{I|D4}} or a 1-pip {{r|Dice Room}}), all items after it will be rerolled into glitched items.
* A majority of the random item effects include farts, including active items.
* Due to the sheer randomness of glitched items, some may cause the game to either crash or lag to the point of unplayability.
** However, some may spawn entities that are normally only accessible using the [[Debug Console]], including the Challenge Trophy that spawns at the end of [[Challenges]] and the Big Chest that spawns after most major bosses. Touching either of these on a floor that would not normally spawn them will instantly end the run and send the player back to the title screen (unless a challenge is currently being played, in which case the player will receive unlocks as if they had completed the challenge normally). Touching a Big Chest on any floor that can spawn them will NOT give the player the respective completion marks but will still end the run (unless Isaac has either {{i|The Polaroid}} or {{i|The Negative}} and is on either {{s|Cathedral}} or {{s|Sheol}}, respectively.)
sections.Interactions:
* {{T|'M}}: Rerolls glitched actives into other glitched actives.
* {{i|Bag of Crafting}}: Recipes are not glitched.
* {{i|Binge Eater}}: Functions as intended, cycling pedestals between a glitched item and an HP up item.
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Using a glitched active spawns a random wisp.}}
* {{I|Death Certificate}}: TMTRAINER will not apply to Death Certificate's items.
* {{I|Diplopia}}: Glitched items are copied normally. Pedestals spawned before acquiring TMTRAINER will duplicate into a glitched item.
* {{I|Dream Catcher}}: Cannot identify glitched items.
* {{I|Genesis}}: Removes TMTRAINER's effect and allows items to spawn normally again, including items which appear in the special Bedroom created by Genesis. This also applies to glitched items which invoke Genesis' effect.
* {{I|Lemegeton}}: Spawns wisps of glitched items. All wisps look like {{I|The Sad Onion}}, but this is purely aesthetic. The wisps do not have any items' effects.
* {{I|Magic Skin}}: All summoned items will be glitched. Magic Skin cannot replace future glitched items after being left behind.
* {{i|Missing No.}}: Can reroll TMTRAINER, but not any previously acquired glitched items.
* {{T|Modeling Clay}}: Cannot transform into glitched items. Will visually vanish from sight, but is still held and can be dropped as normal.
* {{i|Spindown Dice}}: Glitch items will disappear if rerolled.
* {{c|Tainted Cain}}: Can craft TMTRAINER but it will have no effect other than giving shop items random prices which are most often overpriced.

sections.Effects:
* Instead of firing tears, Isaac controls one floating tear that hovers over obstacles. This tear deals constant damage when held in place over an enemy.
* {{dlc|r+}} +0.2 [[shot speed]].
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|nr}} The Ludovico Technique is a [[special item]].
* Ludovico tear is piercing and spectral by default.
* Ludovico tear movement speed is determined by the [[shot speed]] stat.
* Ludovico tear hits per second are determined by the [[tears]] stat, maxed out at 30 ticks per second.
* {{dlc|nr}} When {{E|Death}} uses his {{I|The Hourglass}} attack, the tear is slow to respond, but then moves so quickly that it is nearly impossible to use effectively.
* {{dlc|nr}} When there are no enemies in a room, the tear slowly floats towards Isaac.
** The {{I|Brimstone}} ring still follows when Isaac is outside of it.
* If multiple Ludovico Techniques are acquired (via {{i|Diplopia}}, {{i|Crooked Penny}}, {{i|Bag of Crafting}} or on a [[victory lap]]), then additional smaller tears will orbit the main tear.
** A maximum of 15 smaller tears can orbit the main tear.
* The Ludovico tear is larger than normal, but does not gain size from damage as much as normal tears.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|20/20}} / {{i|The Inner Eye}} / {{I|Mutant Spider}} / {{tf|Conjoined}}: Smaller tears orbit the main tear.
* {{I|Angelic Prism}}: While the tear is in contact with the prism, it will fire 4 additional tears in cardinal directions at Isaac's tear rate.
* {{C|Azazel}}: The same effect as with Brimstone, but the damage is halved.
** '''Azazel''' + {{i|Brimstone}}: Full damage of the laser ring is regained.
* {{I|Backstabber}}: Much easier to inflict bleeding and double damage on most enemies.
* {{I|Berserk!}}: The tear can't be controlled while berserking, but it can be batted around the room until the effect ends.
** {{C|Tainted Samson}}: uses a passive form of Berserk! that works the same way.
* {{tf|Bookworm}}: Causes an additional smaller tear to constantly appear and disappear, teleporting from Isaac's location to the main Ludovico tear in a glitchy manner.
* {{i|Brimstone}}: Tear takes the shape of a very large laser ring. {{Dlc|nr}} The shot speed is ignored. The Tears stat is ignored and the damage is dealt very rapidly at a rate equivalent to 1 tear delay. This ring will always be present and doesn't need charging up like normal Brimstone would.
** '''Brimstone''' + {{i|Incubus}}: Incubus' Brimstone laser is not affected by Ludovico Technique.
*** {{Dlc|r}} Adds a smaller controllable laser ring in addition to the main one.
** '''Brimstone''' + {{i|Twisted Pair}}: Similar effects to Incubus.
** {{Dlc|r}} '''Brimstone''' + {{i|Ipecac}}: +2 damage, beam explodes when colliding with enemies and obstacles.
** '''Brimstone''' + {{i|A Lump of Coal}}: The ring increases in diameter, but not the damage, the farther away it gets from Isaac.
** '''Brimstone''' + {{i|Spoon Bender}}: The ring reaches out to attack enemies near it, reforming into a ring when no enemies are present.
** '''Brimstone''' + {{i|Technology}}: The ring is visually identical to a normal Brimstone ring, but the 1.5x damage multiplier applies.
** '''Brimstone''' + {{i|20/20}}/{{i|The Inner Eye}}/{{I|Mutant Spider}} / {{tf|Conjoined}}: no effect.
** '''Brimstone''' + {{i|Apple!}} / {{i|Holy Light}} / Other tear effects: no effect.
* {{i|Compound Fracture}}: Turns tear into a large bone, which shoots out smaller tears when attacking/touching an enemy. Scattered tears are spectral and piercing.
* {{i|Dead Eye}}: Damage bonus increases until it hits the max of 2x. Since the controllable tear never hits the ground or wall, the bonus cannot be lost.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}}: A bomb is shot out at high speed and can be controlled, another bomb cannot be shot until the previously shot bomb has detonated.
** {{Dlc|r}} Causes your tears to act like {{i|Epic Fetus}} and now inherits all synergies Epic Fetus has.

* {{i|Epiphora}}: Moving the tear in one direction for an extended time increases your fire rate.

* {{i|Explosivo|r}}/{{t|Nose Goblin|n}}/{{i|Sinus Infection|n}}: Every tick of damage the Ludovico tear deals has a chance to stick a separate Explosivo/booger tear onto the enemy allowing Isaac to continue controlling the Ludovico tear.
* {{I|Eye of the Occult}}: While holding a direction key, the Ludovico tear will constantly shoot out controllable tears in random directions. The air time of these tears scales with the range stat.
* {{i|Fate's Reward}}: The familiar gains spectral and piercing tears.
* {{i|Flat Stone}}: The tear starts bouncing at a rate somewhat below Isaac's fire rate, each bounce dealing splash damage.
** '''Flat Stone''' + {{i|Ipecac}}: Causes a poisonous explosion when it bounces instead of plain splash damage, as per normal Ipecac. The first bounce when entering a room does not explode, allowing moving the tear with less risk of self-damage.
* {{i|Fruit Cake}}: The tear will cycle through different effects, based on Isaac's tear rate.
** {{dlc|a+nr}} If Isaac stays in one room long enough the Ludovico tear will often fill the room with many stationary {{i|Trisagion}} tears that last until Isaac leaves the room. This combination can easily clear most rooms.
* {{C|The Forgotten}}: The tear follows the Forgotten when in its skeleton form. It can be hit with its melee attack to propel it, making it do more damage. When switching to the Soul, the tear behaves as normal.
** '''The Forgotten''' + {{i|Multidimensional Baby}}: The second tear acts exactly like the first and can also be hit to propel it.
** '''The Forgotten''' + Multi-shot: Switching back from the Soul to the Forgotten will only remove the main tear, thus creating infinitely persisting tears on the screen. Repeating this process allows suspending arbitrarily high amount of tears.
* {{i|Godhead}}: The tear homes towards nearby enemies and gains a large damaging aura. However, the aura cannot damage an enemy that is in contact with the actual tear; barring a high tear rate, it may be better to keep the aura on the enemies instead of the tear.
* {{dlc|na+}} {{tf|Guppy}}: A large number of flies is rapidly deployed whilst controlling the Ludovico tear.
* {{I|Holy Light}}: The Ludovico tear will release holy beams on itself periodically while touching an enemy.
* {{i|Incubus|anr}}: Isaac gains a controlled tear while also being able to shoot normally with Incubus. Incubus's tears gain piercing and spectral properties.
** {{dlc|r}} Incubus creates a second smaller Ludovico Technique tear instead, which can both be controlled by Isaac. The second tear is slightly delayed/ outside of the main tear. This may cause it to not hit enemies sometimes.
** {{dlc|r}}  {{C|Lilith}}:  Lilith's incubus will fire a smaller Ludovico Technique tear. For each doubled incubus caused by {{i|Box of Friends}}, there will be an additional Ludovico Technique tear that spawns on Lilith's location.
* {{i|Lead Pencil|a+nr}}: The tear blinks red, but the effect is entirely cosmetic.
** {{dlc|r}} Tear barrages are launched in cardinal directions, even when not controlling the tear. Proc rate depends on fire rate.
* {{I|Lodestone}}: The single floating tear will flash grey to indicate that the magnetism might apply on hit. Like Strange Attractor, enemies tagged with magnetism will also draw the floating tear towards said enemy.
* {{i|Loki's Horns|a}}: The Ludovico tear will sometimes shoot 4 smaller [[piercing]] + [[spectral]] tears in each cardinal direction. This chance scales with [[luck]] and goes up to 100% at 20 Luck.
* {{i|Lost Contact}}: Tear will block enemy tears without disappearing.
* {{i|A Lump of Coal}}: The tear becomes larger the further away it is from Isaac, increasing in damage.
* {{i|Mom's Eye|a}}: The Ludovico tear has a chance on each damage tick to fire a smaller [[piercing]] + [[spectral]] tear in a random direction. This chance scales with [[luck]] and goes up to 100% at 10 Luck.
* {{dlc|na+}} {{i|Mom's Wig}}: The item causes spiders to spawn rapidly when moving the tear.
** {{dlc|r}} Causes Spiders to rapidly spawn until the cap of 5 is reached.
* {{i|Monstro's Lung}}: Tear turns red and does more damage.
** {{dlc|a}} Tear becomes a cluster of variously sized tears spread over a small area. The tears move at the same speed when controlled but constantly move around each other.
* {{I|My Reflection}}: The shot speed multiplier causes the tear to move significantly faster, allowing it to catch up to any fast-moving enemies.
* {{I|Mysterious Liquid}}: Creep continuously oozes from underneath the tear.
* {{i|The Parasite}}: Shoots out smaller tears when attacking an enemy. Scattered tears are spectral and piercing.
* {{i|Pause}}: The tear deals damage, even if the enemies are stopped. Moving the tear unpauses the enemies.
* {{i|Strange Attractor}}: Enemies, items and even most bosses will be sucked to the single floating tear, dealing constant damage while keeping Isaac well away from harm, making this combination extremely effective in almost all scenarios.
* {{dlc+|r}}{{C|Tainted Azazel}}: The same effect as Brimstone, dealing full damage (Tainted Azazel's default laser damage is halved unless {{I|Hemoptysis}} is used first). Tainted Azazel can no longer use Hemoptysis.{{dlc-}}
* {{i|Tear Detonator}}: The tear explodes into six smaller tears, then reappears next to the player.
* {{i|Tech.5}}: The tear controls as usual, and Isaac fires the laser towards the tear relative to his position, rather than in the direction the player is moving the tear. The laser becomes spectral.
* {{i|Technology}}: The tear becomes a large laser ring, which visually looks like a shot fired by {{i|Tech X|n}}. Shot speed is ignored. The Tears stat is ignored and the damage is dealt very rapidly at a rate equivalent to 1 tear delay.
* {{i|The Wiz}}: Small tear orbits the main tear. Tear controls rotated 45 degrees clockwise - holding up makes it move northeast and so on.

Because the familiars' travel speeds are not affected by Isaac's shot speed, they only travel in the same spot when Isaac has exactly the amount of shot speed to sync them up.

* {{i|Isaac's Tears}}:
** {{dlc|nr}}: The item charges based on the tear's movement.
** {{dlc|r}}: The item charges even while the tear is not moving, with the speed based on Isaac's tears stat.
* [[Tear Effects|Homing Tears]]: The Ludovico tear will slowly move towards an enemy. This can make it harder to control towards a different enemy or for enemies that hide underground.

* {{dlc|a+nr}}{{t|Nose Goblin|n}}/{{i|Sinus Infection|n}}: '''Not recommended''' as the tear can occasionally stick to an enemy. This leaves Isaac defenseless until the enemy dies or a minute has passed causing the tear to pop and a new one to appear.
* {{i|Notched Axe|nr}}: The Ludovico tear cannot be moved while Notched Axe is held up.
** {{dlc|r}} The tear can be moved by swings, without any special effect happening to it.
* {{i|Proptosis}}: The closer the tear floats to Isaac, the larger it is. The farther away, the smaller.
* {{i|Pupula Duplex}}: Decreases the tear size by taking the form of a Pupula Duplex tear; however, it travels faster.
* {{I|Sulfuric Acid}}: The Ludovico tear occasionally becomes acidic and can destroy objects.
* {{C|Tainted Lilith|r}}: {{I|Gello|n}} shoots a smaller Ludovico tear which disappears if he retreats back into Lilith. However, the automatic aiming of Gello interacts with the manual control of Ludovico, making the tear uncontrollable while fighting enemies.

** {{Dlc|r}}Technology 2's tears penalty applies instead of damage.
*** '''Technology 2''' + {{i|Analog Stick}}: Laser is fired directly at the tear while it is being moved, instead of being limited to cardinal directions.
* {{i|Technology Zero}}: No effect without additional items. Extra tears orbiting the main one or familiar tears will generate arcs to the controlled tear.
* {{i|The Wiz}}: A smaller Ludovico tear will appear and revolve around the main one. Also, the Ludovico tear moves diagonally, up is up-right, down is down-left, left is left-up, right is right-down. This can be counteracted by holding the keys or d-pad in its associated path (up-right to make it go up and so forth with the other keys).
* {{i|Tiny Planet}}: Tear orbits around Isaac, however, the orbit can be grown or shrunken, sped up or slowed down by using the firing keys.
* {{I|Tough Love}} / {{T|Jawbreaker}}: Tear occasionally flicks to being a tooth, which deals 3.2x Isaac's tear damage, before immediately returning to being a normal tear. The frequency at which the tear very briefly transforms into a tooth increases with [[Luck]], permanently becoming a tooth at 9 Luck. {{T|Jawbreaker}} does not change the tear appearance.
* {{i|Trinity Shield}}: The controls of the tear and the shield overlap, making it impossible to consistently control both.
* {{i|Tropicamide}}: No size increase effect. Ludovico tear size scales with damage, and not with size multipliers.

sections.Effects:
* Upon killing an enemy, 1 - 16 blood clot tears are released from them in random directions.
** The amount of tears released from an enemy is based on the enemy's health, and is not affected by Isaac's damage, nor the number of tears hit.
** These tears are red in coloration, regardless of Isaac's tears, but will inherit the coloration of applied to enemy [[Status Effects|status effects]].
* Burst tears will do set damage per floor. The formula for this is: (3.2 + 0.3 x stage).
sections.Notes:
* If an enemy is killed while affected by a [[status effect]], the burst tears will inflict the corresponding effect.
* [[Tear Effects|Homing]], [[range]] and [[shot speed]] do not affect Vasculitis.
* Released tears can be difficult to distinguish from enemy shots, especially from enemies which split in to burst shots upon death such as {{E|Red Boom Fly}} and light blue [[Monsters|champions]].
** {{dlc|r+}} The projectiles are now a unique shape and color to improve visibility.
* All forms of damage will cause an enemy to release tears.
sections.Interactions:
* {{dlc|r}}[[Cards and Runes|Ace Cards]]: Enemies that are turned into [[pickup]]s can’t release tears.
* [[Burn]]: Burning enemies release fire mind tears.
* [[Poison]]: When a poisoned enemy dies, the released tears are tinted green and will poison other enemies.
* {{i|E. Coli}}/{{i|Flush!}}: Enemies that are turned into poop can’t release tears.
* {{I|Fire Mind}}: Not recommended. Vasculitis' tears can explode, with great potential to harm Isaac.
* {{dlc|r}}[[Freeze|Freeze Effects]]: Enemies that die from being frozen can’t release tears.
** {{dlc|r+}} Frozen enemies can release tears.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a flat, rotating fetus [[familiar]] that follows Isaac.
* After entering a {{R|Boss Room}}, the familiar will move closer to the center of the room, and become a clone of the [[boss]]. Isaac must defeat both bosses.
** The Vanishing Twin and original boss will be set to 75% of their maximum health, and their movements and attack patterns will be around 20% slower.
* Upon death, the clone boss will drop an item pedestal where it died from the [[Boss (Item Pool)|boss item pool]], even if the fight isn't over yet.
** {{dlc|r+}} The item cannot appear on top of the trapdoor's tile.
* The effect doesn't occur against [[mini-boss]]es and end-chapter bosses such as {{E|Mom}}, {{E|Mom's Heart}}, {{E|Isaac}}, {{E|Satan}}, etc.
* The Vanishing Twin familiar will return when Isaac reaches the next floor.
sections.Notes:
* If Vanishing Twin becomes a clone of a boss with a hardcoded item drop, such as {{E|Gish}} or one of the [[Harbinger]]s, the second item pedestal will be from the [[Boss (Item Pool)|boss item pool]] instead of the boss' regular drop.
* Managing to defeat the boss before the twin has transformed into it will not prevent the twin from doing the transformation, and the boss fight will continue.
* Obtaining Vanishing Twin in the boss fight itself will not take effect immediately. The boss room must be re-entered in order for the twin to transform.
* On floors with multiple bosses (e.g. {{s|The Void}}) or when getting {{Cu|Labyrinth}}, the twin will only act on the first boss encountered.
* The twin will not transform into bosses that are randomly found in some default room layouts.
* This item has no effect in [[Greed Mode]] and will not normally spawn in this game mode.
* If it becomes a clone of {{E|Great Gideon}}, 2 extra waves of enemies are added to the battle, as well as the second Great Gideon also performing attacks.
* If Vanishing Twin turns into {{e|Clutch}}, the clone will immediately enter its second phase due to not having any {{e|Clickety Clack}}s to possess.
* When multiple {{E|Rotgut}}s are spawned, only one needs to be entered.
* In true Co-op, the pedestal spawned by Vanishing Twin will have an extra item for each player.
* [[Familiar]]s that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Vanishing Twin having the lowest priority at {{dlc|nr+}} 6th / {{dlc|r+}} 8th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.
* Vanishing Twin does not appear in item pools (and cannot be found normally) from [[Chapter 4]] onwards.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Sacrificial Altar}}: The twin can be sacrificed normally at any time.
** If sacrificed after it's transformed into a boss, it will still give an item from the sacrifice, but the boss will not disappear and will also ''not'' spawn an additional item.
* {{i|Satanic Bible}}: Using it before killing the clone boss will cause it to spawn an item from the [[Devil Room (Item Pool)|Devil Room item pool]] instead of from the [[Boss (Item Pool)|Boss item pool]]. This item must be purchased just like a normal [[Devil Room#Deals with the Devil|Devil Deal]].
* {{i|There's Options}}: Will spawn an additional item choice for the item spawned by Vanishing Twin.
* {{t|Tick}}: Further lowers the health of both the original boss and its clone.
* {{i|Vanishing Twin}}: Picking up multiple copies of the item will result in multiple clones getting spawned.
** Each boss will have its health reduced down further to 75% of the health of its previous clone.
** Each of the bosses will spawn a separate item.
** Each clone of {{E|Great Gideon}} adds 2 extra waves of enemies.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|BFFS!}}: Will increase the fetus' size, although it has no effect after the transformation happens.
* {{i|Box of Friends}}: No effect.
* {{p|IV - The Emperor?}}: The twin will clone the additional boss and spawn an item if the original one has not been visited yet. However, this will not allow for another item to be obtained from the floor's original boss, because the twin won't be active until the next floor.
* {{i|Meat Cleaver}}: No effect on the number of items spawned.
* {{c|Tainted Keeper}}: If playing as Tainted Keeper, the item dropped by the clone boss will cost money.

sections.Effects:
* At the start of every floor, generates a ladder which leads to a special {{R|Angel Room}} Shop, regardless of whether a devil deal has been taken. These angel shops always contain the following:
** Three items/pickups for sale. These items/pickups can be on sale, just like with normal {{R|Shop}}s.
*** An item from the [[Angel Room (Item Pool)|Angel Room Item Pool]] for 15 or 30 pennies.
*** An {{e|Eternal Heart}} for 5 pennies.
*** A {{e|Soul Heart}} for 5 pennies.
*** A {{e|Key}} for 5 pennies.
*** A {{p|Holy Card}} for 5 pennies.
** An [[Angel]] statue. The Angel can be fought for a Key Piece like normal.
** A normal {{e|Beggar}} or {{e|Rotten Beggar}} next to the entrance.
** A {{e|Confessional}}, if it has been unlocked.
* The ladder to the angel room disappears if Isaac leaves the starting room, regardless of whether Isaac has climbed it or not.
sections.Interactions:
* {{T|Adoption Papers}}: Does not affect the Angel shop.
* {{i|Coupon}} / {{p|Credit Card}} / {{i|Mr. ME!}}: Can be used to obtain items for free.
* {{I|Death Certificate}}: An additional ladder will spawn in one room of the Death Certificate area. This ladder leads to the same Angel Shop as the one in the starting room of the floor. Purchasing an item will remove Isaac from the Death Certificate area as though he had collected an item normally. Sometimes, the ladder will spawn directly on top of an item pedestal, making the Angel Shop impossible to enter without collecting that item and subsequently being removed from the area.
* {{I|Keeper's Sack}}: Buying items grants stats, same as with other shops.
* {{I|A Pound of Flesh}}: Makes Angel Shops cost health just like regular {{r|Shop}}s.
* {{i|Restock}} / {{T|Store Credit}}: No effect in the Angel shop.
* {{i|Steam Sale}}: Reduces the prices of the items on offer.
* {{i|Glowing Hourglass}}: When used in the Angel shop, uses all three charges and removes the ladder.

sections.Effects: * Two items appear after defeating a [[Boss]]. Only one can be taken; the other will disappear.
sections.Notes:
* If the boss has a fixed item drop such as [[The Harbingers]], the other item will be selected from the normal {{ip|Boss|text=Boss item pool}}.
* Two items appear after clearing {{r|Boss Rush}}.
* Both items that appear after defeating a Boss in {{s|The Void}} are from random item pools. Likewise, both items that appear after defeating {{E|The Fallen}} are {{ip|Devil Room|text=Devil Room items}}.
* There is no effect on items dropped by [[All Mini-Bosses (Bosses)|Mini-Bosses]].
* There is no effect on what appears after defeating {{E|Mom}}, even if {{i|The Polaroid}} / {{i|The Negative}} have not unlocked (in which case only 1 {{ip|Boss|text=Boss item}} will appear).
* Does not retroactively affect {{r|Boss Room}}s that had already been cleared prior to picking it up.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Book of Revelations|r}}: Defeating a [[Harbinger]] will spawn both a regular {{ip|Boss|text=Boss item}} and either {{i|Ball of Bandages}} or {{i|Cube of Meat}}.
* {{dlc+|r}} {{i|Crooked Penny}} / {{i|Diplopia}}: Both items are copied, allowing Isaac to take both copied items without the other disappearing. The original pedestals will function as normal, removing the other if one is collected.{{dlc-}}
* {{p|IV - The Emperor?}}: The extra boss room's rewards will be two choice pedestals.
* {{c|Jacob and Esau}}: Both brothers can take one item each if they are lined up properly.
* {{i|Satanic Bible|r}}: Both items will be {{ip|Devil Room|text=Devil Room items}}; only one can be bought.
* {{i|Vanishing Twin}}: The item which appears after defeating the copied boss is also affected.

sections.Effects:
* Isaac fires tears from both eyes at the same time.
* Isaac's tears are fired diagonally outwards, similar to the effect of the [[R U a Wizard?]] pill.
* Isaac's tears become [[Tear Effects|spectral]].
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|20/20|r}} / {{tf|Conjoined}}: Fires 2 tears in both diagonal directions.
* {{dlc|nr}} {{i|Diplopia}}/{{i|Crooked Penny}}: Each additional copy of The Wiz will make Isaac fire two more tears in a wider diagonal layout.
** {{dlc|r}} Each additional copy of The Wiz will make Isaac fire one extra tear, starting with one tear fired forwards.
* {{I|Eye of the Occult}}: Both tears shoot much closer together and can be controlled, creating for a better double shot similar to what Tractor Beam would grant.
* {{I|The Inner Eye|r}}/{{C|Keeper}}: Fires 2 tears to both diagonal directions with a wider spread.
* {{i|Mutant Spider|r}} /{{C|Tainted Keeper}}: Fires 3 tears to both diagonal directions.
* {{i|Spirit Sword}}: Beams and sword swings are fired forwards instead of diagonally. Isaac spins an additional time when doing a charged attack.
* {{i|Technology Zero}}: Electricity arcs between both tears, damaging enemies between them.
* {{i|Tractor Beam}}: Both tears will follow the beam, making it easier to hit enemies with them.
** '''Tractor Beam''' + {{i|Mom's Knife}}: Knives ignore the path of the beam and remain flying diagonally.
* {{i|Tiny Planet}}: Each shot fires two tears in opposing orbital directions. The orbit can be controlled as normal.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Analog Stick}}: Will make one tear go forwards and the other tear fire at a 90-degree angle to the other tear.
* {{c|Azazel}}/{{I|Brimstone}}/{{c|Tainted Azazel}}: Fires two Brimstone beams diagonally. Beams remain diagonal even if Isaac has {{i|Tractor Beam}}.
** {{dlc|nr}} '''Azazel''' + {{i|Anti-Gravity}}: Overrides The Wiz. {{Citation needed}}
* {{C|Cain}} / {{C|Tainted Cain}}: Makes Cain fire in the two diagonal directions instead of just his right eye as the [[R U a Wizard?]] pill does.
* {{i|Epic Fetus}}: The crosshair is controlled diagonally as if rotated 45 degrees clockwise from usual (i.e.: the up arrow will move it in a northeast direction), and two missiles are fired, similar to the effect of {{i|20/20}}. The crosshair can be moved in the cardinal directions by pressing two arrow keys at once (e.g.: pressing the up and right arrows will move the crosshair right).
* [[Homing tears]]: Tears are more likely to home in on enemies if enemies are coming towards Isaac diagonally. With big enough tears or a big enough enemy, homing tears are very powerful with The Wiz.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: Small tear orbits the main tear. Tear controls rotated 45 degrees clockwise - holding up makes it move northeast and so on.
* {{i|Marked|n}}: Fires two shots aimed diagonally from the crosshair.
* {{i|Monstro's Lung}}: 7-8 tears are fired at each diagonal direction instead of a full burst.
* [[R U a Wizard?]] pill: Makes Isaac fire forward with a normal fire rate and 90 degrees outwards with half fire rate.
* {{i|Sad Bombs}}: Does not affect the number of tears when bombs explode.

sections.Effects:
* Isaac uses a shield to block shots.
* The shield stays in the same direction until Isaac fires in another direction.
sections.Notes:
* The shield can block diagonally by holding down 2 arrow keys at once.
** Tears will be fired vertically while the shield is at an angle.
* The shield can't block beams or explosions.
* The shield can be held in any direction if you're using a joystick.
* Many items that change the color of Isaac's tears will also change the color of the shield; this effect is purely cosmetic.
* When using Tainted Forgotten, the shield goes on the bone pile and not the soul.
sections.Synergies: * {{i|Marked|r}}: The shield will now face the crosshair instead of facing just four cardinal directions.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|BFFS!}}: No effect.
* {{i|Maw Of The Void}}: Trinity shield briefly stays fixed in place during the start of the effect.
* {{dlc|nr}} {{i|Notched Axe}}: While using this item, the shield stays in place. It returns when the effect ends.

sections.Effects:
* When Isaac gets hit, 10 tears are fired in a circle around him (similar to {{i|Tammy's Head}}).
** Tears spawned on hit have a +25 damage bonus.
* When Isaac gets hit, has a chance to activate the {{i|Anemic}} effect for 2 seconds.
** The effect doesn't seem affected by luck.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|20/20}} / {{i|The Inner Eye}} / {{i|Mutant Spider}} / {{i|The Wiz}}: No effect. When Isaac gets damaged, only ten tears will be fired.
* {{i|Apple!}}: Each tear has a chance to fire the razor tear.
* {{C|Azazel}}: Fires ten short-ranged brimstone beams in a circle.
* {{i|Anti-Gravity}}: No effect.
* {{i|Chocolate Milk}}: Fires ten minimally charged tears. Damage of tears is reduced slightly.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}}: Taking damage releases 10 bombs around Isaac, which often leads to taking damage again.
* {{i|Epic Fetus}}: Fires ten normal tears when taking damage.
* {{I|Eye of the Occult}}: Tears are controllable.
* {{i|It Hurts}}: Two rings of tears are released at once.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: No effect.
* {{i|Marked}}: No effect.
* {{i|Monstro's Lung}}: Fires ten red tears when taking damage. No other effects.
* {{I|Playdough Cookie}}: Each one of the 10 tears spawned on hit has one of the available random effects applied to it.
* {{i|Soy Milk}}: Fires ten tiny tears when taking damage. Tear damage is only slightly reduced.
* {{C|Tainted Azazel}}: Fires ten brimstone beams in a circle. These beams do not have the damage penalty T. Azazel's attacks have, and can be further boosted by his {{I|Hemoptysis}} sneeze.
* {{i|Tech X}}: No effect.
* {{I|Technology}}: Fires ten lasers in a circle.
* {{i|Tractor Beam}}: No effect.

sections.Effects: * Gives [[invulnerability]] and +0.28 [[speed]] for six seconds, but removes the ability to shoot tears while the effect is active.
sections.Notes:
* The invulnerability effect negates all forms of damage, including health loss from {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}s and {{e|Devil Beggar}}s.
* The item is similar to {{i|My Little Unicorn}}, with faster recharge time at the cost of being unable to damage enemies while under its effects.
* {{dlc|nr}} If another active item is picked up while in the [[invulnerability]] state granted by Unicorn Stump, Isaac will return to normal immediately, becoming able to shoot tears and take damage.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|4.5 Volt}}: With some damage source while this item is active, it can be permanently invulnerable inside the room while you have enemies.
* {{i|???'s Only Friend}}: The fly can still be controlled while invincible.
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns an orbital rainbow wisp on the middle ring. Wisps do not deal contact damage and will not take contact damage. When Isaac is invulnerable, wisps become much more vibrant and deal contact damage equal to 2x Isaac's damage -5. If Isaac has less than 2.5 damage, the wisps will deal no damage even if Unicorn Stump is active.}}
* {{i|Car Battery}}: Doubles the duration of invulnerability.
* {{I|Mom's Knife}}: Does contact damage in the same direction it was being held at the time of using the Unicorn Stump, giving a massive amount of free damage by ramming into an enemy.
** Works the same with the {{tf|Yes Mother?}} transformation's knife.
* On contact items ({{i|Aries}}, {{i|The Virus}}, etc.): Freely usable in basically every room.
** [[Orbital Familiar]]s ({{i|Cube of Meat}}, {{i|Sacrificial Dagger}}, etc.): The orbital can be used freely in every single room, making it a great alternative source of damage.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: The tear stays in place while Isaac is invincible; although Isaac cannot move the tear, it will continue to damage enemies during his invincibility. This is very useful for stationary enemies.
* {{i|Marked}}: Isaac's tears will still fire, but he will be unable to move the crosshair while invincible.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns two [[familiar]]s who float by Isaac's side and fire tears that use Isaac's [[tears]], [[range]], [[shot speed]], [[tear effects]] and that each deal 0.375x his [[damage]].
* {{transformation contribution|Conjoined}}
sections.Notes:
* Twisted Pair is very similar to the item {{I|Incubus}}. It provides the same total damage per second increase in the form of a familiar (familiars in this case).
* When playing as {{c|Lilith}} or {{c|Tainted Lilith}}, the demon familiars will deal 50% of Lilith's damage each.
* Holding the up/down + left/right attack buttons will make one demon go further behind and the other one in front of Isaac.
* Because the demons need time to adjust their position while firing, the left/right directional buttons can be tapped to shoot more precise, straight lines of tears.
* They don't inherit all effects and stats from the player. See Interactions below check for small oversights.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|BFFS!}}: Twisted Pair's tears deal twice as much damage.
* {{i|Box of Friends}}/{{i|Crooked Penny}}/{{i|Diplopia}}: Each additional Twisted Pair will add two more familiars that float farther out from Isaac.
* {{T|Forgotten Lullaby}}: Increases the fire rate of Twisted Pair.
* {{i|Tractor Beam}}: Twisted Pair's tears follow the beam.
* {{T|Friendship Necklace}}: Causes the Twisted Pair to orbit Isaac, allowing for a more precise firing of tears.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|Epic Fetus}}:  Each familiar will fire a missile from a two additional crosshairs. '''Not Recommended''', as the twisted pair crosshairs are not synced to Isaac's crosshair and move at a much slower rate, making self damage much more likely as the additional crosshairs will struggle to make distance from Isaac. This is likely an oversight.
* {{i|Eye Drops}}: The familiars do not have the staggered attack, stat bonuses still apply.
* {{I|Eye of Greed}} The two familiars will also fire coin tears which spend Isaac's coins. Their shot counter is independent from Isaac's.
* {{i|Sacrificial Altar}}: Only 1 item pedestal is spawned for their sacrifice, unless they were spawned through {{I|Cambion Conception}}, in which case they will count for two.
* {{i|Terra}} + {{i|Brimstone}}/{{i|Technology}}: While Terra + laser items like Brimstone or Technology don't open doors normally, Twisted Pair's lasers can open doors. This is likely an oversight.

sections.Effects:
* If the character has half a red heart or no red hearts after taking damage, it triggers the {{i|Book of Shadows}} effect, creating a [[shield]] that nullifies all types of damage for 5 seconds.
* Allows entrance into {{s|Chest}} after beating {{E|Isaac}} in the {{s|Cathedral}} by touching the chest.
* {{dlc+|r}} Opens {{A|A Strange Door}} in {{s|Depths}} II and its variants that leads to {{s|Mausoleum}}/{{s|Gehenna}} II.{{dlc-}}
** Unlike with the Chest entrance, The Polaroid gets consumed by the door and vanishes from Isaac's inventory.
sections.Notes:
* This item is a guaranteed drop from {{E|Mom}}, if unlocked. Will drop alongside {{i|The Negative}}, provided they are both unlocked. However, they are mutually exclusive: Once one of them is picked up, the other one will disappear.
** With the use of either a teleportation item and 5 pip {{R|Dice Room}}, a {{i|Forget Me Now}}, a {{i|Diplopia}}, a {{i|Crooked Penny}}, or  {{i|R Key}}, both the Polaroid and the Negative or multiple copies of the Polaroid or Negative can be obtained.
** With {{C|Jacob and Esau|r}}, proper alignment of both characters can enable picking up both The Polaroid and The Negative.
** With frame-perfect timing and a bomb, it is possible to pick up both The Polaroid and the Negative.
* The Polaroid always triggers when taking damage as characters who lack [[Red Heart container]]s, such as {{C|???}} and {{C|Tainted ???}}, {{C|Black Judas|r}} and {{C|Tainted Judas}}, {{C|The Soul}}, {{C|Tainted Forgotten}}, {{C|Tainted Bethany}} or any other character who has chosen to trade away their heart containers in [[devil deal]]s, {{R|Black Market}}s, {{i|Guppy's Paw}} or the {{i|Potato Peeler}}.
* The shield effect provided by The Polaroid can be stacked if the character takes damage multiple times. For example, using {{i|IV Bag}} 2 times provides 10 seconds of shield.
* Although {{C|The Lost}} and {{C|Tainted Lost}} don’t have health, The Polaroid can trigger if they take non-fatal damage (e. g. take damage while {{i|Berserk!}} is active or imitate damage via {{i|Dull Razor}}).
* The Polaroid will be the leftmost item after defeating Mom, in case {{Cu|Blind}} is active.
* {{dlc|nr}} It is possible to obtain two Polaroids by obtaining one as an {{C|Eden}} starting item.
* Obtaining multiple copies of The Polaroid does not cause its effect to stack.
* As with all items crucial to story progress ({{I|Key Piece 1}} and {{I|Key Piece 2}}, {{I|Knife Piece 1}} and {{I|Knife Piece 2}}, {{I|Dad's Note}}, and {{I|Dogma}}), this item has protection from full-run rerolls. It does not, however, share the immunity {{I|Dad's Note}} has to D6-type rerolls and {{I|Void}}.
* If Isaac took fatal damage and is revived in the same room, The Polaroid will trigger upon revival.

sections.Effects:
* Grants two {{E|Soul Heart}}s.
* Isaac gains a pulsing blue aura that repels enemies and projectiles.
** The power of the repel force alternates in strength at random, sometimes strong enough to counter a projectile well before it hits Isaac, sometimes only strong enough to slow it down.
** Ground-based enemies will overcome the counterforce easier than flying enemies and projectiles.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|r}} A stronger effect of this item is given temporarily by {{P|I - The Magician?|x}}.
* {{dlc|r}} When playing as {{c|Tainted Forgotten|n}}, this item works only on the Forgotten's body and not the soul.
* {{dlc|r}} When playing as {{C|Tainted Jacob|n}}, Dark Esau is unaffected by this item's repelling properties.

sections.Effects:
* Gives eight [[Familiar#Orbital Familiars|orbital]] flies when picked up.
* Each time a fly blocks a projectile, it will turn into a blue fly.
* Each time a room is cleared, spawns an orbital fly.
** The maximum number of orbital flies Isaac can have is 16.
* {{transformation contribution|Beelzebub}}

* {{dlc|nr}} Gives one {{e|Soul Heart}}, +0.7 [[damage]], -0.18 [[speed]], and the ability to destroy most [[obstacle]]s by walking into them. Cannot be stacked in one room.
** Isaac deals 40 contact damage to enemies, once per second. Does not prevent Isaac from taking contact damage.
* {{dlc|r}} Gives half a {{e|Black Heart}}, +2 [[damage]], -0.18 [[speed]] and the ability to destroy obstacles for the current room.
** If used multiple times in one room, the speed penalty only applies once, but the damage buff can stack.
** Isaac deals 20 contact damage to enemies, twice per second. Does not prevent Isaac from taking contact damage.
*** If an enemy is at 40 HP or less, the contact damage is increased to 40 for that enemy.
* {{dlc|r}} Isaac's tears become red for the current room.
* {{transformation contribution|Leviathan}}
sections.Notes: * Isaac makes a demon sound when taking damage while this item is in use. This is quieter than Isaac's standard damage sound and is easy to miss.
sections.Synergies: * {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns black wisps on the inner ring. Wisps shoot nails that deal double damage from standard wisps and have increased knockback, akin to {{I|8 Inch Nails}}.}}

sections.Effects:
* +0.7 [[tears]].
* +0.16 [[shot speed]].
* Tear color becomes red.
sections.Notes: * Is functionally identical to {{I|Torn Photo}}.

sections.Effects: * Inflicts [[poison]] on enemies who make contact with Isaac. ** {{dlc|na}} The poison deals 2 damage per tick (3 damage per second) and lasts for 2-3 ticks. ** {{dlc|ana+}} The poison deals Isaac's damage per tick (1.5x Isaac's damage per second) and lasts for 2-3 ticks. ** {{dlc|a+nr}} The poison deals Isaac's damage per tick (1.5x Isaac's damage per second) and lasts for 6 ticks for [[Monsters|normal enemies]] and 3 ticks for [[bosses]]. ** {{dlc+|r}} The poison lasts for 6-7 ticks and deals damage equal to (0.2*HeartContainers^2) + 2, where HeartContainers is the total number of [[Health#Red Heart Containers|heart containers]] and {{e|Bone Heart}}s Isaac has. {{dlc-}} *** The poison can be continuously applied to bosses, which normally are immune to status effects for a brief time after being inflicted with one. * {{dlc|r}} Lets Isaac deal 12 contact damage per tick on top of applying poison (24 damage per second). * {{dlc|anr}} Enemies who are killed after they have been inflicted with this type of poison have a 20% chance to drop {{e|Black Heart}}s. * {{dlc|nr}} -0.1 [[speed]] down. ** {{dlc|na}} This is not applied until the next time Isaac's speed stat is updated. * {{dlc|r}} +0.2 [[speed]] up. * {{transformation contribution|Spun}}
sections.Notes:
* This item can drop from killing {{E|Lust}}. {{dlc|nr}} Lust can drop this item even if Isaac has already encountered/possessed it. 
* Taking another copy of {{i|The Virus}}:
** {{dlc|na}} results in a speed down with no benefit.
** {{dlc|a}} does not affect Isaac.
** {{dlc|r}} counts as two items towards the [[Spun]] transformation.
* {{dlc|anr}} The black heart is only dropped if the poison was caused by The Virus. The item's effect doesn't extend to poison tears.
* {{dlc|anr}} If an enemy doesn't do contact damage, The Virus can safely be applied to it for more chances at black hearts. {{E|Fly|text=Flies}}, {{E|Mulligan}}s, and {{E|Host}}s are the most common enemies this can be applied to.
** {{dlc|anr}} With {{i|Skatole}}, {{E|Hive}}s and {{E|Swarmer}}s will constantly spawn normal Flies, meaning they can be endless sources of Black Hearts.
** {{dlc|na+}} Although {{E|Stoney|text=Stonies}} and {{e|Shopkeeper}}s can't be visibly poisoned, they still can drop Black Hearts if destroyed after being touched.
* Enemies won't start taking poison damage if they are pushing up against Isaac; The Virus will be constantly trying to apply poison and refreshing the ticks where poison damage would occur.
** {{dlc|anr}} {{i|Gnawed Leaf}} and The Virus can still work if Isaac has a short-range orbital such as {{i|Cube of Meat}} or {{i|Ball of Bandages}}, as it will kill enemies pushing against Isaac that are not taking poison damage while still dropping Black Hearts.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Abyss}}: When Isaac uses Abyss to absorb The Virus it turns into a green locust that poisons enemies.
* [[Invulnerability]]: Contact while invincible poisons enemies.
sections.Interactions: * {{dlc|nr}} {{i|Odd Mushroom (Large)}}: The speed down from the Virus does not stack with the Odd Mushroom; if both are collected, only a total of -0.1 applies.

sections.Effects:
* After taking {{dlc|nr+}} 12-20 / {{dlc|r+}} 6-12 hits a removed tonsil [[familiar]] starts following Isaac, blocking enemy shots.
* The effect can happen twice, after which the trinket will be destroyed.
* The familiar does not deal damage to enemies.

* When the familiar is generated, Isaac will gain the familiar permanently as a passive item. This allows Isaac to drop the trinket while keeping the familiar.
