*** {{dlc|nr}} If Eden starts with the passive tonsil item and picks up the trinket, the trinket will spawn only one familiar before being consumed.
* {{dlc+|r}} The passive item form of Tonsil no longer exists; its ID has been taken by {{i|Broken Glass Cannon}} and no longer appears in the Collection Page, nor can it be obtained by Eden as a starting item.{{dlc-}}
* Sources of self-inflicted damage, like {{I|IV Bag}} or {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}s, can spawn a familiar.
* Damage that is blocked by {{I|Holy Mantle}} or the {{p|Holy Card}} does not count to the number of hits that are needed for the tonsil familiar to spawn.
* {{dlc|r}} [[Familiar]]s that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Tonsil having the lowest priority at 6th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.
sections.Synergies: * {{dlc|r+}} {{a|Golden Trinket|n}} / {{i|Mom's Box}}: Having either can generate a 3rd tonsil before destroying the trinket. Having both can generate a 4th tonsil before destroying it.
sections.Interactions: * {{i|D4|nr}}: If a passive Tonsil item is given, this item can't be rerolled by the D4 or other items that reroll passive items.

sections.Effects:
* Separates Isaac's head and body for the current [[Rooms|room]]. Isaac's head, which now has [[flight]], will be under the player's control, while his body will seek out enemies to attack by contact damage.
** The body's movement speed is dependent on Isaac's [[speed]].
** {{dlc|nr}} The body deals 5.5 damage per tick, or up to 82.5 damage per second.
** {{dlc|r}} The body deals 5.5 damage per tick, or up to 23.6 damage per second.
sections.Notes:
* The damage of the body [[familiar]] is independent of Isaac's stats. {{dlc|nr}} Its damage per second is the highest of all chasing familiars.
* {{dlc|r}} If Isaac's body is not visible (for example, through the effects of {{i|Transcendence}} or previous uses of the Pinking Shears), the familiar will gain [[Flight]] and take upon a ghost-like body, similar to the Lost's body type.
* If used multiple times in the same room (via battery pickups, for example), more instances of the body familiar can be spawned.
* {{dlc|nr}} If Isaac switches active items while The Pinking Shears is in effect, the body will immediately despawn for the rest of the room.
* The body familiar will avoid [[creep]], and will consequently rarely damage enemies like {{e|Brain}}s and {{e|Blighted Ovum}} that leave creep trails as they walk, instead opting to stand right next to them.
* Using The Pinking Shears just above an obstacle results in the body becoming stuck in the terrain, making it useless until the obstacle is destroyed.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|BFFS!}}: Damage dealt by the body is doubled.
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns wisps on the inner ring, looking like Isaac's floating head. Wisps fire [[piercing]] tears. }}
* {{i|Car Battery}}: Two bodies are spawned at once.
* {{c|Tainted Forgotten}}: Only the head needs to be moved by the {{c|Tainted Soul|n}}.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|Scissors}}: If Scissors and Pinking Shears are used together, control is given back to an invisible head with only a shadow visible as both the head and body are mobilized to attack.
* {{I|Guillotine}}: Using The Pinking Shears after picking up Guillotine results in the head revolving around a shadow, making Isaac's hitbox difficult to determine.
* {{I|The Intruder}}: If the familiar is released after Pinking Shears are used, control is given back to an invisible head with only a shadow visible. This is due to both the head (the spider) and the body being mobilized to attack.

sections.Effects:
* Every 6 seconds, Isaac turns to stone and sprouts spikes for 1 second. While Isaac is in this state, he is immune to damage and deals 40 contact damage.
** Isaac flashes white three times before turning to stone on the fourth flash. The first three flashes are accompanied by a "ticking" sound, the final one with the spike extension sound of a mimic chest.
** Unlike {{i|Gnawed Leaf}}, Isaac can still move and shoot tears.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|r+}} This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|Tuff Twins}}.{{dlc-}}
* {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}s and {{e|Devil Beggar}}s will still deal damage while Tooth and Nail is active.
* With proper timing, {{r|Curse Room}}s can be both entered and exited without taking damage.
* When invincible, {{E|Spiked Chest}}s/{{E|Mimic Chest}}s can be opened without taking damage.
* When under the effects of the [[Pills#Paralysis|Paralysis pill]] Isaac cannot change into a statue.
sections.Synergies:
* Contact damage items work great with Tooth and Nail, such as {{I|Aries}} / {{I|Mom's Heels}} / {{I|The Virus}} for extra damage, {{I|Serpent's Kiss}} for Black Heart generation, {{I|Midas' Touch}} for coin generation etc.
** {{I|Midas' Touch}} also makes the stone turn a yellowish golden while active. Purely visual, but can help remind the player that they have both items.
* {{I|Damocles}}: As Isaac is invincible 1/6th of the time, with some luck, Tooth and Nail may save him from the falling sword.
* {{I|Kamikaze!}}: Allows usage without taking damage during invincibility.
* {{C|The Lost}} can use this item to prevent additional damage from occurring after losing the {{I|Holy Mantle}} (for example, exiting a {{r|Curse Room}} after being hit), and it does not use up the Holy Mantle's 1-hit protection if it has not been lost.

sections.Notes: * Is functionally identical to {{I|Wire Coat Hanger}}.
sections.Interactions: * {{i|Spindown Dice}}: The Sad Onion disappears upon being rerolled, as its internal ID number is 1. Leaves an empty pedestal.

sections.Effects:
* Tears have a 16.67% chance of spawning allied [[Blue Fly|Blue Flies]] when they hit an enemy.
* {{transformation contribution|Beelzebub}}
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|nr}} Because the {{tf|Guppy}} transformation includes the guaranteed ability to spawn flies on hit, the Mulligan's effect is nullified. This means individual tears cannot spawn more than one fly per hit.
** {{dlc|r}} The 66.67% chance of spawning a fly granted by Guppy will not stack with The Mulligan's 16.67% chance.
* {{dlc|r}} Blue flies will only spawn if Isaac has less than 30 blue flies.
* {{Dlc|nr}} This item does not work for {{C|Lilith}} since the {{i|Incubus}} tears do not count for her tears.
* Items and trinkets that increase tear firing rate synergize well with the Mulligan.
* This item is not affected by [[luck]].
sections.Synergies:
* {{C|Azazel}}/{{i|Brimstone}}: Rapid damage ticks can cause large amounts of blue flies to spawn.
* {{i|Chocolate Milk}}: The Mulligan's ability isn't affected by the charge time, meaning rapidly firing uncharged shots will generate a ton of blue flies.
* {{i|Cricket's Body}} / {{i|The Parasite}}: Has a 16.67% chance to spawn a fly on every hit by a split shot, which boosts the spawning of flies immensely.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus|r}}: Bombs have a chance to spawn blue flies when damaging enemies.
* {{i|Finger!}}: Rapidly spawns blue flies when pointed at an enemy.
* {{i|Urn of Souls}}: Fires have a chance to spawn blue flies.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Dr. Fetus|nr}}: Overrides The Mulligan.
* {{i|Epic Fetus}}: Overrides The Mulligan.
* {{i|Mom's Knife|nr}}: Has a very low chance of spawning flies.

sections.Effects:
* While held, enemies leave behind small, red ghosts on death; using the item causes the ghosts to explode, dealing damage to nearby enemies and destroying nearby enemy projectiles. The explosions will not destroy obstacles, move pickups, or damage Isaac.
** The damage exploding ghosts deal is equal to 3 + 0.04x the health of the enemy the ghost spawned from + ((floor-1)x0.5), and each explosion can hit the same enemy up to 4 times. Blast radius increases the more powerful the explosion is.
*** Enemies with high health, such as champion enemies, minibosses, and bosses will leave behind a larger ghost that creates three explosions.
** Isaac will also leave a ghost upon death, which deals 200 flat damage if detonated.
* Using the item will instantly kill any enemy that has the 'ghost' tag and is at 50% or less HP, including bosses.
sections.Synergies:
* {{Book of Belial synergy|description=Instead of exploding on the spot, souls home in on nearby enemies and explode on contact, similarly to {{i|Purgatory}}. The souls deal 2 × Judas's damage up to 3 times and destroy projectiles.}}
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Ghosts very slowly move and shoot tears in the same direction Isaac is shooting. The ghosts' tears deal 3.5 damage, and are fired once every second.}}
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.
* [[Cards and Runes|Ace Cards]]: Enemies that are turned into [[pickup]]s can’t leave ghosts.
* {{i|E. Coli}} / {{i|Flush!}}: Enemies that are turned into poop can’t leave ghosts.
* {{i|Void}}: When absorbed, enemies no longer leave behind ghosts on death. Retains ghost instant kill effect when void is used.

sections.Effects:
* {{dlc|nr}} Grants one {{e|Soul Heart}}.
* {{dlc|r}} Grants one {{e|Black Heart}}.
* +1 [[damage]].
* +0.2 [[speed]].
* {{transformation contribution|Leviathan}}
sections.Synergies: * {{t|Black Feather|r+}}: Counts as an evil item, granting a damage up.

sections.Effects: * Grants [[flight]].
sections.Interactions: * {{I|The Intruder}}: When the effect is activated Isaac becomes invisible.

sections.Effects:
* +1 [[damage]].
* -0.2 [[speed]] ({{dlc|na+}} not applied until the next time Isaac's speed stat is updated or upon taking damage).
** {{dlc|nr}} -0.2 maximum speed.
* +0.2 [[tears]] ({{dlc|na+}} not applied until the next time Isaac's tears stat is updated or upon taking damage).
sections.Notes:
* Has a small chance to be dropped from a destroyed [[tinted rock]].
* Normally only appears once per run, but can appear again if Isaac's items are re-rolled with {{i|D4}}, {{i|D100}}, or a {{R|Dice Room}}.
* {{dlc|nr}} Always has a chance to spawn as long as Isaac does not currently have it. This includes the possibility of spawning and obtaining multiple copies of The Small Rock on the same floor if not picked up the first time.
* Taking the rock in the {{R|Boss Rush}} from a tinted rock in the room will count as taking an item and consequently trigger Boss Rush. The other items do not disappear and will stay until one is picked up.
sections.Interactions: * {{i|Diplopia}}/{{I|Crooked Penny}}: Additional copies grant an additional tears up and speed down with no further increase in damage.

sections.Effects:
* Isaac's tears become icicles that [[freeze]] enemies upon death, turning them into ice statues.
** [[Bosses]] and [[mini-boss]]es cannot be frozen.
* Frozen enemies can be kicked, sliding and leaving damaging creep across the room and shattering when they hit a wall, [[obstacle]] or an enemy, releasing 10 icicle tears in a circle.
** These icicles can either [[slow]] enemies for 4 seconds or turn them into ice statues as well if they deal the lethal hit.
* Killing an enemy by freezing them will prevent any on-death effects from occurring (i.e. splitting into other enemies, firing any post-death tears, exploding, etc.), even after shattering.
* {{dlc|r+}} Isaac's tears have a chance to [[petrify]] enemies.
sections.Notes: * Isaac's own tears cannot apply a slowing effect on enemies. This property is only available for the icicle burst after shattering a frozen enemy. * The on-shatter icicles deal damage equal to 8 + (floor - 1) which is not affected by Isaac's stats. ** These tears do not inherit any of Isaac's tear effects. * The blue creep left behind ice statues while they're sliding across the room rapidly deals 2 flat damage for 11 ticks per second, resulting in 22 damage per second. * Ice statues have 10 health points and can be shattered if shot by 10 tears or projectiles. ** Isaac's damage is irrelevant here and each tear shot will deal only 1 point of damage to them. ** Enemies ignore the ice statues when targeting Isaac and they can also destroy them if shot enough times. ** Explosions will shatter the statues immediately. * Enemies hit by a sliding ice statue receive 35 flat damage which is not affected by Isaac's stats or the current floor. * Enemies killed by hit of a sliding ice statue or the blue creep will not be frozen. * Frozen enemies are considered dead by the game, meaning they don't need to be shattered in order for the room to be cleared. If not shattered, they don't disappear until leaving the room. * Killing enemies by freezing them does not however count as a "kill" for the purposes of activating the on kill effects of certain items and trinkets. Because of this, only enemies killed by icicles from statues, bombs, familiars and other sources will count towards the on kill effects, rendering them quite difficult to use. {{dlc|rnr+}} These items and trinkets are: {{t|Bat Wing}}, {{i|Berserk!}}, {{i|Charm of the Vampire}}, {{i|Contagion}}, {{t|Eve's Bird Foot}}, {{i|Jumper Cables}}, {{i|Lusty Blood}}, {{i|Red Stew}}, {{t|Samson's Lock}}, {{t|Sigil of Baphomet}}, {{i|Toxic Shock}} and {{i|Vasculitis}}. ** {{dlc|r+}} Aforementioned items and trinkets now properly trigger upon enemy being frozen. ** {{i|Hungry Soul}}, {{i|Infestation 2}}, {{i|Quints}}, {{i|Urn of Souls}}, {{i|Vade Retro}} still activate their effects, immediately upon enemy being frozen. ** {{i|Athame}} and {{i|Jar of Flies}} will only activate upon enemy's ice statue being shattered. ** Enemies, that were gold-[[Status Effects#Petrification|petrified]] (e.g. by {{i|Midas' Touch}}), don't drop coins upon becoming ice statues. * Champion enemies that drop consumables won't drop anything until their ice statue is shattered. ** As {{c|Tainted Keeper}}, enemies will drop a [[coin]] immediately when frozen. ** As {{c|Tainted Magdalene}}, enemies killed by hug, will drop a {{e|Half Red Heart}} immediately when frozen. * Using this item in daily-runs is ill-advised as freezing enemies removes a large chunk of exploration bonus. * If a non-boss enemy dies within 10 ticks (0.33 seconds) after being hit by a freezing tear, it will be frozen regardless of what killed it.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Athame}} / {{i|Maw Of The Void}} / {{i|Montezuma's Revenge}} / {{i|Revelation}}: The beam will freeze enemies upon death.
* {{i|Bob's Rotten Head}}: Enemies are frozen when dying to Bob's Rotten Head.
* {{i|Brimstone}}  / {{i|Jacob's Ladder}} / {{i|Tech.5}} / {{i|Technology}} / {{i|Technology 2}} / {{i|Tech X}}: The normally firing laser gets an icy white color and freezes enemies upon death.
* {{dlc|rnr+}} {{i|Death's List}}: The list order isn't broken when killing enemies by freezing them off-order.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}} / {{i|Epic Fetus}}: Bombs will freeze enemies upon death.
* {{i|Gello}}/{{c|Tainted Lilith}}: When the baby is launched, any enemies it kills in its trajectory will freeze and any frozen enemies the baby is launched into slide similarly to when kicked by Isaac.
* {{i|Suplex!}}: Provides another method of shattering the ice statues.
* {{i|Trisagion}}: Can help break statues faster due to tears hitting multiple times.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|4.5 Volt}}: Damage dealt during the killing blow doesn't provide charge.
* {{I|120 Volt}}/{{I|Technology Zero}}: No effect on lasers.
* {{dlc|rnr+}} {{I|Berserk!}} / {{C|Tainted Samson}}: Kills will freeze the enemies upon their death but they don't count as kills, therefore making it impossible to extend the time by killing enemies with the jawbone.
** {{dlc|r+}} Freezing enemies properly extends effect duration.
* {{i|Contagion}}: Enemies that are frozen are still "alive" and can create a gas explosion when they are the first ice statue broken before any other enemy in the room dies.
* {{i|D10}}: Even though frozen enemies are considered dead by the game, rerolling them into a different enemy will bring them back to life.
* {{i|Friendly Ball}}: Cannot be used to capture frozen enemies.
* {{i|Shoop da Whoop!}}: The beam is unable to freeze enemies.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a [[familiar]] that slowly floats diagonally around the room and bounces off walls. The eye blocks enemy shots and deals 8 damage per tick or about 17.1 damage per second to enemies it passes through.
* Gives tears shot from Isaac’s left eye a red appearance.
* {{dlc|r}} All tears shot from the left eye will deal 35% more damage.
sections.Synergies: * {{I|The Scooper}}: When used, causes Isaac's right eye to be scooped out too with the same benefits as the left, effectively granting Isaac a 35% damage boost.

* {{I|Bird's Eye}} / {{I|Ghost Pepper}}: Fire will appear behind Isaac when The Poop is used.
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns wisps on the outer ring, looking like miniature {{E|Dip}}s. Wisps' tears have a 2.5% chance to apply {{I|E. Coli}} to enemies, turning them to poop.}}
* {{T|Brown Cap}}: The Poop may be used as a discounted {{I|Mine Crafter}}, both for utility, as well as combat.
* {{t|Gigante Bean}}: Deals 10 flat damage to nearby enemies.
* {{i|Hallowed Ground}}: Using The Poop will always spawn a {{g|White Poop|n}}.
* {{t|Meconium}}: Using The Poop has chance to spawn a {{g|Black Poop|n}}.
* {{i|Midas' Touch}}: Using The Poop has a chance to spawn {{g|Golden Poop}}.
** The chance of this effect is 100% at {{dlc|nr}} 5 [[Luck]] / {{dlc|r}} 6.56 [[Luck]]
* {{i|9 Volt}}: Can be used in an incomplete room to repeatedly spawn poop.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.
* {{I|Dirty Mind}}: Allows the creation of extra [[Familiar#Dips|Dip familiars]].

sections.Effects: * Most damage taken is reduced to half a heart.
sections.Notes:
* The damage reduction includes most sources in the game that would cause more than half a heart of damage:
** {{E|Bomb}}s.
** Most [[Champion]]s.
*** The exceptions being the skull and large champions - damage from them is reduced from two full hearts to one.
** {{R|Sacrifice Room}}s.
** Environmental hazards such as [[Spikes]].
** Most self-inflicting damage items (exceptions are noted).
** Every source of damage in {{s|Womb}}/{{s|Utero}}/{{s|Scarred Womb}} and beyond, including all enemies, {{R|Curse Room}}s, {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}s, and {{e|Devil Beggar}}s.
** The "HARD HARD" special [[Seeds|seed]].
* {{dlc+|r}} The Wafer does not reduce damage from opening the door to {{s|Mausoleum}} / {{s|Gehenna}}.{{dlc-}} 
* Despite The Wafer reducing damage to 1/2 a heart, this does not change the amount of invincibility frames granted from full/two heart damage sources.
* The Wafer is substantially less useful in Greed Mode, since Chapter 4 and beyond does not increase damage taken like usual.

sections.Effects:
* Grants a large [[Familiar#Orbital Familiars|orbital]] similar to {{E|Teratoma}} that slowly orbits Isaac.
** The orbital repels enemies that touch it and deals 3.5 contact damage to enemies, once per second.
* After blocking 3 shots and/or dealing 3 ticks of contact damage, the orbital splits into two smaller ones that orbit opposite of each other. They behave the same as the original, except they are smaller and can only take 2 hits before being destroyed, bursting into 3 [[blue spider]]s in the process.
** 5 seconds after both orbitals are destroyed, the original, full-size orbital respawns.

sections.Effect:
* Spawns a small blue cross [[familiar]] that follows Isaac and drops a {{E|Soul Heart}} alternatingly:
** {{Dlc|nr}} Every 5 or 6 [[room]]s.
** {{Dlc|r}} Every 7 or 8 [[room]]s.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|r}} [[Familiar]]s that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars.
** {{dlc|nr+}} The Relic has the lowest priority at 6th.
** {{dlc|r+}} The Relic has the lowest priority at 8th.
* Having multiple copies of The Relic, such as duplication through {{i|Diplopia}}, will have each copied familiar paying out with soul hearts. {{c|Lilith}} can make use of this during {{r|Boss Rush}}, having the ability to duplicate the relic using the {{i|Box of Friends}}.
sections.Synergies: * {{i|BFFS!}}: The familiar requires one less room clear to drop a soul heart.

sections.Effects:
* Grants the combined effects of the {{i|Blue Map}}, {{i|Treasure Map}}, and {{i|The Compass}}, revealing the floor layout and all special rooms, including {{R|Secret Room}}s and {{R|Super Secret Room}}s.
* Picking up this item and then dropping it with {{t|Butter!}} or as {{c|Tainted Isaac}} will not remove the effect.
sections.Synergies: * {{dlc|r}} {{I|Book of Secrets}}: Immediately gives the {{i|X-Ray Vision}} effect for the floor upon use.

sections.Effects:
* +1 [[Red Heart container]].
* {{Dlc|r}} Heals 1 additional {{E|Red Heart}}.
* -0.4 [[speed]] down.
** {{dlc|nr}} Also affects maximum speed.
* Isaac gains the ability to destroy [[obstacle]]s by walking into them.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|r+}} This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|Mega Fatty}}.{{dlc-}}
* Holes in the ground can be filled if Isaac walks into adjacent [[rocks]] from the right direction, similar to bombs.
* Avoid walking over [[Mushroom (Obstacle)|Mushrooms]] and [[Bomb Rock]]s, as they can damage Isaac upon destruction.
* With this item, Isaac can walk over and destroy {{g|Red Poop}} and [[Spiked Rock]]s without taking damage. He will still be damaged if he's above the destroyed Red Poop when it reforms.
* Walking over an [[Angel]] Statue in the {{R|Angel Room}} will trigger the boss fight, and the Angel will spawn on top of Isaac. It is possible to avoid taking contact damage by walking away from the statue immediately after touching it.
sections.Interactions: * {{i|A Pony}}/{{i|White Pony}}: The lower limit for Isaac's [[speed]] is decreased from 1.50 to 1.10.

sections.Effects:
* +2.5 [[Range]].
* +0.22 tear size.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Brimstone}} / {{I|Dr. Fetus}} / {{I|Mom's Knife}} : No effect on projectile size.
* {{i|Technology}}: Laser size is increased.
* {{I|Lachryphagy}}: Tears fired will now act as if they have been fed one tear, meaning the tear will explode into 6 parts instead of 5 if undisturbed.

sections.Effects:
* Isaac emits a beam in the direction that his head is facing. Isaac's tears travel in the path of the beam. When Isaac moves or turns his head, tears that are mid-flight will remain within the beam.
* {{dlc|nr}} +0.5 [[Tears]].
* {{dlc|r}} +1.0 [[Fire Rate]].
* {{dlc|nr}} +5.25 [[Range]].
* {{dlc|r}} +2.5 [[Range]].
* +0.5 [[Tear Falling Speed]].
* +0.16 [[Shot Speed]].
sections.Notes:
* This item prevents tears from being fired at angles using momentum.
* Isaac does not automatically aim downwards after he stops firing with this item.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|20/20}}/{{tf|Bookworm}}/{{tf|Conjoined}}/{{i|The Inner Eye}}/{{c|Keeper}}/{{i|Mutant Spider}}/{{c|Tainted Keeper}}/{{i|The Wiz}}: Every extra tear will follow the beam instead of having a spread, making it easier to hit enemies with the extra tears. Essentially increases damage per second.
* {{i|Compound Fracture}}: All split tears will follow the beam greatly increasing effective damage.
** {{dlc|a+nr}} Bone tears will not burst into bone shards when fired at obstacles, however, bone tears will burst into bone shards when fired at enemies.
** {{dlc|r}} Bone tears burst into bone shards when fired at obstacles.
* {{i|Cricket's Body}}/{{i|The Parasite}}: All split tears will follow the beam greatly increasing effective damage.
* {{i|Continuum}}: The tears will re-appear directly in front of Isaac and continue their flight path after going off screen.
* {{i|Guillotine}}: The beam will visually follow Isaac's head as it orbits, but tears will still stay centered relative to Isaac's body making his tears easier to aim.
* {{i|Lachryphagy}}: Tears can still be fed and will still burst. {{dlc|nr}} Burst tears will travel along the beam.
* {{i|Monstro's Lung}}: All tears are fired along the beam but at different heights.
* {{t|Ouroboros Worm}}: The altered patterns tears travel in is confined to the beam allowing Isaac to benefit from the stat bonus and [[spectral tears]] granted without losing accuracy.
* {{i|Pop!}}: Tears stick along the tractor beam even when they slow down and collide, capable of creating a dense line of shots.
* {{t|Rainbow Worm}}: The altered patterns tears travel in is confined to the beam allowing Isaac to benefit from the stat bonuses granted without losing accuracy.
** {{dlc|r}} Many of the worm trinket effects it gives now grant spectral tears as well.
* {{t|Ring Worm|r}}: The altered pattern tears travel in is confined to the beam allowing Isaac to benefit from its stat bonus and spectral tears without losing accuracy.
* {{i|Rubber Cement}} / {{t|Super Ball}}: Tears will no longer be bound to the beam after bouncing off of something.
* {{i|Sinus Infection}}: Once the booger falls off the enemy, Isaac can loosely control it by moving and firing in different directions, and make it stick to another enemy.
* Tear copiers like {{I|Cain's Other Eye|r}} / {{i|Incubus}} / {{i|Sumptorium|n}} / {{i|Twisted Pair|n}}: Tears shot by these familiars will originate from Isaac, following the beam.
* {{t|Wiggle Worm}}: The altered pattern tears travel in is confined to the beam allowing Isaac to benefit from its stat bonus without losing accuracy.
** {{dlc|r}} Wiggle Worm also grants spectral tears with little downside in accuracy.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Analog Stick|nr}}: Tears cannot be fired diagonally; however, stat effects apply.
** {{dlc|r}} Tractor Beam can be angled diagonally or in any direction using an analog stick or mouse controls.
* {{i|Anti-Gravity}}: Tears that are still hovering can be pushed in the direction Isaac is aiming by walking into them.
* {{T|Brain Worm}}: Overrides Brain Worm.
* {{i|Brimstone}} / {{i|Epic Fetus}} / {{i|The Ludovico Technique}} / {{i|Tech X}}: Overridden by Brimstone. Stat effects still apply.
* {{i|C Section}}: Overridden by C Section. Stat effects apply.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}}: After firing a bomb and moving, the bomb will have a homing-style effect towards the beam, but will not stay directly on the beam. '''Not recommended''', as changing directions while firing will cause the bomb to reel back to Isaac at high speed, making self-damage very likely.
* {{i|Euthanasia}}: Needles fired will follow beam; however, burst needles will not.
* {{i|Evil Eye}}: Both evil eyes and tears fired by them will not be affected by the beam.
* {{i|Explosivo|ana+}}: Explosivo's tears will become "entangled" when sticking on an enemy, causing them to jump from the tractor beam to the enemy and vice versa every frame. The tear will explode only once regardless while attached to an enemy or bound to the beam.
* {{i|Eye of the Occult}}: Tears will only move forward while being fired, but control is otherwise overridden.
* {{i|Eye Sore}}: No effect on the extra tears.
* {{i|Haemolacria}}: Fired tears will travel along the beam; however, the burst tears will not.
* [[Homing tears]]: The tears will stay in the line but will slow down when near enemies.
* {{t|Hook Worm}}: Overridden, except for the range increase.
** {{dlc|r}} The tears increase and spectral tears it now grants are also still in effect.
* {{i|Immaculate Heart}}: No effect on the extra tears.
* {{i|Incubus|nr}}: The Incubus tears aren't affected by the beam, but the beam will still be there.
** '''Incubus''' + '''Monstro's Lung''': Incubus's tear barrage will follow the beam.
* {{dlc+|a+nr}} {{i|Lead Pencil}}: Tear barrage will not follow the beam.{{dlc-}}
* {{I|Loki's Horns}}: No effect on extra tears.
* {{dlc|nr}} {{i|Marked}}: Tears will only fire in cardinal directions.
** {{dlc|r}} The beam will point towards the marker.
* {{dlc|nr}} {{i|Multidimensional Baby}}: The beam only affects the original tears, not the duplicated ones.
** {{dlc|r}} The duplicated tears will follow the beam.

* {{dlc|nr}} When used on the last floor of a [[Challenges|challenge]], a trapdoor to the next floor can spawn. If it is entered, Isaac must beat the boss of that floor to spawn the ending trophy.

sections.Effects:
* Upon use, grants +0.75 [[fire rate]], -0.03 [[speed]], and distorts the screen and background music. The effects can be stacked in the same room, and the distortion becomes more pronounced with repeated use. After repeated uses, the colors begin to turn very bright and intense.
** Each use increases the recharge time, which starts at 0.5 seconds with the 1st use, and ends with 15 seconds on the 9th use. After the 10th use, it no longer recharges automatically though it can be recharged and used even more through {{E|Lil' Battery|text=Lil' Batteries}}.
** Leaving the room doubles the speed penalty and multiplies the fire rate bonus by x0.4, for the uses in that room.
** Clearing a room removes one use's worth of penalties and bonuses, giving +0.06 speed and -0.3 fire rate.
** Isaac's costume will change the stronger the Item's effects get.
* {{transformation contribution|Fun Guy}}
sections.Notes: * This item can very rarely drop from destroying [[Rocks#Mushrooms|mushrooms]] in the {{r|Secret Room}}.
sections.Interactions: * {{c|Tainted Lazarus}} / {{i|Esau Jr.}}: The distortion effect will not be removed when flipping between characters.

sections.Effects:
* When used for the first time, Isaac creates a blue portal under where he is standing. The next time he uses the item, he creates an orange portal. Isaac can then walk over either of the portals to teleport instantly to the location of the other one.
** Activating the item more than twice will replace the older of the two portals.
* Upon entering a new floor, the previously placed portals will disappear.
sections.Notes:
* The portals can be placed in any room. However, if a portal leads to a room with a negative grid index (i.e. {{R|Devil Room}}, {{R|Angel Room}}, {{R|I AM ERROR}} room, {{R|Crawl Space}}, {{R|Boss Rush}}, {{R|Black Market}}, {{E|Mega Satan}} room, or {{S|???}} portal room), Isaac will not be able to enter the portal.
* {{Dlc|nr}} Upon teleportation, Isaac is granted with a short invulnerability period which can be abused to trigger the {{e|Blood Donation Machine}} and {{e|Devil Beggar}} without losing health by placing a portal just next to it, teleporting, and touching the Donation Machine or Beggar in the same move. This trick is particularly useful for {{C|The Lost}}. The teleportation trick can also be used to enter a {{R|Curse Room}} without taking damage.
* {{dlc|r}} Upon teleportation, Isaac is granted with a short invulnerability period which can be used to enter a {{r|Curse Room}} without taking damage. However, it cannot be used to play {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}s or similar machines for free. Isaac is also unable to open chests during the animation, meaning {{e|Spiked Chest}}s cannot be opened for free.
** When teleporting between different rooms, Isaac will briefly stay invisible at the door before moving to the portals, and can interact with chests near the door. However, opening Spiked Chests this way will still deal damage to Isaac.
* Portals will stay even if the item is dropped or changed.
* It is possible to stack the two portals on top of each other. Entering one will make you hop infinitely as long as you stay on the portals. It creates invincibility at the cost of mobility and almost, but not all tears.
* If {{cu|Maze}} is active, using portals placed between different rooms may result in a random destination. Two portals in the same room work reliably.
** If room contents are randomized by the curse, it's possible for the portals to end up completely surrounded or even inside rocks or pits. If Isaac can't move to safety, the run can be quit and resumed to be placed at a door.
* {{Dlc+|r}} On {{S|Downpour}} II, Ventricle Razor cannot be used to teleport between the normal and mirror world.{{dlc-}}
* {{Dlc|r}} This item can be useful to exit Mom's boss room to start the [[Ascent]], as long as you use it at least once before entering the boss room.
* {{Dlc|r}} The item only costs 10 cents when found in a {{r|Shop}}.
* This item can be used to steal the rewards from a {{r|Challenge Room}}, a {{r|Boss Challenge Room}} or {{r|Boss Rush}}. This can be done by placing a portal in another room, then taking the rewards from the challenge room. Then, instead of fighting the enemies, use Ventricle Razor to immediately teleport out and keep the rewards.
* When fighting bosses that can drop pickups accompanied by other enemies, Isaac can kill only the boss for the pickups while keeping the other enemies alive, then use Ventricle Razor to teleport out and reset the room. This can be repeated to farm their loots infinitely.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|4.5 Volt}} / {{i|Jumper Cables}}: By swapping to another active item before reentering the room or with {{i|Schoolbag}}, can provide infinite charges by clearing some enemies then leaving with the portals, and repeating.
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns a blue/orange wisp that circles the respective portal. Wisps do not fire tears. Wisps do persist if Isaac leaves the room and reenters.}}
* {{I|Charm of the Vampire}} / {{i|Leech}}: Allows for unlimited healing.
* {{I|Gimpy}}: Allows the possibility to generate unlimited hearts.
* {{I|Head of the Keeper}}: With enough patience, coins can be gathered infinitely.
* {{i|Holy Mantle}}: Can be used to reset the shield at will.
* {{i|Kamikaze!}}: Can be activated without harm while teleporting between portals.
* {{c|Tainted Magdalene|r}}: She can abuse the invincibility from the stacked portals to let enemies approach her and die in her hugs<ref>https://youtu.be/vRYclaFycH0</ref>.
* {{c|Tainted Keeper}}: Leaving and re-entering the room allows for limited coin farming; however, enemies in rooms Tainted Keeper has already visited will eventually stop dropping coins.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Car Battery|ana+}}: Renders the item conventionally useless except for the unlimited invicibility described above.
** {{dlc|a+}} Ventricle Razor works normally.

sections.Effects:
* Upon use, Isaac farts, knocking back enemies and their shots. It also sends out a circular rock wave around him that deal 10 damage per tick to nearby enemies and break [[obstacle]]s.
* {{dlc|r}} Shots deflected by Wait What? farts deal 6 damage if they would've hurt Isaac for half a heart, and 7 for a full heart.
sections.Notes:
* This item is identical to {{i|Butter Bean}} in appearance.
* {{dlc|nr}} {{i|Butter Bean}} has a 10% chance to turn into this item upon pickup.
* {{dlc|r}} Each run has a 5% chance of replacing Butter Bean with Wait What? in item pools. Both items generally do not exist during the same run.
* One way for both items to exist in the same run is via {{i|Death Certificate}} or {{I|Spindown Dice}}. Since both items are identical in appearance, you can differentiate them by looking at the items that are next to them, {{i|Butter Bean}} will be between  {{i|Head of Krampus}} and {{i|Magic Fingers}} while {{i|Wait What?}} will be between {{i|Mama Mega!}} and {{i|Crooked Penny}}.
* This item is useful for opening {{R|Secret Room}}s, {{R|Super Secret Room}}s, [[Bedroom]]s and the path to {{S|Mines}}. In Bedrooms, it can also open up the passage under the carpet.
** To break open a secret room, the wall must be hit with one of the rock waves, not the gas cloud, so Isaac needs to stand a few steps away from the wall.
* The earthquake can open {{E|Bomb Chest}}s.
* The earthquake can destroy {{e|Shopkeeper}}s.
* {{dlc|nr}} The earthquake can be used to blow up the {{e|Donation Machine}} or activate/blow up a {{e|Shop Restock Machine}}.
sections.Synergies:
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns white glowing wisps on the middle ring that don't shoot. The wisps invoke the effect of Wait What? when destroyed and do not persist between rooms.}}
* {{i|Ghost Pepper}} / {{i|Bird's Eye}}: Shoots a flame behind Isaac upon each use of Wait What. Despite {{I|Car Battery}} not duplicating Wait What's shockwave, the flame shot is duplicated.
sections.Interactions: * {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.

sections.Effects:
* Grants a chance to trigger the {{i|Book of Shadows}} effect upon taking damage, creating a [[shield]] that nullifies all types of damage for 10 seconds.
** The activation chance depends on the [[luck]] stat and goes up to 100% with 10 Luck.
* Converts all negative [[pill]]s into positive ones, but does not identify them.
sections.Notes:
* The shield negates health loss from {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}s and {{e|Devil Beggar}}s.
* Does not prevent [[Red Heart container]] loss from {{R|Devil Room}} deals.
* Bad pills already obtained/dropped will be converted to their "good" counterpart.
* As bad pills will turn into good pills, it is possible for two different colored pills to have the same effect.
sections.Synergies: * {{Dlc|r}}{{i|Celtic Cross}} / {{i|The Polaroid}}: Virgo can trigger at the same time as Celtic Cross or The Polaroid, cumulating to up to 22 seconds of shield.
sections.Interactions: * {{i|False PHD}}: Pills can be both good and bad again. Taking bad pills still applies the benefits from False PHD.

sections.Effects:
* Upon use, destroys all pedestal items in the room. Items that require payment cannot be absorbed unless they are bought first.
** If Void destroys an [[activated item]], it gains the activated ability of that item; whenever Void is used, it will simultaneously use all previous active items that were absorbed in the same order they were absorbed. Passive effects of absorbed active items will not apply (e.g., the passive effect of {{i|Mom's Box}}). The active item effects happen after the initial destruction of current pedestal items, and in the order that the active items were absorbed. 
** If Void destroys a [[passive item]], Isaac gains 2 random stat boosts. Possible stat changes include:
*** +1 flat [[Damage]]
*** {{dlc|nr}} +0.5 [[Tears]]
*** {{dlc|r}} +0.5 [[Fire Rate]]
*** +0.2 [[Speed]]
**** {{dlc|nr}} Also affects maximum speed (may never exceed 2.0)
*** +0.2 [[Shot Speed]]
*** +1 [[Luck]]
*** {{dlc|nr}} +0.5 [[Range]]
*** {{dlc|r}} +2.5 [[Range]]
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|nr}} If speed or tears are at their maximum and are chosen, there will be no visible increase.
* {{dlc|r}} If speed is at its maximum and is chosen, there will be no visible increase.
* {{dlc|r}} Void can exceed the normal maximum tears limit.
* Using Void to absorb items in {{r|Boss Rush}} or {{r|Challenge Room}}s counts as taking the items and will cause waves of bosses or enemies to start spawning.
* {{dlc|nr}} The ability of the newly absorbed active item(s) will activate even if the item has no charge. Using any multiple-use item before absorbing it with Void will effectively allow Isaac to use the item twice.
* {{dlc+|r}} If Void is used while Isaac is holding an item above his head, it can still consume the item, allowing to immediately absorb passive items bought from {{r|Devil Room}}s, {{r|Black Market}}s, or {{r|Shop}}s. This also can be used to give Isaac a chance to see what an unknown item is before deciding if he wants to consume it, in the case of an active {{cu|Blind}} or a {{r|Treasure Room}} in {{s|Downpour}}, etc.
** This mechanic can be used to absorb familiars granted by {{p|Soul of Lilith}}.
** Active items can also be absorbed this way if Isaac has {{I|Schoolbag}} and is not carrying a second active item.{{dlc-}}
* {{dlc|r}} The newly absorbed active item(s) won't be used right away, but with the next usage of Void.
* {{dlc|r}} If Isaac absorbs items from a room with choice pedestals, it will only absorb one item, and the other item vanishes as if Isaac took it.
* If Isaac finds another Void, such as during a [[Victory Lap]] where it is left behind in the previous lap, it will have the same active effects stored in it as the other Void.
** Consuming a second Void will create no effect.
* If multiple copies of an active item are absorbed, using Void will activate that effect equally many times.
* Stat boosts upon destroying passive items are determined by the seed and are tied to the number of items destroyed, not the items themselves. If Isaac runs the same seed and chooses to consume different passive items, the same stat boosts will be gained.
** {{dlc|r}} Void's random number generation is advanced once after each usage, so using Void will change what stat boosts are gained.
* Stat boosts are permanent and are retained if Void is dropped (except when the player's build is rerolled, e.g. with {{i|D4}} or {{i|D100}}).
* Using Void to absorb {{i|Key Piece 1}} and {{i|Key Piece 2}} will not permanently remove them from the run. They will continue to spawn after defeating {{e|Uriel}} or {{e|Gabriel}} no matter how many times Isaac uses Void on them, as long as he does not pick them up normally.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Alabaster Box}}: Allows the box to be charged through normal means, rather than by absorbing soul hearts.
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns the wisps of all the active items Void has absorbed. Spawns no wisps by itself. Using Void on Book of Virtues will give stat upgrades instead of its normal effect, as Book of Virtues is considered a passive item.}}
* {{i|Breath of Life|r}}: Immediately grants invincibility frames.
** {{T|Panic Button}}: Getting hit with Breath of Life stored inside Void will negate the damage.
* {{i|Crooked Penny|nr}}: Using Void with the Crooked Penny absorbed will result in items in the room being absorbed as usual, but afterwards new copies of the items or one coin are spawned.
** {{Dlc|r}} If Crooked Penny deletes the contents of the room, they will not be consumed by Void.
* {{I|Eraser}}: Allows the Eraser to be used multiple times per floor.
* {{i|Glass Cannon}}: Can be used without it ever breaking or causing damage to the player.
* {{dlc|nr}} {{i|More Options}} / {{i|There's Options}}: Using Void will cause both items to be absorbed.
* {{i|Moving Box}}: Moving Box will not be added to Void; instead, it is converted into stat boosts like a passive item.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Abyss}}: Since consumed activated items are used before absorbing new items in a room, using Void with Abyss stored inside will destroy pedestals with Abyss' effect first, essentially overriding Void's item consumption effects. Previously consumed active items will still function as normal when using Void. Passive items can still be consumed with Void by picking them up before using Void.
* {{i|Blank Card}} + {{p|? Card}}: Using the ? Card with an absorbed Blank Card simply activates Void. Isaac will not be teleported to the {{r|I AM ERROR}} room and Void will not be deleted.
* {{t|Broken Remote}} / {{i|Teleport!}} / {{i|Teleport 2.0|n}} / {{i|Undefined}} / any other teleport method: Void will still consume any item pedestals in the room, after which the teleport occurs.
* {{dlc|nr}} {{i|The D6}} / {{i|D100}}: If absorbed while there are other pedestal items in the room, it will reroll the items before absorbing them. Likewise, if The D6 or D100 was previously absorbed and Void is used, pedestal items will get rerolled before being absorbed.
** {{dlc|r}} The D6 and D100 can't roll items while being absorbed since their effect isn't triggered the first time anymore but any subsequent Void uses will still roll items before absorbing them.
* {{i|Death Certificate}}: Only allows the consumption of one item per Death Certificate room and the consumed item is treated as if it was picked up causing all other items in the room to disappear and forcing Isaac to leave the area.
* {{i|D infinity|nr}}: When absorbed and Void is used, replicates the effect of a random die item.
** {{dlc|r}} Acts as a copy of one of the 10 dice {{i|D infinity}} can replicate. This die is randomly chosen and does not change.
* {{dlc|nr}} {{i|Diplopia}} / {{i|Forget Me Now}} / {{i|Pandora's Box}} / {{i|Mama Mega!}} / {{i|Mystery Gift}} / any single-use active item: They are used once upon being absorbed, but their effects are not absorbed and will not activate with subsequent Void uses.
** {{dlc|r}} Single-use items won't be used upon their absorption, instead being invoked on the next usage of the Void, which allows Isaac to use the absorbed item later when needed. Their effects will still only be invoked once.
*** {{i|Car Battery}}: As Void will be activated twice, single-use items are immediately used when absorbed.
*** When multiple copies of a given single-use active are in Void, only half of them will be used each time Void is activated, rounded up.
** {{i|Diplopia|r}}: On the next use, the pedestal items in the room will be consumed but another copy of the items will be spawned afterward.
*** {{i|Diplopia|n}} + {{i|Mystery Gift|n}}: If both items are absorbed in the same room, the next use of Void will only trigger Mystery Gift, with the use afterward activating Diplopia
* {{dlc+|r}} {{i|Everything Jar}}/{{i|Larynx}}: Will only replicate the 1-charge version of the effect.{{dlc-}}
* {{i|Flip}}/{{i|Jar of Flies}}/{{i|The Jar}}/{{i|Stitches}}/{{i|Notched Axe}}/{{i|Esau Jr.}}: None of these items do anything when absorbed by Void.
** When playing as {{C|Tainted Lazarus}}, and {{i|Flip}} is absorbed by the void, it will still flip the character. But it is not normally possible to obtain a second Flip, and therefore not normally possible to absorb it.
* {{i|Genesis}}: All effects granted by absorbed items including stat ups and [[activated item]] abilities Void takes are removed without creating items to replace them. Since Void is stripped of any active item abilities it would have gained, any other Void found will also have no other active effects stored in it.
** Void's active effects are reset even if Isaac is currently not holding it.
* {{i|Glowing Hourglass|nr}}: Upon using Void, Isaac is sent to the previous room and most changes are reverted, nullifying many other effects that Void may have absorbed. If the Glass is absorbed in a shop, Isaac is sent back to the previous room, but the Glass will be unused in the shop on its pedestal. This allows for an infinite shop donation circle, eliminating the need for a battery to be present in the shop.
** {{dlc|r}} Hourglass can now be used indefinitely per floor, but every use will cost the entire charge of Void. Makes most active items and Apollyon's Birthright useless.
* {{i|How to Jump}}: If this item is activated by {{i|Void}}, it is possible to get stuck in an impassable area with no ability to escape. Exiting and resuming the run will place Isaac at whichever door he entered the room through.
* {{i|Jar of Wisps}}: Each use will spawn only one wisp.
* {{i|Mega Blast}} / {{i|Mega Mush}}: Allow to use it every {{dlc|nr+}} 6 or {{dlc|r+}} 4 charges instead of 12. Batteries will also full charge Void, instead of giving {{dlc|nr}} 3 or {{dlc|r}} 6 charges to Mega Blast.
* {{i|Remote Detonator}}: Absorbing it with Void does not cause bombs to remain on the ground until Void is used, but using Void explodes all player-placed bombs as usual.
* {{i|Sharp Key}}: Using the Void will cause Isaac to shoot a key the next time he will press the fire key. Keys are consumed as normal.
* {{i|Spin to Win}}: A spinning top orbital will spawn every time the Void is used. The orbitals will last until Isaac leaves the room.
* {{i|Breath of Life|nr}}: Using Void with Breath of Life will immediately grant invincibility frames, then inflict damages to Isaac every second until he leaves the room.
* {{i|Urn of Souls}}: Although a sound effect will play, using Void will do nothing.

sections.Effects:
* +1 [[luck]].
* Spawns a [[familiar]] that sporadically moves around the [[Rooms|room]].
* Upon entering a room with a {{R|Secret Room}}/{{R|Super Secret Room}} entrance,  [[Obstacles#Tinted Rocks|tinted rock]], or a rock with a {{R|Crawl Space}} underneath, it will fly towards it.
** If there are multiple secrets, then it will fly from one to the other.
* {{dlc|r}} {{transformation contribution|Beelzebub}}
sections.Notes:
* The familiar will sometimes hover over a pit or a {{g|Poop}}, indicating that an unreachable crawl space has been generated there.
** {{dlc|nr}}Although it might seem intuitive to dig the spot open with {{i|We Need To Go Deeper!}} or {{p|Ehwaz}}, their chance of spawning a crawl space is independent and not guaranteed to work.
* An extra crawl space that is added by {{t|Stud Finder}} won't be identified by the familiar.

sections.Effects:
* Passively grants [[flight]].
* If Isaac's [[speed]] is less than 1.5, passively increases his speed to 1.5.
* Upon use, Isaac charges in the direction the pony is facing, giving [[invulnerability|invincibility]] during the charge and damaging enemies while also creating beams of light.
** {{dlc|nr}} The beams of light are spaced randomly around the room and deal the same damage as those created by {{i|Crack the Sky}}.
** {{dlc|r}} The beams of light deal 4 times Isaac's damage, plus a flat 10 damage and trail behind Isaac as he charges.
** {{dlc|nr}} The dash deals 40 flat contact damage to enemies.
** {{dlc|r}} The dash deals 4 times Isaac's damage, plus a flat 28 damage.
** {{dlc|r}} Isaac can dash through doors, which means that damage from {{r|Curse Room}} doors can be avoided.
*** Although the dash can persist between rooms, the beams of light only occur in the room it is used in.
* While not time-based, invincibility from White Pony is otherwise identical to damage immunity granted by the [[invulnerability]] effect.
sections.Notes:
* White Pony is only obtainable as a boss drop from {{E|Conquest}}, as a starting item for {{c|Eden}}, by using {{I|Spindown Dice}} on {{I|Sacred Heart}}, or by using {{i|Death Certificate}}.
** White Pony cannot be crafted with the {{I|Bag of Crafting}}.
* If White Pony is replaced by another activated [[item]], Isaac will lose any passive benefits that it had granted.
sections.Synergies:
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Creates white pony wisps on the middle ring that fire white tears with a 10% chance to fire {{I|Holy Light}} tears. The beams of light the wisps' tears make deal extra damage to enemies in a small area equal to 3x the wisps' tear damage.}}
* {{I|Mars}}: Using White Pony after dashing lowers the dash cooldown to approximately 1 second.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.
* {{i|Taurus}} / {{i|Thunder Thighs}}: The speed decreases from the items can lower Isaac's speed past 1.50 (making the new lower speed limits 1.20 and 1.10, respectively). Having both items can lower the minimum speed to 0.80.

sections.Effects:
* Grants a {{e|Rotten Heart}} upon use.
** If Isaac has an empty red heart container or empty bone heart, the rotten heart will fill it.
** If Isaac has only filled red and/or bone hearts, it will replace the contents.
** If Isaac has no red or bone hearts, or they all are already rotten, there is no effect.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|r+}} This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|Rotgut}}.{{dlc-}}
* This item can be crafted from {{i|Bag of Crafting}} with six {{e|Red Heart}}s and two {{e|Rotten Heart}}s.
sections.Synergies: * {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Creates green-glowing rotten hearts wisps on the middle ring. They spawn a [[Blue Fly]] when shooting, similar to {{i|Rotten Baby}}. The wisps also create a small green cloud when destroyed, which is purely cosmetic.}}

sections.Effects: * Grants +1.5 [[Damage]] and +0.3 [[Speed]] whenever Isaac has a {{E|Half Red Heart}} or less.
sections.Notes:
* {{c|Eve}} starts with this item by default, and has the following extra effects:
** The item is activated at one full {{E|Red Heart}} or less.
** Her damage multiplier increases from 0.75 to 1.0 when active.
* The effect is removed after leaving a room with more than half a heart (more than one full heart for {{c|Eve}}).
* The effect may not be immediately applied if Isaac has lost red hearts without taking damage; the effect will activate upon entering a new room.
* The effect is always active for characters without {{E|Red Heart}} containers, such as {{c|???}} and {{c|The Lost}}, though other characters can also lose their heart containers through Devil deals or items like {{i|Guppy's Paw}} or {{i|Abaddon}}.
* {{p|III - The Empress}} grants a similar effect to Whore of Babylon for the current room which does stack with Whore of Babylon.
** Stacking ''The Empress'' on Whore of Babylon either via multiple cards or multiple activations of {{i|Blank Card}} increases damage by the number of uses ''squared'', e.g. +1.5 * 2 * 2 total damage bonus for using the card on top of activated Whore of Babylon.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Blood Rights}} / {{i|Razor Blade}} / {{i|IV Bag}} / {{i|Sumptorium}}: As these items takes {{e|Red Heart}}s before other heart types, it can be use to get the Whore of Babylon activation's condition easier.
*{{i|Sharp Plug}} / {{i|Blood Bombs}}: Prioritize removing {{e|Red Heart}}s first although are conditional on having an applicable active item or having zero bombs. 
*{{i|Shard of Glass}}: Will slowly drain Isaac's red hearts upon taking damage, eventually triggering Whore of Babylon, unless Isaac has a {{e|Rotten Heart}} with no soul, black or bone hearts (unless playing as {{c|Eve}}). 
* {{i|Blood Oath}}: Consistently triggers Whore of Babylon at the start of each floor along with giving other bonuses. 
* {{i|Guppy's Paw}} / {{i|Potato Peeler}}: Can be used to remove red health containers to keep Whore of Babylon Active.
**{{i|Magic Skin}} / {{p|VI - The Lovers?}}: Prioritize removing red heart containers with the downside of giving a [[Health#Broken_Hearts|Broken Heart]] with each use 
* {{t|Crow Heart}}: Can be used to remove red hearts while keeping soul and black hearts intact.
*{{c|The Forgotten}}: By quickly switching to {{c|The Soul}}, Whore of Babylon can be triggered for the room if The Forgotten does not meet the trigger conditions.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|Birthright}} + {{C|Eve}}: Whore of Babylon will be active at all times.
* {{c|Keeper|a}} / {{c|Tainted Keeper}}: As Keeper cannot have half of a Coin Heart, this item has no effect on him.
* {{e|Rotten Heart}}s: Counts as a full Red Heart for the purposes of this item, rendering it impossible to activate (except for {{c|Eve}}).
* {{i|Whore of Babylon}}: No further effect when multiple copies are acquired.
* {{i|Placenta}} / {{i|Charm of the Vampire}} / {{i|Leech}} / {{i|Sol}}: Regen effects can make triggering Whore of Babylon difficult if Isaac has empty [[Health#Red_Heart_Containers|Red Heart Container]]s.
**{{t|Isaac's Fork}} / {{t|Mom's Locket}} / {{t|Stem Cell}}: Regen effects from trinkets can be problematic in maintaining Whore of Babylon if swallowed or smelted 
**{{i|Cambion Conception}} / {{p|Soul of Lilith}}: Have a chance of granting Leech, although are likely still worth using for the chance of receiving strong familiars.
*{{i|Dogma}}: Is forcefully given to Isaac after defeating {{e|Dogma}}, which among other effects heals him up to at least 6 hearts by filling [[Health#Red_Heart_Containers|Red Heart Container]]s and giving {{e|Soul Heart}}s. Forcing Isaac out of Whore of Babylon if he has at least 1 [[Health#Red_Heart_Containers|Red Heart Container]] while under 5 hearts (2 Containers while under 4 hearts for {{c|Eve}})
*{{i|Magneto}}: Can make avoiding {{e|Red Heart}} pickups difficult
*{{c|Bethany}} / {{c|Tainted Magdalene}}: Due to their reliance on red hearts makes Whore of Babylon much more difficult to use.

sections.Effects: * Gives Isaac a random [[Signs of the Zodiac|Zodiac item]] effect that changes each floor.
sections.Notes:
* Getting {{i|Capricorn}}, {{i|Cancer}} and {{i|Libra}} does not grant {{e|Penny|text=Coins}}, {{e|Bomb}}s, {{e|Key}}s or {{e|Soul Heart}}s.
* {{dlc|nr}} Getting {{i|Leo}} will not change Isaac's size.
* {{dlc|r}} {{i|Capricorn}} and {{i|Pisces}} grant +1.0 fire rate instead of their usual +0.5.
* If already in possession of the item given by Zodiac, most have no effect.
** The exceptions are {{i|Capricorn}} giving an additional +0.5 damage, and {{i|Gemini}} giving another familiar.
** {{dlc|r}} Capricorn and Pisces will also grant +1.0 fire rate on top of the normal +0.5.

sections.Effects:
* Restores one full {{e|Red Heart}}.
* {{dlc|r}} When playing in co-op, all other players will be healed for a {{e|Half Red Heart}}.
sections.Notes:
* {{c|Magdalene}} / {{c|Tainted Magdalene|r}} starts with this item by default.
** When used as {{c|Tainted Magdalene}} it restores 2 red hearts instead.
* This item can drop from killing {{E|Super Lust}}. {{dlc|nr}} Super Lust can drop this item even if Isaac has already encountered/possessed it. 
** {{dlc+|r}} It can also be spawned by {{e|Bumbino}} if he picks up 12 cents.{{dlc-}}
* {{Dlc|r}} This item can be crafted from {{i|Bag of Crafting|n}} with eight {{e|Red Heart}}s.
sections.Synergies:
* {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Creates Red Heart wisps in the middle ring. Enemies killed by the wisps' tears have a 1/15 chance to drop a full {{e|Red Heart}}.}}
* {{i|Car Battery}}: Doubles the amount Yum Heart heals.
* {{c|Jacob and Esau}}: Heals the character who uses it for a full red heart and the other for half a red heart.
* {{c|Keeper}} / {{c|Tainted Keeper}}: Heals one [[Health#Coin Hearts|Coin Hearts]]; no [[blue fly]] is generated.
* {{dlc|nr}} {{i|Sharp Plug}} + {{i|The Wafer}} / {{i|Cancer}}: Allows infinite Red Heart regeneration.
* {{dlc|rnr+}} {{c|Tainted Magdalene|n}} + {{i|Sharp Plug}}: Allows infinite usage and infinite invincibility frames.
sections.Interactions: * {{i|Maggy's Bow}}: No effect; will still only replenish one full Red Heart.

sections.Effects:
* Gives Isaac a {{E|Nerve Ending}} [[familiar]] that burrows out of the ground to grab enemies for 4 seconds. Grabbed enemies take damage over time, are [[slow|slowed]], and are unable to move.
** Worm Friend deals 4 damage per tick (8 per second), for a total of 32 damage per grab.
** Worm Friend can target and restrain bosses in addition to normal enemies, even including endgame bosses such as {{E|Ultra Greed}}.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|r+}} This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|The Stain}}.{{dlc-}}
* Enemies can avoid/escape being grabbed if they move fast enough, jump, or teleport.
* Worm friend must wait 5 seconds after losing/killing/releasing its target before it can attack another enemy.
* When playing as {{C|Tainted Lazarus}} / {{C|Dead Tainted Lazarus}}, entering a room with Worm Friend active and then using {{I|Flip}} to swap to the other character will keep Worm Friend active for the remainder of the room.
* When grabbing {{e|The Beast}}, the Beast is still able to dive down and appear on the other side, though no animation will be played for either diving down or up. This can be dangerous as there will be no warning of the Beast switching sides.

sections.Effects:
* Grants one Red [[Heart Container]].
* Heals 1 additional {{e|Red Heart}}.
* [[Charm]]s enemies close to Isaac. The effect wears off quickly after enemies move away from Isaac.
sections.Interactions: * {{i|2Spooky}}: Overridden by Venus.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns an additional {{R|Curse Room}} on each floor, if possible.
** Doesn't work on the [[Ascent]].
* Curse rooms have improved layouts and rewards while Voodoo Head is held.
* A [[Coins|coin]] is guaranteed to spawn in Curse Rooms.
sections.Notes:
* Has no effect in [[Greed Mode]].
* The singular coin generated by the item in curse rooms cannot be a special coin (nickel, dime, lucky, etc).
* Does not retroactively upgrade the current floor's curse room when picked up, if one exists. Its layout won't be improved and there is no guaranteed coin.
* This item is beneficial for {{C|The Lost}} due to the chance of obtaining {{I|Dead Cat}} or {{I|Guppy's Collar}} in curse rooms. However, use caution as the run can easily end from being hit while fighting any enemies inside. A teleport card, such as {{P|0 - The Fool}}, would be advised to prevent such situations.
* This item is also very beneficial for {{C|Tainted Judas}} or {{C|Tainted Forgotten}}, as they can enter and leave curse rooms for free.
* The coin that spawns, while minimal for most characters, is considerably useful for {{C|Keeper}}  and {{C|Tainted Keeper}}, letting them partially heal from the curse room door's donation and letting Tainted Keeper leave even if there are no enemies to get coins from.
* This item causes the level generation to increase the minimum number of dead ends on each floor by 1, increasing the likelihood of curse rooms spawning.
** The level generation does not guarantee an additional curse room can be placed; there is limited space for special rooms, and other types may take priority over it.
*** If a curse room doesn't spawn, it's possible Voodoo Head still increased the dead end count, giving you an extra special room.
sections.Synergies: * {{T|Cursed Penny}}: The coin can be used to teleport out of the curse room and avoid the damage from exiting through the curse room’s door.

sections.Effects: * Opens {{R|Secret Room}}s and {{R|Super Secret Room}}s automatically.
sections.Notes: * {{dlc+|a+nr}} When in {{s|The Void}}, the entrances are not automatically opened if the room is not yet cleared. Re-entering the room once enemies are killed and/or {{g|Pressure Plate}}s pressed will open the doors normally.{{dlc-}}
